target: arch (the installer is Arch-only; the companion Hyprland-Dots are multi-distro and are also consumed by the separate, now-archived JaKooLit/NixOS-Hyprland flake)
one_line: A very popular "kitchen-sink" Hyprland setup. A whiptail bash installer for Arch clones Hyprland-Dots, which uses wallust to theme waybar (about 46 layouts and 60 styles), rofi (20+ themes), swaync, hyprlock, kitty, ghostty, cava and a Quickshell overview from the wallpaper, plus a huge rofi-driven script library. It has lots of features and is friendly to beginners, but the look is inconsistent and the codebase is bloated. It is being handed over to the LinuxBeginnings org in 2026.
freshness: Hyprland-Dots is at DOTS_VERSION 2.3.20 (set in config/hypr/configs/ENVariables.conf), a bugfix release after 2.3.19. The newest dated CHANGELOG entry is 2026-01-20. The configs target Hyprland 0.53+: the new `windowrule = match:...` syntax is the default, the pre-0.53 rules are kept in WindowRules-pre-53.conf, and gestures use the new `gesture = 3, horizontal, workspace` syntax. The newest heading in Arch-Hyprland CHANGELOGS.md is "Dec 2025" (qt5-quickcontrols2 for SDDM, AGS v1 rebuilt from a fork, rofi-wayland replaced by rofi). Both READMEs say: "Beginning of March 2026, This project will be archived and it will be maintained by Dwilliams" (moving to github.com/LinuxBeginnings). A WebFetch of the Arch-Hyprland page showed no archived banner yet, with 4.6k stars, 363 forks and GPL-3.0. LinuxBeginnings/Hyprland-Dots exists and is active (about 3,202 commits, 222 stars, per WebFetch). The JaKooLit/NixOS-Hyprland README already says "This repository has been ARCHIVED". I did not check exact last-commit timestamps because I used the API only for the two tree calls.

aesthetic.palette: There is no single fixed scheme. Colors come from wallust, generated from each wallpaper (palette = "dark16", or "light16" in light mode; backend kmeans; color_space labmixed; threshold 11). The committed sample config/hypr/wallust/wallust-hyprland.conf is a dark purple set: $background rgb(010102), $foreground rgb(FDF8FE), $color4 5E3887, $color5 7344A6, $color10 2D1D5F (inactive border), $color12 7D4AB4 (active border and shadow), $color13 9A5BDD, $color14 F8EAFC. Sample colors-waybar.css: bg #151316, fg #F9E3DF, color12 #7F4EA2, color13 #A0536C, color14 #EDAEA4. Sample rofi colors: bg #181519, fg #FAE8E1, accents #784CA0 and #CC659A. Hardcoded palettes are mixed in throughout. The default waybar style '[Colored] Translucent' uses Tokyo Night accents #ff7a93 #b9f27c #ff9e64 #bb9af7 #7da6ff #0db9d7 with bgcolor #222436 and Catppuccin tooltip colors #1e1e2e/#11111b. swaync hardcodes Tokyo Night #f7768e (close button) and #7aa2f7 (DND switch). '[Extra] Simple Pink' uses #ba5663, #19141b, #c42a60 and CSS 'pink'. '[Wallust] Chroma Tally' uses Ayu gradient buttons #95E6CB→#59C2FF→#D2A6FF plus Nord module colors (#a3be8c, #ebcb8b, #bf616a). The Quickshell overview Appearance.qml has Material 3 defaults: primary #E5B6F2, onPrimary #452152, primaryContainer #5D386A, background/surface #161217, surfaceContainer #231E23, outline #988E97. Qt/Kvantum use Catppuccin Latte/Mocha blue, btop ships all four Catppuccin themes, and the README badges use Catppuccin #cba6f7/#b4befe.
aesthetic.color_pipeline: wallust 3 (config/wallust/wallust.toml) renders templates to 7 active targets: hypr (~/.config/hypr/wallust/wallust-hyprland.conf as $colorN = rgb(..)), waybar (@define-color), rofi (.rasi), kitty (kitty-themes/01-Wallust.conf), ghostty (wallust.conf), quickshell (qml_color.json) and cava. swaync, macchina, wezterm and zathura targets are commented out. On wallpaper change, WallpaperSelect.sh runs `swww img`, then WallustSwww.sh, which runs `wallust run -s `, waits until the target files are newer than the start timestamp, symlinks the wallpaper for rofi, copies it to wallpaper_effects/.wallpaper_current for hyprlock, sends SIGUSR2 to ghostty and reloads waybar. A second path is ThemeChanger.sh (SUPER+T): `wallust theme list | rofi -dmenu`, then `wallust theme `, a two-phase wait (freshness, then size/mtime stability), `hyprctl reload`, kitty SIGUSR1, ghostty SIGUSR2. DarkLight.sh sed-edits the palette line in wallust.toml (dark16/light16), swaps the qt5ct/qt6ct Catppuccin Mocha/Latte color files, re-links waybar/style.css to a random [Dark]/[Light] style and sed-edits the swaync noti-bg rgba. swaync, wlogout and the wallust waybar styles import colors through the relative path '../../.config/waybar/wallust/colors-waybar.css'.
aesthetic.fonts: The font list comes from the Arch installer's fonts.sh: adobe-source-code-pro-fonts, noto-fonts, noto-fonts-emoji, otf-font-awesome, ttf-droid, ttf-fira-code, ttf-fantasque-nerd, ttf-jetbrains-mono, ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd, ttf-victor-mono. Waybar uses "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font" bold at font-size 97% with font-feature-settings '"zero","ss01".."ss05","cv31"'. Rofi uses "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font SemiBold 15" (13 for elements), set in 0-shared-fonts.rasi. Kitty uses "FantasqueSansM Nerd Font Mono Bold" 16; Ghostty uses FantasqueSansM Nerd Font Mono 12 with adjust-cell-height 10%. Hyprlock uses a 173pt clock in "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font ExtraBold", a 64pt date in "Victor Mono Bold Italic", and "Victor Mono Bold Oblique" for other labels. GTK (assets/gtk-3.0/settings.ini) uses "Fira Code Semi-Bold 14". swaync uses "JetBrains Mono Nerd Font" bold 1rem. The Quickshell overview falls back to plain sans-serif.
aesthetic.icons_cursor_gtk_qt: The GTK theme is Andromeda-dark with Flat-Remix-Blue-Dark icons and the Bibata-Modern-Ice cursor at size 24. They come from the JaKooLit/GTK-themes-icons repo, which is zip-extracted into ~/.themes and ~/.icons (gtk-engine-murrine is also installed). The hyprcursor env (HYPRCURSOR_THEME Bibata-Modern-Ice) is commented out, but cursor { enable_hyprcursor = true; sync_gsettings_theme = true }. Qt uses QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME qt5ct/qt6ct (set twice, so qt6ct wins), Kvantum themes catppuccin-latte-blue and catppuccin-mocha-blue, qt5ct/qt6ct Catppuccin-Latte and Mocha color files, and QT_QUICK_CONTROLS_STYLE=org.hyprland.style. nwg-look is used to manage GTK settings. wlogout uses custom PNG icons with hover variants.
aesthetic.geometry: Hyprland (UserDecorations.conf): border_size 2, gaps_in 2, gaps_out 4, rounding 10, active_opacity 1.0, inactive_opacity 0.9, dim_inactive true with dim_strength 0.1 and dim_special 0.8, shadow range 3 and render_power 1 colored $color12 (inactive $color10), blur size 6 passes 3 with new_optimizations, xray true, ignore_opacity, special and popups. Borders are col.active_border $color12 and col.inactive_border $color10, which is solid, not a gradient; an optional RainbowBorders script offers wallust-random, rainbow or gradient_flow modes. Per-tag opacity window rules: terminal 0.9/0.7, settings 0.8/0.7, browser 0.99/0.8, im 0.94/0.86, file-manager 0.9/0.8, viewer 0.82/0.75. Dwindle special_scale_factor 0.8. Waybar (Translucent): bg rgba(0,0,0,0.3), border-radius 10px, margin-top 3, left/right 8, spacing 3; workspace buttons radius 9px. Rofi KooL_style-4: width 35%, window radius 10px, inputbar/elements radius 8px, mainbox padding 20px, listview border 2px. swaync: radius 10px, 2px border @color12, bg rgba(0,0,0,0.8), notification width 300, control center 450x720 top-center, mpris art 96px radius 8. wlogout: buttons radius 80px, window bg rgba(30,30,46,0.8), icon grows from 20% to 50% on hover. Kitty: background_opacity 0.9, window_padding_width 4, cursor_trail 1. Ghostty: background-blur-radius 60. Hyprlock: blur_size 3, passes 2, noise 0.0117, contrast 1.3, brightness 0.8, vibrancy 0.21; input field 306x93 with outline 2 and inner rgba(255,255,255,0.1). Quickshell rounding scale: 8, 12, 17, 23, window 18.
aesthetic.animations: Default (UserAnimations.conf) beziers: wind 0.05,0.9,0.1,1.05; winIn 0.1,1.1,0.1,1.1; winOut 0.3,-0.3,0,1; liner 1,1,1,1; overshot 0.05,0.9,0.1,1.05; smoothOut 0.5,0,0.99,0.99; smoothIn 0.5,-0.5,0.68,1.5. Default animations: windows 6 wind slide, windowsIn 5 winIn slide, windowsOut 3 smoothOut slide, windowsMove 5 wind slide, border 1 liner, borderangle 180 liner loop, fade 3 smoothOut, workspaces 5 overshot, workspacesIn 5 winIn slide, workspacesOut 5 winOut slide. There are 17 switchable presets in config/hypr/animations/, picked through rofi with SUPER SHIFT A: 00-default, 01-default v2, Disable, END-4, HYDE Vertical/default/minimal-1/minimal-2/optimized, ML4W classic/dynamic/fast/high/moving/standard, Mahaveer me-1/me-2. The END-4 preset uses md3_decel 0.05,0.7,0.1,1, md3_accel 0.3,0,0.8,0.15, menu_decel 0.1,1,0,1 and menu_accel 0.38,0.04,1,0.07, with windows popin 60%, layersIn slide and specialWorkspace slidevert. swww wallpaper transition: bezier .43,1.19,1,.4, 60 fps, duration 2, type any; dark/light switching uses type grow from --transition-pos 0.925,0.977. Waybar and wlogout CSS transitions use the springy cubic-bezier(.55,-0.68,.48,1.682).
aesthetic.wallpapers: A small wallpapers/ folder is copied to $(xdg-user-dir PICTURES)/wallpapers. copy.sh offers an optional ~1GB clone of JaKooLit/Wallpaper-Bank and itself warns: "A number of these wallpapers are AI generated or enhanced". Dynamic-Wallpapers/Dark and Light subfolders feed DarkLight.sh. Video wallpapers work through mpvpaper, which WallpaperSelect.sh enables by sed-editing Startup_Apps.conf. GIF and video thumbnails are cached with magick and ffmpeg for the rofi grid picker. WallpaperEffects.sh applies imagemagick effects and writes .wallpaper_modified, which hyprlock can use. WallpaperAutoChange.sh can rotate wallpapers every 30 minutes. The SDDM background is assets/sddm.png, or can be synced to the current wallpaper from Quick Settings. I did not verify provenance or licenses for the bundled images.
aesthetic.vibe: Maximalist and aimed at beginners, not a single curated look. The default render is a dark, wallpaper-tinted purple setup: thin 2px borders, 10px rounding, tight 2/4 gaps, heavy blur, and a translucent black waybar with Tokyo-Night-colored text. It is polished in the sense of doing a lot (animated wallpaper transitions, lockscreen matched to the wallpaper, pop-in animations), but it is not "cute" out of the box. The pastel or cute options (Simple Pink, Catppuccin Latte, Aurora Blossom, light16 mode) exist but have to be picked. Visual coherence is weak: swaync hardcodes Tokyo Night, waybar styles hardcode Nord, Ayu, Catppuccin or Tokyo Night, and all of that sits alongside wallust colors, so components often disagree. Best treated as a catalogue of options and scripts to cherry-pick from, not as an aesthetic to copy wholesale.

components.compositor: Hyprland. It is installed from the Arch repo along with hypridle and hyprlock, plus an assets/hyprland-install script for switching between hyprland and hyprland-git. The config is modular: hyprland.conf sources configs/*.conf (vendor defaults) and then UserConfigs/*.conf (user overrides), plus monitors.conf and workspaces.conf from nwg-displays. Window rules use the 0.53+ syntax. The dwindle layout is the default, with a toggle to master. Polkit is hyprpolkitagent (a NixOS-specific Polkit script is also provided), and xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland is optional.
components.bar_or_shell: Waybar is the bar. Its config uses "include" to pull in shared module files (Modules, ModulesCustom, ModulesGroups, ModulesWorkspaces, UserModules). There are about 46 layouts in waybar/configs (TOP/BOT/LEFT/RIGHT/SummitSplit/glass variants) and about 60 styles in waybar/style ([Catppuccin], [Wallust], [Dark]/[Light], ML4W Glass, and others). SUPER CTRL B and SUPER ALT B switch style and layout by re-symlinking style.css and config. The default TOP layout has a cava visualizer, playerctl, a drawer grouping app/notify/mobo/audio/status, a weather module (Weather.py), a nightlight module and a HINT button. Quickshell (`qs -c overview`) provides only the SUPER+A desktop overview, using Material 3 tokens; AGS v1 is the fallback overview via OverviewToggle.sh.
components.launcher: rofi, the Arch 'rofi' package that now includes Wayland support. 22 themes live in rofi/themes (KooL_style-1 to 15 variants, Win11 list dark/light, fullscreen, adi1090x-derived); the default is KooL_style-4, with a vertical mode switcher and a wallust color import. rofi also drives the wallpaper grid picker, emoji menu, calculator (qalculate), cliphist clipboard, searchable keybinds, web search, RofiBeats online music, and the rofi/kitty/zsh/animation/waybar theme selectors.
components.notifications: swaync, positioned top-center on the overlay layer, with a 6s timeout (3s low, 0 critical). The control center has DND, a buttons-grid (wlogout, lock, exit, airplane mode, mute, blueman), mpris, volume and backlight widgets. Styles are wallust colors mixed with hardcoded Tokyo Night hex. dunst and mako are uninstalled by the installer.
components.lock_idle_logout: hyprlock in 2k and 1080p variants, chosen by a resolution prompt in copy.sh. It sources wallust colors and blurs the current wallpaper, and shows a big AM/PM clock, date, $USER, keyboard layout, uptime, battery and cached weather labels, with Victor Mono italics. hypridle sends a "You are idle!" notification at 540s and locks at 600s through loginctl lock-session; dpms-off and suspend listeners are commented out. wlogout uses a custom PNG icon set with wallust CSS. hyprsunset handles night light (SUPER+N).
components.wallpaper_tool: swww (swww-daemon --format xrgb) for images; the changelog says swww was bumped to v0.11.2, that "SWWW isn't being maintained" and that it will move to awww later. mpvpaper handles video wallpapers. wallust is hooked in after every wallpaper change.
components.terminal: kitty is the default, with about 170 bundled kitty-themes including 00-Default and 01-Wallust, cursor_trail 1 and opacity 0.9. A drop-down kitty is bound to SUPER SHIFT Return (Dropterminal.sh). Ghostty and WezTerm configs are shipped but not installed; ghostty loads optional theme.conf and wallust.conf files and gets SIGUSR2 to reload live.
components.shell_prompt: zsh with oh-my-zsh and the external agnosterzak theme by default. Six more themes (antares, bullet-train, comfyline, emoji, fishbone++, color-input) can be switched with SUPER SHIFT O. pokemon-colorscripts is optional. The changelog notes a switch from eza to lsd. There is no starship. The NixOS variant's Home Manager adds eza, fzf, bat and yazi.
components.editor: None configured. nano and mousepad are installed, and the stale nvim config was removed in v2.3.20. The NixOS variant uses nixvim.
components.file_manager: Thunar is optional (thunar.sh plus thunar_default.sh), with custom actions in assets/Thunar/uca.xml and accels.scm and an xfce4 helpers.rc. gvfs and gvfs-mtp are installed.
components.fetch: fastfetch with four configs: config.jsonc, config-compact.jsonc, config-v2.jsonc and config-pokemon.jsonc (plus an arch.png logo in the installer assets).
components.login_boot: SDDM with the simple_sddm_2 theme, JaKooLit's fork of Keyitdev/sddm-astronaut-theme. The installer sets Current= and InputMethod=qtvirtualkeyboard in /etc/sddm.conf through sudo sed and installs qt6-declarative, qt6-svg, qt6-virtualkeyboard, qt6-multimedia-ffmpeg and qt5-quickcontrols2. Other display managers (gdm, lightdm, lxdm) are disabled. The SDDM wallpaper can be synced to the current wallpaper (sddm_wallpaper.sh, validated against wallust rofi colors). There is no GRUB or Plymouth theming in Arch-Hyprland. NixOS-Hyprland uses the ly greeter with a matrix animation.
components.extras: cava with GLSL shaders (bar_spectrum, normalized_bars, northern_lights) and wallust colors. btop with the Catppuccin themes. swappy, grim and slurp for screenshots (now, area, 5s/10s delay, active window). cliphist storing text and images. Kvantum and qt5ct/qt6ct. nwg-look and nwg-displays. yad cheat sheet (SUPER+H). Searchable keybind menu from a python parser of bindd descriptions (SUPER SHIFT K). Quick Settings menu (SUPER SHIFT E). GameMode toggle that turns off animations, blur and gaps. Blur toggle, opacity toggle and master/dwindle toggle. Desktop magnifier through cursor:zoom_factor on SUPER+ALT+scroll and a 4-finger gesture. Per-window keyboard layout switching. RofiBeats online radio. Battery, disk and temperature monitor systemd user services. Asus ROG support. The NixOS variant's Home Manager adds bottom and yazi.

standout_features: Two-layer config design: config/hypr/configs/*.conf holds vendor defaults that updates overwrite, and config/hypr/UserConfigs/*.conf holds user overrides that are sourced afterwards and preserved on update. Waybar mirrors this with Modules/ and UserModules/ plus the "include" key.

Tag-based window rules in the new Hyprland 0.53 syntax. Apps are grouped once (`windowrule = match:class ^(...)$, tag +browser`) and styled per tag (`match:tag terminal, opacity 0.9 0.7`; `match:tag settings, float on, center on`; size (monitor_w*0.7) (monitor_h*0.7)). The old syntax is kept in WindowRules-pre-53.conf.

Global Theme Changer (SUPER+T, contributed by TheAhumMaitra): `wallust theme list | rofi -dmenu` applies a named built-in palette to every templated app. It uses a robust two-phase wait (files newer than the start timestamp, then size and mtime stable), then runs hyprctl reload and signals kitty (SIGUSR1), ghostty (SIGUSR2) and waybar.

Rofi wallpaper grid picker (SUPER+W). It shows 6x2 thumbnails with the icon size computed from monitor height and scale, caches GIF first frames through magick and video thumbnails through ffmpeg, and includes a '. random' entry. Selecting an image switches to swww; selecting a video switches to mpvpaper and persists the choice.

Dark/Light toggle. It swaps the wallust palette between dark16 and light16, the wallpaper folder, the Qt Catppuccin Mocha/Latte color files, the waybar style (a random [Dark] or [Light] one) and the swaync background, using a swww 'grow' transition that starts from the waybar button position (0.925,0.977).

Animation preset library: 17 files covering END-4 Material 3 curves, HyDE, ML4W and others, switchable at runtime from rofi (SUPER SHIFT A). Waybar also has a style/layout switcher and rofi a theme switcher.

Self-documenting keybinds. Every bind uses `bindd` with a description, and a python keybind parser feeds a searchable rofi cheat sheet (SUPER SHIFT K) plus a yad hint sheet (SUPER+H) that is also reachable from a waybar HINT button.
Quickshell desktop overview (SUPER+A or a 3-finger swipe up) using Material 3 color tokens, with automatic fallback to AGS v1.
Rainbow border modes (Disabled / Wallust Color / Rainbow / Gradient flow) built on `animation = borderangle, 1, 180, liner, loop`, toggled from Quick Settings.

Hardware-aware copy.sh (scripts/lib_detect.sh). It uses lspci and hostnamectl to detect Nvidia (uncommenting LIBVA/GLX/NVD env vars and setting no_hardware_cursors=1), VMs (software renderer and a Virtual-1 monitor) and NixOS (swapping in a NixOS polkit script), and it picks a desktop or laptop waybar based on chassis type.
Gesture set in the new syntax: 3-finger horizontal for workspaces, 4-finger up/down to zoom the cursor by 1.5x, 3-finger up to open the overview.

Installer UX: a whiptail checklist, a `--preset` file for unattended installs, per-component scripts that can be re-run from the repo root, timestamped Install-Logs, uninstall.sh, and `copy.sh --express-update` that trims old backups.
structure_install: Arch-Hyprland is only the installer. auto-install.sh is run as `sh <(curl -L .../auto-install.sh)`, or you clone the repo and run ./install.sh. install.sh installs whiptail and shows a checklist (nvidia, nouveau, input_group, sddm, sddm_theme, gtk_themes, bluetooth, thunar, quickshell, xdph, zsh, pokemon, rog, dots). It supports `--preset <file>` and runs install-scripts/*.sh in order: 00-base, pacman, paru or yay, 01-hypr-pkgs (uninstalls dunst, mako, rofi, wallust-git and AGS, then installs cliphist, grim, slurp, swappy, swaync, swww, wallust, waybar, wlogout, kitty, kvantum, qt5ct, qt6ct, rofi, yad, hyprpolkitagent and more, plus btop, cava, loupe, fastfetch, mpv, nwg-look, nwg-displays, qalculate-gtk and yt-dlp), pipewire, fonts, hyprland (hyprland, hypridle, hyprlock), then the optional scripts, then 02-Final-Check. Choosing 'dots' runs dotfiles-main.sh, which runs `git clone --depth=1 JaKooLit/Hyprland-Dots` and then ./copy.sh. copy.sh is modular (scripts/lib_backup, lib_detect, lib_prompts, lib_apps, lib_copy, lib_update, copy_menu). It backs up existing ~/.config directories, applies Nvidia/VM/NixOS tweaks, asks for keyboard layout, resolution (<1440p or >=1440p, swapping hyprlock and other files), clock format and animations, copies config/* to ~/.config, copies wallpapers to ~/Pictures/wallpapers, optionally clones the 1GB Wallpaper-Bank, and links the waybar config/style. Updates use `copy.sh --express-update`, and the release is recorded in env DOTS_VERSION. The Hyprland-Dots tree covers: config/{hypr (hyprland.conf, configs/, UserConfigs/, UserScripts/, scripts/ with ~55 scripts, animations/, wallust/, hyprlock*.conf, hypridle.conf, Monitor_Profiles/), waybar, rofi, swaync, wlogout, wallust, kitty, ghostty, wezterm, cava, btop, fastfetch, quickshell, ags, Kvantum, qt5ct, qt6ct, swappy}, i18n READMEs, and archive/release.sh and upgrade.sh.
nix_patterns: Neither of these repos contains Nix. NixOS support lives in the separate JaKooLit/NixOS-Hyprland, whose README now says it is ARCHIVED and moved to LinuxBeginnings/NixOS-Hyprland.

The NixOS-Hyprland flake.nix pins nixos-unstable plus home-manager master (follows nixpkgs), nixvim, alejandra, ags pinned to ref v1, catppuccin/nix (nixosModules.catppuccin) and quickshell from git.outfoxxed.me. It defines a local pkgs/waybar-weather.nix package.

One nixosConfigurations host with hardcoded values: host = "jak-hl", username = "dwilliams", system = "x86_64-linux". Modules are listed flat: hosts/${host}/config.nix plus modules/{overlays,quickshell,packages,fonts,portals,theme,ly,nh}.nix, and it sets `nixpkgs.config.allowBroken = true` as a CUDA workaround.

Home Manager runs as a NixOS module (useGlobalPkgs = true) but manages only a few programs: nixvim, ghostty, bat, bottom, btop, eza, fzf, git, yazi. The Hyprland dotfiles are still copied imperatively by copy.sh. The README admits "This is not purely written in Nix-Language" and points to ZaneyOS instead.

Hyprland-Dots carries NixOS workarounds: scripts/Polkit-NixOS.sh, scripts/UptimeNixOS.sh (called from hyprlock as the fallback to `uptime -p`), and detect_nixos_adjust in lib_detect.sh, which checks `hostnamectl | grep 'Operating System: NixOS'`.

Porting lesson: the scripts sed-edit their own config files at runtime (wallust.toml, Startup_Apps.conf, swaync style.css, waybar symlinks), which breaks when Home Manager links configs read-only from the Nix store. On NixOS, keep wallust or matugen outputs in writable ~/.cache or ~/.config/*/generated files that the HM-managed configs import or source.

key_snippets.purpose: Core window geometry, blur and shadow, driven by wallust color variables
key_snippets.excerpt:
source = $HOME/.config/hypr/wallust/wallust-hyprland.conf

general {
  border_size = 2
  gaps_in = 2
  gaps_out = 4
  col.active_border = $color12
  col.inactive_border = $color10
}

decoration {
  rounding = 10
  active_opacity = 1.0
  inactive_opacity = 0.9
  fullscreen_opacity = 1.0
  dim_inactive = true
  dim_strength = 0.1
  dim_special = 0.8
  shadow {
    enabled = true
    range = 3
    render_power = 1
    color =  $color12
    color_inactive = $color10
  }
  blur {
    enabled = true
    size = 6
    passes = 3
    new_optimizations = true
    xray = true
    ignore_opacity = true
    special = true
    popups = true
  }
}

key_snippets.purpose: Default bezier curves and animation timings
key_snippets.excerpt:
animations {
  enabled = yes
  bezier = wind, 0.05, 0.9, 0.1, 1.05
  bezier = winIn, 0.1, 1.1, 0.1, 1.1
  bezier = winOut, 0.3, -0.3, 0, 1
  bezier = liner, 1, 1, 1, 1
  bezier = overshot, 0.05, 0.9, 0.1, 1.05
  bezier = smoothOut, 0.5, 0, 0.99, 0.99
  bezier = smoothIn, 0.5, -0.5, 0.68, 1.5
  animation = windows, 1, 6, wind, slide
  animation = windowsIn, 1, 5, winIn, slide
  animation = windowsOut, 1, 3, smoothOut, slide
  animation = windowsMove, 1, 5, wind, slide
  animation = border, 1, 1, liner
  animation = borderangle, 1, 180, liner, loop #used by rainbow borders and rotating colors
  animation = fade, 1, 3, smoothOut
  animation = workspaces, 1, 5, overshot
  animation = workspacesIn, 1, 5, winIn, slide
  animation = workspacesOut, 1, 5, winOut, slide
}

key_snippets.purpose: Wallpaper-to-palette fan-out across all themed apps
key_snippets.excerpt:
backend = "kmeans"
color_space = "labmixed"
palette = "dark16"
threshold = 11

[templates]
cava.template = 'colors-cava'
cava.target = '~/.config/cava/config'
hypr.template = 'colors-hyprland.conf'
hypr.target = '~/.config/hypr/wallust/wallust-hyprland.conf'
rofi.template = 'colors-rofi.rasi'

key_snippets.purpose: Tag-based window rules in the Hyprland >=0.53 syntax
key_snippets.excerpt:
windowrule = match:class ^([Ff]irefox|org.mozilla.firefox|[Ff]irefox-esr|[Ff]irefox-bin)$, tag +browser
windowrule = match:class ^(zen-alpha|zen)$, tag +browser
windowrule = match:class ^(Alacritty|kitty|kitty-dropterm)$, tag +terminal
windowrule = match:class ^(pavucontrol|org.pulseaudio.pavucontrol|com.saivert.pwvucontrol)$, tag +settings

windowrule = match:tag multimedia_video, no_blur on
windowrule = match:tag settings, float on, center on
windowrule = match:title ^(Save As)$, float on, size (monitor_w*0.7) (monitor_h*0.6), center on

# OPACITY
windowrule = match:tag browser, opacity 0.99 0.8
windowrule = match:tag terminal, opacity 0.9 0.7
windowrule = match:tag settings, opacity 0.8 0.7

# windowrule to avoid idle for fullscreen apps
windowrule = match:fullscreen true, idle_inhibit fullscreen
windowrule = idle_inhibit fullscreen, match:class ^(*)$

key_snippets.purpose: swww transition parameters and the wallust refresh hook
key_snippets.excerpt:
FPS=60
TYPE="any"
DURATION=2
BEZIER=".43,1.19,1,.4"
SWWW_PARAMS="--transition-fps $FPS --transition-type $TYPE --transition-duration $DURATION --transition-bezier $BEZIER"
...
icon_size=$(echo "scale=1; ($monitor_height * 3) / ($scale_factor * 150)" | bc)
adjusted_icon_size=$(echo "$icon_size" | awk '{if ($1 < 15) $1 = 20; if ($1 > 25) $1 = 25; print $1}')
rofi_override="element-icon{size:${adjusted_icon_size}%;}"
...
apply_image_wallpaper() {
  local image_path="$1"
  kill_wallpaper_for_image
  if ! pgrep -x "swww-daemon" >/dev/null; then
    swww-daemon --format xrgb &
  fi
  swww img -o "$focused_monitor" "$image_path" $SWWW_PARAMS
  "$SCRIPTSDIR/WallustSwww.sh" "$image_path"
  sleep 2
  "$SCRIPTSDIR/Refresh.sh"
}

weaknesses: Symlinks with a hardcoded home path are committed to the repo. config/waybar/style.css resolves to the literal text "/home/ja/.config/waybar/style/[Colored] Translucent.css" and config/waybar/config to "/home/ja/.config/waybar/configs/[TOP] Simple". The raw repo is therefore broken for any other user until copy.sh re-links them.

CSS colors are imported through the fragile relative path `@import '../../.config/waybar/wallust/colors-waybar.css'` in swaync/style.css, wlogout/style.css and the [Wallust] waybar styles, instead of an absolute or generated path.

The palette is incoherent despite the wallust pipeline. swaync hardcodes Tokyo Night #f7768e/#7aa2f7, the default waybar style hardcodes Tokyo Night accents with Catppuccin tooltips, Chroma Tally hardcodes Ayu and Nord, and the qml_color.json template mixes hardcoded hex with {{color7}}, including invalid "#{{color7}}" (double #).

Small CSS and config bugs. `background: rgba (0, 0, 0, 0.5);` in [Wallust] Chroma Tally.css is invalid CSS because of the space. `@define-color bgcolor` is defined twice in Translucent.css. `animation: gradient_f` is referenced without keyframes. ENVariables.conf sets QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME to qt5ct and then qt6ct, so the last one wins. WindowRules has meaningless `idle_inhibit fullscreen, match:class ^(*)$` and `match:title ^(*)$` rules with an invalid regex.

Runtime self-mutation. DarkLight.sh sed-edits wallust.toml and swaync style.css, WallpaperSelect.sh sed-edits UserConfigs/Startup_Apps.conf to switch between swww and mpvpaper, and the waybar and rofi selectors re-symlink files. This is not declarative and breaks on NixOS or Home Manager read-only configs.
Heavy use of sleep-based races in Refresh.sh and WallpaperSelect.sh (sleep 0.1, 0.3, 1, 2). Refresh.sh kills and restarts waybar and swaync on every theme change instead of hot-reloading.

Bloat and upkeep burden: about 170 kitty themes, about 60 waybar styles, and about 46 waybar layouts including committed '(old v1..v5)' copies, 22 rofi themes, 17 animation presets, and both AGS and Quickshell overviews. It is hard to curate and unclear which combinations are tested.

Legacy dependencies. AGS v1 is deprecated upstream and is built from a JaKooLit fork with PAM stubbed out. swww is described in the project's own changelog as unmaintained, with a planned move to awww. Some README advice is stale: it references 00-hypr-pkgs.sh while the file is 01-hypr-pkgs.sh, and it gives rofi-wayland advice although the changelog says it switched to 'rofi'.
Tuned for 1440p. copy.sh handles smaller screens by swapping whole files (hyprlock-1080p.conf) based on a prompt instead of scaling values.

Installer is heavy-handed: curl-to-sh auto-install, silent uninstall of dunst, mako, rofi and AGS, sudo sed on /etc/sddm.conf, GTK themes and icons unpacked from a third-party zip repo into ~/.themes instead of packages, and nvidia-dkms by default for Nvidia.

Wallpapers: the optional 1GB Wallpaper-Bank contains, by the author's own warning, AI-generated or enhanced images, and I could not verify provenance or licenses for the bundled images. Credited third-party material (adi1090x rofi themes, ML4W, HyDE, END-4 animations, sddm-astronaut fork) has licenses I did not verify.

Maintenance handover: both READMEs announce archival from March 2026 with maintenance moving to LinuxBeginnings, and NixOS-Hyprland is already archived with the hardcoded username "dwilliams" and host "jak-hl" in its flake.
steal_list: Split vendor and user config: hypr/configs/*.conf as generated defaults, then hypr/UserConfigs/*.conf sourced afterwards as mutable user overrides. On NixOS, generate the vendor half with Home Manager and leave the user files writable.

Adopt tag-based window rules in the 0.53 syntax (`windowrule = match:class ..., tag +terminal` and then `match:tag terminal, opacity 0.9 0.7`) so per-category opacity, float and size stay in one place.

Build a one-pass palette fan-out with wallust or matugen covering hypr, waybar or quickshell, rofi, kitty, ghostty, cava and swaync. Copy ThemeChanger.sh's reload discipline: wait until the outputs are newer than the start timestamp and stable in size and mtime, then `hyprctl reload`, kitty SIGUSR1, ghostty SIGUSR2 and `waybar-msg cmd reload`. Put the generated files in a writable path that the Nix-managed configs import.

Offer a 'named palette' picker (the `wallust theme list | rofi` pattern) next to wallpaper-derived colors, so the user can force a curated pastel scheme (Catppuccin Latte/Mocha, Rose Pine) regardless of the wallpaper.

Copy the rofi wallpaper grid picker: thumbnail icon size computed from monitor height and scale, cached GIF and video thumbnails, a random entry, and a swww/awww transition with bezier .43,1.19,1,.4 at 60 fps over 2s. Use a 'grow' transition from the bar button position for dark/light switches.

Keep the lockscreen matched to the wallpaper: copy the current wallpaper to a stable path, blur it in hyprlock (blur 3x2, contrast 1.3, brightness 0.8, vibrancy 0.21), color the labels from the palette file, and use an italic display font (Victor Mono Bold Italic) for the date for an elegant, cute look.

Ship a small curated animation preset folder (for example a springy default and END-4's md3_decel 0.05,0.7,0.1,1 with popin 60%, plus a 'performance' preset) with a rofi switcher, instead of one hardcoded animation block.
Use `bindd` descriptions everywhere and generate a searchable rofi keybind cheat sheet from `hyprctl binds -j`, which avoids a custom parser.
Use the Quickshell overview (Material 3 tokens, rounding scale 8/12/17/23) as the SUPER+A exposé, preferably as part of a unified Quickshell shell instead of a bolt-on next to waybar.

Borrow small quality-of-life settings: misc anr_missed_pings = 15, allow_session_lock_restore = true, cursor no_hardware_cursors = 2 with automatic 1 on Nvidia or VMs, 3-finger workspace swipe with the new `gesture =` syntax, and a 4-finger or SUPER+ALT+scroll cursor:zoom_factor magnifier.

Include a GameMode toggle that disables animations, blur, gaps and rounding in one keypress, and an optional gradient_flow border mode that uses `borderangle ... loop` for an animated wallust-colored border.
Use JetBrains Mono stylistic sets in the bar (font-feature-settings "zero","ss01"-"ss05","cv31") and turn on kitty `cursor_trail 1` for extra polish.

Avoid these practices: committed absolute symlinks, relative '../../.config' CSS imports, sed-editing your own configs at runtime, hardcoding a second palette (Tokyo Night hex) next to generated colors, and sleep-based refresh races.

one_line: "Minimal Bocchi" is a Bocchi the Rock!-themed Hyprland rice for Arch, built on prasanthrangan/hyprdots with leftover JaKooLit files. It uses a hand-tuned pywal palette of muted pink, gold and steel-blue on #1b1e25, a pill-segmented Waybar, a tri-color Japanese hyprlock and a catnip image fetch. It looks pretty, but the repo is a raw home-dir snapshot with no installer.
freshness: The GitHub page shows 73 commits, 620 stars, 25 forks, no license, and description "Hyprland Config Files". I could not see the date of the last commit (the page fetch didn't show it, and I used my one API call on the tree). Screenshot filenames are dated 240407 (7 April 2024). The config syntax matches Hyprland from early-to-mid 2024 (drop_shadow, new_is_master, windowrulev2, gestures{workspace_swipe}), and the .config/hypr/v2.2.6 marker refers to JaKooLit Hyprland-Dots v2.2.6. I judge it effectively unmaintained since about 2024, but that is not verified.

aesthetic.palette: A custom pywal scheme (wal/schemes/bocchi-bg.json), not a stock theme. bg/color0 #1b1e25; fg/color7 #ebddbc (cream); color1 #967786 (mauve); color2 #7293A9 (steel blue); color3 #D5A5AA (dusty rose); color4 #83A6BF (sky blue); color5 #EAB2C2 (pastel pink, the main accent); color6 #DEC386 (soft gold); color8 #a49a83. Colors 9-15 repeat 1-7. Waybar Wall-Dcol.css: bar-bg rgba(27,30,37,1), main-bg #242830, main-fg #ebddbc, wb-act-bg #DEC386, wb-hvr-bg #B28999. Rofi theme.rasi: main-bg #1b1e25, main-fg #CCD9FFE6, main-br #D9C95EE6, main-ex #76C4D7E6, select-bg #F0AAC180, select-fg #522936E6. Rofi config also hardcodes #EAB2C2 (entry border and selected row), #83A3BB (text/placeholder) and #1B1E25. Hypr colors.conf (wallbash override): active border rgba(E1A2B7ff)->rgba(522936ff) 45deg, inactive rgba(2F364Aff)->rgba(76C4D7ff). The active theme is Catppuccin-Mocha.conf with borders ca9ee6->f2d5cf, but border_size = 0, so borders are invisible. Waybar calendar: months #ffead3, weekdays #ffcc66, today #ff6699. Cava Wall-Dcol gradient: #293352 #3A476B #4B737D #57848F #A39B65 #C2B87A #E69AB3 #F0AAC1. NvChad 'ashes' theme is overridden with the same Bocchi hexes (base0D #EAB2C2, base05 #DEC386, base08 #83A6BF, base00 #1b1e25). The pink/gold/blue/red set seems to echo the Kessoku Band members' hair colors; that is my reading, not stated in the repo.
aesthetic.color_pipeline: This is a messy hybrid of three systems. (1) pywal: hyprland.conf runs `exec-once = wal --theme ~/.cache/wal/schemes/_home_kyokino_Pictures_wallpapers_bgs_bocchi-4_png_dark_None_None_1.1.0.json`. hyprlock sources $HOME/.cache/wal/colors-hyprland. .zshrc runs `(cat ~/.cache/wal/sequences &)` and sources colors-tty.sh. (2) Hyprdots 'wallbash': swwwallpaper.sh makes thumbnail, .blur and .rofi images with ImageMagick. swwwallbash.sh builds a .dcol palette with wallbash.sh, then runs every *.dcol template in ~/.config/hyprdots/wallbash in parallel, sed-replacing <wallbash_pry1..4>, <wallbash_txt1..4> and <wallbash_Nxa1..9> placeholders. The template directory itself is not in the repo. (3) Many hexes are hand-pasted straight into waybar style.css, rofi config.rasi and chadrc.lua, so changing the wallpaper does not fully re-theme the desktop. Hyprdots-style theme switching is available through per-theme files (Catppuccin-Latte/Mocha, Cyberpunk-Edge, Decay-Green, Frosted-Glass, Graphite-Mono, Gruvbox-Retro, Material-Sakura, Rose-Pine, Tokyo-Night, Wall-Dcol) for hypr, kitty, rofi and waybar, each chosen by a theme.conf symlink.
aesthetic.fonts: JetBrainsMono Nerd Font in Waybar (bold, 13px), kitty (11.0), rofi and hyprlock ('JetBrains Mono Nerd Font 10'). The GTK interface font is 'Cantarell 10'. The GTK monospace font is 'CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font Mono 9'. Font antialiasing is rgba with full hinting, set through gsettings in hypr/themes/common.conf.
aesthetic.icons_cursor_gtk_qt: Cursor: Bibata-Modern-Ice, size 20, set via `hyprctl setcursor` and gsettings. Icons: Tela-circle-dracula (Catppuccin-Mocha theme and rofi); Material-Sakura uses Tela-circle-black. GTK theme: 'Catppuccin-Mocha' with color-scheme prefer-dark. Qt: QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME=qt5ct; the kvantum override is commented out. Qt config files are not in the repo.
aesthetic.geometry: Active theme Catppuccin-Mocha.conf: gaps_in 6, gaps_out 15, border_size 0, rounding 5, no_border_on_floating true, resize_on_border true. Shadow: drop_shadow true, shadow_range 11, render_power 3, shadow_ignore_window true. Blur: size 4, passes 3, new_optimizations on, ignore_opacity on, xray true, vibrancy 0. Dwindle force_split 2. common.conf adds dim_special 0.3 and blur special = true. Window opacity rules: 0.80/0.80 for kitty, Code, Discord, Spotify, Dolphin and others; 0.90 for firefox and Brave; 0.80/0.70 for pavucontrol, blueman and nm-applet. Layer blur plus ignorezero for rofi, notifications and swaync; blur for logout_dialog. Waybar: height 28, width 1900, margin-top 10, window radius 7px, module-group end caps radius 5px, workspace buttons radius 8px, launcher button 5px radius with pink #EAB2C2 background. Rofi: 49em x 37em, square corners (border-radius 0), 1px pink input border. rofilaunch.sh sets rofi window radius to 2x the Hyprland rounding and border width to the Hyprland border_size. The unused JaKooLit UserSettings.conf has gaps 4/8, border 2, rounding 8, blur 5/2, dim_inactive 0.1. The unused Material-Sakura theme has gaps 8/14, border 4, rounding 12, shadow_offset 6 6.
aesthetic.animations: animations.conf defines: bezier wind = 0.05, 0.9, 0.1, 1.05; winIn = 0.1, 1.1, 0.1, 1.1; winOut = 0.3, -0.3, 0, 1; liner = 1, 1, 1, 1. Animations: windows 1,6,wind,slide; windowsIn 1,6,winIn,popin; windowsOut 1,5,winOut,slide; windowsMove 1,5,wind,slide; fade 1,10,default; workspaces 1,5,wind. A looping borderangle animation is commented out. swww wallpaper transition: grow from the cursor position (`--transition-pos $(hyprctl cursorpos)`), bezier .43,1.19,1,.4, 0.7s at 60fps. Waybar CSS: hover and active transitions use cubic-bezier(.55,-0.68,.48,1.682) over 0.3-0.4s. gamemode.sh comments out every CSS animation line and turns off Hyprland effects.
aesthetic.wallpapers: Pictures/bgs has bocchi-4.png, kita-1.png and sitting-1.png; Pictures/icons has bocchi-transparent.png. .config/catnip has bocchi-icon.png, bocchi-transparent.png and girl-7.png. hyprlock points at bocchi-new.png, which is not in the repo. All of these are Bocchi the Rock! anime fan art; the README credits a pixiv artwork for the fetch icon. There is no license and no per-image permission, so the art cannot be redistributed safely. The Screenshots and Preview folders hold PNG previews.
aesthetic.vibe: Cozy, muted, pastel anime rice. Soft pink, cream and gold on a near-black blue-grey (#1b1e25), with no borders, small 5px rounding and heavy 3-pass blur. The bar floats (10px top margin) and is split into segmented pills, with each of the three persistent workspace glyphs in its own color. The lockscreen writes ぼっち・ざ・ろっく！ in three colors above a 64pt clock and 'Hi there, $USER'. The palette is tasteful and coherent, and the character-color theming is a strong idea. It is also a single-wallpaper, single-mood rice: much of it is stock hyprdots (window rules, keybinds, scripts, the waybar generator), rofi is plain square boxes, and polish is uneven (invisible borders, hand-pasted hexes). Pretty and cute in screenshots, but mid-tier engineering. The best parts to borrow are the palette and the hyprlock/fetch personalization.

components.compositor: Hyprland, 2024-era syntax. hyprland.conf sources animations.conf, keybindings.conf, windowrules.conf, themes/common.conf, themes/theme.conf (a symlink to Catppuccin-Mocha.conf), themes/colors.conf (wallbash override), monitors.conf and userprefs.conf. The JaKooLit configs/ and UserConfigs/ trees are also committed but hyprland.conf never sources them.
components.bar_or_shell: Waybar. config.jsonc is generated by hyprdots wbarconfgen.sh from config.ctl, a pipe-delimited table of layouts. Row 1 is active: top bar with workspaces on the left, and updates, tray, network/bluetooth/pulseaudio/mic, battery/backlight, idle_inhibitor+clock and a 󰋄 launcher on the right. Modules are grouped with custom/l_end and custom/r_end cap modules into rounded pills. There is a weather script (Weather.py). style.css is hand-edited with the Bocchi hexes.
components.launcher: Rofi (wayland fork assumed; not stated). rofilaunch.sh has d/w/f modes: drun, window, filebrowser. It injects Hyprland rounding, border width, font and icon theme through -theme-str. config.rasi is a minimal list with placeholder 'looking for something...?'. There are 9 style presets (style_1-9) with wallpaper-image side panels (url('~/.config/swww/wall.rofi') and wall.blur), plus quickapps, clipboard, themeselect and 5 Steam gamelauncher .rasi layouts.
components.notifications: dunst is launched with `exec-once = dunst`, but no dunst config is in the repo; wallbashdunst.sh implies a template-generated config. Layer rules also target swaync, but swaync isn't configured.
components.lock_idle_logout: Lock: hyprlock using pywal colors. Background is the wallpaper with blur_size 5, passes 3, contrast 1.3, brightness 0.8, vibrancy 0.21. Three colored Japanese title labels, an HH:MM:SS clock at 64pt, 'Hi there, $USER', a 250x50 input field and 'Type to unlock!'. Bound to SUPER+L. Idle: no hypridle or swayidle config found; there is only a waybar idle_inhibitor. Logout: wlogout via hyprdots logoutlaunch.sh, which scales margins and font to monitor resolution and envsubsts a CSS template. The wlogout layout and style files are not in the repo.
components.wallpaper_tool: swww, driven by hyprdots swwwallpaper.sh. It supports next/previous/set, caches thumbnail, blur and rofi versions with ImageMagick, and uses a grow transition from the cursor position.
components.terminal: kitty: JetBrainsMono Nerd Font 11.0, window_padding_width 20, confirm_os_window_close 0. It includes themes/theme.conf, a symlink to Wall-Dcol.conf. background_opacity is commented out; transparency comes from a Hyprland opacity rule at 0.80.
components.shell_prompt: zsh with oh-my-zsh and powerlevel10k (.p10k.zsh included). Plugins: git, archlinux, zsh-autosuggestions, zsh-syntax-highlighting. ls is aliased to exa --icons. Terminal colors come from pywal sequences. catnip runs on every shell start.
components.editor: Neovim with NvChad v2.5 (chadrc.lua). The 'ashes' theme's base_16/base_30 are overridden with the Bocchi palette. README also lists VS Code, bound to SUPER+C with --disable-gpu.
components.file_manager: ranger (rc.conf, rifle.conf, scope.sh, commands.py). Dolphin is bound to SUPER+E.
components.fetch: catnip (iinsertNameHere/catnip, written in Nim). imageMode is enabled with /home/kyokino/.config/catnip/bocchi-transparent.png at scale 23, Inline layout. Stat names are shortened to nme, hst, upt, dst, ker, twm, trm, shl, clr with Nerd Font icons.
components.login_boot: SDDM with Keyitdev's sddm-flower-theme per the README credit and screenshot. The theme config is not in the repo. No GRUB or Plymouth theming.
components.extras: cava with a gradient config, Wall-Dcol colors and GLSL shaders (bar_spectrum, normalized_bars, northern_lights). btop with about 35 bundled themes. The color-scripts collection (stark/Color-Scripts, about 50 scripts plus preview PNGs). README also lists ncspot, sptlrx lyrics, tomato-c pomodoro, cbonsai, asciiquarium, and a Firefox 'aesthetic-startpage' with a pixiv wallpaper; none of those configs are included. Clipboard: cliphist via wl-paste watchers, shown in a rofi menu with SUPER+V. Screenshots: hyprdots screenshot.sh with modes s, sf (frozen), m and p. Gamemode toggle on SUPER+ALT+G. Window pin on SUPER+SHIFT+F. Keybind hints via keybinds_hint.sh.

standout_features: Character-palette theming: the Kessoku Band's hair colors (pink #EAB2C2, gold #DEC386, blue #83A6BF, rose #D5A5AA; my interpretation) are used as a pywal scheme and carried into the terminal, Waybar, rofi, NvChad, cava and hyprlock.

Waybar persistent workspaces colored one by one with nth-child: `#workspaces button.persistent:nth-child(2){color:#EAB2C2}`, `nth-child(3){color:#83A6BF}`, active #EBDDBC. A cheap, cute way to make workspace dots read as a 'band'.

hyprlock title built from three labels in $color6/$color3/$color4 spelling ぼっち・ざ・ろっく！, over a 64pt bold HH:MM:SS clock and 'Hi there, $USER'. Shows how to theme a lockscreen around the anime/character motif.
swww wallpaper changes that 'grow' from the cursor position (`--transition-pos $(hyprctl cursorpos)`, bezier .43,1.19,1,.4, 0.7s, 60fps).
Waybar bouncy hover and active transitions with overshoot: cubic-bezier(.55,-0.68,.48,1.682).

rofilaunch.sh reads the live Hyprland rounding, border_size, GTK font size and icon theme with hyprctl/gsettings, then injects them via -theme-str. The launcher always matches the compositor geometry.
Rofi style presets that use the current wallpaper (wall.rofi) and a blurred copy (wall.blur) as panel backgrounds. swwwallpaper.sh pre-renders both with ImageMagick.
config.ctl: a pipe-delimited table of whole Waybar layouts (position, height, left/center/right module groups), cycled by wbarconfgen.sh. Comes from hyprdots.
gamemode.sh turns off animations, shadows, blur, gaps and rounding in one `hyprctl --batch`, and comments out Waybar CSS animations with sed.
catnip image fetch showing a transparent Bocchi PNG with short three-letter stat labels.
structure_install: There is no installer, flake or bootstrap script. The repo is a flat snapshot of a home directory: .config/{btop,catnip,cava,hypr,hyprdots,kitty,nvim,ranger,rofi,waybar}, plus .zshrc, .config/.zshrc (duplicate), .p10k.zsh, Pictures/{bgs,icons}, wal/schemes/bocchi-bg.json, color-scripts/, Preview/ and Screenshots/. The README says to install prasanthrangan/hyprdots first ('Used their installation and tweaked from there') and copy these files over. wal/schemes/readme.txt tells the user to edit the absolute wallpaper path in the JSON by hand. The hyprdots support tree (~/.config/hyprdots/theme.ctl and the wallbash/*.dcol templates) is missing, as are the wlogout, dunst, sddm, ncspot, sptlrx and Firefox configs. So the repo does not reproduce the rice on its own. It also carries JaKooLit Hyprland-Dots v2.2.6 folders (configs/, UserConfigs/, UserScripts/, scripts/) that are dead weight next to the hyprdots-based main config. .gitignore is a VimCrypt-encrypted binary blob, which is odd and unreadable. Scripts depend on Arch tools (pacman -Qi, yay/paru in globalcontrol.sh).

key_snippets.purpose: Tri-color Japanese title plus clock: the personalized lockscreen
Per-workspace character colors and bouncy hover transition
Wallpaper transition that grows from the cursor

swww img "$(readlink "${wallSet}")" \
--transition-bezier .43,1.19,1,.4 \

weaknesses: Deprecated or removed Hyprland syntax (based on my knowledge of the Hyprland changelogs; I did not re-check the wiki in this session): decoration:drop_shadow/shadow_range/shadow_render_power/col.shadow (now a decoration { shadow { ... } } block), master:new_is_master (replaced by new_status), windowrulev2 (merged into windowrule), gestures{workspace_swipe} (replaced by the gesture keyword), layerrule blur,rofi / ignorezero (rule syntax has changed), and the JaKooLit general:sensitivity/apply_sens_to_raw. A current Hyprland will throw config errors.

Hardcoded username and paths everywhere: /home/kyokino in waybar config.jsonc (cpuinfo, gpuinfo, updates, volumecontrol, logoutlaunch), catnip imageMode path, globalcontrol.sh CloneDir, wal scheme 'wallpaper' and the exec-once `wal --theme ~/.cache/wal/schemes/_home_kyokino_Pictures_wallpapers_bgs_bocchi-4_png_...json`. Waybar backlight is pinned to intel_backlight and monitors.conf to 'desc:AU Optronics 0x403D' (the author's Acer laptop panel).

Symlinks committed as absolute paths to the author's home: hypr/themes/theme.conf, kitty/themes/theme.conf and waybar/themes/theme.css contain only '/home/kyokino/...'. They break on any other machine.

Incomplete and not reproducible: no install script, hyprdots theme.ctl and wallbash *.dcol templates missing, no dunst, wlogout, sddm, hypridle, Firefox or ncspot configs even though the README advertises them, and hyprlock points at a bocchi-new.png that is not in the repo.

Two dotfile frameworks mixed together (prasanthrangan/hyprdots active, plus JaKooLit Hyprland-Dots v2.2.6 configs/UserConfigs/scripts never sourced). The same job is done three ways (pywal, wallbash, per-theme files), and hand-pasted hexes stop wallpaper changes from re-theming the waybar, rofi and nvim accents.

Aesthetic inconsistencies: border_size = 0 makes the gradient border colors pointless; rofi uses square corners while windows use 5px and Waybar 7-8px; the Waybar CSS mixes @define-color variables with literal hexes, and there is a typo selector '#blueooth'.

Licensing: no repository license, and it bundles Bocchi the Rock! fan art and pixiv-sourced images (bocchi-4.png, kita-1.png, sitting-1.png, bocchi-transparent.png, girl-7.png) without clear redistribution rights. It also bundles third-party color-scripts and about 35 btop themes.

Arch-only assumptions (pacman -Qi and yay/paru in globalcontrol.sh, the archlinux oh-my-zsh plugin); there is no NixOS path. It also uses deprecated exa (now eza), oh-my-zsh plus p10k (p10k is in limited maintenance), and a .gitignore that is a VimCrypt-encrypted blob.

Performance and robustness: hyprdots scripts run synchronous hyprctl, jq and gsettings calls on every invocation. gamemode.sh edits waybar style.css in place with sed, and the lock file lives in /tmp.
steal_list: Adopt the Bocchi-style muted pastel palette as a named scheme (bg #1b1e25, surface #242830, fg #ebddbc, pink #EAB2C2, gold #DEC386, blue #83A6BF, rose #D5A5AA, mauve #967786, steel #7293A9). Make it a matugen/stylix override or a base16 scheme so it works on both Arch and NixOS.

Character or 'band' workspace coloring: give each persistent workspace its own accent via nth-child (or per-workspace classes in a Quickshell/AGS bar), with a bouncy cubic-bezier(.55,-0.68,.48,1.682) hover.

Personalized hyprlock: multi-colored kana or title labels in palette colors over a large bold clock, a greeting with $USER, wallpaper blur of 3 passes with contrast 1.3, brightness 0.8, vibrancy 0.21, and a fade_on_empty input. Port it to the current hyprlock syntax.

Wallpaper transitions that grow from the cursor: `swww img --transition-type grow --transition-pos $(hyprctl cursorpos) --transition-bezier .43,1.19,1,.4 --transition-duration 0.7 --transition-fps 60`. swww has since been renamed awww upstream (not verified here); check before pinning.
Pre-render per-wallpaper variants (thumbnail, a 10%-scale blurred copy, a 2000px rofi crop) when the wallpaper changes, and use them as launcher and lockscreen panel backgrounds.

Have the launcher inherit compositor geometry at runtime: read decoration:rounding and general:border_size via `hyprctl -j getoption` and inject them as rofi -theme-str, so radii always match. On NixOS, generate this from a single Nix variable instead.
One-key gamemode that batch-disables animations, blur, shadow, gaps and rounding with `hyprctl --batch`, and restores them with `hyprctl reload`.

Image fetch with a transparent character PNG (catnip imageMode, or fastfetch with the kitty image protocol) and short lowercase stat labels (nme, hst, upt, dst, ker, twm, trm, shl) for a cute terminal greeting.
The hyprdots animation set (wind 0.05,0.9,0.1,1.05 / winIn 0.1,1.1,0.1,1.1 popin / winOut 0.3,-0.3,0,1) as a proven, playful baseline.
Do NOT copy: the absolute-path symlinks, hardcoded /home/<user>, the bundled anime fan art, the mixed hyprdots+JaKooLit trees, or the deprecated Hyprland keywords.

one_line: A small Hyprland rice for CachyOS/Arch whose last commit was March 2024. It has a bottom Waybar made of candy-colored pills, a Rofi launcher adapted from adi1090x with pale-pink (misty rose) leaf-shaped cards and a picture banner, and a swaync notification center tinted with the Srcery palette. Every color is hand-picked and typed in directly. There is no installer, no package list and no Nix.
freshness: The GitHub commits Atom feed shows only commits from 2024-03-03 to 2024-03-04 (latest 2024-03-04T13:58:37Z, HEAD 58a0eb2a). The repo looks like a one-time dump that was never maintained, about 2.5 years stale as of 2026-09-25. Committed nohup.out logs are dated 2024-03-01. The Hyprland syntax matches roughly v0.35-0.37 (early 2024).

aesthetic.palette:
There is no single named scheme; the README says the author hand-picked colors from DeviantArt art, then used AI color generators and ChatGPT, starting from the BlackLotus and Srcery schemes. Colors seen in the files:
- Hyprland border: active rgba(ff5e81ac) (pink-red with alpha), inactive rgba(595959aa), shadow rgba(1a1a1aee).
- Waybar style.css: bar background #F5F5F5 with 8px radius and text #c8c8c8. Default pill #302e31 on #e5e5e5. Module pills (bg / fg): temperature #FF5C8F / #432D39, idle_inhibitor #DB7093 / #432D39 (activated #2E8B57 / white), backlight #E02C6D / #fab6ed, battery #0dac64 / #e9f48d (critical #f53c3c blinking), network #1b93bc / #f4d9cf, custom-media #66cc99 / #2a5c45, wireplumber #F75341 / #c8c8c8, notification #20B2AA / #1E5D4F, workspaces #20B2AA (inactive buttons #1E5D4F, active #fff), power #f60c5a / #ecc5e2, Arch logo #2f88ff.
- Waybar style2.css (dark variant): bar #121212, pills #1e1e1e, workspaces #7984a4.
- Rofi launcher (type-7/style-8): background #FFE4E1, background-alt #ffffff, foreground #645074, selected #73C3EB, active #2f88ff, urgent #a55377.
- Rofi power menu and wifi menu: #121212 / #191919 / #c8c8c8, selected #3c81f7 (power) or #2f88ff (wifi), active #798347, urgent #a55377, violet #6d64d8, uptime pill #E02c6d on #121212.
- swaync (Srcery-like): cc-bg #191919, noti-bg #121212, border #47423E, text #E0CDA5, black #1C1B19, red #F75341, green #519F50, yellow #FBB829, blue #2C78BF, purple #E02C6D, aqua #0AAEB3, gray #BEAC8E, white #BAA67F, widget title #2f88ff.
- Cava gradient: #65BEAA, #9A80CE, #DA8BAA, #C388B2, #CC94B0, #DD88A5, #CC88AA, #DD99A7.
- Alacritty and swaylock use stock Nord: bg #2E3440, fg #D8DEE9, ring #4C566A, key-hl #A3BE8C, inside #3B4252.
- Hyprlock: outer #151515, inner rgb(200,200,200).
aesthetic.color_pipeline: Static only. There is no matugen, wallust, pywal or stylix. Each app has its own hardcoded hex values, and they do not agree: Nord in Alacritty and swaylock, Srcery in swaync, custom candy colors in Waybar, pastel misty rose in the Rofi launcher, and adi1090x's onedark import left in rofi/applets/shared/colors.rasi. The 17 adi1090x rofi/colors/*.rasi presets are bundled, plus a custom my.rasi (#121212 / #3c81f7 / #a55377). Nothing carries colors from one app to another.
aesthetic.fonts:
From the README: system font SF Pro Text Medium, terminal font JetBrains Mono Nerd Font. In the files:
- Waybar: 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font' 13px, font-weight 900.
- Rofi: 'JetBrains Mono Nerd Font 10'; the power icons use the 'feather 28' icon font.
- swaync: Iosevka Nerd Font, with 'Symbols Nerd Font' for the title button.
- Alacritty: JetBrains Mono Nerd Font size 12, but bold and italic fall back to 'monospace'.
- Hyprlock label: SF Pro Display Bold 30.
- swaylock: 'Cantarelle Regular' (a typo for Cantarell).
- The swaylock-fancy keybind uses Hack-Regular.
aesthetic.icons_cursor_gtk_qt: From the README: GTK theme Fluent Round Dark (gnome-look 1574551), icons We10X Special Dark, cursor Bibata Modern Ice. rofi/config.rasi sets icon-theme 'Papirus', which does not match. There is no Qt/Kvantum config, and neither gsettings nor the cursor is set in hyprland.conf.
aesthetic.geometry:
- Hyprland: gaps_in 5, gaps_out 8, border_size 3, rounding 8. Opacity 0.93 active, 0.80 inactive, 1.0 fullscreen. Blur size 8, passes 3, ignore_opacity true, xray false. drop_shadow with shadow_range 4 and render_power 3. The dwindle layout is used.
- Keybinds toggle gaps at runtime: SUPER+G sets 0/0, SUPER+SHIFT+G sets 5/3.
- Waybar: at the bottom, height 40, left/right/bottom margins 5, spacing 5. Pills have 5px radius (workspaces 20px) and 0 15px padding; the bar window has 8px radius.
- Rofi launcher: 800px wide, anchored south with offsets -550 x / -400 y. Mainbox radius 8px. The inputbar banner has 100px 60px padding. Elements use an asymmetric 15px 5px 15px 5px radius (the 'leaf' shape); the entry field is the mirror 5px 15px 5px 15px. Two columns by 6 lines, 32px icons.
- Rofi power menu: 800px wide, offsets 550 x / -280 y. Mainbox radius 50px, inputbar 40px, circular (100%) buttons with 30px 10px padding, 6 columns by 1 row.
- swaync: 10px radius everywhere, 350px wide, 48px icons, control center at 0.9 alpha with a 0 0 10px black shadow.
- Alacritty opacity 0.8.
- swaylock: blur 7x5, vignette 0.5:0.5, indicator radius 120 and thickness 20.
aesthetic.animations:
Custom bezier curves:
- wind = 0.05, 0.9, 0.1, 1.05
- winIn = 0.1, 1.1, 0.1, 1.1
- winOut = 0.3, -0.3, 0, 1
- liner = 1, 1, 1, 1

Animations:
- windows: 6, wind, slide
- windowsIn: 6, winIn, slide
- windowsOut: 5, winOut, slide
- windowsMove: 5, wind, slide
- border: 1, liner
- borderangle: 30, liner, loop
- fade: 10, default
- workspaces: 5, wind

Window rules force 'slide right' for kitty and alacritty. The borderangle loop does nothing visible because the border is one solid color, not a gradient. A commented-out 'overshot' bezier (0.13, 0.99, 0.29, 1.1) is also present. In Waybar, background-color transitions over 0.5s and a critical battery blinks via a CSS @keyframes animation.
aesthetic.wallpapers: No wallpapers are bundled. The README shows 8 wallpapers hosted on imgur (including a GIF) with no source or license info. At runtime, swaybg loads the CachyOS package wallpaper /usr/share/wallpapers/cachyos-wallpapers/Liquid.png, and hyprlock points at /home/prtyksh/Downloads/arch.png. The Rofi banners rofi/images/t.png (810 KB) and power.png (154 KB) are custom illustrations that do not exist upstream and have unknown origin. The other rofi/images files (a.png etc.) are byte-identical copies from adi1090x/rofi, which is GPL-3.0.
aesthetic.vibe: Playful and bright, closer to 'candy' or 'bubblegum toybox' than soft pastel. The light #F5F5F5 floating bottom bar has every module in a different saturated pill: hot pink, magenta, teal, green, ocean blue, coral. The cutest piece is the Rofi launcher: misty-rose #FFE4E1 cards, dusty-lavender #645074 text, sky-blue #73C3EB selection, leaf-shaped corners and an illustration banner. The circular-button power menu and the pastel mint-lavender-pink cava gradient are also nice. Overall polish is moderate to low. Palettes clash between apps (Nord terminal and lock, Srcery notifications, candy bar, pastel launcher). Pixel offsets assume one 1920x1080 screen. There are three competing lock tools. Most of the Hyprland config is the CachyOS default with the colors changed. It reads as a first rice with a few charming ideas, not a cohesive system. I did not view the imgur screenshots, so this judgment comes from the config files.

components.compositor: Hyprland with the dwindle layout. hypr/hyprland.conf appears to be derived from CachyOS's default Hyprland settings: it has the CachyOSHello float rule, the danmufloat/QQ/NetEase rules, a wob FIFO, polkit-kde, fcitx5 and the cachyos-wallpapers path. There is a single hardcoded monitor line (monitor=,1920x1080@60.09600,0x0,1).
components.bar_or_shell:
Waybar, launched with `waybar -c .config/waybar/config-hypr`. Its style.css is the light candy-pill theme; style2.css is a dark #121212 variant and 'style (copy).css' is a transparent variant.
- Left modules: custom/rofi (Arch glyph), hyprland/workspaces (4 persistent), temperature, custom/media (mediaplayer.py via Playerctl).
- Center: clock#date and custom/weather (curl wttr.in ?format=1 every 7200s).
- Right: idle_inhibitor, custom/notification (toggles swaync), network (click opens the rofi wifi menu), battery, backlight, wireplumber, custom/power (opens the rofi power menu).
There is no Quickshell, AGS or eww.
components.launcher: Rofi, using a trimmed fork of adi1090x/rofi (about 200 files bundled). Three pieces are actually used: launchers/type-7/style-8 (pastel launcher with the t.png banner, drun, 2 columns), applets/type-4/style-3 (power menu of 6 circular icons with the power.png banner) and ultimate.rasi (wifi list). rofi-wifi-menu.sh wraps nmcli.
components.notifications: SwayNotificationCenter at the top right. Its config enables the title, DnD, notifications, backlight, volume and mpris widgets; the MPRIS image is 96px with 12px radius. A buttons-grid of hyprshade toggles (redshift, dim, grayscale, vibrance, invert) is configured but missing from the widgets list, and the committed log shows hyprshade was not installed. The CSS is credited to Axenide/Dotfiles and recolored toward Srcery.
components.lock_idle_logout:
- Idle: swayidle locks with swaylock after 600s and before sleep, and suspends after 1200s. hypridle is not used.
- Lock: swaylock (a swaylock-effects config with Nord colors, clock and blur). SUPER+L runs `swaylock-fancy -e -K -p 10 -f Hack-Regular`. hypr/hyprlock.conf is minimal, has a hardcoded path and is never called.
- Logout: the rofi power menu (lock, logout, suspend, hibernate, reboot, shutdown) with a yes/no confirm dialog. Logout runs `kill -9 -1`, inherited from adi1090x.
components.wallpaper_tool: swaybg (`swaybg -o \* -i /usr/share/wallpapers/cachyos-wallpapers/Liquid.png -m fill`). There is no swww, hyprpaper or wallpaper switcher.
components.terminal: Alacritty (TOML): Nord colors, opacity 0.8, JetBrains Mono Nerd Font size 12, underline cursor, title 'Alacritty@CachyOS'. Two duplicate '(copy)' configs are also committed.
components.shell_prompt: None in the repo (no zsh/fish/starship configs).
components.editor: None in the repo.
components.file_manager: None configured. Only Hyprland opacity rules for Thunar and Nautilus (0.92).
components.fetch: None in the repo.
components.login_boot: None (no display manager, GRUB, Plymouth or sddm theme).
components.extras:
- cava: pastel 8-stop gradient, plus sdl_glsl shaders northern_lights.frag, bar_spectrum.frag and pass_through.vert.
- Screenshots: hyprshot (Print, CTRL+Print, SHIFT+Print), grim+slurp+swappy (SUPER+A), and grimblast wrapper scripts in hypr/scripts.
- wob volume OSD fed by a per-instance FIFO. Volume up/down uses pamixer, mute uses amixer.
- brightnessctl, playerctl, nm-applet, fcitx5, polkit-kde-authentication-agent-1, gsimplecal (clock click), xsensors (temperature click), gnome-calculator (SUPER+SHIFT+P).
- Mentioned in the README but not in the repo: the Bonjourr Firefox startpage and the Spicetify extensions 'Lyrics Plus' and 'Beautiful Lyrics'.

standout_features: The Rofi launcher is the cutest piece. It uses 'leaf' corners (border-radius 15px 5px 15px 5px on elements, the mirror 5px 15px 5px 15px on the search entry), a misty-rose #FFE4E1 background with #645074 text and #73C3EB selection, and a full-width illustration banner (inputbar background-image url("~/.config/rofi/images/t.png", width) with 100px 60px padding). It is anchored at the bottom-left above the bar, so it feels like a start menu.

The Rofi power menu is a single row of 6 fully round (radius 100%) icon buttons in the 'feather 28' font, under an illustrated power.png banner, with a pink #E02c6d uptime pill and a 2-button confirm dialog built from inline -theme-str overrides.

Waybar sits at the bottom as a light, floating (margin 5), rounded bar with color-coded pills. Each module has its own saturated background and a tinted text color (temperature #FF5C8F/#432D39, backlight #E02C6D/#fab6ed, battery #0dac64/#e9f48d, network #1b93bc/#f4d9cf, media #66cc99/#2a5c45). The critical battery blinks via @keyframes, and weather classes (sunnyDay, rainyNight, etc.) each have their own color.
The volume OSD needs no daemon: wob reads a FIFO named after the Hyprland instance (/tmp/$HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE.wob), and the volume keybinds write the pamixer level into it.

The swaync control center has italic bold summaries in #E02C6D, the time in #2C78BF, and a DnD switch that turns pink when on. A buttons-grid is prepared to toggle hyprshade screen shaders (redshift, dim, grayscale, vibrance, invert), though it is not enabled.
The cava visualizer uses a pastel mint to lavender to pink gradient (#65BEAA to #DD99A7) and ships custom SDL GLSL shaders (northern_lights.frag, bar_spectrum.frag).
A Rofi wifi picker (nmcli) opens when you click the Waybar network module and prompts for a password on secured networks.
SUPER+G and SUPER+SHIFT+G switch between zero gaps and normal gaps at runtime via hyprctl --batch.
Window animations are springy and have some personality: winIn overshoots to 1.1, and winOut has a -0.3 anticipation dip.
structure_install: The repo is flat and mirrors ~/.config: alacritty/, cava/ (config + shaders/), hypr/ (hyprland.conf, hyprlock.conf, scripts/screenshot*), rofi/ (the full adi1090x tree: applets/, colors/, images/, launchers/type-1..7, powermenu/type-1..6, plus custom ultimate.rasi, launchpad.rasi, windows11-grid-dark.rasi and rofi-wifi-menu.sh), swaylock/config, swaync/ (config.json, style.css) and waybar/ (config-hypr, style.css, style2.css, mediaplayer.py, modules/*.sh and a backup/ duplicate). There is no install script, package list, stow layout or license. The README only tells you which three Rofi scripts to launch and which .rasi files to edit. To install, you would copy the folders into ~/.config by hand, replace every /home/prtyksh path, and install the dependencies yourself: hyprland, waybar, rofi-wayland, swaync, swaybg, swayidle, swaylock-effects, swaylock-fancy, wob, pamixer, brightnessctl, playerctl, python-gobject/playerctl, grimblast, hyprshot, grim, slurp, swappy, cava, alacritty, nerd fonts, SF Pro and the feather font.
