weaknesses: Hyprland syntax from early 2024 that current releases reject. decoration:drop_shadow, shadow_range, shadow_render_power and col.shadow moved into a decoration:shadow {} block in v0.45. blur:new_optimizations has been removed. dwindle and master no_gaps_when_only was removed (use workspace rules for smart gaps). master:new_is_master was replaced by new_status. The v1 `windowrule=float,Rofi` and `windowrule=opacity 0.92,Thunar` forms, and windowrulev2 itself, were superseded by newer windowrule syntax. The gestures{workspace_swipe...} block was replaced by the `gesture =` keyword. These version details come from my knowledge of Hyprland changelogs and were not re-checked against the wiki in this session.

`layerrule = blur,rofi` is placed inside the decoration{} block rather than at the top level. `animation = borderangle, 1, 30, liner, loop` runs continuously even though col.active_border is one color, so it costs redraws and shows nothing.

Username paths are hardcoded throughout. Keybinds and Waybar on-click actions call /home/prtyksh/.config/rofi/...; hyprlock uses /home/prtyksh/Downloads/arch.png; `waybar -c .config/waybar/config-hypr` uses a path relative to cwd. The wallpaper depends on the CachyOS-only package path /usr/share/wallpapers/cachyos-wallpapers/Liquid.png.

Repo hygiene is poor. Three nohup.out logs are committed (they leak the username and show that hyprshade was missing). There are '(copy)' and '(another copy)' duplicate configs and a waybar/backup/ duplicate folder. About 200 unused adi1090x rofi files are included; only 3 themes are used. There is no LICENSE, no install script and no dependency list.

Colors are not unified. The terminal and swaylock are Nord, swaync is Srcery-like, the bar is custom candy, the Rofi launcher is pastel misty rose, and rofi/applets/shared/colors.rasi still imports onedark. No theme generator or shared variables tie them together.

Three lockers compete: swaylock from swayidle and the power menu, swaylock-fancy on SUPER+L, and hyprlock.conf, which is never used. The swaylock font is misspelled 'Cantarelle Regular'. swayidle is used instead of hypridle.

Waybar issues: `today-format` is deprecated (Waybar now uses a calendar{format{today}} block). The kanji workspace `format-icons` never render because the format is "{name}", not "{icon}". `exec-if: ping wttr.in -c1` is a fragile network check. The bar's default text color #c8c8c8 on the #F5F5F5 background has almost no contrast.
The power menu's Logout runs `kill -9 -1` (inherited from adi1090x). That SIGKILLs every user process with no clean shutdown; `hyprctl dispatch exit` or `uwsm stop` should be used instead.
Pixel offsets are hardcoded for one 1920x1080 display (Rofi x-offset -550/550 and y-offset -400/-280, plus the monitor line), so the menus will be misplaced on other resolutions or with scaling.

Bundled art: the custom Rofi banners t.png (810 KB) and power.png (154 KB) have unknown provenance and no license. The GPL-3.0 adi1090x images are redistributed without attribution files. The README wallpapers are on imgur with no credits.

Alacritty bold and italic faces fall back to generic 'monospace' instead of JetBrains Mono. Volume up/down uses pamixer while mute uses amixer. The swaync buttons-grid is configured but never enabled.
steal_list: Use the asymmetric 'leaf' radius (15px 5px 15px 5px, and the mirror 5px 15px 5px 15px on inputs) as a cute signature shape across the launcher, power menu buttons, bar pills and Quickshell widgets.

Add an illustrated banner header to Rofi or a Quickshell launcher (inputbar background-image url(..., width) with about 100px 60px padding). Pair it with a misty-rose #FFE4E1 background, #645074 dusty-lavender text and #73C3EB sky-blue selection for a soft pastel launcher. Ship self-made or CC-licensed art only.
Copy the power-menu pattern: one row of round icon buttons, an uptime message pill and a 2-button confirm step. Use `hyprctl dispatch exit` (or uwsm) for logout, never kill -9 -1.
Keep the idea of color-coded bar pills (each module gets its own hue with a darker or lighter tinted foreground), but generate the hues from one matugen or stylix palette and check the contrast.
Adapt the springy beziers: winIn 0.1,1.1,0.1,1.1 (overshoot), winOut 0.3,-0.3,0,1 (anticipation), wind 0.05,0.9,0.1,1.05. Only add an animated borderangle loop when the border is a gradient.

Use the cava pastel gradient (#65BEAA, #9A80CE, #DA8BAA, #C388B2, #CC94B0, #DD88A5, #CC88AA, #DD99A7) as a default, or template it from the wallpaper palette. Include cava's sdl_glsl shaders for a desktop visualizer window.

Add screen-shader toggles in the notification center or control panel (redshift, dim, grayscale, vibrance, invert). On current Hyprland, implement them with hyprshade or `decoration:screen_shader`, or use hyprsunset for night light.
Include a daemon-free OSD via a per-instance FIFO fed to wob, or replace it with swayosd. On NixOS, run the FIFO or wob as a systemd user service.
Include the nmcli Rofi wifi picker bound to the bar's network module, and add runtime gap toggle keybinds (SUPER+G for zen mode with zero gaps).

one_line: A minimal, flat "zen" Hyprland setup for Arch only. It adopted Hyprland 0.55's Lua config early and recolors everything from the wallpaper with matugen (eww, kitty, rofi, and nvim via lush). But it is halfway through moving from eww to quickshell: the quickshell config isn't in the repo, and the README describes an older version.
freshness: Active. The commits page shows merges of PRs #136-#141 on Aug 16-17, 2026, including "fix: ditch hyprlang" (the move to Lua config) and "fix: hypr template script and install". The profile lists the repo as updated Sep 24, 2026. 902 stars, 32 forks, about 220 commits on main, and three branches (main, staging, development). Older parts show their age: .p10k.zsh says "Generated ... on 2024-09-17", scripts carry "by Abuku (2024)", and the README still says the colors come from pywal. The owner has a newer sibling repo, hayyaoe/ishara (a Lua Hyprland config with matugen and a dual Regular/Zen mode), which may be where the missing quickshell work lives. I did not verify that.

aesthetic.palette: No fixed palette: every color is generated from the wallpaper by matugen at runtime (`matugen --source-color-index 0 -m dark image $WP`). Templates read matugen's base16 output and map it straight to color0-15: `$color1: {{base16.base01.default.hex}}` through `$color15: {{base16.base0f.default.hex}}`. Background is base00. Foreground is inconsistent: eww uses base04, kitty base06, nvim lush base05. Because base01-07 in base16 are a gray ramp, terminal ANSI red, green, yellow and so on come out as shades of gray. That gives a near-monochrome Material-You-dark look, and it is a bug. The only fixed hex I found is the yazi border `#838ba7` (Catppuccin Frappé overlay1). Most eww styling comes from SCSS mixes such as `mix($background,$foreground,95%)` for bar panels and `mix($color5,$foreground,90%)` for the volume fill.
aesthetic.color_pipeline: Current: change-wallpaper.sh <n> [-g] edits the path lines in the (gitignored) hypr/service/hyprpaper.conf and hyprlock.conf, then runs update-color.sh. That runs matugen, whose config.toml writes templates to eww/colors.scss, kitty/kitty-colors.conf, nvim/colors/lush-colors.json, nvim/colors/vim-colors.vim and rofi/rofi-dark-colors.rasi. It then restarts hyprpaper, runs `killall eww` and `eww open-many side-bar notifications`, recolors each running kitty with `kitty @ --to unix:/tmp/kitty-* set-colors -a -c`, and sends `<cmd>colorscheme lush-colors<CR>` to each /tmp/nvim* socket. In nvim, lush.nvim reads the JSON and builds highlight groups including treesitter @-groups. Leftovers from older pipelines are still committed: wallust.toml (palette 'dark16', misspelled key `theshold = 70`, check_contrast) with its own templates, and select_wallpaper_rofi.sh, which still calls `wal -i`.
aesthetic.fonts: Iosevka (eww `*{font-family:"Iosevka"; font-weight:bold}`, kitty `font_family Iosevka`, rofi launcher `Iosevka 14`). Mononoki 14 for the rofi wallpaper and password menus. Font Awesome 6 Free (rofi power menu at 24, eww vertical power menu). Packages installed: ttf-iosevka-nerd, ttf-nerd-fonts-symbols-mono, noto-fonts. Font Awesome and Mononoki are not installed by INSTALL.sh.
aesthetic.icons_cursor_gtk_qt: A bundled hyprcursor theme, `.local/share/icons/theme_NotwaitaBlack` (manifest: "Notwaita Xcursors - @ful1e5 fork - packaged by Virt"), plus scripts/create_xcursor.sh. rofi names the `kora` icon theme but sets show-icons false, and kora is not installed. qt6ct, kvantum, gtk3 and gtk4 are installed, but there is no GTK, Qt or Kvantum theme config in the repo.
aesthetic.geometry: Hyprland (core/appearence.lua): gaps_in=4, gaps_out=8, border_size=0, rounding=14, active_opacity=1.0, inactive_opacity=0.9, layout=dwindle, resize_on_border=false, allow_tearing=false. Blur is off (enabled=false, though size=8, passes=2, vibrancy=0.8, contrast=0.6 are set). Shadow is off. cursor.no_hardware_cursors=true. eww: bar and sidebar radius 12px with 4-5px padding, inner pills radius 8px, slider troughs radius 5px with min-height 4-8px, cover art radius 4px, notification cards radius 12px with 12px padding. rofi: window 350px wide, 10px padding, radius 12px, inputbar radius 8px, 3 lines. Power menu is 520px with 5 columns and 30px 25px 25px 30px element padding. kitty: window_margin_width 18, background_opacity 1.
aesthetic.animations: One custom curve, `hl.curve("basic", { type = "bezier", points = { {0.05, 0.8}, {0.1, 1} } })`, is defined but never used: every animation uses bezier "default". Speeds: global 8; windows, windowsIn, windowsMove and fade 4; windowsOut 4 with style "popin 95%"; workspaces 6 with style "slidevert". In eww, revealers use slideleft, slideup or slideright at 300ms (500ms for the music module), and SCSS has `transition: color 0.3s ease-in-out`.
aesthetic.wallpapers: 28 numbered JPGs (wallpapers/1.jpg through 28.jpg) are bundled with no source, artist or license, and the repo has no LICENSE file. The owner also keeps a separate `aesthetic-wallpapers` repo. normalize_wallpaper.sh converts png/webp/jpeg to .jpg and makes `preview-*.jpg` thumbnails (`magick -resize 800x600 -quality 50`) for the eww wallpaper picker, a 310px-wide scrolling column of 300x200 tiles on the left edge. The daemon is hyprpaper, restarted with killall on every change.
aesthetic.vibe: Clean, quiet and minimal, which fits the "zen" name. It is flat: no borders, no blur, no shadows, generous rounding (14), small gaps, and one bold Iosevka font throughout. The theme follows the wallpaper and ends up mostly monochrome. The "zenities" box-drawing logo (installer, fastfetch, alpha-nvim) gives it a consistent identity. It is not cute or pastel: there are no accent pops, gradients or kawaii touches, and the gray ANSI mapping flattens terminal and editor syntax colors. The eww parts (vertical sidebar with hover sliders, circular-progress rings, cover art in the bar) are neat but look like a first-generation eww rice from 2024. Tidy and pleasant, not showpiece-level.

components.compositor: Hyprland 0.55+ with the new Lua config. `.config/hypr/hyprland.lua` requires core.animations, appearence, execs, keybinds, rules and settings, then user.apps, keybinds, execs, inputs and monitors. The user files are copied once from `.templates/hypr/` by scripts/hypr.sh and are gitignored. It starts through UWSM (`hl.on("hyprland.start", ...)` runs `uwsm finalize` and `uwsm app -- qs`). There are submaps for keyboard resize and move (ALT+N and ALT+M, arrow keys, repeating, escape to reset).
components.bar_or_shell: In transition. Hyprland autostarts quickshell (`qs`) and the media keys call `qs ipc call volume update|mic update|brightness update`, but there is no quickshell/QML config anywhere in the repo tree. The committed shell is eww (yuck + SCSS), built from git with cargo. It has a horizontal top bar (launcher and hover power menu, dot workspaces, ncspot music with cover art and seek slider, memory and battery rings, brightness and volume sliders that slide out on hover, wifi, clock that reveals the date), a vertical left side-bar (update-color.sh opens this one, not the top bar), a device-control grid (wifi, bluetooth, idle toggle, screenshot, volume and brightness sliders), a resource monitor (vertical CPU, TMP, DSK and BAT bars), a custom calendar, a music widget, and a wallpaper picker.
components.launcher: rofi: drun/run, `∂` prompt, placeholder "find the zen", Iosevka 14, 350px, colors from matugen via rofi-dark-colors.rasi. Separate rofi configs exist for the power menu (5 Font Awesome icons), wallpaper and password. The user template `.templates/hypr/apps.lua` sets `menu = "hyprlauncher"`, so fresh installs bind SUPER+SPACE to hyprlauncher, not rofi.
components.notifications: A homemade Python D-Bus server (`.config/eww/scripts/notification_handler.py`) that claims org.freedesktop.Notifications, prints yuck markup that an eww `literal` widget renders in a top-right overlay window, and removes each notification after a hardcoded 10s. It declares `Notify` with signature `susssasa{ss}i` (the spec says a{sv}), always returns id 0, and has no GetCapabilities, CloseNotification or action support. No mako, dunst or swaync.
components.lock_idle_logout: hyprlock and hypridle are installed, but their configs are not in the repo: `.config/hypr/service/hyprlock.conf` and `hyprpaper.conf` are gitignored as "autogenerated" and I found nothing that generates them. The wallpaper script only edits their `path =` line. Logout goes through a rofi power menu (scripts/power_management.sh: shutdown, reboot, lock, suspend, exit via `hyprctl dispatch exit`) and the eww power menus revealed on hover (they run `shutdown now`, `reboot` or `killall Hyprland` with no confirmation). Idle is toggled by starting or killing hypridle from the sidebar, with status polled every 2s.
components.wallpaper_tool: hyprpaper (restarted with killall on each change). Pickers: the eww wallpaper panel with ImageMagick previews (SUPER+SHIFT+W per the README), and a legacy rofi picker that still calls pywal.
components.terminal: kitty: Iosevka, window_margin_width 18, opacity 1, `allow_remote_control yes`, `listen_on unix:/tmp/kitty`, includes kitty-colors.conf generated by matugen. It is recolored live over the socket. Note that INSTALL.sh does not install kitty.
components.shell_prompt: zsh with Powerlevel10k (Lean style, `❯` prompt char, magenta/red), fzf --zsh, zoxide, thefuck, nvm, an eza `ls` alias, and fastfetch once per interactive session. scripts/zsh_setup.sh writes .zshrc and .zshenv, which source ~/.config/zsh/rice.zsh and env.zsh.
components.editor: Neovim with lazy.nvim: lush.nvim theme loaded from the matugen JSON, alpha-nvim dashboard with the zenities logo, telescope, neo-tree, treesitter, LSP config, none-ls, completions, nvim-dap, flutter-tools, lualine.
components.file_manager: yazi (SUPER+M opens `kitty -e yazi`, and a floating variant is used), with its own theme.toml and keymap.
components.fetch: fastfetch: custom text logo (`     • •` / `┓┏┓┏┓┓╋┓┏┓┏` / `┗┗ ┛┗┗┗┗┗ ┛`), keys OS, KERN (uname trimmed with sed) and UP, cyan keys, two-space separator.
components.login_boot: None. No display manager, GRUB/Limine/systemd-boot theme or Plymouth config. INSTALL.sh ends with a forced `sudo reboot` after a 5s countdown.
components.extras: ncspot (the only player the eww bar tracks, via `playerctl --player=ncspot`, including `mpris:artUrl` cover art), cava (installed, no config), tmux (prefix C-s, Colemak h/n/e/i pane navigation, status bar on top using ANSI colour4 accents, TPM), bottom and btop, a hyprshot screenshot menu in rofi (fullscreen, region, window, clipboard), bluetuith in a floating kitty (AUR, not installed), hyprsunset (installed, not configured), GitHub Actions CI (shellcheck, then an INSTALL.sh run in an archlinux:latest container, then a release tarball on v* tags).

standout_features: Early adopter of Hyprland 0.55's Lua config, with a clean split: `core/*.lua` (managed by the repo) and `user/*.lua` (copied once from `.templates/hypr/` by scripts/hypr.sh, which never overwrites an existing file, and gitignored). You can `git pull` without merge conflicts.

Live recolor of the whole desktop from one wallpaper choice: matugen feeds eww SCSS, kitty, rofi, a vim colorscheme and a lush.nvim JSON. update-color.sh then pushes the change to running apps with `kitty @ --to unix:$SOCKET set-colors -a -c ...` and `nvim --server $sock --remote-send "<cmd>colorscheme lush-colors<CR>"`, so terminals and editors recolor without restarting.
lush.nvim plugin that builds the Neovim theme, including treesitter `@` captures, from a generated JSON palette. A tidy way to theme nvim from a palette at runtime.
eww wallpaper picker panel fed by ImageMagick thumbnails (`preview-*.jpg`, 800x600 at quality 50) built automatically when the picker opens.

Vertical eww sidebar: vertical music seek bar with the title rotated 90 degrees (`:angle 90`), cover art, circular-progress rings for battery and memory, and volume/brightness sliders that slide up on hover (300ms).
Media keys call `wpctl`/`brightnessctl` and then `qs ipc call volume update`, so the shell's OSD refreshes by push instead of polling.
One branded box-drawing logo ("zenities") reused in the installer banner, fastfetch and the alpha-nvim dashboard.

Installer care: timestamped backups to `~/.zenities_backups/backup_$TS`, symlink-to-repo detection so reruns are idempotent, `stow --restow`, a spinner with 3 retries, and full output logged to install-log.txt.
CI that runs shellcheck and then does a real INSTALL.sh run as a non-root sudo user in an `archlinux:latest` container, plus release tarballs on tags.
Resize and move submaps with repeating arrow keys, and the upstream suppress-maximize and XWayland-drag-fix window rules ported to Lua.
structure_install: Stow-style home mirror: `.config/{bottom,eww,fastfetch,hypr,kitty,matugen,ncspot,nvim,rofi,wallust,yazi,zsh}`, `.local/share/icons/theme_NotwaitaBlack`, `.templates/hypr/*.lua`, `.p10k.zsh`, `.tmux.conf`, `scripts/*.sh` (end up at ~/scripts), `wallpapers/*.jpg` (end up at ~/wallpapers), `screenshots/`, INSTALL.sh, UNINSTALL.sh, .github/workflows/ci.yml. `.stow-local-ignore` excludes the README, the install scripts, .git and .github. Install (Arch only, per the README): `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/hayyaoe/zenities ~/zenities && sh INSTALL.sh`. The script runs `pacman -Syu --noconfirm`, creates the polkitd user and group if missing, installs about 55 CORE_PACKAGES with pacman only, installs rustup stable, backs up conflicting ~/.config dirs, runs `stow --restow --target=$HOME .`, clones eww from git and builds it (`cargo build --release --no-default-features --features=wayland`, copied to /usr/local/bin), then runs hypr.sh (templates), zsh_setup.sh and normalize_wallpaper.sh, clones p10k, disables systemd-resolved and enables NetworkManager, enables bluetooth, chsh to zsh, generates colors for wallpaper 7, and reboots. There is no Nix support and no update script (the sibling repo ishara adds update.sh).

key_snippets.purpose: Wallpaper to matugen to live hot-reload of running apps (worth copying)
key_snippets.excerpt:
run_if_exists matugen --source-color-index 0 -m dark image "$WP_PATH"

if [[ "$RELOAD_APPS" == "--generate-only" || "$RELOAD_APPS" == "-g" ]]; then
    echo "Generate only. Skipping app reload."
    exit 0
fi

if command -v hyprpaper >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    safe_kill hyprpaper
    hyprpaper -c "$HOME/.config/hypr/service/hyprpaper.conf" &
fi

if pgrep -x "eww" >/dev/null; then
    killall eww
    sleep 1
    eww open-many side-bar notifications
else
    eww open-many side-bar notifications
fi

for SOCKET in /tmp/kitty-*; do
    if [ -S "$SOCKET" ]; then
        run_if_exists kitty @ --to "unix:$SOCKET" set-colors -a -c ~/.config/kitty/kitty-colors.conf
    fi
done

for sock in /tmp/nvim*; do
    if [ -S "$sock" ]; then
        run_if_exists nvim --server "$sock" --remote-send "<cmd>colorscheme lush-colors<CR>"
    fi
done

weaknesses: Arch only (pacman calls hardcoded everywhere). No Nix, no flake, no Home Manager.

The shell is half-migrated. Hyprland autostarts `uwsm app -- qs` and the media keys call `qs ipc call ...`, but no quickshell config is committed. The only shell in the repo is eww, built unpinned from git HEAD with cargo. On a fresh install, qs either does nothing or has no config.

The README is badly out of date: it says colors come from pywal, tells you to edit `autogenerated=1` in hyprland.conf (there is no hyprland.conf now), and its keybind tables (ALT+hjkl focus, SUPER+A/P/H/R, SUPER+CTRL move) do not match core/keybinds.lua (arrow focus, ALT+N/ALT+M submaps).

Three generations of color pipeline are committed together: pywal (`wal -i` in select_wallpaper_rofi.sh, and `~/.cache/wal` in UNINSTALL.sh), wallust (wallust.toml with the misspelled `theshold` key and its own templates), and matugen (the active one). There is also a dead `~/ags/colors.scss` target.

The matugen base16 to color0-15 mapping is semantically wrong. ANSI red, green, yellow, blue, magenta and cyan get grayscale values (base01-07), which hurts terminal, tmux and nvim syntax readability. Foreground also differs across apps (base04, base05 or base06).

Lua config bugs: the right-click resize bind passes `{direction = "true"}` instead of `{mouse = true}`; the drag bind passes the string "true"; and `.templates/hypr/inputs.lua` has `accel_profile=flat` unquoted, which is nil in Lua.

The eww scripts still use hyprlang-era dispatch strings: `hyprctl dispatch workspace N`, `hyprctl dispatch exec "[float; size 525 260] kitty ..."`, `hyprctl dispatch exit`. The official 0.55 Lua example uses `hyprctl dispatch 'hl.dsp.exit()'`, so these may break once hyprlang is dropped. I did not test this.

hyprlock.conf and hyprpaper.conf are gitignored as "autogenerated", and I could not find any generator. The lock screen and wallpaper daemon have no config in the repo, and change-wallpaper.sh edits files that may not exist.

INSTALL.sh bugs and heavy-handed steps: the final color-init call is mis-quoted (see snippet), which triggers `exit 1` before the reboot. It disables systemd-resolved system-wide, creates the polkitd user by hand, forces `sudo reboot` after 5s, and pulls p10k from two places (clones ~/powerlevel10k, but .zshrc sources /usr/share/zsh-theme-powerlevel10k, which is never installed).

Missing dependencies: kitty, quickshell, uwsm, hyprlauncher (the default menu in the template) and python-dbus (needed by the notification daemon) are all in Arch extra but not in CORE_PACKAGES. bluetuith is AUR-only and not installed. The fonts Font Awesome 6 and Mononoki are not installed, nor is the kora icon theme.
UNINSTALL.sh has `sed -e` where it means `set -e`, restores `.bak` backups that INSTALL.sh no longer creates (it now uses ~/.zenities_backups), runs `rm -rf ~/zenities` and reboots.

Hardcoded paths and assumptions: ~/wallpapers, ~/scripts, /tmp/kitty and /tmp/nvim* sockets, `playerctl --player=ncspot` only, eww windows only on monitor 0, `$HOME/Workspace` in alpha-nvim, a broken `export PATH="/eww/target/release:$PATH"` in rice.zsh, and an eww workspace-scroll script path (`~/.config/eww/bar/scripts/change-active-workspace.sh`) that does not exist in the tree.
Heavy eww polling: volume, mic, brightness, music seek and volume icon every 1s, and a hypridle pgrep every 2s. Only the workspace modules use the socket2 event stream.

The homemade notification daemon breaks the spec: hints typed a{ss} instead of a{sv}, returns id 0, no GetCapabilities, CloseNotification or actions, fixed 10s timeout, and it hand-escapes strings into yuck markup, which is fragile.
The power buttons (`shutdown now`, `reboot`, `killall Hyprland`) sit in hover-revealed menus with no confirmation.
Licensing: 28 bundled wallpapers with no attribution or license, no LICENSE file for the repo, and a bundled third-party cursor theme (Notwaita fork) credited only in its manifest.
Committed junk: ncspot/userstate.cbor, ncspot/config.toml.bak, and yazi `theme.toml-1763779503160144` / `yazi.toml-1763779503124923` backup files.
Flat look: blur, shadows and borders are all off, and the animation curve is defined but unused. Not much for a rice meant to be cute or eye-catching.
steal_list: Lua Hyprland layout for 0.55+: `hyprland.lua` requires `core.*` (managed) and `user.*` (created from templates once, gitignored, never overwritten). On NixOS, generate `core/` with home-manager `xdg.configFile` and leave `user/` writable, so Arch and NixOS share the same Lua tree.

One wallpaper-driven matugen `config.toml` with a template per app, plus a single `apply-theme` script that hot-reloads running apps: `kitty @ --to unix:<sock> set-colors -a -c <file>` (requires `allow_remote_control yes` + `listen_on unix:/tmp/kitty`), `nvim --server <sock> --remote-send '<cmd>colorscheme ...<CR>'`, and a shell IPC reload. Fix their mapping: use Material roles (primary, secondary, tertiary, error, surface_*) or base16 base08-0F for ANSI accents, and pick a pastel-leaning scheme type.
lush.nvim reading a generated JSON palette, so Neovim gets a real theme (including treesitter groups) from the wallpaper palette.
Automatic wallpaper thumbnails (`magick -resize 800x600 -quality 50` to `preview-*.jpg`, skipping ones that exist) feeding a visual picker. Rebuild it in quickshell as a carousel or grid.

Hover reveals for bar modules: sliders, labels and power actions stay hidden and slide out (about 300ms). Plus circular-progress rings for battery and memory, and cover art in the bar. Port these to QML.
Media keys that update volume/brightness and then call `qs ipc call <target> update`, so the OSD is pushed by events instead of polling.
A brand glyph logo reused in the installer banner, fastfetch (`logo.type = file`) and the nvim dashboard, for a consistent identity.

Installer hygiene: timestamped backups, 'already a symlink into repo' detection, `stow --restow`, retry wrapper, and a log file. Add CI that runs shellcheck and a real install in an `archlinux:latest` container, and a matching `nix flake check` / HM build job for NixOS.
UWSM session launch (`uwsm finalize` in `hl.on("hyprland.start")`, `uwsm app -- <cmd>` for autostarts).
Resize and move submaps with `{repeating=true}` arrow binds, and the upstream `suppress_event = "maximize"` and XWayland drag-fix rules.

Avoid their mistakes: pin shell dependencies instead of building eww from HEAD, don't ship unlicensed wallpapers (use a fetch script or CC0 set with attribution), don't disable systemd-resolved or force a reboot, keep the README in sync with the binds, and ship lock-screen and wallpaper-daemon configs instead of gitignoring them.

one_line: A small Arch-only Hyprland rice from July 2023 made by a first-time ricer. The desktop uses Waybar, rofi, dunst, kitty and swww, and pywal16 recolors the whole desktop from the wallpaper, including Discord, Spotify, Telegram, Firefox, Chromium and cava. The config syntax is badly outdated and several parts are broken; its value is as a list of ideas, not as a base to build on.
freshness: The repo is dead. It has 20 commits, all between 2023-07-24 ("ready to go") and 2023-07-30 ("Update hyprland.conf", plus new env_var.conf and env_nvidia.conf). There is nothing after that, so it is more than 3 years stale as of 2026-09-25. It has 88 stars and 5 forks, and its topics are hyprland, hyprland-arch and waybar. No license file is visible on the repo page, and there are no releases. The README credits 1amSimp1e/dots (late-night), rchrdwllm/dotfiles and JaKooLit/Hyprland-v3. install.sh still prints "Installing rchrdwllm's dotfiles...", which shows how much was forked. I could not view the 5 screenshots (ScreenShots/preview*.png) because the README has no captions and I could not render the images, so the visual verdict below comes from the config values only.

aesthetic.palette: The dynamic palette comes from pywal16 (`wal -i <wall> --cols16`). Several files also hardcode a dark Tokyo-Night/Nord mix. Waybar: bar bg rgba(26,27,38,0.5) (#1a1b26 Tokyo Night), module pills #1f2530, launcher and power pills #1b242b, text #e5e5e5, active workspace #6a92d7, focused workspace #bf616a (Nord red), inactive workspace #7984A4, urgent #eb4d4b, cpu #fb958b, memory #ebcb8b, audio #7d9bba, backlight #8fbcbb, clock #c8d2e0 with a #bf616a icon span, battery #c0caf5, charging #26a65b, critical #f53c3c, network #b48ead. Weather classes: sunnyDay #c2ca76, clearNight #cad3f5, rainy #5aaca5, severe #eb937d. Hyprland: active border 0xff5e81ac, inactive 0x66333333, shadow 0xffa7caff, inactive shadow 0x50000000. Kitty (static): bg #14151e, fg #98b0d3, color0 #151720, color1 #dd6777, color2 #90ceaa, color3 #ecd3a0, color4 #86aaec, color5 #c296eb, color6 #93cee9, color7 #cbced3, color8 #4f5572, url #5de4c7, active border #3d59a1. Rofi: bg #15161E, bg-alt #1A1B26, fg #C0CAF5, selected #FB958B, active #414868, urgent #F7768E (Tokyo Night). The power menu uses selected #33467C. Dunst: bg #0d0f16, fg #CDD6F4, frame #1C2325/#191d24, highlight #7ba5dd, critical and volume highlight #ee6a70, backlight #ffb29b. SDDM sugar-candy: Main #c0c0c0, Accent #376591, BG #050506. The committed cava gradient (generated by wal) is #3C66BB, #645C90, #A16BA3, #E57AB1. The adi1090x launcher is set to onedark (#1B1B23 / #61AFEF / #98C379 / #E06C75) but is never used.
aesthetic.color_pipeline: pywal16 (eylles/pywal16, installed by hand with pip --break-system-packages) is run from the rofi wallpaper picker (Super+W) and on startup (initWall runs `wal -R --cols16`). Templates in ~/.config/wal/templates: colors-hyprland.conf ($background/$color11/$color14), colors-rofi.rasi, kitty.conf, colors-cava.cava (gradient color10 to color13), colors-spicetify.ini, colors-bashtop.theme. After running wal, scripts call `pywalfox update` (Firefox), `pywal-discord -t default` (BetterDiscord), `wal-telegram --wal`, and copy-and-rename scripts for spicetify's color.ini and cava's config. swaylock sources ~/.cache/wal/colors.sh. userChrome.css and the Firefox startpage @import file:///home/irako/.cache/wal/colors.css. generate-theme.sh (from ChromiumPywal) builds a Chromium MV3 theme manifest from colors.sh. VS Code uses the Wal theme extension. Bugs: hyprland.conf sources the raw template (/home/irako/.config/wal/templates/colors-hyprland.conf) instead of the generated ~/.cache/wal file, and it never uses those variables because the borders are hardcoded. So Hyprland itself never changes color. Waybar style.css and dunstrc are fully static, so the bar and notifications don't follow the wallpaper either.
aesthetic.fonts: 'Font Awesome' is set as the main font almost everywhere: kitty font_family, rofi ('Font Awesome 10.6' / 10.5 / 10), Waybar (* font-family: Font Awesome; 17px), swaylock ('Font Awesome:style=Thin,Regular 40'), Firefox userChrome and startpage, and SDDM. That is an icon font, so real text falls back to whatever fontconfig picks. Dunst uses 'Product Sans', which is proprietary and not installed by the script. GTK uses 'Inter 11'. The repo bundles assets/MesloLGS NF Regular.ttf, but the README says you need CascadiaMono.zip from 1amSimp1e/fonts. The installer adds otf-font-awesome, otf-font-awesome-4 and ttf-font-awesome. Waybar uses old Nerd Font v2 codepoints (e.g. 直, 睊, 婢), which were removed in Nerd Fonts v3.
aesthetic.icons_cursor_gtk_qt: The GTK theme is WhiteSur-Dark (whitesur-gtk-theme-git), icons are Papirus (whitesur-icon-theme-git is also installed), and the cursor is WhiteSur-cursors with XCURSOR_SIZE 18 in hyprland.conf and gtk-cursor-theme-size=0 in settings.ini. These are applied by a gsettings script (hypr/scripts/gtkthemes) plus gtk-3.0/settings.ini. There is no Qt/Kvantum theming. qt5ct only appears in commented-out env lines.
aesthetic.geometry: Hyprland: gaps_in 5, gaps_out 10, border_size 2, rounding 5. Blur: size 10, passes 4, blur_new_optimizations true, blurls=waybar and blurls=lockscreen. Shadow: drop_shadow true, range 5, render_power 3. Opacity: active 0.95, inactive 0.8, fullscreen 1.0; kitty, thunar and code get windowrulev2 opacity 0.8 0.8. Waybar: height 30, margin-top 6, left/right 10, spacing 5, window border-radius 8px, module pills radius 9.5px, workspaces pill 7.8px, launcher and power pills 7.5px, padding 0 10px. Rofi: launcher 400px wide, radius 10, padding 30, 8 lines. Wallpaper picker: 800px wide, radius 20, 2 columns x 10 lines, element radius 20. Power menu: 400px, radius 12, confirm dialog 250px. Dunst: width 320, offset 10x12, corner_radius 17, frame_width 3, padding 16/12, progress_bar_height 14, icons 32 to 48. swaylock: indicator-radius 80, thickness 5, effect-blur 10x20, vignette 0.2:0.2, fade-in 0.5. Kitty: window_padding_width 20, font_size 13. SDDM sugar-candy: RoundCorners 20, shadow 6 at 0.6. Anime SDDM: FastBlur radius animates 0 to 30 over 300ms.
aesthetic.animations: Animations are disabled: `animations { enabled=no }`. The defined but inactive values are `bezier=overshot,0.13,0.99,0.29,1.1` (a commented alternative is 0.05,0.9,0.1,1.1), windows 1,4,overshot,popin; fade 1,10,default; workspaces 1,6,overshot,slide; border 1,10,default. Per-window `animation popin` rules exist for kitty/update-sys, thunar and chromium. The only motion that actually runs is the swww wallpaper change: `--transition-type grow --transition-fps 60 --transition-duration 1.0 --transition-bezier 0.65,0,0.35,1 --transition-step 255`. Waybar has a 0.5s background transition and a blinking critical-battery keyframe. SDDM has opacity and blur state transitions of 100 and 300ms.
aesthetic.wallpapers: Three wallpapers ship in .config/hypr/wallpapers: aesthetic-anime-bedroom.jpg, backpacker.jpg and girl-clouds.png. There is also Anime/background.jpg for SDDM, and sugar-candy Backgrounds (Colorful Dune, Desert, Dune, Mountain, Rocks, Undraw.svg, samurai_strike.jpg). None have attribution or license. The anime images are likely third-party art. The Super+W rofi picker selects from the wallpaper folder, and the choice is saved in ~/.cache/mywall.
aesthetic.vibe: It is a typical mid-2023 r/unixporn-style dark 'anime Tokyo-Night' Hyprland setup: translucent pill Waybar, blurred windows at 0.8 opacity, and pywal recoloring that reaches unusually far (Spotify, Discord, Telegram, Firefox, Chromium, cava). It is not really cute or pastel. The static colors are cool navy/blue with Nord accents, window corners are sharp (rounding 5), and animations are off, so it would feel static and a bit dated. Polish is low. Colors are split between wal-driven and hardcoded, there are no real text fonts, and the config has syntax errors. Overall it looks decent in screenshots but falls apart on inspection. As a reference its value is the breadth of apps it themes, not its visual design.

components.compositor: Hyprland, installed as hyprland-git from the AUR, in a single ~/.config/hypr/hyprland.conf. configs/env_var.conf and env_nvidia.conf exist, but their `source` lines are commented out. The installer tries to uncomment them with sed on the misspelled path 'dotfiles/.congif/hypr/hyprland.conf', so that never works. Keyboard layout is hardcoded to `it` and the monitor to `,highres,auto,1`. Layout is dwindle with pseudotile.
components.bar_or_shell: Waybar (dotfiles/.config/waybar/config + style.css). Left: custom/launcher, cpu, memory, wlr/workspaces, custom/weather (wttrbar --location Munich). Center: custom/spotify (mediaplayer.py). Right: tray, backlight, pulseaudio, network (click opens rofi-wifi-menu.sh), battery, clock, custom/power-menu. A bluetooth module with rofi-bluetooth is defined but not placed in the bar. eww is installed and `exec-once=eww open bar` is commented out. There is no eww config in the repo, only a leftover dunst to eww popup script.
components.launcher: rofi, using adi1090x configs. Super+Space runs `rofi -show drun` with ~/.config/rofi/config.rasi (400px, icons off, Tokyo Night colors). The rofi wallpaper picker (rofi/scripts/wallpaper, style.rasi) and the power menu (waybar/scripts/power-menu/powermenu.sh with a Yes/No confirm dialog) also use rofi. The full adi1090x launcher pack (style-1 to style-15, 16 color schemes: adapta, arc, black, catppuccin, cyberpunk, dracula, everforest, gruvbox, lovelace, navy, nord, onedark, paper, solarized, tokyonight, yousai) is bundled under hypr/scripts/appLaunch, but nothing is bound to launcher.sh. The wallpaper script references wofi, which is never installed.
components.notifications: dunst, configured in dunstrc. Font 'Product Sans', top-right, corner_radius 17, progress bar enabled. Volume and backlight OSD notifications use set_stack_tag rules plus `dunstify -h int:value:$vol -r 2593` from hypr/scripts/volume and brightness. A songArtLogger.sh rule fetches Spotify cover art (rewriting open.spotify.com to i.scdn.co). Critical notifications play a sound with canberra-gtk-play. Custom icon PNGs are in dunst/assets/ui.
components.lock_idle_logout: Lock is swaylock-effects via hypr/scripts/lock: --screenshots, blur 10x20, vignette, clock, indicator colors from pywal colors.sh. It is only reachable from the rofi power menu (Super+X). Super+L runs `wlogout`, but wlogout is neither installed nor configured. There is no idle daemon (no swayidle or hypridle), so the screen never auto-locks. The power menu offers lock, suspend (which runs `mpc -q pause` and `amixer set Master mute` first), logout (`hyprctl dispatch exit 1`), reboot and shutdown.
components.wallpaper_tool: swww. The picker runs `swww kill`, then `swww init`, then `swww img` with a grow transition. initWall also starts swww, but then sets the wallpaper with swaybg, so two wallpaper daemons conflict. `swww init` is the old invocation; newer releases use swww-daemon.
components.terminal: kitty, on Wayland. font_family is 'Font Awesome' (wrong), size 13, padding 20, static dark palette, tab_bar_style fade. There is also a wal kitty.conf template, but the static kitty.conf never includes the generated colors. Colors reach the terminal through `cat ~/.cache/wal/sequences` in .zshrc.
components.shell_prompt: zsh with oh-my-zsh and powerlevel10k (.p10k.zsh, patched to show the pyenv venv), plus zsh-autosuggestions and zsh-syntax-highlighting. .zshrc runs neofetch with a custom braille-art logo, cats the wal sequences twice, sources colors-tty.sh, and runs pyenv init. It has bleachbit aliases, and one of them has a stray trailing 'p' typo.
components.editor: Neovim, an NvChad v2-era core/plugins layout set up for Python (mason, lspconfig, cmp, telescope, treesitter, nvimtree). The README install steps hardcode /home/irako. VS Code (visual-studio-code-bin) uses the dlasagno Wal theme.
components.file_manager: Thunar with volman, tumbler and archive plugin (optional in the installer), plus ranger (Super+Shift+Enter runs `kitty ranger`, and the ranger config includes scope.sh and rifle.conf).
components.fetch: neofetch (upstream archived in 2024) with an ASCII backend, a custom braille logo.txt, and colors=(distro).
components.login_boot: SDDM. install.sh copies both the sugar-candy theme (background samurai_strike.jpg, HeaderText 'Hello, Irako!', FormPosition left, RoundCorners 20) and an 'Anime' theme, then sets Current=Anime. The Anime theme's metadata says it is the 'Elegant' theme, CC-BY-SA. It is Qt5 QML using QtGraphicalEffects FastBlur, with Deepin/KDE/XFCE session indicator PNGs and a user avatar copied from irako.png. SDDM config goes to /lib/sddm/sddm.conf.d/default.conf. There is no GRUB, Limine or systemd-boot theme and no Plymouth.
components.extras: cava (4-color gradient from wal), spicetify 'Pywal' theme (restarted via Ctrl+Alt+S, which runs `kitty cava & spicetify watch -s`), BetterDiscord with pywal-discord, wal-telegram, pywalfox for Firefox, a Firefox userChrome.css that hides tab favicons and uses wal tab colors, a custom Firefox startpage (index.html, clock via time.js, 4 bookmark columns), a ChromiumPywal theme generator, grim+slurp to swappy on Super+P, a committed hyprpicker ELF binary (68 KB) plus hyprPicker.sh (convert to dunstify color swatch; bind commented out), a wf-recorder bind (commented), tmux with tpm (prefix C-Space), wttrbar weather, mediaplayer.py, rofi-wifi-menu.sh, rofi-bluetooth, a bashtop wal template, tty-clock, pipes.sh, and blueman-applet.

standout_features: One wallpaper change updates the colors of many apps. Super+W opens a rofi picker, then swww does a grow transition, then `wal --cols16` runs, then pywalfox, pywal-discord, wal-telegram, spicetify and cava are recolored in one pass. That covers Spotify, Discord, Telegram, Firefox and Chromium, which is wider than most rices.

pywal16 (16-color variant) is used instead of stock pywal, so templates can use the bright colors color9 to color15 as accents: rofi selected=color9, spicetify button=color9/color14, cava gradient color10 to color13.

Dunst is used as an OSD. Volume and brightness scripts send `dunstify -h int:value:N -r 2593` with a progress bar, dunstrc gives them stack tags and custom highlights, and a notification sound plays through canberra-gtk-play.
A dunst rule script (songArtLogger.sh) downloads the current Spotify track's album art (rewriting the artUrl to i.scdn.co) and caches it for media notifications.
The Chromium theme generator writes a manifest_version 3 theme.json from pywal colors (frame=background, toolbar=color11, ntp_link=color11) and uses the wallpaper as the new-tab background.
Firefox gets both a pywal-driven userChrome.css (tab colors, hidden favicons) and a local startpage (big clock, quote, 4-column bookmark grid) that imports ~/.cache/wal/colors.css.
The Waybar weather module colors itself per wttrbar class (sunnyDay #c2ca76, clearNight #cad3f5, rainy #5aaca5, snowy #d6e7e5, severe #eb937d).
The lockscreen is swaylock-effects themed from wal's colors.sh at lock time: screenshot blur 10x20, vignette 0.2:0.2, radius-80 ring, 0.5s fade-in.
The rofi power menu shows hostname and uptime (`uptime -p`) in the header and asks Yes/No before shutdown, reboot, suspend or logout.
structure_install: Layout: README.md; ScreenShots/preview{,1..4}.png; assets/MesloLGS NF Regular.ttf; wasami-rice.sh (stage 1); and dotfiles/, which contains .config/{BetterDiscord,cava,dunst,firefox,gtk-3.0,hypr,kitty,neofetch,nvim,ranger,rofi,spicetify,swappy,tmux,wal,waybar}, .local/bin/generate-theme.sh, .zshrc, .p10k.zsh, Anime/ (SDDM theme), usr/share/sddm/themes/sugar-candy, lib/sddm/sddm.conf.d/default.conf, irako.png (avatar) and install.sh (stage 2). The target is a fresh minimal Arch install with pipewire, systemd-boot and NetworkManager. Stage 1, wasami-rice.sh, refuses to run as root, installs yay-bin or paru-bin, runs -Syu, and detects NVIDIA through lspci. With NVIDIA it adds nvidia-dkms, libva-nvidia-driver-git, mkinitcpio MODULES and modeset=1. It then installs hyprland-git and package arrays: prep_stage (brightnessctl dunst eww grimblast-git swww swaybg swaylock-effects rofi kitty wttrbar sddm-sugar-candy-git xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland/-wlr ...), themes_stage (whitesur gtk/icon/cursor, papirus, font-awesome), software_stage (vscode, firefox-developer-edition, discord, betterdiscord, telegram, pywalfox, pywal-discord-git, wal-telegram-git, spotify, spicetify-cli, cava, chromium ...) and other_toys (neovim tmux zsh waybar docker pyenv bleachbit-cli ...). Thunar and Bluetooth are optional, and it copies the ttf fonts to ~/.fonts. Stage 2, dotfiles/install.sh, runs `cp -r .config $HOME`, copies the SDDM themes with sudo, runs sed to replace 'irako' with $USER (after the copy, and on wrong 'dotfiles/...' paths), enables sddm and bluetooth (without sudo), and seeds a first palette with a random wallpaper and `wal -i ... --cols16`. The remaining setup is manual README steps: oh-my-zsh, p10k and plugins; pywal16 via pip --break-system-packages; chmod on /opt/spotify plus spicetify backup apply; betterdiscordctl install; editing the Firefox CSS username; and cloning NvChad. There is no symlink manager (stow, chezmoi) and no idempotency.

key_snippets.purpose: The core of the theme pipeline: pick a wallpaper in rofi, apply it with an swww transition, regenerate pywal16 colors, and push them to other apps.
key_snippets.excerpt:
wallpapers=$HOME/.config/hypr/wallpapers
image="$(ls $wallpapers | rofi -dmenu -i -p "  Select wallpaper: " -theme ${dir}/${theme}.rasi)"
wallpaper=$wallpapers/$image

# Save the new wallpepers so Hyprland will pick it up next boot
echo $wallpapers/$image > $HOME/.cache/mywall
...
swww kill

swww init

swww img $wallpaper --transition-type grow --transition-fps 60 --transition-duration 1.0 --transition-bezier 0.65,0,0.35,1 --transition-step 255

echo $wallpaper
wal -i $wallpaper --cols16
pywalfox update
pywal-discord -t default
wal-telegram --wal

. $HOME/.config/spicetify/Themes/Pywal/update-colors.sh
. $HOME/.config/cava/scripts/update-colors.sh
