key_snippets.purpose: Example pywal template mapping 16 colors onto Spotify (spicetify). The cava template is similar, a 4-stop gradient from color10 to color13.

weaknesses: Hyprland syntax from 2023 that current Hyprland rejects or has replaced: `blur=yes`, `blur_size`, `blur_passes` and `blur_new_optimizations` as flat decoration keys (now the decoration:blur{} subsection); `drop_shadow`, `shadow_range` and `col.shadow` (now decoration:shadow{}); `blurls=` (now layerrule blur); `master { new_is_master }` (removed); `general { sensitivity, apply_sens_to_raw }`; `gestures { workspace_swipe }` (replaced by the gesture keyword); old v1 `windowrule = float,^(pavucontrol)$` and `windowrule=tile,spotify` plus separate windowrulev2 (merged or reworked in later releases); `misc:suppress_portal_warnings`. Newer Hyprland versions would print many config errors.

Actual config errors: a bare line `^.*nvim.*$` in hyprland.conf; `bind = $mainMod, mouse_up, workspace, e-1s` (typo); in the volume script `[$volume -gt 0 ]` is missing a space; the brightness get_icon uses `("$current" -ge "0")` (runs a command instead of a test).

The pywal integration is broken where it matters most. Hyprland sources the raw template in ~/.config/wal/templates, which contains literal `{background.strip}`, instead of ~/.cache/wal/colors-hyprland.conf, and the variables are never used. Waybar CSS, dunstrc and kitty.conf are all static hex, so the bar, notifications and borders don't change with the wallpaper.

Username 'irako' is hardcoded everywhere: `source = /home/irako/...`, Firefox `@import file:///home/irako/.cache/wal/colors.css`, the BetterDiscord CSS wallpaper path /home/irako/Wallpapers/bigsur-dark.jpg, the SDDM HeaderText 'Hello, Irako!', irako.png, and the README's NvChad clone path. install.sh's sed fixes run after the copy, on wrong relative paths (dotfiles/... from inside dotfiles/), and one has a broken quote: `sed -i "s/irako/$USER"/ ...`.

Other hardcoded machine-specific values: kb_layout=it, weather `--location Munich`, Waybar backlight device "DP-1" (not a backlight device), battery BAT0/ADP0, startpage.sh serving ~/Repos/PersonalProjects/startpage (which doesn't exist in the repo), and an LAN IP-free but user-specific bookmark list.

Install scripts are fragile: a stray `for str in ${myArray[@]}` loop; `cat logo.txt` for a file not at the repo root; sed on the misspelled path `dotfiles/.congif/...`; `mkinitcpio --generate /boot/initramfs-custom.img`, which writes an image nothing boots; `sudo echo ... | sudo tee`; `systemctl enable sddm.service` without sudo; `set -e` combined with `| tee` loops; pywal16 installed with `pip --break-system-packages`; the unstable hyprland-git and a separate wlroots package; both xdg-desktop-portal-wlr and -hyprland installed.

Old portal hacks (xdgdesktop and screensharing.sh) killall and relaunch the portals from different paths (/usr/lib vs /usr/libexec) at startup. That was a JaKooLit v3-era workaround, and systemd user services make it unnecessary.

Font Awesome is used as the text font in kitty, rofi, Waybar, swaylock, Firefox and SDDM. Dunst depends on proprietary 'Product Sans'. Waybar uses Nerd Font v2 codepoints (直, 睊, 婢) that were removed in Nerd Fonts v3, and Waybar's `wlr/workspaces` module was replaced by `hyprland/workspaces`.
Animations are disabled, rounding is only 5, and there is no idle or auto-lock (no hypridle or swayidle). Super+L calls wlogout, which is not installed or configured.

Conflicting and dead components: swaybg and swww both set the wallpaper (initWall runs `swww init`, then swaybg); eww, light, gegl and wofi are referenced or installed but unused; the adi1090x launcher pack (15 styles, 16 schemes) is bundled but never bound; the eww popup script points at ~/.local/bin/eww.

Committed binary and generated artifacts: a 68 KB hyprpicker ELF in hypr/scripts; a pywal-generated BetterDiscord CSS, spicetify color.ini and cava config; neofetch config.conf.bck. Cava's update script replaces the whole cava config with the color-only template.

Licensing: wallpapers (anime bedroom, girl-clouds, backpacker, Anime/background.jpg, samurai_strike.jpg) have no attribution. The SDDM 'Anime' theme is a renamed copy of 'Elegant' (CC-BY-SA) that keeps the metadata Name=Elegant. The repo itself has no visible license. SDDM themes are Qt5-only (QtGraphicalEffects), which is at risk as SDDM and distros move to Qt6.

Uses unmaintained or archived tools: neofetch (archived), `swww init` (deprecated in favor of swww-daemon), BetterDiscord with pywal-discord (breaks often), powerlevel10k (the maintainer says it has very limited support), and NvChad v2 layout copied by hand.
There is no NixOS support of any kind, and the scripts are Arch/AUR-only.
steal_list: Keep the 'one wallpaper, whole-desktop recolor' idea, but move it to matugen (Material You) or wallust with proper templates rendered into ~/.cache or ~/.config: Hyprland col.active_border via a sourced generated file, Waybar/quickshell CSS @import, rofi colors.rasi, kitty `include`, dunst or swaync, hyprlock, spicetify color.ini, pywalfox, vesktop/Discord CSS, cava gradient, gtk.css. On NixOS, reproduce the static part with Stylix and keep matugen for runtime switching.

Adapt the wallpaper picker flow (rofi or a grid thumbnail picker, then a swww/awww transition, then color regeneration, then hooks) and save the last wallpaper to ~/.cache so boot can restore it. Reuse the swww transition values (`--transition-type grow --transition-fps 60 --transition-duration 1.0 --transition-bezier 0.65,0,0.35,1`), or use 'wipe'/'outer' at 144 fps for smoother motion.
Use the 16-color palette (pywal16 --cols16, or matugen/wallust equivalents) and map accents deliberately: selected=color9, active=color11/14, gradients color10 to color13 for cava.

Volume and brightness OSD through a notification daemon, with a progress-value hint, a fixed replace ID or x-canonical-private-synchronous stack tag, and a soft canberra sound. Or upgrade to swayosd or a quickshell OSD.
Lockscreen colors read from the generated palette at lock time. Rebuild it with hyprlock (blur, vignette, clock, avatar) instead of swaylock-effects, and add hypridle for auto-lock and DPMS.
The rofi power menu with a hostname and uptime header and a two-column Yes/No confirm dialog (adi1090x type-1 pattern), restyled pastel with rounded 20px elements.
Per-condition colored weather in the bar using wttrbar's CSS classes (sunnyDay, clearNight, rainy, snowy, severe) with pastel colors.
Spotify album-art cache script (artUrl rewritten to i.scdn.co) to feed media notifications or a now-playing widget.

Pywal/matugen-driven Firefox extras: userChrome tab colors plus a local startpage (big clock, quote, bookmark grid) importing the generated colors.css. Also the Chromium MV3 theme generator from palette plus wallpaper.

Do NOT copy: flat Hyprland blur/shadow keys, v1 windowrules, hardcoded /home/<user> paths, Font Awesome as a UI font, committed binaries and generated files, killall portal hacks, or unattributed wallpapers. Use current Hyprland decoration{blur{},shadow{}}, layerrules, `$HOME`/XDG vars, a real UI font (e.g. Inter/Rubik/Lexend plus JetBrainsMono/Maple Mono NF), and ship only CC0 or credited art.

one_line: A small Nord-flavoured Hyprland + Waybar + rofi (adi1090x) + dunst + foot rice for Arch. Its standout pieces are a music-centric hyprlock (album-art card and song labels) and an event-driven Spotify pill cluster in Waybar. There is no install script and no Nix support, and many paths are hardcoded to /home/tdm.
freshness: 58 commits between Jul 27 2023 ("The top bar") and Mar 10 2026 (latest: "Added a sidebar", which adds waybar/Sidebar using niri/* modules). There were bursts of activity in Sep 2024 (grimblast), Nov 2024 (hyprlock and its preview) and Mar–May 2025 ("Updated Config", plus an IME-switch notification commit written in Vietnamese). 66 stars, 3 forks, and no license shown on the repo page. The config is partially updated for newer Hyprland: it has the `shadow {}` block and `windowrule = float, class:...`, but it still mixes in windowrulev2 and `gestures { workspace_swipe }`. The newest commit suggests the author is moving toward niri.

aesthetic.palette: Nord-based, with a darker 'Nordic' base and a few warm pastel accents. Surfaces: #242933 (waybar window, tooltip, dunst bg), #3B4252 (pills, bar border, foot regular0), #2E3440 (foot bg, inactive border, rofi bg), #383E4A (rofi bg-alt), #617180 (sidebar hover/slider bg), #4C566A. Text: #D8DEE9 (foot fg), #E5E9F0, #ECEFF4, #d1cfcf (dunst/hyprlock text, rgba(209,207,207,0.75) on lock), #8a909e (clock), #85909e (empty workspaces), #676f82 (rofi placeholder). Blues: #85b4ea (active border, dunst frame, lock image border rgb(133,180,234)), #85b4ee (cava bars), #81A1C1 (active workspace, rofi selected, volume), #88C0D0, #8FBCBB, #5E81AC (network), #7a95c9 (launcher icon), #6BA0DE (misc launchpad accent). Warm accents: #fa9f8e (salmon, cpu/workspaces), #b9fac2 (mint, memory), #d4d2a9 (workspace dots), #e78284 (power button, Catppuccin Frappe red), #fb958b (muted/disconnected), #ecd3a0 (warning). Foot ANSI palette is stock Nord (#BF616A #A3BE8C #EBCB8B #81A1C1 #B48EAD #88C0D0 #E5E9F0). The unused rofi powermenu 'nordic' style has #425775 #475C7B #FDBB6D #DA717F #685E79 #DA4453. Calendar markup uses #8fbcbb, #8a909e, #99ffdd, #81a1c1 and #88c0d0. Dunst critical: bg #900000, frame #ff0000.
aesthetic.color_pipeline: Static, hand-coded hex in every file. No pywal, matugen, wallust or stylix. rofi shares one colour file (rofi/colors/nord.rasi) through @import in shared/colors.rasi. Everything else (waybar CSS, dunst, foot, hyprland, hyprlock, cava) duplicates the hex values by hand. The Sidebar CSS references undefined GTK colour variables @gruv-beige, @gruv-green and @hover-black, left over from a copied gruvbox config.
aesthetic.fonts: JetBrainsMono Nerd Font (waybar, rofi powermenu at 15), Iosevka Nerd Font (rofi launcher at 13; waybar clock/cpu/memory at 16–17px), Material Design Icons (first in the waybar font stack), Source Code Pro (foot at size 12, dunst 'source-code-pro 12', hyprlock song labels 'Source Code Pro bold' 17/15), 'JetBrains Mono' 22 for the lock date, 'JetBrains Mono Extrabold' 95 for the lock clock, 'feather' icon font (powermenu glyphs at 24 and 64), FantasqueSansMono Nerd Font and 'Noto Sans Bold 10' (legacy rofi misc themes), WenQuanYi Micro Hei (CJK fallback).
aesthetic.icons_cursor_gtk_qt: Papirus icon theme (dunst icon_theme = Papirus with recursive lookup; rofi launchpad icon-theme Papirus). Cursor 'elementary' set by `hyprctl setcursor elementary 20`, but env sets XCURSOR_SIZE=27, so the sizes disagree. No GTK or Qt theme, kvantum, qt5ct or nwg-look config in the repo. Thunar is the file manager.
aesthetic.geometry: Hyprland: gaps_in 5, gaps_out 10, border_size 3, active rgb(85b4ea) (solid, no gradient), inactive rgb(2E3440), rounding 5. Blur is DISABLED (enabled = false; size 5 and passes 2 are unused). Shadow: range 100, render_power 5, color 0x53000000, color_inactive 0x32000000. No opacity rules. Waybar: floating bar with margins 10/10/10, height 30, window radius 8px, 3px solid #3b4252 border. Pills are #3b4252 with 8px radius and 10px margins, and adjacent pills are fused with negative margins (-5px) and half radii. rofi launcher: 600px wide, 8px window radius, 3px bordered inputbar with 5px radius, 32px icons, 7 lines. Powermenu: 115px column anchored east with x-offset -15px, 3px border, 8px radius, 20px element padding. Dunst: corner_radius 8, frame_width 3, width (0,600), height 130, top-center, offset 10x15, icon_corner_radius 5, progress bar height 10. Hyprlock: input field 250x60, rounding 32, transparent outer and rgba(0,0,0,0.2) inner, background blur_passes 2 with brightness 0.6, vibrancy 0.2. Album-art image is 256px with rounding 6, border 3 and a commented rotate = -6 variant. Foot pad 20x20. Sidebar waybar: width 50, height 700, margins 4, pills with 8px margin and 8px radius.
aesthetic.animations: bezier=overshot,0.13,0.99,0.29,1.1 (an earlier 0.05,0.9,0.1,1.1 is commented out). animation=windows,1,3,overshot; border,1,10,default; fade,1,5,default; workspaces,1,5,overshot,slide. Waybar: @keyframes button_activate (opacity .3→1, 0.3s ease-in-out). The active workspace grows via padding 0 13px with transition all 0.3s. Hover shows a radial-gradient glow. The Sidebar sets a global `transition: 0.25s ease-out` and 250ms drawer transitions. swww wallpaper transition: `--transition-type grow --transition-pos 0.045,0.945` (grows from the bottom-left).
aesthetic.wallpapers: None bundled. Hardcoded path /home/tdm/Pictures/Wallpapers/IMG_3620.PNG is used by both swww and hyprlock. The screenshots show a dusky blue bokeh string-lights photo on the desktop and a blurred pink-and-blue sunset on the lock screen. Previews/Preview1.png also shows Spotify album art (third-party cover art, but only in the screenshots). A waybar right-click action calls ~/.config/waybar/scripts/swww.sh, which is not in the repo.
aesthetic.vibe: A cozy 'Nord at dusk' look: muted slate-blue floating bar made of pills, soft salmon, mint and cream accents, flat opaque surfaces, no blur, and music front and centre (Spotify pills, a cava panel, album art on the lock screen). It looks tidy and pleasant in screenshots and has a lo-fi cuteness, but it is not pastel/kawaii and not especially polished. Colours are hand-duplicated, one accent (#e78284) is borrowed from Catppuccin, and much of the rofi and powermenu work is stock adi1090x themes. Honest rating: roughly 6/10 for looks and 4/10 for engineering. It is worth mining for a few ideas, such as the lock-screen music card and the fused pills, but not as a base.

components.compositor: Hyprland: a single hyprland.conf plus a sourced bind.conf. The latest commit adds a Waybar sidebar built for niri (niri/workspaces, niri msg action toggle-overview), but there is no niri config in the repo.
components.bar_or_shell: Waybar, with two configs. (1) Top floating bar (waybar/config + style.css). Left: custom/launcher, hyprland/workspaces (4 persistent), cpu, memory. Centre: custom/song_name, custom/pre, custom/spotify, custom/next, all driven by Python playerctl GLib scripts. Right: tray, custom/ibus (EN/VN), network, pulseaudio, clock with a calendar tooltip, custom/powermenu. (2) waybar/Sidebar: a vertical left bar 50px wide with niri/workspaces rotated 270°, drawer groups (group/tray, group/more → group/audio and group/brightness with vertical sliders), battery, a stacked clock '{:%H\n%M}', and a power button.
components.launcher: rofi (the lbonn Wayland fork per the README) with adi1090x launchers type-2 style-1 (Nord, Iosevka Nerd Font 13, drun only, 'Search...' placeholder). A legacy misc/launchpad.rasi offers a fullscreen 7x4 grid with 81px icons, but it is launched with -x11.
components.notifications: dunst (dunst/hyprdunst, started with `dunst -conf .config/dunst/hyprdunst`). Top-centre, 3px #85b4ea frame, 8px radius, source-code-pro 12, Papirus icons, progress bar enabled. Replace IDs are used for screenshot and IME-toggle toasts. avizo (avizo-service and volumectl) provides the volume OSD.
components.lock_idle_logout: hyprlock.conf: blurred wallpaper, date and a JetBrains Mono Extrabold 95pt clock, transparent pill input, a 256px album-art image refreshed every 2s via art.sh, song title and artist labels, and network and IME labels in the top-right. However, SUPER+L and the powermenu's lock both call gtklock, not hyprlock. There is no idle daemon (no hypridle or swayidle). Logout/power uses the rofi powermenu type-2 style-5 (a vertical east-docked column with feather icons and a yes/no confirm dialog); logout runs `killall Hyprland`.
components.wallpaper_tool: swww (swww-daemon + swww img with a grow transition). A swww.sh picker script is referenced but missing from the repo.
components.terminal: foot in server mode (foot --server + footclient on SUPER+Return). Font 'source code pro:size=12', pad 20x20, Nord 16-colour palette, alpha=1.
components.shell_prompt: Not included. The waybar window rewrite rule mentions fish, but there is no shell or prompt config.
components.editor: Not included.
components.file_manager: Thunar (bound to SUPER+E); no config included.
components.fetch: neofetch, with a custom braille-art ascii.txt and print_info rows styled as coloured '██ Label' blocks using bold ANSI colours cl12–cl17.
components.login_boot: None. No display manager, GRUB, systemd-boot or plymouth theming.
components.extras: cava (60fps, bar_width 1, bar_spacing 1, mono/left, reverse, foreground '#85b4ee', gravity 200); grimblast screenshot script (--freeze copysave area, then a dunstify toast with the image as its icon); copyq clipboard server; ibus with ibus-bamboo for Vietnamese input, with a waybar toggle and notification; polkit-gnome; nm-applet; brave on SUPER+W; Spotify control through playerctl Python scripts; float rules for pavucontrol, KDE Connect, localsend, steam and xdg-desktop-portal-gtk.

standout_features: Music-first hyprlock. An image widget uses `reload_cmd = ~/.config/hypr/scripts/art.sh` with `reload_time = 2` to show the current track's album art (a 256px card with a 3px #85b4ea border). art.sh fetches mpris:artUrl with curl, converts it with ImageMagick and caches it as '<artist> - <album>.png'. Title and artist labels sit underneath. The Hyprlock preview shows two stacked cards, one rotated -6°, which gives a cute polaroid-stack effect; that rotated variant is commented out in the current config.

Waybar centre media cluster built from four separate modules (song_name pill + prev/play/next segment). Each module is an event-driven Python Playerctl/GLib script emitting JSON rather than a polling shell loop, and it detects Spotify ads ('AD PLAYING').

Fused-pill CSS trick: #network uses border-radius 8px 0 0 8px with margin-right -5px, and #pulseaudio uses 0 8px 8px 0 with margin-left -5px. Two modules render as one capsule, and the same pattern is used for the pre/spotify/next media controls.

Active workspace drawn as an elongated capsule by repeating a Nerd Font glyph ('active': '󱓻󱓻󱓻󱓻󱓻󱓻') and animating padding 0→13px with a 0.3s ease-in-out opacity keyframe. It is a cheap morphing-pill indicator with no custom widget toolkit.

Vertical sidebar Waybar (Mar 2026) with nested drawer groups: group/more contains group/audio and group/brightness, each with a vertical slider. The sliders are styled as 10px-wide rounded troughs (#242933) with #81a1c1/#88c0d0 highlights. It also has a stacked HH/MM clock and a collapsible tray behind an arrow glyph.
swww wallpaper transition 'grow' anchored at 0.045,0.945, so the new wallpaper blooms from the corner area near the launcher button.

Rofi power menu docked as a narrow 115px vertical column on the east edge (x-offset -15px), close to the bar's power button, with a 2-column yes/no confirmation built entirely from -theme-str overrides.
Hyprlock status corner: network strength glyphs from /proc/net/wireless and the IME state (EN/VN) as small top-right labels. Dunst replace-IDs (-r 1006) stop IME-toggle toasts from stacking.
structure_install: A flat collection of ~/.config directories at the repo root: cava/, dunst/ (single file 'hyprdunst'), foot/, hypr/ (hyprland.conf, bind.conf, hyprlock.conf, scripts/*.sh), neofetch/, rofi/ (adi1090x launchers type-2 and misc, powermenu type-2 and legacy, colors/nord.rasi), waybar/ (config, style.css, Sidebar/, scripts/*.py|sh), and Previews/*.png. There is no install script, package list, stow layout, symlink manager or flake. The README's install instructions are literally 'You know what to do' plus a chmod +x reminder. Users are expected to copy the directories into ~/.config and then replace every /home/tdm path by hand.

key_snippets.purpose: Album-art card plus track label on the lock screen (the most distinctive piece)
key_snippets.excerpt:
image {
    monitor = 
    size = 256 # lesser side if not 1:1 ratio
    rounding = 6 # negative values mean circle
    border_size = 3
    border_color =  rgb(133, 180, 234)
    rotate = 0 # degrees, counter-clockwise
    reload_time = 2
    reload_cmd = ~/.config/hypr/scripts/art.sh
    position = 0, -25
    halign = center
    valign = center
    opacity = 1
}

label {
    monitor =
    text = cmd[update:1000] echo "$(/home/tdm/.config/hypr/scripts/songdetail.sh --title)" 
    color = rgba(209, 207, 207, 0.75)
    font_size = 17  
    font_family = Source Code Pro bold
    position = 0, -200
    halign = center
    valign = center
}

key_snippets.purpose: Fetch, convert and cache MPRIS cover art for hyprlock (hardcoded /home/tdm; unquoted $url test)
key_snippets.excerpt:
#!/usr/bin/bash
url=$(playerctl metadata mpris:artUrl)
artist=$(playerctl metadata xesam:artist)
album=$(playerctl metadata xesam:album)
metadata=$(printf "$artist - $album")

if [ $url == "No player found" ]
then
  exit
elif [ -f /home/tdm/.cache/albumart/"$metadata".png ]
then
  echo /home/tdm/.cache/albumart/"$metadata".png
else
  curl -s $url -o /home/tdm/.cache/albumart/"$metadata"
  magick /home/tdm/.cache/albumart/"$metadata" /home/tdm/.cache/albumart/"$metadata".png
  rm /home/tdm/.cache/albumart/"$metadata"
  echo /home/tdm/.cache/albumart/"$metadata".png
fi

key_snippets.purpose: Geometry, shadow and overshoot animation values
Fused-capsule trick (network + volume share one pill via negative margins and half radii)
Glyph-repeat active workspace capsule
Vertical slider styling for drawer groups in the sidebar bar

weaknesses: Hardcoded username and paths everywhere: /home/tdm/... appears in bind.conf (launcher, powermenu, reload, grimblast, ibus), hyprlock.conf (wallpaper, songdetail.sh), art.sh (cache dir, which must already exist), waybar config (launcher, swww.sh, ibus) and the swww exec-once wallpaper path.

Broken or missing references. bind.conf calls ~/.config/hypr/scripts/reload but the file is reload.sh. waybar calls scripts/swww.sh, which is missing. The Sidebar calls ~/.config/rofi/launchers/launcher.sh and ~/.config/rofi/powermenu/powermenu.sh (the legacy X11 one, which uses betterlockscreen and `rofi -x11`), and the launcher.sh path does not exist. Sidebar CSS uses undefined @gruv-beige, @gruv-green and @hover-black, which GTK CSS will reject, so the stylesheet can fail to load. network.sh calls a nonexistent `proc` instead of printf. There is also a `monitor=hl2` typo and a corrupted comment line ('https://wiki.hymonitor=,preferred,...').

Outdated or mixed Hyprland syntax: windowrulev2 is used alongside new-style `windowrule = float, class:...` (windowrulev2 was merged into windowrule in 0.48, and rule syntax has been reworked again in later releases; this could not be re-verified here). `gestures { workspace_swipe = on }` belongs to the pre-0.51 gesture system. `bringactivetotop` is a legacy dispatcher. `autogenerated = 0` is leftover boilerplate. `device:epic-mouse-v1 {}` is an empty example block.

Everything is one exec-once line joined with '&' (waybar, avizo, ibus, polkit, copyq, foot server, nm-applet), with no uwsm or systemd user services. `dunst -conf .config/dunst/hyprdunst` uses a relative path. `hyprctl setcursor elementary 20` conflicts with env XCURSOR_SIZE=27.

Lock is inconsistent: hyprlock.conf exists, but SUPER+L and the powermenu both launch gtklock. There is no hypridle or any idle/DPMS handling. The powermenu's suspend path runs `mpc -q pause; amixer set Master mute`, which assumes MPD and ALSA.

No colour pipeline: the same Nord hex values are copy-pasted into more than 6 files, so retheming means editing every file. Blur is disabled and there is no transparency, so it feels flat compared with modern rices.

The media scripts are hardwired to `--player spotify`. There are three near-duplicate 120-line Python files (next.py, pre.py, spotify.py) that differ only in the output string. mediaplayer.py is a fourth copy. The waybar `nospacing` key is not a real option.
Heavy reliance on vendored adi1090x rofi themes (credited, GPL-3.0 upstream) with little original styling. The repo shows no license. Preview screenshots embed third-party album art.

Personal and locale-specific bits: ibus-bamboo Vietnamese IME (EN/VN), brave, 4 workspaces only (5–0 commented out), 1920x1080 monitor lines. There is no Nix support and no install automation, and the README install section is 'You know what to do.'
steal_list: Hyprlock 'now playing' card: an image widget with reload_cmd set to a cover-art cache script and reload_time 2, plus title and artist labels. Optionally stack a second copy with rotate = -6 behind it for a cute polaroid look. Rewrite the script with $XDG_CACHE_HOME, mkdir -p, quoting, and handling of file:// art URLs.

Fused-pill Waybar grouping: adjacent modules with complementary half radii (8px 0 0 8px / 0 8px 8px 0) and ±5px negative margins so related modules (net+vol, prev/play/next) read as one capsule. Recolour it through a generated palette instead of hardcoded Nord.

Morphing active-workspace capsule: a repeated glyph or padding 0→13px transition with a 0.3s ease-in-out opacity keyframe. It is a cheap, attractive indicator that works in plain Waybar on both Arch and NixOS (home-manager programs.waybar).
Waybar drawer groups with vertical sliders (group/audio and group/brightness nested in group/more, 250ms transition, 10px rounded troughs) for a clean collapsible control strip or sidebar variant.
swww (now awww upstream) 'grow' transition anchored at the launcher corner (e.g. 0.045,0.945) so wallpaper changes visually originate from the bar button that triggered them.
Overshoot bezier 0.13,0.99,0.29,1.1 on windows (speed 3) and workspaces (speed 5, slide) as a tasteful springy baseline.
Event-driven Playerctl/GLib Python module emitting JSON for Waybar (no polling), with ad detection. Consolidate it into one script with a --role flag and make it player-agnostic.

Dunst notification replace-IDs (-r) for transient toasts (screenshot saved with a thumbnail, IME/volume toggles) so they update in place instead of stacking; also grimblast --freeze copysave area with an image-thumbnail notification.

The east-docked narrow rofi power column (115px, x-offset -15) with a -theme-str-built yes/no confirm. It is a nicer idea than a fullscreen powermenu, but should lock with hyprlock and log out with `hyprctl dispatch exit` or `uwsm stop` rather than killall.

target: multi-distro (Arch-first; pkglists for Fedora/Debian/Gentoo marked untested; no NixOS support at all)
one_line: A modular Hyprland rice built on waybar, rofi, SwayNC, hyprlock and wlogout. Its strongest idea is a per-component "skins + themes" switcher: colors come from wallust with dark/light modes, and it ships image and video wallpapers plus small C++ helper daemons. The look is a generic see-through "floating pill" style rather than cute/pastel, and development is officially paused.
freshness: Commit atom feed: the latest commits (2026-07-18, 2026-05-26, 2026-05-20, 2026-05-12, 2026-03-09) are all README or FUNDING edits. The last functional changes were on 2026-03-04 ("Update install.sh", "Update hyprland.conf", "Create input.conf"), with a burst of commits on 2026-02-28. The latest release badge is v1.6. License is GPL-3.0. The README has a banner reading "Development is Paused, Indefinitely" because the author stopped using Arch. It points to a Quickshell-based successor, NeKoRoSHELL DLux (github.com/NeKoRoSYS/NeKoRoSHELL-DLux-Shell), which is "under development". The Hyprland syntax is fairly current for early 2026: block-style `windowrule { name=..; match:class=..; suppress_event=maximize }`, `layerrule = match:namespace X, blur on`, `gesture = 3, horizontal, workspace`, and `rounding_power`. The only exception is the stale option noted under weaknesses. CI (.github/workflows/build-and-lint.yml) runs ShellCheck on bin/ and runs `make all` for the C++ daemons.

aesthetic.palette: Mostly dynamic: wallust generates the palette from the wallpaper (backend "wal", color_space "lab", palette "dark16" or "light16", threshold 11, saturation 10). Semantic roles: $color13 is the accent for active window borders, rofi window/input borders and SwayNC borders. @color5 is the pill underline (border-bottom 0.175rem), the rofi selected-row background and the SwayNC toggle-on/gradient color. $color0 is the window shadow color. Hardcoded hex values: text/text-invert #F5F5F5/#121212 (swapped in light mode), appended by apply-colors.sh. Hyprland $inactive = rgb(116,109,105), which is #746D69. Waybar calendar days #acb0d0 and today #41a6b5 (Tokyo-Night-like and not themed). SwayNC button border #45475a (Catppuccin Mocha surface1) and disabled text #969696. Rofi selected text #ffffff. Rofi alpha suffixes: window {{background}}a6 (~65%), input {{foreground}}26 (~15%). hyprlock legacy: text rgba(242,243,244,0.75) (#F2F3F4BF), fail rgba(204,36,29) (#CC241D, the Gruvbox red), fallback bg rgba(25,20,20) (#191414). wlogout backdrop rgba(12,12,12,0.9). Power-profile colors use raw CSS names (red, green, cornflowerblue). README accent #986EF7 (purple). There is no pastel or named scheme; the palette is whatever the wallpaper produces.
aesthetic.color_pipeline: wallust with two TOML configs (wallust-dark.toml and wallust-light.toml). Templates render to ~/.cache/wallust/: colors-hyprland(-raw).conf, which exposes $background/$foreground/$color0-15 via rgb({{colorN | strip}}); colors-waybar.css (@define-color, also imported by SwayNC and wlogout); colors-rofi.rasi; and colors-kitty.conf. How it runs: set-wallpaper.sh calls apply-colors.sh, which runs wallust on the cached 200px thumbnail for speed. If that fails it retries with `-b full -t 5`. It then appends the text/text-invert tokens for the current contrast mode, renames the hyprland raw file into place, kills and restarts waybar in the right navbar mode, and runs `swaync-client -rs`. The dark/light mode is stored in ~/.cache/nekoroshell/theme_mode and toggled by contrast-switcher.sh, which is also a button in the SwayNC grid. Hyprland reads the colors through `source = ~/.cache/wallust/colors-hyprland.conf` in the skin's appearance.conf. Video wallpapers also get colors, taken from a thumbnail frame extracted with ffmpeg.
aesthetic.fonts: JetBrains Mono everywhere. Waybar: 'JetBrains Mono Nerd Font', 9pt, weight 700; workspace icons 10.5pt. Rofi: "JetBrains Mono 12", selected row "JetBrains Mono Bold 14". SwayNC: "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font" for body, "JetBrains Mono Extrabold" 24pt for the title. hyprlock: clock "JetBrains Mono Extrabold" at font_size 95, date line "JetBrains Mono" 16. kitty: JetBrains Mono in regular/Bold/Italic/Bold Italic. Packages: ttf-jetbrains-mono, ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd, noto-fonts, noto-fonts-cjk, noto-fonts-emoji. No rounded or "cute" display font.
aesthetic.icons_cursor_gtk_qt: Largely unthemed. XCURSOR_SIZE and HYPRCURSOR_SIZE are both 15, but no cursor theme is set. QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME=qt6ct, and qt5ct/qt6ct/kvantum appear only in the author's personal pkglist. The README roadmap still lists "Qt and Kvantum integration" as undecided. No GTK theme, icon theme or nwg-look config was found. Nerd Font glyphs are used for all waybar and SwayNC icons. wlogout uses 12 bundled PNG icons (lock/logout/suspend/hibernate/shutdown/reboot, each with a -hover variant). The lock-screen avatar is ~/.face.icon, changeable with home/change-avatar.sh.
aesthetic.geometry: Hyprland "legacy" skin: gaps_in 5, gaps_out 20, border_size 2, rounding 10, rounding_power 2, active_opacity 0.825, inactive_opacity 0.3 (very see-through), shadow range 4 / render_power 3 / color $color0, blur size 5 / passes 2 / vibrancy 0.1696, dwindle with pseudotile and preserve_split. "compact" skin: gaps 2/4, border 1, rounding 0, active 1.0 / inactive 0.75, master layout (mfact 0.5, orientation left). Waybar legacy: bar margin "5 0", transparent bar background, module groups as pills with border-radius 0.9375rem (15px), background alpha(@background,0.75), and a colored underline border-bottom 0.175rem solid @color5. Tray has radius 0.5rem and a 1px border. Layer rules blur waybar with ignore_alpha 0.1. Rofi: width 29em, border 0.125em @color13, radius 0.625em, input radius 0.3125em, 8 lines, element padding 0.625em, selected row gets a @color5 fill plus a 0.125em @color13 underline. Layer rules: rofi blur on, ignore_alpha 0.1, dim_around 1. SwayNC: background color-mix(@background, transparent 39%), radius 0.625rem, margin 1.25rem, border 0.155rem @color13, drop shadow -0.9375rem 0 1.25rem rgba(0,0,0,.4). Grid buttons are pills (radius 62.4375rem) with a gradient to alpha(@color5,.25). Control center is 500x600. Layer rules for SwayNC: blur, ignore_alpha 0.6, dim_around, and `animation slide right 1 4 winIn`. hyprlock legacy: blurred screenshot background (blur_passes 1, brightness 0.45), pill input field 15%x5% with rounding 50 and outline 2, 100px avatar with a 2px border. wlogout: 0.9-opacity backdrop, buttons with radius 0.625rem, 0.3125rem @color13 bottom border and a vertical gradient to alpha(@color5,0.5). kitty: window_padding_width 5 10, cursor_trail 3.
aesthetic.animations: Legacy skin beziers: wind = 0.05,0.9,0.1,1.05; winIn = 0.1,1.1,0.1,1.1; winOut = 0.3,-0.3,0,1; liner = 1,1,1,1; almostLinear = 0.5,0.5,0.75,1.0. Legacy animations: windows 6 wind slide; windowsIn 6 winIn slide; windowsOut 5 winOut slide; windowsMove 5 wind slide; border 1 liner; borderangle 30 liner loop; layers 6 wind popin 90%; layersIn 6 winIn popin 90%; layersOut 5 winOut popin 90%; workspaces 5 wind; fadeIn 1.73, fadeOut 1.46, fade 3.03 (all almostLinear). The file also keeps the stock Hyprland default curve set (easeOutQuint, easeInOutCubic, quick) commented out. Compact skin beziers: snappy = 0.15,1.0,0.1,1.0; snappyOut = 0.3,0.0,0.8,0.15. Compact animations: windows/In 3, Out 2, Move 3 (slide); layers 2 / out 1.5 popin 90%; workspaces 2.5; fades 1.0. The SwayNC layers reuse winIn with slide right. Waybar tray drawer transition-duration is 500. hyprlock fades 1.8 with a (non-standard) linear bezier.
aesthetic.wallpapers: 22 files bundled in .config/wallpapers. Anime or franchise art: My Hero Academia, bleach.jpg, war-devil-chainsaw-man, yoru-csm.png, my-neighbor-totoro-sunflowers.png, blue-anime-girl, blue-girl-among-flowers, bw-girl. Microsoft Windows 11 stock wallpapers: windows-11.jpg, windows-11-dark.jpg, windows-11-blue-stock-white.jpg, windows.jpg. Landscapes: mount-fuji, china-mountains, night mountains, black-hole. One video: bad-apple.mp4. No attribution or license file for any of them. Wallpaper tooling: swww for images, mpvpaper for video, and mpvpaper-stop to pause video when a window covers it. There is a rofi grid picker with thumbnails, a random picker, and a paste-a-URL-to-download flow.
aesthetic.vibe: I couldn't view the showcase PNGs (read-only; I can't download images), so this judgment comes from the config. The look is a clean, conventional wallust rice: translucent blurred windows (focused at 82.5% opacity, unfocused at only 30%), floating rounded pills in waybar with a single accent underline, and a centered rofi box with a colored border. SwayNC is the best-looking part: a gradient buttons grid, pill toggles and a slide-in from the right with an overshoot curve. Polish is moderate. Styling is consistent across waybar, SwayNC, rofi and wlogout thanks to the shared @color5/@color13 tokens and the underline motif, but there are leftovers: hardcoded Tokyo-Night calendar colors, a Catppuccin #45475a border, named CSS colors, and hyprlock skins pointing at a pywal path that doesn't exist. It isn't cute or pastel. The anime feel comes entirely from the wallpapers and the fastfetch ASCII art (anime-face, gojo2, ohayou). It's more a "framework" than a showpiece; the author says it is partly inspired by JaKooLit's Hyprland-Dots.

components.compositor: Hyprland. hyprland.conf sources conf.d/*.conf (00-environment, 01-debug, 02-autostart, 03-monitors, 04-windowrules, 05-input, 06-keybinds), then a user sandbox (hypr/user/configs/{environment,hardware,monitors,appearance,animations,windowrules,input,keybinds}.conf), which is seeded once from hypr/user/templates. appearance.conf and animations.conf are generated from the chosen skin (hypr/user/skins/{legacy,compact}). Also: hypremoji.conf, and exec-once for user/scripts/autostart.sh.
components.bar_or_shell: Waybar with two skins: legacy (top) and legacy-bottom. Groups: gleft1 (battery, cpu, backlight), gleft2 (hyprland/workspaces with workspace-taskbar icons and 5 persistent workspaces), a tray drawer, gright2 (wireplumber, bluetooth, network, tray), gright1 (memory, temperature, swaync notification), custom/ctlcenter (⏻ opens wlogout), and power-profiles-daemon. The clock is centered in 12-hour format. Three visibility modes run through C++ wrappers: Static (plain waybar), Dynamic (navbar-watcher: shown only when windows are visible) and Hover (navbar-hover: shows when the cursor enters an ACTIVATE_SIZE=10px edge and hides after leaving DEACTIVATE_SIZE=60px). Hover is configured per skin in navbar-hover.conf. The successor project, DLux, moves to Quickshell.
components.launcher: rofi, listed as rofi-wayland in pkglist-arch and as rofi in the personal list. One skin, legacy. The bin/rofi-launch wrapper has run, drun (with icons) and game modes; game mode runs `gamemoderun rofi -show drun`. Rofi dmenu also drives the clipboard (cliphist), the customize menu, the navbar-mode picker, and the wallpaper picker (4x3 grid of 120px thumbnails via -theme-str). A leftover windowrule still centers wofi.
components.notifications: SwayNC (legacy skin). Widgets: buttons-grid (7 per row: wifi via nmcli, bluetooth, DND, dark/light contrast, hyprsunset night light), mpris (96px art, radius 12), title, notifications. Inline replies and 2FA actions are on; timeout 10, low 5. bin/makenotif wraps notify-send with the x-canonical-private-synchronous replace hint, an int:value progress bar, actions, and an optional sound via bin/playsound.
components.lock_idle_logout: hyprlock has two skins. legacy: blurred screenshot background, big Extrabold clock, date, avatar, "hello, $USER!", and clickable shutdown/reboot/suspend labels using onclick = sys-power .... mkhmtcore: themed from $color vars. hypridle: lock at 300s through sys-power lock, dim with brightnessctl -s set 5 at 420s, and suspend also at 420s; after_sleep runs dpms on and start-navbar. wlogout (legacy skin with PNG assets): 6 actions that all go through bin/sys-power, a compositor- and init-agnostic wrapper (systemctl, then zzz, then /sys/power/state). hyprsunset: at 20:00, 4350K with gamma 0.9; identity at 07:00; max-gamma 150.
components.wallpaper_tool: swww for images (swww-daemon plus swww restore at autostart), mpvpaper for video (hwdec nvdec on NVIDIA, auto otherwise, over an IPC socket), and mpvpaper-stop to pause video when fullscreen or occluded. Thumbnails are cached in ~/.cache/nekoroshell/wallpaper-thumbs, made with ffmpeg for video and ImageMagick for images. Pasting an http(s) link into the rofi picker downloads the file with curl and shows a live progress notification. Upstream swww has since been renamed to awww and moved to Codeberg; its GitHub README says so.
components.terminal: kitty: JetBrains Mono, window_padding_width 5 10, cursor_trail 3, shell /usr/bin/zsh, colors included from ~/.cache/wallust/colors-kitty.conf.
components.shell_prompt: zsh with Powerlevel10k (home/.p10k.zsh; the installer clones ~/powerlevel10k) plus a bash fallback. The installer adds a PATH block between `# --- NeKoRoSHELL START/END ---` markers in .bashrc and .zshrc.
components.editor: No editor config shipped. vim/neovim are in the pkglists, and `nekoroshell update` uses vimdiff (MERGE_TOOL) for merges. visual-studio-code-bin is in the personal list only.
components.file_manager: Dolphin ($fileManager = dolphin, plus kio-admin). Nothing is themed for it.
components.fetch: fastfetch with custom ASCII logos (anime-face.txt, emu.txt, gojo2.txt, ohayou.txt), PNGs, a p10k-render.zsh helper, and a boxed module layout with Nerd Font keys. start-dashboard.sh tiles four kitty windows (fastfetch, tty-clock, cava, btop) on workspace 1 using layoutmsg presel, with hardcoded windowrules for 720p (610x307 each) and commented-out 1080p values.
components.login_boot: None configured in the dotfiles: no SDDM/greetd theme, no GRUB/Limine theme and no Plymouth theme. plymouth, grub and os-prober appear only in the author's personal pkglist-nekoro.txt.
components.extras: cava with a set of GLSL shaders (bar_spectrum, eye_of_phi, northern_lights, spectrogram, winamp_line_style_spectrum) and themes (solarized_dark, tricolor). btop.conf. Hypremoji emoji picker with its own style.css. cliphist clipboard on SUPER+V. Screenshots via hyprshot (output/window/region with --freeze, copied to clipboard, notification plus camera-shutter sound). hyprpicker. C++ tools: show-keybinds (parses keybind comments into a cheatsheet), hypr-nice (renices windows off the active workspace to 19), eject-forbidden, navbar-hover and navbar-watcher. Shell tools: nk-gamemode (turns off animations, blur, gaps and rounding and kills the wallpaper daemons), kill-layers, sunset-toggle. A special "magic" workspace. The personal list also has spicetify-cli and spotify, but no spicetify theme is shipped.

standout_features: Per-component skin system. Each component keeps its skins in `.config/<pkg>/skins/<skin>/`. `bin/customize` writes tiny auto-generated shim files (a CSS @import, a rasi @import, a jsonc include, or a copied/concatenated Hyprland conf) with a "DO NOT EDIT" header. It stores an md5 in `<file>.sum` and backs up the file whenever it detects the user edited a generated file (check_user_mod/save_hash).

Each skin ships its own `layerrule.conf` (blur, ignore_alpha, dim_around, slide animations). `customize` removes the old skin's `source =` line from the user's windowrules.conf and appends the new one, so layer rules follow the chosen skin.

Themes are plain bash scripts in `.config/themes/<name>/*.sh` that call `quick-theme <wallpaper> <navbar> <launcher> <lockscreen> <panel> <power> <windows>` followed by a contrast switch, for example legacy vs legacy-dark.
Dark/light contrast mode switches between wallust dark16 and light16 palettes and appends the text/text-invert tokens. It's exposed as a toggle button in the SwayNC control center.

Rofi wallpaper grid picker with cached thumbnails (ffmpeg grabs a frame for videos). Pasting a URL downloads the file with a live notify-send progress bar and a completion sound, then sets it as the wallpaper and re-themes everything.
Video wallpapers with mpvpaper plus mpvpaper-stop, which pauses playback when windows cover it. It picks NVIDIA vs auto hardware decoding at runtime, and wallust colors are taken from a video frame.

Three navbar visibility modes (Static, Dynamic, Hover) with per-skin edge trigger sizes and hysteresis (ACTIVATE_SIZE=10 < DEACTIVATE_SIZE=60) so reaching for an app's toolbar doesn't pop the bar. Waybar also hides automatically while the SwayNC control center is open.

A user sandbox with lifecycle hooks: hypr/user/{configs,scripts,hooks}. Templates are copied once, and hooks run at post-install, post-update and on-theme-change. `nekoroshell update` gives a per-file overwrite/keep/diff/merge prompt, and there are `create-skin`, `create-theme` and `uninstall` subcommands.

`sys-power`: one lock/logout/suspend/hibernate/reboot/shutdown wrapper used by wlogout, hyprlock's clickable labels and hypridle. It handles Hyprland, Sway and niri, and systemd, elogind (zzz) or raw sysfs.
`show-keybinds` (C++) builds a SUPER+SHIFT+/ cheatsheet from the trailing `# comment` on each bind line, so the documentation lives next to the binding.

Installer niceties: --dry-run, a tar.gz backup of the existing config, laptop detection through /sys/class/power_supply/BAT* that writes touchpad `gesture =` lines, and monitor detection via hyprctl or sysfs that fills in __PRIMARY_MONITOR__ placeholders.

SwayNC control center slides in from the right using the overshoot bezier winIn (0.1,1.1,0.1,1.1) with dim_around. Its gradient buttons grid includes an hyprsunset night-light toggle whose state comes from `hyprctl hyprsunset profile`.
structure_install:
Layout: `.config/` holds the configs (btop, cava, fastfetch, hypr, hypremoji, kitty, rofi, swaync, themes, wallpapers, wallust, waybar, wlogout). `bin/` holds the user scripts, installed to ~/.local/bin/nekoroshell and added to PATH. `src/` holds the C++ daemons, built by the Makefile with g++ -O3. `home/` holds .zshrc, .bashrc, .p10k.zsh, .face.icon and change-avatar.sh. `packages/` holds pkglist-{arch,debian,fedora,gentoo,nekoro}.txt, and `showcase/` the screenshots. There are also THEMING.md and CHANGELOG.md.

Install: `git clone … && bash install.sh [--dry-run]`. It's interactive: you type "Minimal" (deploy configs only) or "Compilation" (also install dependencies). Compilation mode:
- caches sudo with a keep-alive loop
- detects the OS from /etc/os-release
- bootstraps base-devel, git, cargo, go and flatpak, and builds yay from the AUR
- installs the pkglist through paru or yay (or dnf/apt/emerge)
- runs `cargo install wallust` and swww from git
- runs `go install cliphist`
- installs flatpaks from a flatpak.txt, which isn't in the repo

Both modes then:
- tar the existing ~/.config dirs, then `rm -rf` and `cp -a` each one
- seed hypr/user/configs from templates and create the hooks
- write hardware.conf gestures on laptops
- fill in the monitor placeholders
- sed every `/home/nekorosys` into $HOME
- inject the PATH block into the rc files
- copy .p10k.zsh and .face.icon

Compilation mode also downloads hyprshot, clones powerlevel10k and runs `make` for the daemons. Finally the installer chmods everything, checks the core commands are present and runs the post-install hook. Updates go through `nekoroshell update`, which fetches the latest release to /tmp/nekoroshell_upgrade and merges file by file. Runtime state lives in ~/.cache/nekoroshell (theme_mode, navbar_mode, navbar-hover.conf, video_wallpaper, wallpaper-thumbs) and ~/.cache/wallust.

key_snippets.purpose: Skin shim writer with md5-based detection of user edits (a reusable pattern for mutable theming)
key_snippets.excerpt:
check_user_mod() {
    local file="$1"
    if [ -f "$file" ] && [ -f "$file.sum" ]; then
        local current_sum=$(md5sum "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)
        local stored_sum=$(cat "$file.sum")
        if [ "$current_sum" != "$stored_sum" ]; then
            local backup="${file}.user_bak_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)"
            makenotif customize dialog-warning "Config Modified" "Manual edits to $(basename "$file") backed up." false
            cp "$file" "$backup"
        fi
    fi
}
...
    case "$type" in
        css)   echo -e "${WARNING_CSS}@import \"$source_abs\";" > "$target" ;;
        rasi)  echo -e "${WARNING_CSS}@import \"$source_abs/config.rasi\"\n@import \"$source_abs/style.rasi\"" > "$target" ;;
        jsonc) echo -e "${WARNING_JSONC}{ \"include\": [ \"$source_abs\" ] }" > "$target" ;;
        hypr)  echo -e "${WARNING_CONF}" > "$target"; cat "$source_abs" >> "$target" ;;
        copy)  cp "$source_abs" "$target" || true ;;
    esac
    save_hash "$target"
...
