weaknesses: It targets X11 and i3 only. There's nothing for Hyprland, Wayland or NixOS, and the README Todo 'Switch to Wayland' was never done.

The colour schemes don't match: Catppuccin Mocha, Latte and Frappé, Horizon Dark, Tokyo Night, and polybar's untouched example palette (#ffb52a/#e60053, line-color #f00) all appear, so there's no single source of truth.

There's a real bug with exec_always: i3 starts polybar-visibility-toggler.sh (an infinite 0.1s loop that calls xrandr), picom, dunst and copyq with exec_always, but only polybar is killed first. Every $mod+Shift+r reload adds more loops and duplicate daemons. The toggler also calls xrandr ten times a second, which is expensive, and only handles the first monitor.

polybar modules/powermenu.ini references `${color.cyan}`, `${color.background-alt}` and so on, but the section is named [colors], and `cyan` doesn't exist. Its click-left runs ~/.config/rofi/applets/bin/powermenu.sh, which isn't in the repo, so the power button is broken.

The README doesn't match the configs: it says the notification daemon is mako, but the config is dunst. It has no install instructions, no dependency list, and its screenshot link points to another account (chupapee/dotfiles).

Picom is set up for blur but doesn't blur: blur-kern "3x3box" is set while blur-method and blur-background are commented out. It uses the slow xrender backend, and fade steps of 1.0 turn fading off in practice. It also uses the old wintypes and *-exclude syntax, which picom v12 replaced with `rules` (I know this from my own knowledge; I didn't check it against picom docs in this session).

alacritty.toml uses top-level `live_config_reload` and `[shell]`. In Alacritty 0.14+ these moved to `[general]` and `[terminal.shell]` (from my own knowledge; I didn't check it against Alacritty's changelog in this session). The file is also hardcoded to /usr/bin/zsh, and so is WezTerm's default_prog.

The dark/light toggle only flips the GTK3 theme name. It doesn't set `color-scheme prefer-dark`, so GTK4/libadwaita and portal-aware apps won't follow. Its `sed s/Adwaita/Adwaita-dark/g` rewrites every 'Adwaita' in settings.ini, including an icon or cursor theme if one is set. Rofi, polybar, dunst and Alacritty don't follow the toggle.

Paths and hardware are hardcoded: ~/wallpapers, /home/$USER/Pictures/screenshots/$(date) (a filename with spaces and no extension, in a folder that isn't created), BAT0/AC, us,ru keyboard layouts, /usr/share/icons/gnome/16x16 icon paths, and the rofi terminal "wterm" (a typo).
There's no idle or lock daemon, no display manager or boot theming, no cursor theme, no Qt theming and no wallpaper management beyond a random feh pick. i3lock -i with a raw PNG looks plain.

There's dead or leftover code: battery-popup.sh is vendored from a 2016 third-party script but never started (cbatticon is used instead), lazyvim.json is left over from LazyVim, the Neovim config has a darcula theme it doesn't use, and noice sets `background_color = '#FF0000'`, which isn't a real option.
There's no LICENSE file, which makes reuse legally unclear. The good news is that no copyrighted wallpapers (The Last of Us art) are bundled.
steal_list: Per-role package layout (bar/, compositor/, launcher/, notifications/, shell/, terminal/, wm/): mirror it as Stow packages on Arch and as matching Home Manager modules on NixOS, so both distros share the same component boundaries.

A one-key dark/light toggle wired to every app. Do it the modern way: set `gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme prefer-dark/default` and use `wezterm.gui.get_appearance()` or the xdg portal instead of shelling out to gsettings. Also swap the rofi/fuzzel theme, bar CSS, swaync/mako and hyprlock colours from one script or one matugen/stylix polarity switch.

The rofi launcher layout: a 3-column icon grid, a coloured pill prompt with dark text, selected items shown by a pink text colour (#f38ba8) instead of a heavy highlight, papirus icons at about 25px, and roughly 1200×600. Port it to rofi-wayland with a pastel palette, add bigger rounding (12–16px) and a translucent background with Hyprland layerrule blur.
Separate light and dark theme files for the launcher (Mocha #1e1e2e/#89b4fa/#cdd6f4 and Latte #eff1f5/#1e66f5/#4c4f69), selected by the global theme toggle instead of hardcoded.

Share one wallpaper pool between the desktop and the lock screen. On Hyprland: `swww img $(shuf ...)` or awww, plus hyprlock `background { path = ... }` from the same pick, with a timed slideshow, which is this repo's unfinished TODO.
A bar that autohides at the screen edge, done without polling: Waybar `mode: hide` with `modifier-reveal`, a signal, or a Quickshell PanelWindow with a hover region.

Notification behaviour to copy: left click closes, middle click runs the action and closes, right click closes all; stack duplicates; show a progress bar for volume and brightness; limit to 4 visible. Carry these into a swaync/mako config with rounded corners and a pastel frame.
A clipboard manager in a floating window with a fixed size (600×600, no border). On Hyprland: cliphist + rofi/fuzzel with a windowrule for float, size and centre.
Brightness and volume modules that pick icons from the current percentage and adjust on scroll. Adopt them in a Waybar or Quickshell module with Nerd Font glyphs.
Pin apps to workspaces (browser to 1, code to 2, chat to 3) and give workspaces Nerd Font icons. On Hyprland, use `windowrule = workspace N, class:...` with icon labels in the bar.

one_line: A Hyprland rice for Garuda/Arch, forked from Archcraft (adi1090x) and recoloured in Catppuccin Macchiato mauve/lavender. It has a Waybar with 12 swappable themes, adi1090x-style rofi menus, mako, hyprlock, swww and kitty/fish/oh-my-posh, plus a vendored HyprPanel (AGS v1) as an optional bar. Pretty and pastel, but mostly borrowed and now marked unmaintained.
freshness: The README starts with "UNMAINTAINED IN FAVOR OF https://github.com/yurihikari/ml4w-lightcrimson-dotfiles". The last commit (2026-06-08) only added that notice. The one before (2026-01-01) was "Updated and cleaned hyprland.conf for Hyprland 0.53.0". Earlier commits: 2025-12-01 (added yad dependency), 2025-11-18 (Hyprland stable instead of -git, 2 wallpapers, ags config), 2025-09-11 (gesture fix), 2025-07-11 (screen mirroring script), 2025-03-27 (windowrule update for 0.48). About 496 stars, scraped from the GitHub page. hyprland.conf is fairly current (0.53 block windowrules, new `gesture =` syntax), but most other files (Archcraft 2020-2023 scripts, the AGS v1 HyprPanel fork, README install URLs) are stale. The README still links to the old repo name garuda-sway-config.

aesthetic.palette: Mostly Catppuccin Macchiato, with a leftover Archcraft palette in several apps. Macchiato values from hypr/waybar/machiatto.css: base #24273a, mantle #1e2030, crust #181926, text #cad3f5, subtext0 #a5adcb, subtext1 #b8c0e0, surface0 #363a4f, surface1 #494d64, surface2 #5b6078, overlay0 #6e738d, overlay1 #8087a2, overlay2 #939ab7, blue #8aadf4, lavender #b7bdf8, sapphire #7dc4e4, sky #91d7e3, teal #8bd5ca, green #a6da95, yellow #eed49f, peach #f5a97f, maroon #ee99a0, red #ed8796, mauve #c6a0f6, pink #f5bde6, flamingo #f0c6c6, rosewater #f4dbd6. Hyprland borders: active gradient 0xFFB4A1DB -> 0xFFD04E9D at 45deg (Archcraft lavender to hot pink), inactive `1e2030` (written with no 0x/rgb prefix), group borders 0xFFDB695B / 0xFF4BC66D. The Archcraft palette in wlogout/wofi colors.css, the swaylock script and slurp: background #20262C, alt1 #343A40, alt2 #3E444A, fg #f1fcf9, red #DB86BA, green #74DD91, yellow #E49186, blue #75DBE1, magenta #B4A1DB, cyan #9EE9EA, pink #D04E9D, orange #DB695B. Rofi shared/colors.rasi: bg #24273a, bg-alt #1e2030, border/selected/active #c6a0f6, urgent #ed8796. Mako: bg #24273a, text #cad3f5, border #c6a0f6, low/normal #B4A1DB, high #D04E9D, mpd category #E49186. Hyprlock: rgb(36,39,58) bg, rgb(198,160,246) mauve text/outline, rgb(237,135,150) fail. The Waybar cava module uses Catppuccin *Mocha* #cba6f7/#89b4fa, which does not match the rest. Clock calendar spans use #ffead3, #ecc6d9, #99ffdd, #ffcc66, #ff6699. The foot bright colours come from Archcraft (d04e9d, 4bc66d, db695b, 3dbac2, 825ece, 62cdcd).
aesthetic.color_pipeline: Static, with no global template engine. Catppuccin Macchiato is hand-copied into each app: waybar machiatto.css, kitty colors.conf, rofi colors.rasi, mako, hyprlock, a btop theme, fish Catppuccin themes, an oh-my-posh catppuccin_macchiato.omp.json, and Kvantum Catppuccin-Macchiato-Lavender. The only dynamic part is inside the vendored HyprPanel: ags/services/matugen/index.ts runs `matugen image <wall> -t scheme-<type> --contrast <c> --json hex` and remaps its own colour map. That only themes the panel, and the shipped hyprpanel_config.json does not appear to turn matugen on (it sets theme.matugen_settings.mode dark and wallpaper.pywal false). Palette switching for Waybar works by copying hypr/waybar/themes/<name>/{config.jsonc,style.css} over the live files with a yad dialog. Theme dirs: frappe, frappe-bar, latte, latte-bar, macchiato, macchiato-bar, macchiato-bar-fhd, macchiato-blue, macchiato-fhd, mocha, mocha-bar, mocha-blue.
aesthetic.fonts: JetBrainsMono Nerd Font family throughout: 'JetBrainsMonoNL Nerd Font Mono' (kitty size 18, rofi 16), 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font' (foot size 8, Waybar theme variants 18px bold, hyprlock), 'JetBrainsMonoNL Nerd Font Propo Medium Italic' at 1.0rem (HyprPanel). Default hypr/waybar/style.css uses UbuntuMono 18px bold. GTK uses 'Noto Sans 10'. wlogout/wofi use 'JetBrains Mono', 'Iosevka Nerd Font', archcraft. The rofi power menu uses the Archcraft 'feather bold 32' icon font. ttf-font-awesome plus the whole nerd-fonts group are installed.
aesthetic.icons_cursor_gtk_qt: GTK theme catppuccin-macchiato-mauve-standard+default, icons Tela-circle-purple-dark, cursor BreezeX-RoséPine at size 32 (plus the rose-pine-cursor and rose-pine-hyprcursor packages). Applied through gsettings in hypr/scripts/gtkthemes and gtk-3.0/settings.ini (prefer-dark=1, hintslight, rgb). Qt uses Kvantum Catppuccin-Macchiato-Lavender. fish sets QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb globally, which is odd on Wayland. Notification/OSD icons are custom PNGs in hypr/mako/icons (volume, brightness, mic, timer, picture, palette, dropper, music). wlogout has PNG icons.
aesthetic.geometry: Hyprland (hyprtheme.conf): border_size 2, gaps_in 5, gaps_out 10, rounding 10, gradient angle 45deg. active_opacity 1.0, inactive_opacity 0.8, fullscreen_opacity 1.0, dim_inactive false. Blur enabled with size 16 (passes left at default). Shadow colour variables 0x66000000 are defined but never used. A windowrule sets opacity 0.93 for code/kitty/vesktop/youtube-music/thunar/zed/nemo. `layerrule = blur on`. dwindle special_scale_factor 0.8. Waybar: height 30, fully transparent window, each module a pill with background rgba(36,39,58,0.6), border-radius 10px, margin 8px, padding 6px 9px. Joined pill groups use asymmetric radii (10px 0 0 10px / 0 10px 10px 0). Launcher and power buttons are solid mauve and red pills. The '-bar' variants use a solid shade(@base,0.9) bar with 0.5s ease transitions and a 10px-radius tooltip with a 2px mauve border. Rofi launcher: 1000px wide, radius 20px, 2px mauve border, 2 columns x 8 lines, fully round (100%) pills, 32px icons, wallpaper banner inputbar with 80px 60px padding. Rofi power menu: 800px, radius 20px, 6x1 icon buttons, radius 12px. Mako: 300x100, margin 10, padding 15, border 2, radius 15, icon max 48, top-right, overlay layer, max-visible 5. Hyprlock: screenshot background, blur_size 4, blur_passes 3, noise 0.0117, contrast 1.0, vibrancy 0.21; input 250x50, outline 3, dots 0.2/0.64, fail_transition 300ms; 64px clock. Kitty: padding 10, powerline slanted tabs on top. Foot: pad 15x15. wlogout: radius 10, 5 per row, 50px spacing.
aesthetic.animations: No custom beziers. Everything uses `default`: windowsIn 1,5,default,popin 0%; windowsOut 1,5,default,popin; windowsMove 1,5,default,slide; fadeIn/fadeOut/fadeSwitch/fadeShadow/fadeDim 1,8,default; border 1,10,default; workspaces 1,5,default,slide. Per-class window animations: foot-full slides down, wlogout slides up. The wallpaper transition is the most polished motion: `swww img ... --transition-type grow --transition-fps 120 --transition-pos 'top-right' --transition-duration 2`. Waybar theme variants use CSS `transition: all 0.5s ease`, and a critical battery blinks with 0.5s linear infinite alternate.
aesthetic.wallpapers: Bundled in backgrounds/: aesthetic.jpg, ba_tori_macchiato.png, cat-waves-macchiato.png, cat-waves-mocha.png, deer.jpg, kayoko_macchiato.png, march7.jpg, mountain_sunset.jpg, wp6374897.webp. Also hypr/wallpapers/: lockscreen.png, wallpaper.jpg, wallpaper-alt.jpg. The README credits the default March 7th (Honkai: Star Rail) wallpaper to pixiv artwork 97911234 by artist 'Rafa'. ba_tori and kayoko look like Blue Archive fan art, judging by the filenames (not verified). No licence or attribution for the others. wp6374897.webp, apparently from a wallpaper-aggregator site, is also hardcoded as the rofi banner image. The MIT licence does not cover any of this art. cat-waves-* are Catppuccin-community style wallpapers.
aesthetic.vibe: A soft, cute, anime-leaning pastel look: a lavender-to-pink gradient border, floating translucent pills on a transparent Waybar, a rofi launcher with a big anime wallpaper banner, a mauve-on-navy hyprlock over a blurred screenshot, and a kitty image logo in fastfetch. The screenshots show it looking pleasant and cohesive at first glance. It is 'nice Catppuccin rice' rather than top tier. There are no custom beziers, no shadows, and nothing dynamic from the wallpaper. The Archcraft palette (#20262C) leaks into wlogout/wofi/swaylock/foot, and the Waybar cava uses Mocha while everything else is Macchiato, so up close it is inconsistent. The polish is mid: good defaults, borrowed structure (Archcraft scripts, a verbatim HyprPanel fork), and yad dialogs that look plain next to the rest.

components.compositor: Hyprland (stable; config updated for 0.53.0), based on Archcraft's 'Hyprland configuration file for Archcraft Version 0.22.0'. It sources hyprtheme.conf for theme variables. dwindle layout, fr,us layout with grp:alt_shift_toggle, 3-finger horizontal workspace gesture, special workspace scratchpad on SUPER+EQUAL.
components.bar_or_shell: Waybar is the default, launched by hypr/scripts/statusbar with `--bar main-bar --config ~/.config/hypr/waybar/config.jsonc`. Left: launcher, hyprland/workspaces, theme-swap button, tray, cava-internal, mpd#2/#3/#4 prev/play/next cluster, mpd. Center: clock with a pastel calendar tooltip. Right: backlight, pulseaudio, hyprland/language, temperature, memory, battery, network, power. There are 12 theme variants under hypr/waybar/themes. The alternative is HyprPanel (AGS v1 TypeScript fork vendored in ags/, from Jas-SinghFSU) with ags/config/hyprpanel_config.json and a custom ags/themes/lightcrimson_macchiato.json. You enable it by uncommenting `hyprpanel &` in the startup script. A legacy top-level waybar/ (Sway era) also exists.
components.launcher: rofi-wayland with adi1090x-style themes in hypr/rofi: launcher.rasi (drun/run/filebrowser/window, wallpaper banner), runner, music, networkmenu (plus networkmenu_config.ini), screenshot, powermenu plus confirm.rasi, and shared colors/fonts. There are also wofi configs (wofi_menu, wofi_powermenu), wofi-emoji on SUPER+E, and a full vendored copy of the adi1090x rofi collection under rofi/ (basic, deathemonic).
components.notifications: mako (hypr/mako/config), launched by hypr/scripts/notifications. It plays a freedesktop sound on notify via mpv, uses urgency and mpd-category rules, and is used as an OSD through notify-send -h string:x-canonical-private-synchronous with custom PNG icons for volume/brightness/mic/screenshot countdown. HyprPanel's own notification popups apply when that panel is used.
components.lock_idle_logout: hyprlock (hypr/hyprlock.conf): blurred screenshot background, HH:MM:SS clock, 'Hey $USER', current keyboard layout, 'Type to unlock!'. Bound to CTRL+ALT+L and to lid close via bindl switch:on:Lid Switch. A legacy swaylock-effects script (hypr/scripts/lockscreen) is still in the repo. There is no hypridle/swayidle config. Logout: rofi power menu (SUPER+X) with a yes/no confirmation. Suspend pauses mpc, mutes via pulsemixer and runs hyprlock first. wlogout layout/style is also present but its bind is commented out.
components.wallpaper_tool: swww (swww-daemon started in the startup script). The hypr/scripts/background yad list picker with image previews is bound to SUPER+SHIFT+B. It writes the choice to ~/.config/hypr/env/.current_background and sends a notification using the wallpaper as its icon.
components.terminal: kitty is the default via hypr/scripts/terminal. Options: -f floating (kitty-float class), -F fullscreen, -s slurp an area and size a floating kitty to it. Kitty uses Catppuccin Macchiato, JetBrainsMonoNL Nerd Font Mono 18, padding 10 and powerline slanted tabs. foot (hypr/foot) is used for the floating cheatsheet (micro opening cheatsheet.md, SUPER+SHIFT+I). alacritty is used in Waybar on-click actions (btop, nmtui, htop). alacritty.toml plus a legacy YAML theme are included.
components.shell_prompt: fish (Garuda/CachyOS-style config.fish with exa/bat aliases, bang-bang functions, find-the-command hook, done.fish, and mpd_update/fishfetch functions) plus oh-my-posh using ~/.config/oh-my-posh/themes/catppuccin_macchiato.omp.json. The fish_plugins file lists catppuccin/fish. A fallback fish_prompt prints blue pwd and a red/yellow/green '❯❯❯'.
components.editor: geany (SUPER+SHIFT+E) and micro for the cheatsheet. VSCode (code) and zed appear only in opacity rules. No editor config is shipped.
components.file_manager: thunar (SUPER+N). nemo appears in opacity rules.
components.fetch: fastfetch (fastfetch/config.jsonc): kitty-protocol PNG logo (pngs/icon.png, height 18), colour-dot rows, a custom quote ('We thirst for the seven wailings. / We bear the koan of Jericho.'), Nerd-Font keyed modules including media and an 'OS Age' command using `stat -c %W /`, and 'GitHub : yurihikari' hardcoded. Legacy neofetch configs are also included, with hutao/elaina ASCII art.
components.login_boot: None found. No display manager, GRUB/Limine/systemd-boot theme or Plymouth. The fish alias `grubup` implies GRUB, but it is not themed here.
components.extras: cava (the raw ascii output of cava/config1 is piped through sed into block glyphs inside Waybar; a normal cava config and GLSL shaders normalized_bars.frag/pass_through.vert are also included). mpd + mpc with the Waybar transport cluster and a rofi music menu. btop with the catppuccin_macchiato theme. Kvantum Catppuccin-Macchiato-Lavender. hyprpicker colour picker (SUPER+P). The screenshot script (grim/slurp/wl-copy with 5s/10s countdowns and viewnior preview) plus grimblast and gpu-screen-recorder listed as dependencies. The HyprPanel screen_record.sh/snapshot.sh. A yad display-mode switcher (hypr/scripts/screen: Normal / Presentation mirror / Selective mirror via hyprctl keyword monitor). A cheatsheet.md. nm-applet, blueberry, pavucontrol, gnome-keyring and polkit-gnome.

standout_features: Gradient window border from Archcraft lavender 0xFFB4A1DB to hot pink 0xFFD04E9D at 45deg, kept in a separate hyprtheme.conf variables file ($hypr_border_size, $hypr_gaps_in/out, $hypr_rounding, colour variables), so the look can be changed without touching the main config.

Waybar 'floating pills' look: the bar window is fully transparent and each module is its own rgba(36,39,58,0.6) pill with 10px radius and 8px margins. Pills are grouped with asymmetric radii (backlight 10px 0 0 10px ... battery 0 10px 10px 0), and the launcher and power buttons are solid mauve and red pills.

An inline MPD transport inside Waybar built from three mpd module instances (mpd#2 prev, mpd#3 play/pause state icon, mpd#4 next) styled as one joined pill, plus a live cava visualizer rendered as ▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█ glyphs by piping `cava -p config1` (raw ascii, ascii_max_range 6) through sed.

A Waybar theme switcher: hypr/waybar/themes/<name>/{config.jsonc,style.css} for 12 Catppuccin flavour/layout variants (floating vs solid '-bar', '-blue' accent, '-fhd' sizing for 1080p). A yad list copies the chosen files over the live ones and restarts Waybar, triggered from a 'Themes' pill on the bar or SUPER+SHIFT+T.

Wallpaper picker using `yad --list --image-column` with thumbnails, then `swww img --transition-type grow --transition-fps 120 --transition-pos top-right --transition-duration 2`, then a notify-send that uses the new wallpaper as its icon.

A rofi launcher with an anime wallpaper banner as the inputbar background (url(..., width), 80px 60px padding), rounded pill prompt/entry/mode buttons, and a 2-column grid of 32px icons in a 1000px 20px-radius window with a 2px mauve border. The matching 6-button icon power menu uses the same banner and a confirmation dialog.

A mako-as-OSD pattern: volume/brightness/mic/screenshot scripts call notify-send with x-canonical-private-synchronous hints so notifications replace each other in place, with custom PNG icons chosen by level (volume-low/mid/high/mute, brightness-20..100).

A screenshot script with a notification countdown ('Taking shot in : N' for 5/10s), capture sound, copy to clipboard, viewnior preview and saved/deleted feedback. The slurp selection colours match the palette (-b 20262CCC -c B4A1DBff -s B4A1DB0D -w 2).
`terminal -s`: drag out a rectangle with slurp to spawn a floating kitty of exactly that size. It generates a kitty-custom.conf that includes kitty.conf and sets initial_window_width/height.

A display-mode switcher (hypr/scripts/screen) with yad: Normal, Presentation (mirror laptop to all externals via `hyprctl keyword monitor <ext>,highres@60,0x0,1.25,mirror,<laptop>`) and Selective mirror.

hyprlock over a live blurred screenshot (blur_size 4, passes 3, noise 0.0117, vibrancy 0.21), with a friendly 'Hey <User>' label (text_transform capitalize), a live HH:MM:SS clock, a keyboard-layout readout and a 300ms fail colour transition.
fastfetch with a kitty-graphics PNG logo, colour-dot rows, a custom quote block and an 'OS Age' module computed from filesystem birth time (`stat -c %W /`).

Optional HyprPanel (AGS) with a dashboard (shortcuts, directories, system monitors), weather, media and notification menus, a user-authored lightcrimson_macchiato.json theme, and built-in matugen wallpaper theming.
structure_install: Flat ~/.config mirror at the repo root: Kvantum/, ags/ (a full vendored HyprPanel source tree with package.json, tsconfig, scss, themes, and its own flake.nix/nix/default.nix from upstream), alacritty/, backgrounds/, btop/, cava/, fastfetch/, fish/, gtk-3.0/, hypr/ (hyprland.conf, hyprtheme.conf, hyprlock.conf, cheatsheet.md, and foot/, mako/, rofi/, scripts/, wallpapers/, waybar/, wlogout/, wofi/ all nested under hypr so the Hyprland session uses its own copies), kitty/, mako/, mpd/, neofetch/, oh-my-posh/themes/, rofi/, waybar/ (legacy Sway-era), wofi/. Two install paths. (1) Manual: `git clone ... && cp -r garuda-sway-config/* ~/.config`; note the README clone URL is the old repo name. (2) install.sh, Arch/Garuda only and interactive. It optionally runs a system update (the `update` alias on Garuda, else `sudo pacman -Syu --noconfirm`), installs paru, and adds Chaotic-AUR keys plus the repo to /etc/pacman.conf. It then paru-installs about 33 deps (yad fastfetch cava-git foot mpd mpc ttf-font-awesome nerd-fonts hyprpicker pipewire wireplumber fish pavucontrol most rose-pine-cursor rose-pine-hyprcursor bluez bluez-utils grimblast gpu-screen-recorder btop networkmanager matugen wl-clipboard swww dart-sass brightnessctl gnome-bluetooth-3.0 micro blueberry oh-my-posh wofi-emoji kitty) and runs `curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash` followed by symlinking bun into /usr/local/bin. It offers to `pacman -Rdd` rofi, hyprland-git and aylurs-gtk-shell, then installs rofi-wayland, hyprland, waybar, hyprlock and ags-hyprpanel-git, and removes wlsunset. Finally it runs `rsync -av $DIR/* ~/.config` (excluding .git/LICENSE/README), appends a btop color_theme line and offers a reboot. Autostart goes through a single `exec-once=~/.config/hypr/scripts/startup` bash script.
nix_patterns: No NixOS or home-manager configuration by the repo author. The only Nix files are ags/flake.nix, ags/flake.lock and ags/nix/default.nix, vendored unchanged from upstream HyprPanel as part of the copied source tree.

For a NixOS port, every file would need translating: the hardcoded /usr/lib/polkit-gnome path, /usr/share/doc/find-the-command/ftc.fish, /usr/share/sounds paths, /bin/fish in foot.ini, and the pacman/paru/chaotic-aur logic all break on NixOS. The per-app Catppuccin Macchiato files map directly onto the catppuccin/nix module (flavor = macchiato, accent = mauve), or stylix with a base16 Macchiato scheme.

weaknesses: Officially unmaintained: the README points to yurihikari/ml4w-lightcrimson-dotfiles, and the install and clone instructions still use the old garuda-sway-config repo name.

Mostly derivative work. hyprland.conf, the scripts, rofi, wlogout, wofi, foot and mako are Archcraft's (adi1090x, copyright headers kept) with colours changed. ags/ is a verbatim fork of HyprPanel on AGS v1, including its .github CI, eslint config and flake. Upstream HyprPanel has since moved to AGS v2/Astal, so the vendored tree is dead weight and diverges from the ags-hyprpanel-git package the installer actually installs.

Inconsistent palettes. The Archcraft #20262C/#B4A1DB/#D04E9D set is still used in wlogout, wofi, the swaylock script, the slurp colours, foot bright colours and the Hyprland borders. Waybar's cava module uses Catppuccin Mocha hex (#cba6f7/#89b4fa) while its CSS is Macchiato. hypr/waybar/current_config.txt says 'lightcrimson', but no such Waybar theme exists.

Probable Hyprland config bugs (not tested). `$inactive_border_col_1 = 1e2030` has no 0x/rgb() prefix. The `workspaceopt allfloat/allpseudo` dispatchers are bound, though I believe they were removed from Hyprland some time ago (not checked against docs). The shadow variables are defined but no shadow {} block uses them. `layerrule = blur on` has no layer match. $wofi_screenshot points to ~/.config/sway/scripts/screenshot.sh, which the repo no longer ships.
No custom bezier curves: every animation uses `default`, so window motion looks stock.

Hardcoded to one user and machine. French AZERTY workspace binds (ampersand, eacute, egrave, ccedilla, agrave) mixed with number binds, kb_layout fr,us. Temperature hwmon-path /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon1/temp1_input. Weather location 'Los Angeles' in imperial units. 'GitHub : yurihikari' in fastfetch. Brave/geany/thunar/librewolf/vesktop/youtube-music baked into binds and the HyprPanel shortcuts. The screen script assumes the first monitor is the laptop and hardcodes 1.25/1.2 scaling and a 120Hz panel. The Selective mode uses the wrong variable ($ext instead of $TARGET).

Bad session practices in the startup script. It starts `pipewire &` and `wireplumber &` manually, which fights the systemd user units. It uses `killall -9 waybar mako`, `exec ... &` lines, the Arch-only /usr/lib/polkit-gnome path, and starts both nm-applet and mpd from the script. There is no hypridle or any idle/DPMS handling, only lid-switch lock.

Risky install.sh. It adds Chaotic-AUR to /etc/pacman.conf, uses --noconfirm everywhere, runs `curl ... | bash` for bun and then `ln -s` into /usr/local/bin without sudo (this will fail). It offers `pacman -Rdd` (ignoring dependencies), installs the whole nerd-fonts group, blindly rsyncs everything over ~/.config, and appends to btop.conf on every run. Arch/Garuda only, with no idempotency or backup.
Runtime state committed to git: mpd/mpd.db, mpd/pid, mpd/log and mpd/state get rsynced over the user's own. fish/fish_variables is committed too.

Bundled, likely copyrighted fan art with no licence: March 7th (Honkai: Star Rail, pixiv 97911234 by Rafa), what looks like Blue Archive fan art (ba_tori, kayoko), and wp6374897.webp, apparently from a wallpaper aggregator and also hardcoded as the rofi banner. The repo's MIT licence cannot cover these.
Cava.sh uses ps|grep plus `killall cava`, which kills any other cava instance the user runs. Waybar now has a native cava module, which is even defined but unused in this config.
yad dialogs for the theme, wallpaper and display pickers are plain GTK list windows that clash with the polished rofi/HyprPanel look.
Nothing for NixOS: all paths assume FHS Arch (/usr/share/doc/find-the-command, /usr/share/sounds, /bin/fish in foot.ini), and fish forces QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb on a Wayland session.
steal_list: Keep compositor theme variables in their own sourced file (hyprtheme.conf style), but write colours as rgba()/0xAARRGGBB and generate the file from a single palette source (matugen template or stylix/catppuccin-nix) so Arch and NixOS share it.

The lavender-to-pink 45deg gradient border (B4A1DB to D04E9D) is a strong 'cute' signature. Pair it with custom beziers (for example overshot popin and easeOutQuint workspaces), which this repo lacks.

The Waybar floating-pill layout: transparent bar, rgba(base, 0.6) pills with 10px radius and 8px margin, joined groups via asymmetric radii, solid accent pills for the launcher (mauve) and power (red) buttons, and 0.5s ease transitions from the '-bar' variants.

The inline MPD prev/play/next cluster as one joined pill, plus an inline visualizer. Use Waybar's native `cava` module (already sketched in this config with bars 18, framerate 60, method pipewire) instead of the killall-based Cava.sh.
Pastel calendar tooltip markup for the clock (months #ffead3, days #ecc6d9, weeks #99ffdd, weekdays #ffcc66, today #ff6699 underlined). Recolour to the chosen palette.

The theme-variant directory pattern (themes/<name>/{config.jsonc,style.css}) with a one-click switcher. Replace yad with a rofi or fuzzel picker and, on NixOS, generate variants with home-manager instead of cp-ing over live files.

swww (now awww upstream) 'grow' transition from the top-right at 120fps over 2s, plus a notification showing the new wallpaper as its icon. Pair it with a rofi image-grid picker and a matugen/wallust re-theme hook.

A rofi launcher with a wallpaper banner header (inputbar background-image url(..., width), large padding, round pill entry and mode buttons, 2-column 32px-icon grid, 20px radius, 2px accent border), and the matching icon power menu with a confirmation step that pauses media and locks before suspend.

hyprlock over a live blurred screenshot (blur_passes 3, noise 0.0117, vibrancy 0.21), with a friendly capitalised 'Hey <user>' greeting, a keyboard-layout readout and a fail_transition colour animation. Add hypridle, which this repo lacks.
Mako/swaync synchronous-hint OSD notifications with level-specific icons and a countdown screenshot flow (5/10s notifications, capture sound, clipboard copy, preview, palette-matched slurp colours).

Small utilities worth keeping: `terminal -s` (slurp a rectangle to spawn a floating kitty that size), a display-mode switcher (normal/mirror) via hyprctl keyword monitor, a floating cheatsheet window bound to SUPER+SHIFT+I, and fastfetch's 'OS Age' module from `stat -c %W /`.

The coherent Catppuccin Macchiato app set: GTK catppuccin-macchiato-mauve, Tela-circle-purple-dark icons, BreezeX-RoséPine cursor (hyprcursor variant), Kvantum Catppuccin-Macchiato-Lavender, btop/kitty/fish/oh-my-posh Macchiato. On NixOS, reproduce it with the catppuccin/nix module (flavor macchiato, accent mauve) rather than copying files.

one_line: "Rumda": a cozy Hyprland + Quickshell rice in warm beige, caramel and espresso tones. It has a vertical left bar, a slide-up dashboard with a GitHub contribution heatmap, a pixel-art cat mascot, animated light/dark/pixel/warm theme switching, and a matte-frame look from borders-plus-plus. It is built on xfcasio/amadeus, the author runs Fedora, and it has no Arch or Nix packaging.
freshness: Actively maintained. The commits.atom feed shows the last commit on 2026-06-13 (README). Earlier 2026 commits: "swww renamed to awww", "change old windowrulev2 syntax", "gate the last few hypr/quickshell commands in the install script", "userContent.css + hypr_compact.sh", "compact mode shadow toggle", "fix overflow issue in warm bar on small screens" and "major refactor - reformat all qml files" (Apr 2026). The README says the Rumda-pistachio theme is unmaintained and that the cat widget and bluetooth are still WIP. I did not check star or fork counts.

aesthetic.palette: Custom 'Rumda' warm latte/caramel/cookie scheme. It is earthy-warm, not candy-pastel. LIGHT (common/quickshell/light/config/Colors.qml): bar #f0c997, border #f2bc88, moduleBG #f0bb90, indicatorBG #dba380, accent #a1694d, accent2 #c47c4f, gradientAccent2 #a87358, error #9A4235, shadow #AA784d37, dashBG #F5DCC6, dashModules #f2cdac. Contribution levels run #db986e > #ba7245 > #9e5b2f > #8f4f24 > #7d431f. DARK (dark/config/Colors.qml): bar #1c1612, dashBG #2b221a, moduleBG #3d2e21, border #3A2D22, accent #c47c4f, gradient #d68e60, indicator #f0bb90. Dark contribution levels run #5c3d2d > #f7b292; the pixel-dark flavour uses border #784D37. Hyprland borders: light rgba(f2bc88FF), dark rgba(784d37FF), warm rgba(F0BB90FF), pixel rgba(90664AFF). Terminal (Alacritty light): bg #F5DCC6, fg #4E2E1F, cursor #6D4A39, selection bg #E6C0A1. ANSI: black #20111b, red #be100e, green #858162, yellow #d08b30, blue #426a79, magenta #97522c, cyan #989a9c, white #968c83, bright black #5e5252, bright white #F5DCC6. Ghostty says this palette is 'Belafonte Day', entered by hand. Rofi: bg #F2D5BB, fg #9E6D54, selected #c47c4f, active #a1694d, and a frame/offset-shadow colour of #8F664A. Mako light: bg #F2CDAC, text #A1694D, border #F2BC88. Mako dark: bg #3D2E21, text #F0BB90, border #784D37. The NvChad base16 light theme has base00 #F5DCC6, base08 #ab4637, base0B #447028 and base0D #426A79.
aesthetic.color_pipeline: Static hand-picked hex values. There is no matugen, wallust, pywal or stylix. Colours are duplicated by hand in Quickshell Colors.qml (six copies across the light, dark, pixel and warm flavours), in each light/dark hyprland.conf, and in the alacritty, ghostty, mako, rofi colors.rasi, hyprlock, NvChad base46, btop/bpytop, yazi (kanagawa flavors) and Vencord files. Switching themes means swapping whole files. scripts/hyprtheme.sh runs `ln -fs` from light-config/ or dark-config/ into ~/.config for hyprland.conf, then calls alacrittytheme.sh, yazitheme.sh, zathuratheme.sh, makotheme.sh and locktheme.sh, then `hyprctl reload`. wall.sh changes the wallpaper through awww. warmtheme.sh and pixeltheme.sh also kill and restart Quickshell with a different flavour's shell.qml.
aesthetic.fonts: Terminess Nerd Font (Terminus), bundled in common/fonts/Terminus with its LICENSE, is used in Alacritty (Bold, size 12), mako, the hyprlock input and date, and zsh. Dogica Pixel is bundled (dogica/dogicapixel .ttf) and is the rofi font at size 7 ('Dogica Pixel 7'). Suls.ttf is also bundled. Hyprlock's clock uses Noto Sans Bold at 100. jetbrains-mono-fonts is listed in the dependencies. The Vencord theme uses 'Ac437 PhoenixVGA 9x16'. The README banner uses Silkscreen. installFonts.sh copies the fonts to ~/.local/share/fonts and runs fc-cache.
aesthetic.icons_cursor_gtk_qt: No GTK, Qt, icon-theme or cursor configuration exists anywhere in the repo. Bar and dashboard icons are hand-picked SVGs in quickshell/*/icons: svgrepo files such as cat-svgrepo-com(1).svg and ethernet-svgrepo-com.svg, fedora-symbolic.svg, pixel-style logoutPix, padlockPix, powerPix and readmePix SVGs, connected/disconnected cat faces, plus leftover *backup.svg copies. For Firefox, the README recommends the AMO theme 'rumda' by Looma.
aesthetic.geometry: Hyprland (light): gaps_in 9, gaps_out 45,40,45,40, border_size 3, rounding 7, active_opacity 1.0, inactive_opacity 0.99. Blur is on with size 1, passes 2, vibrancy 0.1696. Shadow is on with range 7, render_power 9, offset 5 4, colour 0xAA784d37. Dark: same gaps, inactive_opacity 1.0, shadow disabled. The borders-plus-plus plugin adds one extra border (light: 11px #F5DCC6; dark: 13px #1C1612; warm: 11px #F0C997), which gives a thick matte picture frame around each window. Pixel flavour: rounding 1, border_size 1 #90664A, a stacked 4-border setup (2/0/3/8px in #F5DCC6/#F5DCC6/#F2BC88/#F5DCC6), blur off, and a hard retro offset shadow (range 1, render_power 12, offset 9 9, colour 0xCC784D37). Warm: gaps_in 10, border 4. hypr_compact.sh (Super+G) switches to gaps_out 5,5,5,13 and gaps_in 1 with shadow off. Quickshell bar: vertical and left-anchored, width 48, marginTop/Bottom 80, marginLeft 18, radius 4, border 2, DropShadow offset 3,0, radius 6, spread 0.45. Modules are 28px wide with radius 7 and a 1px border. Workspace pills are 8px custom ShapePaths, 34px tall when active and 19px when inactive. Dashboard: 790x485, radius 12, border 3, inner padding 10, inner module radius 9, 12px contribution squares, shadow offset 3,3. Rofi: 20% x 34%, square corners (radius 0/1), a 6px right/bottom hard offset shadow made with window padding over #8F664A, and a 2px mainbox border. Mako: 300x200, border 2, radius 2, margin 20, padding 8. Hyprlock: input 10% x 4% with rounding 8, background brightness 0.70, blur 1x1.
aesthetic.animations: Hyprland beziers: easeOutQuint 0.23,1,0.32,1; easeInOutCubic 0.65,0.05,0.36,1; linear 0,0,1,1; almostLinear 0.5,0.5,0.75,1.0; quick 0.15,0,0.1,1; overshoot 0.05,0.9,0.1,1.1; fakeElastic 0.68,0.5,0.265,1 (light/warm) or 0.68,-0.1,0.265,1 (dark); xfcBezier 0.1,0.9,0.1,1.03 (from amadeus). Animation lines: windows 4.79 easeOutQuint; windowsIn 4 default slide bottom; windowsOut 8 default slide top; windowsMove 3 fakeElastic slide; fadeIn 1.73 and fadeOut 1.46 almostLinear; fade 3.03 quick; layers 3.81 easeOutQuint; layersIn 4 easeOutQuint fade; layersOut 1.5 linear fade; workspaces 4 xfcBezier; border 1.39 easeOutQuint. `animation = borderangle, 1.39` is malformed. Quickshell: when the theme switches, the bar slides off-screen (anchors margin animated to 'barsGrave' 1400px over 600ms InOutCubic), then after 950ms the Loader swaps LightBar and DarkBar. Workspace pill height uses OutQuart 200ms. The dashboard slides up from the bottom with InOutCubic 250ms. The cat 'jump' plays 9 PNG frames with per-frame margin, size and rotation keyframes. Wallpaper changes use awww `--transition-type grow --transition-pos top-right` (pixel/warm: bottom-left) with duration 1 and bezier 0.4,0.0,0.2,1.0. Hyprlock uses a linear fade of 1.0.
aesthetic.wallpapers: Bundled in pictures/: light-wallpaper.png, the dark-wallpaper variants (-archived, -gruv, -highcontrast, -original, _vesper), wallpaper-warm.png, nazhim-warm.png, nazhim-pixel.png, lock.png and lock-dark.png. The profile pictures are GatoInPan*.png (a cat in a pan). The rofi folder also holds F2p8SHtWoAAE2HD.jpg (a Twitter/X-style media filename), p1.png and p2.webp, and quickshell has player-background.jpg. The README gives no artist credit or license for any wallpaper or art, so provenance is unclear.
aesthetic.vibe: Very cute, cozy and distinctive: 'a warmer, more cozy desktop' (installer tagline, with kaomoji cats). The whole desktop reads like milk tea and cookies. It pairs a thin vertical bar with chamfered pill workspaces, a cat face that smiles when you are online, and chunky beige matte window frames from the double borders. The Dogica pixel font in rofi and the hard offset shadows give a retro zine or pixel-art feel. The light theme is the strongest, and the pixel flavour (1px rounding, stacked borders, 9px hard shadow) is a charming neo-brutalist variant. It is quite polished visually but the engineering is unfinished. The cat mascot is disabled by default because of glitches, bluetooth is WIP, dashboard sizes are hard-coded for 1920px screens, and QML is copy-pasted six times. It is less 'pastel' than it is warm and earthy, and highly cohesive within that palette.

components.compositor: Hyprland, dwindle layout with pseudotile and preserve_split. It uses the borders-plus-plus plugin via hyprpm; hyprbars and imgborders blocks are present but disabled or commented. Keyboard layouts are us and ara, toggled with grp:win_space_toggle.
components.bar_or_shell: Quickshell (QML), based on xfcasio/amadeus. A vertical left bar is split into TopSection, CenterSection and BottomSection. Modules: Workspaces (custom Shape pills), VolumeControl with PopoutVolume, RadialIndicator, WeatherStatus (curl wttr.in ?format=%t), ThemeSwitch, InternetConnection (a cat face that pings 1.0.0.1 every 5s; clicking it switches to the pixel flavour) and Power. The Dashboard overlay opens with Super+Tab through a FIFO and contains ProfileAndPower, DashBoardControls (media, screenshot, terminal, folder, search, bluetooth WIP), DashBrightnessControl and ContribGraph (a GitHub heatmap from github-contributions-api.jogruber.de with tooltips). There is also a Rumda_the_cat walking/jumping sprite widget, CatAnimation.
components.launcher: Rofi, from an adi1090x template: drun with icons off, 'Dogica Pixel 7', a 'Search...' placeholder and a hard offset shadow frame. Super+Q opens a 'calligraphy' variant: rofi_poetry.py picks a random Arabic poetry couplet from quotes.txt and writes it into an SVG, inkscape converts that to PNG, and rofi shows it as a header imagebox.
components.notifications: mako, with light and dark configs swapped by makotheme.sh. Settings: anchor top-right, layer overlay, group-by app-name, 5s timeout, max-visible 5.
components.lock_idle_logout: hyprlock, with light and dark confs symlinked by locktheme.sh: image background, centred Noto Sans Bold clock, Terminess date, and an input field placed low on screen (0,-450). There is no hypridle or other idle daemon. Power, logout and lock are handled by the Quickshell Power module and the dashboard's ProfileAndPower (pixel icons). Super+L runs hyprlock.
components.wallpaper_tool: awww, the renamed swww. wall.sh starts awww-daemon if it is not running and applies a grow transition.
components.terminal: Alacritty is the default ($terminal): Terminess Nerd Font Bold 12, padding 7/8, underline blinking cursor, no decorations. Ghostty is on Super+Shift+Return with the same palette ('Belafonte Day'), window-padding 7/8 and a config-float variant.
components.shell_prompt: zsh with oh-my-zsh (plugins git and zsh-shift-select), zsh-syntax-highlighting and zsh-autosuggestions from /usr/share, and fzf. The PS1 is hand-rolled with truecolour brown tones (#6D5E53 user, #AD704A @, #c47c4f host, #9A4235 error) plus a vcs_info git segment. eza aliases are included. The FZF colours (#00070B etc.) are left over from a different theme.
components.editor: Neovim with NvChad. It ships custom base46 themes rumda-light, rumda-dark, rumda-warm and rumda-extra-warm, plus chadrc.lua (not installed by default), conform and lspconfig.
components.file_manager: Nautilus is on the keybind and in Common.qml cFileManager. yazi is themed with the kanagawa-dragon and kanagawa-lotus flavors (installed with `ya pkg`). thunar is in the dependencies.
components.fetch: neofetch with a custom config.conf, art.txt and an SVG image through the kitty backend (alias `rumdafetch='neofetch --source .../2.svg --kitty --size 230'`).
components.login_boot: None. There is no display manager, GRUB, systemd-boot or Plymouth theming.
components.extras: btop and bpytop 'rumda' themes. Firefox userContent.css replaces the new-tab page with a blank background and a sleeping cat image hosted on nytril-ark.github.io, and the README recommends the AMO 'rumda' Firefox theme. A Vencord theme is the refact0r 'midnight' theme recoloured (rumda.midnight.light.css). Zathura is themed. Screenshots use grim, slurp and swappy (qscreen.sh copies a region to wl-copy; screenshot.sh edits in swappy). ocr.sh runs grim, slurp and tesseract into wl-copy. hyprpicker is on Super+Shift+C, OBS on Ctrl+Alt+R, and hypr_compact.sh on Super+G. There is also a 'tinkerer' first-run backup and onboarding flow. Bongocat lines are commented out.

standout_features: Rumda the cat: a pixel-art mascot drawn as its own wlr-layershell surface next to the bar. On theme switch it plays 9 PNG jump frames, each with its own margin, size and rotation keyframes, and 'leaves' the bar. Clicking the empty spot plays the frames in reverse to bring it back. A separate 16-frame walk cycle can move it across the screen.

Animated bar swap on theme change: the bar slides off-screen (600ms InOutCubic, 1400px 'barsGrave'). After 950ms a Loader swaps LightBar and DarkBar, the new bar slides in, and the same moment hyprtheme.sh symlinks every app config and awww plays a 'grow' wallpaper transition from the top-right. The result is one choreographed light/dark switch.
The internet indicator is a cat face that smiles when connected and frowns when offline. Clicking it switches to the 'pixel' flavour.
Custom chamfered workspace pills built with QtQuick.Shapes PathLine/PathArc (8px wide; 34px active vs 19px inactive; OutQuart 200ms). They look more handmade than stock rounded rectangles.

A matte picture-frame look from borders-plus-plus: one thick 11-13px inner border in the background colour (#F5DCC6 light, #1C1612 dark) inside a 3px accent border. The pixel flavour stacks 4 borders (2/0/3/8px) with a hard 9px offset shadow for a retro zine or brutalist style.

A dashboard (Super+Tab) that slides up from the bottom. It has a profile picture, power buttons, media and quick controls, a brightness slider, and a GitHub contribution heatmap recoloured into a 5-step caramel ramp with hover tooltips.

The 'calligraphy' rofi: a Python script puts a random Arabic poetry couplet into an SVG header in theme colours and renders it with inkscape before launching rofi. This is a personal, cultural touch that is easy to generalise (quotes or haiku in the launcher header).
The rofi hard offset shadow is made with window padding `0px 6px 6px 0px` over a #8F664A window background with square corners, giving a neo-brutalist card look without compositor shadows.
Compact-mode toggle (Super+G): a stateful script flips gaps_out between 45,40,45,40 and 5,5,5,13, flips gaps_in between 9 and 1, and turns shadows on or off through hyprctl keyword.

Four coordinated flavours (light, dark, warm, pixel), each with its own Hyprland conf, Quickshell tree and wallpaper. A single script switches everything, including the Alacritty, Yazi, Zathura, Mako, Hyprlock and NvChad themes.

The installer is friendly and includes kaomoji cats. It has per-component INSTALL_* toggles and timestamped backups. A 'tinkerer' flag file catches users who skipped the installer: the configs are backed up and tinkerer.md opens in an editor.
structure_install: The top level contains common/ (hypr keybinds.conf and environment.conf, the quickshell trees light/, dark/ and shared/ with shell.qml, nvim/NvChad themes, btop, bpytop, neofetch, fonts, firefox, vencord and tinkerer), light-config/ and dark-config/ (per-theme alacritty, ghostty, hypr/hyprland.conf and hyprlock.conf, mako, rofi including rofi/calligraphy, btop, yazi and zathura), flavours/ (pixel-rumda/{dark,light}/hyprland.conf and a full quickshell copy; warm-rumda/hyprland.conf, alacritty.toml and a full quickshell copy), pictures/ (wallpapers, lock images, profile pictures, screenshots and gifs), rumda-pistachio/ (the old theme with its own installer), scripts/ (hyprtheme, wall, alacrittytheme, yazitheme, zathuratheme, makotheme, locktheme, pixeltheme, pixel_hypr, warmtheme, warm_hypr, warm_alacritty, hypr_compact, calligraphy with rofi_poetry.py, screenshot, qscreen, ocr, installFonts), .zshrc and install.sh. Install: `cd ~/.config && git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/Nytril-ark/rumda && cd rumda && ./install.sh`, and the repo must stay at ~/.config/rumda. install.sh does not install any packages. The user installs the dependencies by hand; the README lists Fedora-style names such as jetbrains-mono-fonts and lz4-devel. The script asks light or pistachio, then git pull (or optionally `git reset --hard origin/main`). It copies each light-config/common subtree into ~/.config/<app> after moving old configs to *.backup.<timestamp>, runs installFonts.sh, writes the tinkerer flag, runs hyprtheme.sh light (which replaces ~/.config/hypr/hyprland.conf with a symlink back into the repo), kills and relaunches quickshell with `-p ~/.config/rumda/common/quickshell/shell.qml`, and installs the yazi flavor with `ya pkg`. At runtime Hyprland `source=`s keybinds from the repo path and exec-once's quickshell, wall.sh and hyprtheme.sh on every login.

key_snippets.purpose: Theme switch pipeline: symlink the per-theme Hyprland conf, fan out to per-app theme scripts, then reload
key_snippets.excerpt:
case "$THEME" in
  light)
    SRC="$RUMDA_DIR/light-config/hypr/hyprland.conf"
    ;;
  dark)
    SRC="$RUMDA_DIR/dark-config/hypr/hyprland.conf"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "Usage: $0 [light|dark]"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

if [[ ! -f "$SRC" ]]; then
  echo "Theme config not found at: $SRC"
  exit 1
fi

sleep 0.9
rm -f "$COMMON_FILE"
ln -fs "$SRC" "$COMMON_FILE"

key_snippets.purpose: Neo-brutalist launcher card: a hard 6px offset shadow made from window padding over a brown background

weaknesses: Nothing works on Arch or NixOS out of the box. The author runs Fedora (README: 'I use Fedora'), dependency names are Fedora packages (jetbrains-mono-fonts, lz4-devel), and install.sh installs no packages. There is no PKGBUILD, package list or flake/home-manager module.

Massive copy-paste: the whole QML tree (bar, barModules, barSections, widgets, icons, config) exists six times (common light/dark, pixel-rumda light/dark, warm-rumda light/dark). dark-config/rofi/rofi/ duplicates dark-config/rofi/. Stray *backup.svg and converted-1760526429.svg files are committed. Palette values are repeated by hand in 10+ files with no single source of truth or template generator.

Hard-coded paths: `/home/$USER/.config/rumda/...` everywhere (keybinds, exec-once, hyprlock `path = /home/$USER/.config/rumda/pictures/lock.png`; I did not verify whether hyprlock expands $USER). exec-once uses a relative path, `quickshell -p .config/rumda/...`, that depends on cwd being $HOME. The disabled imgborders block contains `/home/hexogen/Downloads/border1.png`. .zshrc contains `/home/hexogen/...` aliases, sccache and bun. The repo must live at ~/.config/rumda.

Hard-coded screen assumptions: ScreenConf.screenWidth is 1920, dashboard is 790x485, barsGrave is 1400px, cat margins are hard-coded ('bind it to the bar later'), and cGithubUsername defaults to the author's 'Nytril-ark'.

Hacky IPC: the dashboard toggle is `echo toggle > /tmp/qs-dashboard.fifo`, read by a `bash -c 'mkfifo ...; while true; do cat fifo; done'` Process inside Quickshell. Quickshell's IpcHandler plus `qs ipc call` would be the idiomatic replacement. The internet status runs `ping -c1 1.0.0.1` every 5s instead of NetworkManager/DBus. Weather curls wttr.in and the contribution graph curls a third-party API with no error UI.

Hyprland syntax risks: `animation = borderangle, 1.39` is malformed (it lacks the onoff/speed/curve fields). Window rules use the 0.48-era `windowrule = suppressevent maximize, class:.*` form. My understanding is that Hyprland later reworked rule syntax (0.53 'match:' style), but I did not check that against the current wiki. The top gap depends on a non-core plugin (borders-plus-plus via hyprpm), which breaks on Hyprland updates.

Theme switching mixes approaches. The installer copies files into ~/.config, then hyprtheme.sh deletes ~/.config/hypr/hyprland.conf and symlinks it into the repo. It runs from exec-once on every login and sleeps 0.9s. It uses `killall quickshell` to change flavour. The installer can run `git reset --hard origin/main` on the user's clone.

Missing pieces for a complete rice: no idle daemon (hypridle), no GTK/Qt/icon/cursor theming, no display manager or bootloader theme, no clipboard manager, no polkit agent, no environment.conf content (the file is empty). Bluetooth and the cat widget are WIP, and the cat is disabled by default.

Unclear licensing of bundled art: the wallpapers (nazhim-*.png, dark-wallpaper variants, lock.png), a Twitter-style image F2p8SHtWoAAE2HD.jpg in the rofi folder, svgrepo icons and Suls.ttf come with no credits or licenses. The repo has no top-level LICENSE; I saw only the nvim LICENSE and the Terminus font LICENSE in the tree listing. The Firefox new-tab CSS loads images from the author's github.io site at runtime.

Inconsistencies: the FZF colours in .zshrc (#00070B, #F26E74, #C488EC) come from a different theme and clash with the palette. installFonts messages say fonts go to /usr/share/fonts but the script copies to ~/.local/share/fonts. The rofi and ghostty files still carry the adi1090x and template boilerplate. Alacritty uses `blur = true` with opacity 1.0, so the blur has no effect.
steal_list: The warm 'latte/caramel' palette as a named light flavour: bar #f0c997, surface #F5DCC6, module #f0bb90/#f2cdac, border #f2bc88, accents #c47c4f/#a1694d, deep text #4E2E1F/#45373c, shadow #784d37. Pair it with the dark 'espresso' counterpart (#1c1612/#2b221a/#3d2e21 with #f0bb90 text), ideally generated from one tokens file (Nix attrset or JSON) and not duplicated by hand.

The matte-frame window look: a thick inner border in the surface colour (11-13px) inside a thin accent border, using borders-plus-plus. Offer a pixel variant with rounding 1, stacked 2/3/8px borders, blur off and a hard offset shadow (offset 9 9, range 1, render_power 12). Keep it optional, since the plugin must be rebuilt with every Hyprland version.

A mascot as a layer-shell widget: a pixel-art pet sprite with keyframed jump/walk frames next to the bar, reacting to events (theme switch, connectivity). Also a status face (smile when online, frown when offline) instead of a plain wifi glyph.

Choreographed theme switching: bar slides out, Loader swaps the bar, wallpaper 'grow' transition from a corner (awww, bezier 0.4,0.0,0.2,1.0, 1s), every app theme swapped, then one hyprctl reload. On NixOS this could be home-manager specialisations or a symlink-farm activation script; on Arch, a stow-based switch script.
Custom Shape-drawn workspace pills (8px wide, active 34px vs inactive 19px, OutQuart 200ms) in a slim vertical bar (48px, radius 4, 2px border, soft offset drop shadow).

A slide-up dashboard with a GitHub contribution heatmap recoloured to the theme's 5-step accent ramp, plus hover tooltips, profile picture, media, brightness and power. Replace the FIFO with a Quickshell IpcHandler bound to `qs ipc call dashboard toggle`.

A neo-brutalist rofi card: square corners, a 2px border and a 6px right/bottom hard shadow made from window padding over a darker background. Use a pixel font (Dogica Pixel 7) for the launcher only, keep Terminess Nerd Font in the terminal and notifications.
A 'poetry/quote header' launcher variant that renders a random couplet or haiku into the launcher header image in theme colours.
A compact-mode toggle keybind (Super+G) that uses hyprctl keyword to flip roomy gaps (45,40,45,40 / 9) to tight gaps (5 / 1) and turn shadows on or off.
The xfcBezier (0.1,0.9,0.1,1.03) for workspaces, easeOutQuint for windows and layers, and slide-bottom-in / slide-top-out window animations as a tasteful, snappy default.
Small quality-of-life scripts: OCR a region to the clipboard (grim, slurp, tesseract, wl-copy), region copy, region edit with swappy, and a hyprpicker binding.
Installer UX ideas: per-component INSTALL_* toggles, timestamped backups, a first-run 'tinkerer' guard for users who skip the installer, and cute kaomoji output.

one_line: Very active, script-heavy "DE-like" rice for Hyprland, Niri, MangoWM and Labwc on Arch, Fedora and NixOS. The Hyprland side uses the new native Lua config (hyprland.lua, hl.* API). The look is monochrome black glass plus one accent colour taken from the wallpaper and pushed to every app. It adds its own Python/GTK layer-shell mini-apps: a cava underbar, rounded screen corners, edge triggers, desktop icons and a Waybar-based taskbar.
freshness: Extremely fresh. The commits Atom feed shows the latest commit at 2026-09-25T03:26:46Z (today) and several commits a day on 09-23, 09-24 and 09-25. The stable tag is v26.09-1 (hakucfg/setting.sh has SETTING_VERSION="26.09-1"), and the README screenshots are dated 2026-09-23. It follows current upstream Hyprland: the config is hyprland.lua with the hl.* API. I checked that hyprwm/Hyprland main now ships example/hyprland.lua and that example/hyprland.conf returns 404. Hyprlock and hypridle still use hyprlang .conf. The NixOS flakes pin nixos-26.05. The README says of NixOS: "I've not maintained the NixOS version. Every bugs will not be fixed." The Discord and TikTok showcase channels are active.

aesthetic.palette: There is no named scheme. Everything is one accent colour on translucent black. The default accent is #ffffff (THEME_DEFAULT_ACCENT). The live accent is taken from the wallpaper by colorthief, or picked from presets in change_theme.sh: Slate Blue #7288AE, Green #A2CB8B, Peach #FFB399, Yellow #EFBF04, Pink #F9B2D7, White #FFFFFF, Grey #BFC9D1. Surfaces: rgba(0,0,0,0.7) for Rofi and the top Waybar, rgba(0,0,0,0.8) for Waybar island pills, rgba(0,0,0,0.9) for SwayNC, rgba(15,15,15,0.9) for Thunar. Text foreground #dfdfdf; placeholder rgba(223,223,223,0.3-0.4). Hover text is #000000 on the accent. The Waybar calendar uses #ffead3 (months), #ecc6d9 (days), #99ffdd (weeks), #ffcc66 (weekdays) and #ff6699 (today). The kitty ANSI palette is hardcoded Gruvbox: color0 #000000, color8 #282828, #cc241d/#fb4934, #98971a/#b8bb26, #d79921/#fabd2f, #458588/#83a598, #b16286/#d3869b, #689d6a/#8ec07c. color7, color15 and foreground are all set to the accent. Btop: main_bg #000000, main_fg #c0c0c0, box titles use the accent. Niri: overview backdrop #262626, focus-ring inactive #505050, urgent #9b0000, shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.7). Hyprland: active border rgba(<accent>ff), inactive rgba(ffffff00), shadow rgba(000000cc), optional fullscreen border rgb(FF0000) to rgb(880808). Hyprlock fail colour rgba(204,34,34,0.5).
aesthetic.color_pipeline: A custom pipeline, not matugen, wallust or pywal. (1) wallpaper_select.sh (a Rofi grid with icon previews) or random_wallpaper.sh (a bash loop, WALL_INTERVAL=300s) calls wallpaper_set.sh. That script runs `awww img` for images (options: --transition-type random --transition-step 90 --transition-fps 60) or mpvpaper for video. It then uses ImageMagick to crop Rofi preview images (800x250 and 600x800) into ~/.cache, plus a blurred backdrop for Niri. (2) get_accent_color.py runs ColorThief.get_palette(color_count=5) and picks a colour in one of four modes: vivid (default: max of brightness*(0.5+saturation), with saturation at least 0.2), dominant, brightest or saturated. (3) accent_color_or_fallback() computes WCAG relative luminance; if L<0.179 it falls back to #ffffff. (4) gen_style.sh saves ACCENT_COLOR, FONT_FAMILY and FONT_SIZE to ~/.local/state/hakuspace/state/state.env, the single source of truth. It then runs one-way renderers into ~/.local/state/hakuspace/theme/: colors.css (@define-color accent_color), fonts.css, hyprland-style.lua and hyprland-style.conf (the .conf is for hyprlock), rofi-style.rasi, kitty-style.conf, newtab.css (Firefox new tab), niri-style.kdl and mangowm-style.conf. It also rewrites btop's HakuBtop.theme and splices marked blocks into the Labwc themerc and rc.xml with awk. (5) apply_style.sh sets the GTK font with gsettings, reloads Waybar, the taskbar and desktop icons, runs `swaync-client --reload-config --reload-css`, sends `kitty @ load-config` to every /tmp/kitty-* socket and reloads cava. Each app imports its generated file: Waybar and SwayNC via @import url(../../.local/state/hakuspace/theme/colors.css), Rofi via @import rofi-style.rasi, kitty via include, Hyprland via pcall(dofile) of hyprland-style.lua, hyprlock via source=.
aesthetic.fonts: The font is chosen by the user. The default is THEME_DEFAULT_FONT="monospace" at size 14 (Hyprland's fallback is 16). The Change Font menu lists every family from `fc-list : family` in Rofi. Installed fonts: ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd (NixOS: nerd-fonts.jetbrains-mono), noto-fonts, noto-fonts-cjk and noto-fonts-emoji. Waybar sets font-weight: bold everywhere. Hyprlock uses "$font_family extraBold": the hour and minute at 130, the greeting at 20, the date at 14. Labwc fonts are FONT_SIZE-2, with a minimum of 8.
aesthetic.icons_cursor_gtk_qt: These come from the separate hakuspace-archive repo's setup script: the Midnight-Gray GTK theme, Tela-black icons and the Bibata-Modern-Ice cursor. They are switched with nwg-look ("GTK Settings" in Rofi). Qt uses QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME=gtk3 and QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME_QT6=gtk3, even though qt5ct and qt6ct are installed. A custom gtk-3.0/gtk.css themes only Thunar: rgba(15,15,15,0.9) background, the accent for selected items and hover, 4px radii. Waybar and Rofi icons are Nerd Font glyphs. Optional Hyprland plugin: hypr-dynamic-cursors.
aesthetic.geometry: Hyprland: gaps_in 10, gaps_out 16, border_size 2 (active border is the accent, inactive is transparent), rounding 12, rounding_power 10 (squircle corners). active_opacity 1.0, inactive_opacity 0.9. Shadow: range 20, render_power 6, offset {2,2}, color rgba(000000cc). Blur: size 10, passes 3, vibrancy 2, contrast 1.4, noise 0.05, input_methods true, special false. Rules set opacity 0.9 for thunar, kitty, code and jetbrains, and 0.8 for the haku.sh widget windows. The default layout is scrolling, with column_width 0.5; code, browsers and discord get scrolling_width 1.0 and Thunar 0.6. A 'center-focused' toggle (SUPER+F1) switches to gaps_out 80. Waybar: `* { border-radius: 4px (island) / 8px (top) }`; island groups are margin 8px, padding 8px, rgba(0,0,0,0.8) with box-shadow 0 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5). Workspace pills are min-width 10px, 40px when active; opacity is 0.5-0.6 for inactive and 0.2 for empty; hover padding grows from 10 to 20-28px. Tooltips: radius 12. The taskbar uses a linear-gradient from rgba(0,0,0,0.9) to rgba(0,0,0,0.4); the active item gets a 3px accent bottom border and 8px 8px 0 0 radius. Rofi 'line' theme: 35%x50%, padding 20, 3px accent rules, 12px tab radii, elements radius 6. Rofi 'tablet' theme: 50%x50% with a 15% vertical wallpaper imagebox at radius 12. SwayNC: notifications radius 16, padding 12, border-bottom 3px accent, box-shadow 4px 4px 4px; control centre radius 12; sliders 999px pills with an 8px trough. Hyprlock: background is a screenshot with blur_passes 2, contrast 1.2, brightness 0.5, vibrancy 0.1696; a centre card of 420x640 with rounding 64 in rgba(0,0,0,0.3); input field 250x60 with outline 0 and inner rgba(255,255,255,0.05). Kitty: background_opacity 0.9, window_margin_width 20, cursor_trail 2, cursor_trail_decay 0.1 0.4. Rounded-screen overlay: radius 20, thickness 4. Niri: gaps 16, shadow softness 20 and spread 5, tab-indicator corner-radius 16, overview zoom 0.6.
aesthetic.animations: Hyprland (Lua): hl.curve("smoothzz", bezier points {0.2,0.9},{0.2,1}). windows, windowsIn and windowsOut slide at speed 6, 6 and 12; windowsMove speed 8; layers speed 8. All fades use bezier default at speed 6. fadeDpms speed 20; border speed 10; borderangle speed 30 with loop=true. Workspaces use slidevert at speed 8 (smoothzz); specialWorkspace fades (6 in, 8 out); zoomFactor and monitorAdded use smoothzz at speed 6. Layer rules: Rofi 'slide' with blur, Waybar 'fade', swaync-control-center 'slide right', taskbar 'slide bottom', desktop-icons no_anim. Waybar CSS: `transition: all 1s cubic-bezier(0, 0.5, 0.35, 1)`, hover padding growth, a 1s blink keyframe on the recording timer, and drawer groups with transition-duration 1000 and click-to-reveal. Niri: slowdown 1.7 and a custom GLSL window-open shader ('circular iris' from the top-left corner, 200ms ease-out-quad, feather 0.03), with a centre-iris variant commented out. Wallpaper: awww random transitions at 90 steps and 60fps.
aesthetic.wallpapers: None are in the main repo tree. They come from hakuspace-archive: anime and illustration art credited to pixiv and DeviantArt artists such as Gracile, Android/アンドロイド, airfish, ゲン助, mmAir and かづいせ, with one marked 'unknown'. No licence or permission is stated beyond 'belong to their respective creators'. Wallpapers are read from ~/Pictures/Wallpapers (png, jpg, jpeg, gif, webp), with video 'lively' wallpapers in ~/Videos/Wallpapers played by mpvpaper. Auto-rotation runs every 300s. I could not view the README screenshots (GitHub user-attachments images).
aesthetic.vibe: Clean, cohesive, 'sleek techy-minimal': translucent black panels, bold monospace text and a single glowing accent that re-tints the whole desktop on every wallpaper change. It is polished and consistent across roughly 10 apps and 4 compositors, and the little extras (cava waves under the bar, rounded screen corners, squircle windows, iris window-open shader in Niri, big two-tone hyprlock clock, kitty cursor trail) make it feel like a custom DE. It is not pastel or 'cute' by itself. It is essentially monochrome, radii are mixed (4px pills next to 12-64px cards), and the only warmth comes from the anime wallpapers or a pastel preset accent (#F9B2D7 pink, #FFB399 peach). For a cute or pastel target, borrow its architecture and UX, not its palette.

components.compositor: Hyprland, primary, configured entirely in native Lua: hyprland.lua requires config/{config,autostart,environment,animation,keybinding,rule,layout} and then pcall(require) of the user file ~/hakucfg/wm/hyprland-custom.lua. The default layout is scrolling, and SUPER+X cycles scrolling, dwindle and master per workspace. Also shipped: Niri (KDL, with custom shaders), MangoWM (.conf) and Labwc (rc.xml, themerc). Optional Hyprland plugins are hyprexpo (sandwichfarm fork) and hypr-dynamic-cursors, both via hyprpm.
components.bar_or_shell: Waybar with 7 switchable layouts (top, left, coredge, minimal, neon, island, legacy) and shared JSON modules included from waybar/module/*. It uses ext/workspaces so one config works on every compositor, and drawer groups with click-to-reveal for music, clock and monitor. SUPER+SHIFT+W cycles layouts and SUPER+CTRL+W toggles the bar. A second Waybar instance runs as a binary symlinked to ~/.local/bin/taskbar (so pkill -x taskbar can target it) and provides a wlr/taskbar dock with pinned apps, toggled with SUPER+W. There is no quickshell, AGS or eww.
components.launcher: Rofi. config.rasi imports a state file (@theme "line") that is switchable between the legacy, line, tablet and television themes, with wallpaper preview images inside Rofi. Other Rofi uses: hakumenu.sh (one Rofi session with three script modes: General, Theme and Setting), wallpaper-select.rasi (icon grid), shutdown.rasi and shutdown-vert.rasi power menus, rofi-emoji (SUPER+/) and a cliphist clipboard menu.
components.notifications: SwayNC. Notifications and the control centre are themed from colors.css, with volume and backlight sliders, a DND toggle and a menubar; the control centre slides in from the right. SUPER+N opens it with swaync-client -t -sw.
components.lock_idle_logout: Hyprlock. lock.sh picks hyprlock.conf, or hyprlock_tiny.conf below 1920x1080, using hyprctl, niri msg, mmsg or wlr-randr to find the resolution. The layout is based on mahaveergurjar/Hyprlock-Dots: the hour in the accent over white minutes at 130pt, a 420x640 card with rounding 64, 'Hi there, $USER' and 'Use Me ;)'. Hypridle stages: dim to 10% at 120s, lock at 150s, DPMS off at 180s, suspend at 300s. Each stage has condition_cmd=idle_inhibit.sh, which inhibits while unmuted, uncorked audio is playing (5s grace) or while a manual toggle is set. This needs hypridle 0.1.8 or newer. Logout, shutdown and exit use Rofi shutdown.sh and exit.sh, which gracefully kill a list of apps and warn when RAM is low.
components.wallpaper_tool: awww (the renamed swww, codeberg LGFae/awww) for images and GIFs, mpvpaper for video wallpapers, and ImageMagick for preview and backdrop caches.
components.terminal: Kitty: opacity 0.9, margin 20, beam cursor, cursor_trail 2, Gruvbox ANSI colours with the accent as foreground. allow_remote_control yes with listen_on unix:/tmp/kitty is used for live theme reloads.
components.shell_prompt: Fish with Starship. The Starship prompt is two lines of white monochrome: `╭─● user@host | 󰝰 path  branch [status] ●───fill───● 󱎫 dur 󱑎 HH:MM` and then `╰─▶︎`. Also installed: eza, zoxide, direnv and lazygit (on NixOS).
components.editor: VS Code (visual-studio-code-bin on Arch, vscode on NixOS), forced into special workspace 'magic' and toggled with SUPER+`. nano is configured through .nanorc and programs.nano.
components.file_manager: Thunar with archive and volman plugins, tumbler and ffmpegthumbnailer, a custom uca.xml and a custom gtk.css skin. Thunar and xfconf settings are deployed once and never overwritten.
components.fetch: fastfetch with a custom hakufetch.txt ASCII logo and a boxed key layout ('╭─Haku-Space─╮', │ user/kernel/os/wm/disk/memory/pkgs │) followed by colour circles.
components.login_boot: Ly TUI display manager on Arch (pkg-service.txt); the NixOS module deliberately sets no display manager. The author's personal NixOS config enables ly and GRUB. No Plymouth or bootloader theming was found.
components.extras: Mini-apps written in Python with GTK3 and gtk-layer-shell, each started through a *_manager.sh script with state kept in ~/.local/state/hakuspace/state. (1) cava_layer.py: a VTE terminal running cava as an 'underbar' layer beneath Waybar, which parses kitty.conf including its includes to match colours and font. (2) rounded_screen.py: a Cairo even-odd fill for 20px screen corners, click-through through an empty input region that is re-applied on size-allocate, and invisible exclusive-zone windows on the BOTTOM layer. (3) edge_trigger.py: 2px hot edges with a 200ms dwell and 800ms cooldown; top opens the wallpaper picker, bottom the haku menu, right the power menu. (4) desktop_icons.py: shows ~/Desktop on the desktop. Other extras: haku.sh 'rice showcase', which spawns kitty windows running fastfetch, tty-clock, lavat and cava and arranges them per layout with `hyprctl eval` Lua; Firefox userChrome.css and newtab.html themed by the accent; a generated btop theme; cliphist; wl-screenrec recorder with a Waybar timer; hyprsunset or gammastep nightlight at 4000K; a Cloudflare WARP toggle; fcitx5 input method env vars; a hyprpicker accent picker; power-profiles-daemon.

standout_features: Among these references it is one of the first to use Hyprland's native Lua config (hyprland.lua and the hl.* API: hl.config, hl.bind, hl.window_rule, hl.layer_rule, hl.curve, hl.animation, hl.on("hyprland.start"), hl.gesture). It uses Lua for things hyprlang cannot do: named rule handles toggled with `rule:set_enabled(bool)` from the user file, a SUPER+M minimize-to-special:minimized toggle using window tags, per-workspace layout cycling with notify-send, a magnifier zoom that clamps cursor.zoom_factor between 1 and 3, a 'center-focused' gaps toggle, and 'move all windows of this workspace' binds.

Theming with a single source of truth: state.env holds ACCENT_COLOR, FONT_FAMILY and FONT_SIZE, and one-way renderers write per-app include files for Waybar and SwayNC CSS, Rofi rasi, kitty, Hyprland Lua and conf, hyprlock, Niri KDL, Mango, Labwc, btop and the Firefox new tab. apply_style.sh then live-reloads every app, including all kitty sockets.
Accent extraction from the wallpaper with four selectable modes (vivid, dominant, brightest, saturated) and a WCAG relative-luminance guard (L<0.179) so the accent is never too dark on black glass.
Cava 'underbar': a gtk-layer-shell VTE terminal running cava directly under Waybar, colour-synced by parsing kitty.conf and its includes.

Rounded screen corners overlay: a Cairo even-odd fill, click-through input region re-applied on size-allocate, and exclusive-zone spacer windows on the BOTTOM layer so Waybar is pushed inward. The source comments document the reasoning about layer ordering.
Edge triggers (hot edges) with dwell and cooldown that open the wallpaper picker, menu or power menu from screen edges.

Seven Waybar layouts, all using ext/workspaces so one bar config works across Hyprland, Niri, Mango and Labwc, plus a second Waybar instance run under a symlinked binary name as a dock or taskbar with pinned apps.
Rofi themes that embed a cropped wallpaper preview (ImageMagick `-resize 600x800^ -gravity Center -crop`) generated on every wallpaper change.
Audio-aware idle: hypridle condition_cmd runs a script that checks pactl sink-inputs for uncorked, unmuted streams with a 5s grace period, plus a manual inhibit toggle.
Niri custom GLSL window-open shader (circular iris reveal from the top-left).

User overlay directory ~/hakucfg (wm/hyprland-custom.lua, niri-custom.kdl, mango-custom.conf, kitty.conf, hypridle.conf, setting.sh) that survives updates, with ONCE_CONFIGS for GUI-edited files and install.sh, update.sh, rollback.sh and doctor.sh to find broken symlinks.

Hyprlock layout: a two-tone stacked HH/MM at 130pt (hour in the accent, minutes in white 80%) on a rounding-64 translucent card over a blurred screenshot, with a smaller variant for screens below 1080p.
structure_install: Layout: src/home/ mirrors $HOME (.config/*, .local/state/hakuspace, .themes/hakulab, hakucfg/ templates). src/core/{app,lib,menu,sys,theme,util} holds about 50 bash and Python scripts that are flattened into ~/.local/bin. src/packages/pkg-{core,service,optional,hyprland,niri,mango,labwc}.txt are commented package lists. nix/ holds the flake and module. assets/browser holds the Firefox CSS. docs/ holds architecture, management and core docs in English and Vietnamese, plus a Fedora guide. scripts/{variables,functions}.sh are helpers. Install: clone (tag v26.09-1 recommended) and run ./install.sh. It prompts for window manager(s) and a deploy mode (deep symlink or copy), backs up conflicts to ~/.backup/Backup_<timestamp>, installs yay if needed, and installs the package lists with yay on Arch only. On NixOS it either copies hakuspace-config.nix to /etc/nixos and sed-injects it into configuration.nix imports with sudo, or copies flake.nix.example over /etc/nixos/flake.nix. It then deploys configs and scripts, copies ONCE_CONFIGS a single time, seeds ~/hakucfg and sets fish as the shell. update.sh picks the latest or stable tag, detects the deploy mode, redeploys and skips ONCE_CONFIGS and hakucfg. rollback.sh restores a backup, and doctor.sh scans for broken or overwritten symlinks. Visual assets (GTK theme, icons, cursor, wallpapers) come from a separate hakuspace-archive setup script.
nix_patterns: The flake lives in the nix/ subdirectory and exposes only nixosModules.default and nixosModules.hakuspace (= ./hakuspace-config.nix). Consumers use `url = "github:hakuimaku/hakuspace?dir=nix"` with inputs.nixpkgs.follows. nixpkgs is pinned to nixos-26.05.

NixOS module with options.hakuspace.enable (default true) and hakuspace.enableFishShell (default true), built with lib.mkIf and lib.mkMerge; nearly every setting is lib.mkDefault so the host can override it.
No home-manager, by design. Dotfiles are still deployed imperatively by install.sh and update.sh through symlinks or copies, so the Nix side only installs system packages and programs.

Enables programs.hyprland, programs.niri, programs.mangowc and programs.labwc together. The xdg.portal.config sets a portal per compositor: hyprland uses [hyprland gtk], niri [gnome gtk], mango and labwc [wlr gtk].

The Python GTK layer-shell mini-apps need PyGObject, so the module builds a symlinkJoin around python3.withPackages [colorthief pygobject3] and uses wrapProgram to prefix GI_TYPELIB_PATH and LD_LIBRARY_PATH with the pango, gtk3, gtk-layer-shell, vte and other typelibs.
Sets environment.variables.GSETTINGS_SCHEMA_DIR manually to the gsettings-desktop-schemas path.

The personal flake (nix/myown) adds nixpkgs-unstable passed through specialArgs as `unstable`, the zen-browser flake, fcitx5-lotus, GRUB and ly. It hardcodes the user 'hakuimaku' and time.timeZone Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.
The README asks for hypridle from unstable (0.1.8) because stable ships 0.1.7.
