Wallpaper accent extraction with selectable modes
Lua-only UX: minimize-to-special toggle and magnifier zoom
key_snippets.excerpt:
hl.bind(mainMod .. " + M", function ()
    if hl.get_workspace("special:minimized") then
        hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.move({ workspace = hl.get_active_workspace(), window = "tag:minimized" }))
        hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.clear_tags({ window = "tag:minimized" }))
    else
        hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.tag({ tag = "minimized", window = hl.get_active_window() }))
        hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.move({ workspace = "special:minimized", follow = false }))
    end
end)
...
local function zoom(offset)
    local current = hl.get_config("cursor.zoom_factor")
    if offset ~= nil then
        current = current + offset
    elseif current ~= MIN_ZOOM then
        current = MIN_ZOOM
    else
        current = ZOOM_TOGGLE_FACTOR
    end
    current = math.max(MIN_ZOOM, math.min(MAX_ZOOM, current))
    hl.config({ cursor = { zoom_factor = current } })
end

key_snippets.purpose: Staged idle with an audio-aware inhibit condition (hypridle 0.1.8 or newer)
key_snippets.excerpt:
$timeout_dim = 120
$timeout_lock = 150
$timeout_dpms = 180
$timeout_suspend = 300
$condition_retry_timeout = 30

# Include timeout
source = ~/hakucfg/hypridle.con*

general {
    lock_cmd = pidof hyprlock || ~/.local/bin/lock.sh
    before_sleep_cmd = loginctl lock-session && ~/.local/bin/dpms_handler.sh off
    after_sleep_cmd = ~/.local/bin/dpms_handler.sh on
}

# Set brightness
listener {
    timeout = $timeout_dim
    on-timeout = brightnessctl -s set 10
    on-resume = brightnessctl -r
    condition_cmd = ~/.local/bin/idle_inhibit.sh
    condition_retry = $condition_retry_timeout
}

weaknesses: The palette is a single accent on black. There is no palette or scheme generation (no Material You or matugen roles, no surface or container tones). The kitty ANSI colours are hardcoded Gruvbox while foreground, color7 and color15 all equal the accent, so terminal colours clash with pastel wallpapers. Dark wallpapers silently fall back to a #ffffff accent (the WCAG L<0.179 check) instead of lightening the hue.

Probable bug: config/plugin.lua uses font_size, font_family and border_color, but those are `local` in config/config.lua. Lua locals do not cross require() boundaries, so hyprexpo's label_font_size, label_font_family and border_color_hover would be nil.

Probable bug: in rule.lua the 'haku-desktop-icons' window_rule table has two `match =` keys. Lua keeps only the last one, so the namespace constraint is silently dropped. In the island Waybar clock actions JSON, on-scroll-up and on-scroll-down are also duplicated.

Rule handles (suppressMaximizeRule, fullWidth_ScrollingLayout, ...) are global variables so the user file can toggle them. It works, but it pollutes the global namespace. Returning a module table would be cleaner.

Hardware-specific env in the shared config: LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME=iHD (Intel only) and VDPAU_DRIVER=va_gl, plus global SDL_VIDEODRIVER=wayland and QT_QPA_PLATFORM=wayland with no xcb fallback. These can break AMD or NVIDIA VA-API and some games or Qt apps. fcitx5 env vars are set and `fcitx5 -d` is autostarted, but I found no fcitx5 in the package lists I read (core, service, optional, hyprland, niri).

Heavy dependence on /tmp and polling: /tmp/random_wallpaper_status is read every second in a bash loop, along with /tmp/recording_time, /tmp/cava-layer.pid and a kitty remote-control socket at unix:/tmp/kitty with allow_remote_control yes. $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR would be better. haku.sh uses kill -9.

The mini-apps are separate Python GTK3 and gtk-layer-shell processes. The README itself puts them at about +60-100MB RAM each, about 1.5GB total with all enabled, and says cava has high CPU use. One QML shell (quickshell) would be lighter and more cohesive. GTK3 is also ageing.

The NixOS support is thin and self-declared unmaintained. The module defaults enable=true, turns on 4 compositors, and installs vscode, go, gcc, pulseaudio, gparted and more at system level. It has no home-manager, so dotfiles are not declarative. install.sh runs `sudo sed -i` to inject imports into /etc/nixos/configuration.nix and can overwrite /etc/nixos/flake.nix.

The installer only automates Arch (yay). Fedora is a manual guide, and yay-bin is built in /tmp. Several AUR -git or -bin packages are used (wl-screenrec-git, lavat-git, cloudflare-warp-bin, visual-studio-code-bin).
lock.sh chooses the hyprlock config from the first monitor's resolution only. Multi-monitor or HiDPI setups may get the wrong layout, and hyprlock has no per-monitor configuration here.

Licensing: the wallpapers (pixiv and DeviantArt art, one credited as 'unknown') are redistributed through hakuspace-archive with credit but no stated permission. The GTK theme, icons and cursor are third-party gnome-look items. A best-of-breed rice should not bundle the art.
Radii and weights are inconsistent: 4px Waybar pills, 8px or 12px elsewhere, a 64px lock card, 0px Rofi windows, and bold text everywhere. It reads 'techy' rather than soft or cute.
The README says the NixOS stable channel ships hypridle 0.1.7 while idle_inhibit.sh hard-fails below 0.1.8, so the idle chain is fragile on stable NixOS.
steal_list: Adopt the state.env single source of truth with one-way renderers to per-app include files (colors.css, rofi rasi, kitty include, a hyprland-style.lua table, hyprlock source, niri KDL, btop theme, Firefox newtab CSS), followed by an apply script that live-reloads each app. Swap the single colorthief accent for matugen or wallust so it emits a full pastel palette.

Keep the WCAG luminance guard, but make it lighten or pastelize the extracted hue (e.g. raise tone in HCT) instead of falling back to white. Keep the vivid, dominant, brightest and saturated modes as a user setting.

Use Hyprland's native Lua config: split it into required modules, pcall(require) a user overlay file, and expose named rule handles with :set_enabled() so users can toggle rules without editing base files. Return them from a module table instead of globals.

Port the Lua keybind tricks: SUPER+M minimize-to-special with tags, a magnifier zoom that clamps cursor.zoom_factor, per-workspace layout cycling, a center-focused gaps toggle, and 'move all windows to workspace N'.

Borrow the geometry baseline: rounding 12 with rounding_power 10 (squircle), gaps 10/16, blur size 10, passes 3, vibrancy 2, contrast 1.4, noise 0.05, inactive_opacity 0.9, and the smoothzz bezier (0.2,0.9,0.2,1) with slidevert workspaces and Rofi slide plus blur layer rules.
Keep the audio-aware hypridle condition_cmd (pactl sink-input corked and muted check with a grace period) and the dim at 120s, lock 150s, DPMS 180s, suspend 300s staging.
Borrow the hyprlock design: stacked two-tone HH/MM at 130pt on a rounded-64 translucent card over a blurred screenshot. Recolour it with the pastel palette and add per-monitor handling.

Reimplement the rounded screen corners, cava underbar and edge hot-corners inside one quickshell or AGS process rather than separate Python processes. Keep the insight that exclusive-zone spacers must sit on the BOTTOM layer to push the bar.
Build Rofi themes with an embedded wallpaper preview imagebox, using ImageMagick-cropped caches regenerated on each wallpaper change, and add a Rofi wallpaper grid picker.

Use Waybar ext/workspaces (or an equivalent abstraction) so one bar works across Hyprland and Niri. Add drawer groups with click-to-reveal, pill workspaces that widen to 40px when active, and hover padding growth with transition all 1s cubic-bezier(0,0.5,0.35,1).
Borrow the Niri custom-shader window-open 'iris' animation for the Niri variant.

Keep the user-overlay directory pattern (~/hakucfg style) plus install, update, rollback and doctor scripts, ONCE_CONFIGS for GUI-mutated files, and timestamped backups. On NixOS, replace this with home-manager modules while keeping the same overlay contract.

Copy the NixOS portal-per-compositor mapping (hyprland: hyprland+gtk, niri: gnome+gtk, wlr compositors: wlr+gtk) and the symlinkJoin/wrapProgram trick for PyGObject typelibs if any Python layer-shell helpers remain.
Add kitty cursor_trail 2 with cursor_trail_decay 0.1 0.4, window_margin_width 20 and background_opacity 0.9. Theme kitty's full 16-colour palette from the generated scheme.

one_line: A custom Quickshell desktop shell for Arch and Hyprland 0.56+ (configured in Lua). It is built around one black "dynamic island" that changes shape into the launcher, control centre, notifications, OSD, notes, games and pets. A Python pipeline takes the wallpaper's accent colour and repaints about 15 apps with WCAG contrast checks.
freshness: Very active. The latest commits are all dated 2026-09-22 (e.g. "fix: settle what the 0.3.2 review found", "feat(quickshell): change the account's picture and name for both screens", "fix(hypr): rebuild the plugins when Hyprland changes under them"). 104 commits on main, 237 stars, 14 forks. It needs Hyprland 0.56+ (tested on 0.56.2) with the new Lua config, and Quickshell 0.3. check.yml runs CI syntax checks on main/dev; release.yml publishes a GitHub release when a v* tag is pushed on main. Copyright 2026, GPL-3.0.

aesthetic.palette: The default tokens (Theme.qml) are Apple iOS dark system colours: background #0c0c0c, surface #141414, surfaceHover #202020, border #282828, text #ffffff, textMuted #8e8e93, accent #0a84ff, accentHover #409cff, red #ff453a, green #32d74b, yellow #ffd60a, timer #64d2ff. The island is fixed pure black in every palette (#000000, #141414, #1f1f1f hover, #262626 border). Sticky notes use paperWash #c4ffffff over the tint, ink #1c1c1e, radius 10. The adaptive (wallpaper) palette computes background = (17+r*0.04, 19+g*0.04, 24+b*0.05), then surface +14, hover +16/16/18, border +16/16/20. Text is #eef2f7 and muted #94a1b2, and the status colours are fixed Catppuccin Mocha: #f38ba8 red, #a6e3a1 green, #f9e2af yellow, #89b4fa blue. The fallback accent is #89B4FA. There are 9 curated palettes in Palettes.qml: Catppuccin Mocha (#1e1e2e/#181825/#313244/#45475a/#cdd6f4, accent #89b4fa), Catppuccin Latte (#eff1f5, accent #1e66f5), Tokyo Night (#1a1b26, accent #7aa2f7), Gruvbox Dark (#282828, accent #d79921), Nord (#2e3440, accent #88c0d0), Rosé Pine (#191724, accent #ebbcba), Cyberpunk (#0d0f18, accent #ff007f/#00e5ff), Bauhaus (#1a1a1a, accent #e52521) and Crimson Moon (#120a0d, accent #e63946). Kitty's terminal background is the accent scaled by 0.22 towards black. The installer's wordmark is an ochre gradient from rgb(142,102,42) to rgb(240,179,87), accent #ce8e36.
aesthetic.color_pipeline: This is a custom script, not matugen, wallust or pywal. scripts/theme_manager.py (about 3980 lines of Python) runs `magick -resize 120x120 -colors 24 -unique-colors txt:-`, then picks one accent: the most saturated mid-tone with sat>0.2 and 0.2
aesthetic.fonts: Inter for the shell UI, with 'Inter Display' used when text is drawn very large. JetBrainsMono Nerd Font Mono for the terminal and bar glyphs (the VSCodium default is 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font Mono, monospace'). Grape Nuts, a handwriting script font bundled under the OFL in ~/.local/share/fonts, for note bodies and the shell's signature. Adwaita Sans 11 for GTK. Noto, Noto Emoji and Noto CJK as fallbacks. The font picker resolves a comma-separated stack to the first installed family, because Qt only accepts one family. Sizes: label 10, small 11, regular 13, medium 14, large 16, widget 30, display 68. The SDDM clock is size 300 and the date 26.
aesthetic.icons_cursor_gtk_qt: Icons: a generated 'impasto' theme that inherits Papirus-Dark, then Adwaita, then hicolor, with folder colours re-pointed to the accent; Qt apps use Breeze icons. Cursor: a vector hyprcursor 'impasto-cursor' rebuilt in the chosen colour (Bibata repainted), with Bibata-Modern-Classic as the XCursor fallback at size 24, plus the hypr-dynamic-cursors plugin for shake-to-find magnification (threshold 4.0, base 3.0, timeout 500). GTK: the Adwaita theme with prefer-dark and a generated gtk.css. Qt: QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME=qt6ct, Fusion style, a generated colour scheme, and kdeglobals for KDE apps.
aesthetic.geometry: Hyprland: gaps_in 7 (14 px between windows) and gaps_out 18. border_size 0, so there are no borders at all. rounding 22 with rounding_power 2. active and inactive opacity both 1.0. Blur: size 6, passes 2, xray true, ignore_opacity, new_optimizations. Shadow is off by default; when switched on it is range 14, render_power 3, opacity 0.5, pushed at runtime. Floating windows snap with window_gap 14 and monitor_gap 18. The hyprglass refraction plugin is tuned but disabled by default (blur_strength 0.7, refraction 1.0, chromatic_aberration 0.6, fresnel 1.0, specular 1.0, edge_thickness 0.10, lens_distortion 0.3, tint 0x8899aa11). A layer_rule blurs the impasto-desktop layer with ignore_alpha 0.15. Kitty uses background_opacity 0.90 and window_padding_width 8. QML radii are small 8, medium 12, large 18, pill 999, desktop/dock 22 (to match Hyprland's rounding), notch fillet 6, and pictures at 0.24 of the box. Capsule spacing is 8. The desktop grid cell is 86–108 px with an 18 px gutter. The control centre is a 6×8 grid of 140×64 cells with a 12 px gutter. The dock icon scales 1.125 on hover. The bar's own shadow is the window shadow scaled by 0.6. SDDM uses capsuleHeight 32 and barTopMargin 16.
aesthetic.animations: Curves are not in hyprland.lua (it only sets animations.enabled = true). theme/Motion.qml defines presets that CompositorService pushes as a single atomic `hyprctl eval` Lua chunk. Durations are in deciseconds, listed as slow (geometry) / medium (appear/disappear) / fast (colour changes): Glide (id macos) bezier [0.32,0.72,0,1], 2.6/1.8/1.4, windows and workspaces slide. Brisk [0.22,1,0.36,1], 1.3/1.0/0.8, windows 'popin 94%'. Calm [0.25,0.1,0.25,1], 4.2/3.0/2.2, 'popin 85%', workspaces fade. Bounce [0.05,0.9,0.1,1.15], 3.2/2.0/1.4, 'popin 80%'. None. fadeIn is deliberately disabled so the wallpaper does not flash through the gap while windows re-tile. Layers use fade. Shell motion uses the easings OutCubic (Smooth), OutQuint (Snappy), OutBack (Springy) and Linear, with durations 140/200/380 ms scaled by a motionScale percentage. The island morphs its size and corner radius while its contents cross-fade. Wallpaper changes go through awww transitions (default wipe, 1 s); the Fuji profile sets 'circle', which is not in theme_manager's accepted list, so it may be mapped elsewhere (unverified).
aesthetic.wallpapers: 40 JPEGs are bundled in home/.local/share/wallpapers. The README calls them 'forty paintings, in the style it is named after' (impasto oil technique). Examples: japanese-castle-full-moon, pagoda-fuji-blossom, tropical-bay-night, capri-faraglioni, positano-market, cat-billiards, bengal-cat-audi, tiger-snow, panther-stained-glass, red-lamborghini-urus-rain, white-countach-meadow, black-porsche-palms, private-jet, roman-legion, spartan-helmet-shore. The repo gives no source, artist or licence for any of them, and SDDM ships its own background.jpg. I did not view the images.
aesthetic.vibe: Premium Apple/iOS-inspired design (a Dynamic Island clone, iOS system colours, no window borders, large 22 px radii) mixed with a painterly theme where the whole desk takes on the colour of an oil-painting wallpaper. It is one of the most engineered and polished Quickshell shells I have seen: ~250 QML files, design tokens, declared panel sizes, concave notch fillets, animated palette transitions, and Settings UI where each option is drawn as the thing it changes. Cute elements are real but secondary: 5 bar pets (Dot, Sprout, Ember, Sol, Drift) that hatch from eggs, level up and never die, drawn as creature, plush, paper or pixel; pastel sticky notes in handwriting; 13 mini-game files (Tetris, Snake, 2048, Hextris, Solitaire, Whack…); and an animated pixel-art fastfetch greeting (koi, lava lamp). Out of the box it is dark and near-black with one accent, not an anime-pastel rice. It becomes pastel only with the Catppuccin or Rosé Pine palettes or a pastel wallpaper.

components.compositor: Hyprland 0.56+ with the Lua config: hyprland.lua requires modules/monitors, autostart, env, look, animations, input, keybinds and windowrules, plus a programs.lua helper. It uses hl.config, hl.bind, hl.window_rule, hl.layer_rule, hl.gesture, hl.on and hl.dsp.*. Two plugins are built with hyprpm: hypr-dynamic-cursors (shake to find) and hyprglass (refracted glass). Runtime options are pushed with `hyprctl eval` from Quickshell's CompositorService. Keybinds are read from a profile file ~/.local/state/quickshell/keys.tsv written by the shell, with defaults as fallback.
components.bar_or_shell: A custom Quickshell 0.3 shell. The bar has three styles (grouped around the island, spread to the edges, or everything in one capsule) and modules dragged onto a picture of the bar from a catalogue. The centre is a DynamicIsland with layers modules/summary/osd/notification/panel. Also: a dock on every screen, desktop widgets under the windows (Modern or Analogue faces), a notes deck on the screen edge, and a separate Settings window. Every screen gets a full bar and one of them is 'live' (the focused monitor).
components.launcher: Built into the island (LauncherPanel/LauncherService); no rofi or fuzzel. Prefix sigils: plain text searches apps (ranked by use), '=' calculates, '@' finds an open window, '!' starts a countdown, ''' opens clipboard history (with image rows), '>' lists the shell's panels and settings. Pinned dock apps come first. SUPER+Space opens it and SUPER+V opens clipboard mode.
components.notifications: Quickshell owns org.freedesktop.Notifications, so there is no separate daemon. Notifications appear as an island layer (430×68) and are listed in the control centre.
components.lock_idle_logout: Lock: Quickshell LockScreen (ext-session-lock) over a grim screenshot of the desk blurred with MultiEffect; any key brings up the account and password field. Optional face unlock uses howdy-next through a separate PAM service /etc/pam.d/impasto-face ('-auth sufficient pam_howdy.so' then 'pam_deny.so'), so a failed face never costs a password attempt. Idle: IdleService uses Quickshell IdleMonitor (ext-idle-notify) instead of hypridle, with lock/screen-off/suspend timeouts that respect inhibitors. Screen off is a Lua dpms chunk that only handles the first monitor. Logout: a session panel in the island (SUPER+X, Ctrl+Alt+Del, or XF86PowerOff with logind HandlePowerKey=ignore), and hyprshutdown for SUPER+SHIFT+E. Every sleep is held until the lock is up.
components.wallpaper_tool: awww (the swww successor) with awww-daemon. theme_manager.py runs `awww img <path> --transition-type <t> --transition-duration 1`. `qs ipc call wallpaper set <path>` lets outside callers such as Thunar's 'Set as Wallpaper' trigger the palette push.
components.terminal: kitty: JetBrainsMono Nerd Font Mono, background_opacity 0.90, padding 8, cursor_trail 10 (decay 0.01 0.05), allow_remote_control socket-only listening on unix:${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/kitty.sock, and include files for the generated palette and font fragments.
components.shell_prompt: zsh with oh-my-zsh (git, zsh-autosuggestions, zsh-syntax-highlighting) and starship. The prompt is text-only with no backgrounds: user@host and path (bold cyan, which carries the accent), a '❯' character, and status, duration, git, node and python on the right. Only ANSI colour names are used so the prompt follows the kitty palette. Also fzf, zoxide and fnm, each guarded so a missing tool prints no error.
components.editor: Neovim (lazy.nvim, fzf-lua, LSP, treesitter, git, tree, ui plugins; the colorscheme is generated in the state dir and pushed live over RPC sockets) and VSCodium (a generated 'Impasto' theme extension; ./setup vscodium merges settings and installs extensions).
components.file_manager: yazi in the terminal (generated flavor plus tmTheme preview) and Thunar in a window (xfconf settings, a custom right-click menu, recoloured Papirus folders), with tumbler and ffmpegthumbnailer for thumbnails.
components.fetch: fastfetch with a kitty-icat logo: an animated pixel-art GIF (54×60 frames scaled ×5) drawn in the active palette by greeting.py and shown with the `fa` alias. Keys are cyan (the accent) and icons are Material glyphs.
components.login_boot: SDDM theme 'impasto' written in QML, visually matched to the lock screen: the same island, clock and pill over a blurred painting. It reads the battery from /sys (needs QML_XHR_ALLOW_FILE_READ=1) and faces from /var/lib/impasto/faces. It is switched on only if no other display manager is in use. The tree has no GRUB, systemd-boot or Plymouth theming.
components.extras: cava and btop (themed), spicetify, Vesktop CSS, Zen browser chrome, imv, satty for annotation, tesseract OCR capture, wl-screenrec/wf-recorder recording, a Quickshell capture overlay, hyprpicker, hyprsunset night light, ddcutil brightness for external monitors, a Claude Code usage module, a GitHub contribution grid, weather, a packages/updates panel, a kanban task board, sticky notes, pets, mini games, a cava spectrum along the screen edge (GLSL spectrum.frag.qsb), asciiquarium, unimatrix, cbonsai and tty-clock.

standout_features: The dynamic island: one black capsule (DynamicIsland.qml) that resizes to predeclared panel sizes (e.g. stats 940×614, session 720×180, overview 1560×(72+rows*190)) and cross-fades contents through a Loader. When attached to the top edge it grows concave 'notch fillets' drawn with QtQuick.Shapes PathAngleArc (NotchFillet.qml), and every bar module opens into the island rather than its own popup.

Multi-monitor island handoff: every screen has a full bar, and a single 'live' flag follows the focused monitor. No surface is recreated, so moving between screens costs zero frames. Each bar sits inside a Variants over Quickshell.screens so it survives hotplug.
Launcher with prefix sigils ('=' calc, '@' windows, '!' timer, ''' clipboard with image rows, '>' shell panels and settings), with apps ranked by launch frequency.

Wallpaper-to-everything palette with WCAG enforcement: ANSI slots are lifted to 4.5:1 (bright ones to 7:1), and the Papirus folder recolour is done without root through a user icon theme of symlinks. Colours are pushed live to running kitty (kitten @ load-config), neovim (RPC sockets) and cava.

Compositor animation presets (Glide, Brisk, Calm, Bounce, None) live in QML and are pushed as one atomic `hyprctl eval` Lua chunk. fadeIn is deliberately disabled so the wallpaper does not flash while windows re-tile.

Quickshell replaces several separate daemons: notifications (owns the D-Bus name), hypridle (IdleMonitor), hyprlock (ext-session-lock with a MultiEffect blur of a grim screenshot), OSD, screenshot/OCR/record overlay, and a clipboard manager.

Face unlock through a separate PAM stack (impasto-face) that runs in parallel with password auth, and an SDDM theme that shares the lock screen's island, clock and pill, so boot and lock look the same.
Desktop widget grid with two themes per widget: Modern (a figure with a caption) and Analogue (skeuomorphic thermometer, knob, gauge, parcel, joystick, record, hourglass).

Cute extras done carefully: 5 pets that never die and have 4 art styles and egg hatching, pastel sticky notes in the Grape Nuts handwriting font, 13 mini-games that play inside the island, and animated pixel-art fastfetch scenes coloured by the palette.

Keybind profiles: Settings → Keys writes keys.tsv, and keybinds.lua binds by description with fallbacks. Profiles (Moon castle, Fuji, Night bay) save a whole desk as JSON: wallpaper, bar layout, widgets, dock pins and keys.

An installer that copies instead of symlinking: a sha256 manifest, edited files kept with the new version written as .new, deleted files left deleted unless --restore, backups, --dry-run, uninstall, `sync --watch` with inotify, and a `check` verb that CI also runs.

Small, careful fixes: a Chromium/Electron touchpad scroll correction (scroll_touchpad 0.19 ≈ 1/5.3), float-and-centre at 60% of the monitor via a Lua function, per-monitor workspace back-and-forth, and a lid switch routed through Quickshell GlobalShortcut because `switch:` binds in the same file as hl.monitor() are silently dropped.
structure_install: Layout: `home/` mirrors $HOME (.config/hypr Lua modules, .config/quickshell with ~250 QML files and Python backends in scripts/, kitty, nvim, yazi, btop, cava, fastfetch, gtk-3.0/4.0, starship.toml, .zshrc, .local/share/fonts, .local/share/wallpapers with 40 JPEGs, .local/share/impasto profiles). `system/` mirrors / (sddm.conf.d, the SDDM theme, a logind drop-in, a PAM impasto-face file, polkit actions, /usr/lib/impasto helpers). `packages/pacman.txt` and `packages/aur.txt` are grouped and commented by feature, and an optional section that is missing disables its feature instead of failing. `setup` is a single bash script. Install is `git clone … ~/impasto && ./setup install`. Verbs: install, update (git pull then reinstall), uninstall, packages, sync [--watch], system, plugins (hyprpm), defaults, cursors, spotify, vscodium, thunar, vesktop, face, files, check, help. Flags: --skip-packages, --skip-system, --skip-plugins, --skip-extras, --aur-helper yay|paru, --noconfirm, -n/--dry-run, --restore. Files are copied atomically (written beside, then renamed), with a manifest in ~/.local/state/impasto and backups in ~/.local/state/impasto/backups/<timestamp>. The main branch moves only on releases; dev is work in progress. The installer upgrades the system during install (pacman -S --needed) and builds yay if no AUR helper exists.

Face unlock as a separate PAM service running beside the password (never burns password attempts)

#%PAM-1.0
# The lock screen's second service, run next to `login` rather than inside
# it: a face that is not recognised never counts against the password's
# attempts, and the password never waits on the camera. Only the lock screen
# uses it. `./setup face` installs howdy-next; without it the `-` skips the

key_snippets.purpose: Profile-driven keybinds: shell writes keys.tsv, Lua binds by description with fallback
key_snippets.excerpt:
local function profile_keys()
    local state = os.getenv("XDG_STATE_HOME") or (os.getenv("HOME") .. "/.local/state")
    local keys  = {}
    local file  = io.open(state .. "/quickshell/keys.tsv")
    if not file then
        return keys
    end
    for line in file:lines() do
        local description, combination = line:match("^([^#\t][^\t]*)\t(.*)$")
        if description then
            keys[description] = combination
        end
    end
    file:close()
    return keys
end

local keys = profile_keys()

local function bind(combination, action, options)
    local chosen = keys[options.description]
    if chosen == nil then
        chosen = combination
    end
    if chosen ~= "" then
        hl.bind(chosen, action, options)
    end
end

weaknesses: Arch only. The installer uses pacman, pacman -Qqo, the AUR (yay/paru), hyprpm and FHS paths, and there is no Nix support at all. Porting to NixOS means rewriting setup as Home Manager/NixOS modules and replacing hyprpm with nixpkgs hyprlandPlugins.

It needs the very new Hyprland Lua config (0.55+/0.56). Most references and Home Manager's wayland.windowManager.hyprland.settings produce hyprlang, and I did not verify whether HM supports Lua output. The Lua would probably have to be shipped raw through xdg.configFile. It is also fragile if the Lua API changes between Hyprland releases.

The 40 bundled wallpapers (and the SDDM background.jpg) have no attribution, source or licence in a GPL-3.0 repo. Names like red-lamborghini-urus-rain, panther-dollar-bills, footballers-pitch and white-porsche-front suggest images of unknown provenance, so they should not be redistributed.

Personal leftovers in shared config: MATLAB R2025b window rules, 'aa-practices-float', an 'Xlispg' rule, MATLAB entries added to PATH in .zshrc, and a comment about a Spanish keyboard layout while kb_layout is 'us'.
The polkit agent path /usr/lib/polkit-kde-authentication-agent-1 is hardcoded (FHS; breaks on NixOS). The autostart plugin bootstrap is a long shell one-liner that reads /var/cache/hyprpm/$USER.

theme_manager.py is a single ~3980-line Python file that writes directly into third-party app internals (Zen's inline-style overrides, spicetify, the VSCodium extensions dir, Vesktop CSS variables, kdeglobals). It will break when those apps change, and it writes into ~/.config dirs (gtk-3.0/gtk.css, btop/themes, qt6ct, yazi/flavors, kdeglobals) that would collide with read-only Home Manager symlinks.

The adaptive palette is simple compared with matugen/Material You: it picks one accent from a 24-colour quantize, surfaces are always near-black, text greys and status colours are fixed (Catppuccin Mocha), there is no light variant, and no tonal palette.
No window borders and active/inactive opacity both 1.0, so the only focus cue is the shadow, and that is off by default.
Idle screen-off only handles the first monitor (hl.get_monitors()[1]), as its own comment admits.
kitty remote control is enabled on a user-readable socket (socket-only, but any process running as the user can drive the terminal). Face unlock pulls in howdy-next and opencv.
Very large surface (hundreds of QML files, games, pets, GitHub and Claude usage modules). Heavy to audit or maintain, and it is tied to Quickshell 0.3 APIs.
Plugins built with hyprpm need base-devel, cmake, meson and cpio installed and a rebuild after every Hyprland update (handled by an autostart terminal prompt).
steal_list: Use a single design-token singleton (Theme.qml pattern): semantic colours, radii 8/12/18/pill, 22 px radius matching Hyprland rounding, capsule spacing 8, and gaps_out 18 equal to the bar edge margin and desktop gutter, so the shell and compositor share one grid.

Keep animation curves in one place and push them to Hyprland atomically with `hyprctl eval`. Offer user-selectable presets: Glide [0.32,0.72,0,1], Brisk [0.22,1,0.36,1], Calm [0.25,0.1,0.25,1], Bounce [0.05,0.9,0.1,1.15]. Disable fadeIn to avoid the flash while windows re-tile.

Apply WCAG contrast lifting in whatever colour pipeline is chosen (4.5:1 for normal ANSI, 7:1 for bright). Put the accent in the ANSI cyan slot and use ANSI names in starship/fastfetch so everything follows the terminal palette. Combine this with matugen/Stylix for richer tonal palettes.
Recolour Papirus folders without root by generating a user icon theme that inherits Papirus-Dark and symlinks folder icons to the swatch nearest the accent.
Push theme changes to running apps: kitty `kitten @ load-config` over globbed sockets (listen_on unix:${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/kitty.sock), neovim over nvim.*.0 RPC sockets, and cava theme reload.

Collapse the idle, lock, notification and OSD daemons into the shell (Quickshell IdleMonitor with respectInhibitors, WlSessionLock with a blurred grim screenshot, NotificationServer). This also avoids hyprlock/hypridle packaging differences between Arch and NixOS.
Match the SDDM theme visually to the lock screen (same clock, pill and island). On NixOS use services.displayManager.sddm.theme with a derivation of the QML theme.
Face unlock as a separate PAM service that never consumes password attempts (-auth sufficient pam_howdy.so / auth required pam_deny.so). On NixOS this maps to security.pam.services.<name>.text.

Dynamic island ideas: predeclared panel sizes so the shape animates before contents load, concave notch fillets with QtQuick.Shapes PathAngleArc, and one 'live' bar per focused monitor instead of recreating surfaces.
A launcher with prefix sigils (=, @, !, ', >) and ranking by launch frequency.

Cute touches worth copying for a pastel rice: pastel sticky notes (tint washed with #c4ffffff) in an OFL handwriting font (Grape Nuts), bar pets that cannot die, and an animated pixel-art fastfetch logo drawn in the palette via kitty-icat GIF (kitty filters images linearly, so scale the pixels ×5 first).

Hyprland details: snap floating windows with window_gap 14 / monitor_gap 18, float-and-centre at 60% of the monitor via a Lua function, a Chromium/Electron scroll_touchpad 0.19 rule, a 3-finger horizontal workspace gesture, cursor inactive_timeout 5, shake-to-find cursor magnification, and a layer_rule blur with ignore_alpha 0.15 for widget layers.

Installer ergonomics for the Arch side: copy with a sha256 manifest, write .new next to edited files, back up anything in the way, support --dry-run, uninstall and `sync --watch`, and run CI syntax checks (lua, zsh, bash, JSON, TOML, Python). On the Nix side, prefer Home Manager with mutable escape hatches for runtime-generated theme files (write them to ~/.local/state and include/source them from the managed configs, as impasto already does for kitty).

one_line: A personal Arch-only, GNU-stow Hyprland (plus a secondary niri) setup. The polished parts are a Waybar with drawer groups, a hyprlock layout with a big stacked clock, and Material-3 animation curves. Around them sit a mix of Catppuccin Mocha, Tokyo Night and Nord-ish colours, dead files and outdated Hyprland syntax. It has no Nix support.
freshness: The default branch is `catppuccin` (657 commits, about 226 stars, 6 forks; no license file was found). The last commit is 2025-06-17 ("chore : change to vim keybinds"). Before that: 2025-06-09 "MASSIVE UPDATE GO BRR/BRRR" and 2025-05-03 "feat(uwsm): use UWSM for Hyprland". So the repo is about 15 months stale as of 2026-09-25. It predates the Hyprland 0.51 gesture rework and the 0.53 window-rule syntax overhaul, so the Hyprland config will throw errors on current Hyprland.

The colours are inconsistent across apps.
- Hyprland (hypr/mocha.conf): the full Catppuccin Mocha variable set, e.g. rosewater f5e0dc, pink f5c2e7, mauve cba6f7, red f38ba8, peach fab387, yellow f9e2af, green a6e3a1, teal 94e2d5, sky 89dceb, sapphire 74c7ec, blue 89b4fa, lavender b4befe, text cdd6f4, surface0 313244, surface1 45475a, base 1e1e2e, mantle 181825, crust 11111b. Active border is rgb(cba6f7) mauve; inactive border is rgb(24273A), which is Macchiato base, not Mocha.
- theme.conf also has dead leftover borders 0xFF53E2AE / 0xFFF48FB1 that are overridden.
- scheme/current.conf (not sourced anywhere) holds Catppuccin Macchiato plus a Material You scheme: primary BAC3FF, tertiary E5BAD8, background 121318, surfaceContainer 1F1F25.
- Waybar mixes palettes: bar background rgba(26,27,38,0.2), module pills #252733, workspaces #7a95c9, active workspace #ecd3a0, cpu #fb958b, memory #a1c999, battery #8fbcbb, pulseaudio #81a1c1, network #5e81ac, power #e78284, tooltip #1f232b. Window-title rewrites use Macchiato accents #8aadf4, #ed8796, #f5a97f, #a6da95, #c6a0f6. Calendar uses Mocha #f5e0dc, #f9e2af, #f38ba8.
- Rofi (colors/tokyonight.rasi): background #1A1B26, background-alt #282839, foreground #D9E0EE, selected #7AA2F7, active #ABE9B3, urgent #F28FAD.
- Fuzzel: background 16161eff, text c0caf5ff / cdd6f4ff, match 2ac3deff, selection 343a55ff, border 45475aff.
- Ghostty: theme tokyonight_night.

aesthetic.geometry:
Active Hyprland (themes/profound/theme.conf):
- border_size 2, gaps_in 3, gaps_out 5, rounding 0 (sharp corners).
- Shadow on, range 30, color 0x44000000; tiled windows get noshadow.
- Blur size 4, passes 4, new_optimizations on, ignore_opacity on, xray false.
- windowrulev2 opacity 0.90 for zen, thunar, Slack, discord, Spotify, neovide, kitty, vesktop, wezterm, ghostty and YouTube Music.
- Layer rules: blur on gtk-layer-shell / launcher / notifications / shell:*, with ignorealpha 0.5 / 0.69 / 0.6; `layerrule = xray 1, .*`.

Unused overrides.conf would have set blur 8/2, gaps 10/40, border 3 and shadow range 20 / render_power 3, plus smart gaps 20 for a single window.

niri: gaps 9, focus-ring width 2, border off, shadow softness 20 / spread 7 / offset -1,-5, geometry-corner-radius 6 with clip-to-geometry.

Waybar: modules are #252733 pills with border-radius 8px, margins 7 to 8.5px top and bottom, padding 0 10px. Bar background is only 20% opaque. Tooltip radius 15px.

Other components:
- Rofi type1: west-anchored sidebar, 450px wide, 98% tall, x-offset 10px, padding 40px, inputbar radius 9px, elements radius 4px.
- Rofi type6: centered, 1000px, radius 15px, image side panel.
- Fuzzel: border 2, radius 10.

- dunst: corner_radius 0, frame 3.
- hyprlock: rounding 12; input 275x55; white pill chips with radius -1 (full pill).
- Ghostty padding 7; kitty padding 10.

The active Hyprland block in theme.conf uses Material-3 / end-4-style curves.
- Beziers:

  - md3_decel (0.05,0.5,0.1,1)
  - md3_accel (0.3,0,0.6,0.15)

  - windowsOut: 3, md3_accel, popin 60%

  - fadeLayersIn: 1, menu_decel; fadeLayersOut: 2.5, menu_accel

- Three more commented-out alternative blocks exist, including specialWorkspace slidevert / slidefadevert 15% and a myCurve (0.05,0.9,0.1,1.05) popin 80% variant.
- Waybar's active workspace uses transition all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.55,-0.68,0.48,1.68), a bouncy overshoot.
- niri defines custom GLSL shaders: an expanding-circle window-open (200ms, linear) and a shrinking-circle window-close (175ms), with slowdown 1.2. However the block starts with `off`, so all niri animations are disabled.
aesthetic.wallpapers: Wallpapers were moved out to a separate repo; the README link says github.com/greeid/wallpapers. The hypr README credits orangci/walls-catppuccin-mocha. hyprpaper.conf preloads ~/Pictures/Wallpapers/forest_dark_winter.jpg on eDP-1 with splash = true, but the autostart actually launches swww-daemon, so hyprpaper looks unused. There is no wallpaper picker or colour-extraction script in the active config; the old JaKooLit-derived bmodf/ tree has WallpaperSelect.sh.
aesthetic.vibe: A clean, dark, low-saturation look: almost fully transparent bar with floating #252733 pills, square-cornered tiled windows with a mauve 2px border, and heavy 4-pass blur. The screenshot captions show Catppuccin-themed Zen/Tabliss, Thunar, YT Music, Vesktop and rofi. The standout pieces are the hyprlock screen (huge stacked HH over MM in PP Neue Machina, time-of-day greeting, now-playing card, white pill chips for battery, network and Bluetooth) and the Waybar drawers with colour-coded app-title rewrites. It reads as competent and tasteful rather than cute: rounding 0, no pastel gradients, no mascots or kawaii touches. Mixing Tokyo Night (rofi, fuzzel, ghostty) with Catppuccin (hypr, kitty, swaync, starship) and Nord-ish Waybar colours stops it from feeling unified. I'd rate it a mid-to-upper-tier personal rice with a few borrowable gems, not a polished distributable.

components.compositor: Hyprland, launched through UWSM (`uwsm app --` prefixes; commit 'feat(uwsm)'), in a split config: hyprland.conf sources configs/{local_vars,keybinds,monitors,execs,env_vars,win_rules}.conf, then themes/profound/theme.conf and mocha.conf. Layout is dwindle, toggled to master by scripts/ChangeLayout, which also rebinds keys live via `hyprctl keyword`. A secondary niri config (niri/.config/niri/config.kdl) has scrollable columns, preset widths 0.25/0.5/0.75/1.0 and shader animations. The legacy bmodf/hypr tree is an old JaKooLit Hyprland-Dots v1 copy (RainbowBorders.sh, WofiBeats.sh, catppuccin frappe/latte/macchiato/mocha themes). The install script also covers qtile and bspwm.
components.bar_or_shell:
The active bar is Waybar (`exec-once = uwsm app -- waybar`) with config.jsonc and style.css.
- Left: hyprland/window with a rewrite map, a drawer group of cpu/temperature/memory, workspaces (only-populated), custom/update and custom/weather (weather.py).
- Center: a swaync bell, a drawer group for clock time/date, and a drawer group for idle_inhibitor and power-profiles-daemon.
- Right: mpris drawer, tray, audio drawer (pulseaudio plus microphone), backlight drawer, battery drawer, power-menu.
- Every custom/separator#dot-line separator has an empty format string (glyph not preserved in the raw file), so separators render as nothing.

HyprPanel (AGS, ags-hyprpanel-git) is also configured in hyprpanel/config.json: floating bar, opacity 85, border_radius 1em, buttons radius 0.8em, Lexend font, matugen off. Its exec line is commented out. It is still the panel listed in the README.
components.launcher:
Rofi, using the lbonn Wayland fork (rofi-lbonn-wayland-only-git), with adi1090x themes.
- type1.rasi: west sidebar, 450px wide, 98% tall; used by SUPER+Space in Hyprland (hardcoded /home/greed path).
- type6.rasi: centered 1000px panel with an image side panel (images/f.png); used by niri.
- config.rasi: 550x450, centered.
- Colours are imported from colors/tokyonight.rasi.

Fuzzel handles the cliphist clipboard picker (SUPER+V, --match-mode fzf, 15 lines, width 80) and fuzzel-emoji (SUPER+comma). ALT+Space opens a rofi window switcher.
components.notifications: swaync is styled (style.css: Catppuccin Mocha cards, radius 12.6px, critical inset glow #f38ba8) and bound to SUPER+T and a Waybar bell (`swaync-client -swb`). Its exec-once is commented out, so it depends on D-Bus activation. config.json and config.jsonc both return 404; only the style is in the repo. A dunstrc also exists (Google Sans 11, width (300,400), top-right offset (10,50), frame 3, Mocha colours). There is also an `exec-once = sleep 5; pkill xfce4-notifyd` hack. SwayOSD (swayosd-server) provides volume and brightness OSDs.
components.lock_idle_logout:
hyprlock.conf is a heavily customised layout. It appears adapted from a community template, since greeting.sh has a commented-out `username="TamarindX"`.
- Background: the screenshot, blur_passes 2, contrast 0.8916, brightness 0.7172, vibrancy 0.1696.
- Profile picture: ~/.face, 90px, top-left.
- User info label: kernel version and a `pacman -Q | wc -l` package count.
- Weather: ip-api.com over plain http, then wttr.in.
- Clock: split HH and MM labels at 150pt in PP Neue Machina Ultra-Bold.
- Text labels: greeting ('GO TO SLEEP!' after midnight), 'Today is <day>', and the date with an ordinal suffix.
- Input field: 275x55, rounding 12, inner rgba(0,0,0,0.5).
- Status chips: white pill shapes for battery, network and Bluetooth fed by scripts.
- Media card: a 550x120 now-playing shape with playerctl.sh title, artist, album and source glyphs.

hypridle: 150s dims the backlight to 10 (brightnessctl -s/-r), 300s runs loginctl lock-session, 330s turns dpms off, 1800s suspends.

There is no logout menu: Waybar's power button calls ~/.config/rofi/powermenu.sh, which is missing (404). SUPER+SHIFT+Q runs `shutdown now` with no confirmation. A swaylock folder is legacy.
components.wallpaper_tool: swww-daemon is started, but nothing in the active config calls `swww img`. hyprpaper.conf also exists (forest_dark_winter.jpg, splash on). The legacy bmodf tree uses swaybg.
components.terminal: Ghostty is the main terminal (the $terminal var): JetBrainsMono NF SemiBold 13, theme tokyonight_night, padding 7, window-decoration false, gtk-single-instance, tabs at the bottom. Also configured: kitty (Catppuccin-Mocha, powerline tab bar, padding 10) and alacritty (catppuccin and tokyonight variants in yml/toml). tmux uses a catppuccin-mocha.tmuxtheme.
components.shell_prompt:
fish with fisher plugins (fzf.fish, nvm, tokyonight conf.d), plus:
- bang-bang `!!` / `!$` emulation
- an `nvims` fzf picker to switch NVIM_APPNAME configs (Ctrl+A)
- eza aliases, `lf` aliased to yazi
- Catppuccin and Tokyo Night fish themes

Starship prompt: catppuccin_mocha palette. Format is battery, directory, git_branch and git_status, then a line break and the character; right side shows python and cmd_duration. Symbols: success ➜, a Nerd Font glyph for error and vi-mode, git branch shown as (rosewater branch | status).
components.editor: Neovim lives in the external greed-d/nvim-minimal repo. The repo also carries nvim/ and vanvim/ folders, and fish helpers for astronvim, NvChad, lazyvim and kvim via NVIM_APPNAME.
components.file_manager: The README says Thunar and window rules send thunar to workspace 6, but keybinds.conf sets `$fileManager = uwsm app -- nautilus`, so the two disagree. Yazi is aliased as `lf`.
components.fetch: The README lists nitch; the repo contains neofetch/.config/neofetch with config.conf, config.small.conf, alien.txt and several .bak files.
components.login_boot: None found. There is no display manager, bootloader, or Plymouth config in the repo.
components.extras:
- Comfy/: a Spicetify 'Comfy' theme (app.scss, color.ini, theme.js).
- ytm-cat-mocha.css and ytm.css for th-ch YouTube Music.
- vesktop/: Vencord client.
- extras/: Discord themes (ayu-dark, nord, tokyodark .theme.css), a Tabliss new-tab css/json, and foss_droid.md.
- mpd and ncmpcpp configs (including a committed error.log).
- Clipboard: cliphist with wl-paste text and image watchers (started four times, redundantly).
- Screenshots: grimblast (area, output and screen, copy or save) plus swappy for annotation.
- arRPC (Discord rich presence), xdm-app download manager, polkit-gnome, nm-applet.
- An xdph script that kills and restarts the XDG portals.
- Waybar system-update.sh counts official, AUR and flatpak updates.
- paru and systemd folders; a picom config for the X11 WMs.

standout_features: The Waybar 'drawer' groups make the bar declutter itself: cpu/temperature/memory, audio/mic, backlight, battery, clock time/date, idle-inhibitor/power-profile and mpris each collapse to one icon and slide open on hover (transition-duration 500, transition-left-to-right).

The Waybar hyprland/window 'rewrite' dictionary turns raw window classes and titles into coloured Nerd Font icons plus friendly names with Pango spans. Examples: Firefox #ed8796, Zen #f5a97f, VS Code #8aadf4, nvim #a6da95, mpv #c6a0f6, YT Music #FF0000, Telegram #24A1DE, and .docx/.xlsx/.pptx/.pdf coloured by file type.
A per-core CPU sparkline in Waybar: format "{icon0}{icon1}{icon2}{icon3} {usage:>2}%" with icons ▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█, refreshed every second.

The hyprlock screen: huge stacked HH over MM clock (150pt PP Neue Machina Ultra-Bold) on a blurred screenshot, time-of-day greeting ('GO TO SLEEP!' after midnight), 'Today is <day>', an ordinal date, a now-playing card with source glyphs (Firefox/Spotify/Chrome), and white pill chips for battery, network and Bluetooth in the bottom corners.
Staged hypridle: dim to 10% at 150s (brightnessctl -s/-r restores the level), lock at 300s, DPMS off at 330s, suspend at 1800s.
Material-3 motion curves (md3_decel/md3_accel popin 60% for windows, menu_decel/menu_accel slide for layers and workspaces). These give fast, springy pop-in and slide behaviour.
The niri config has custom GLSL window-open/close shaders: an expanding-circle reveal (200ms) and a shrinking-circle close (175ms). Nice idea, but disabled by `off`.

system-update.sh for Waybar counts official, AUR (paru/yay) and flatpak updates, shows a tooltip breakdown, opens a terminal to upgrade on click, and refreshes the module with `pkill -RTMIN+20 waybar` on exit.
Picture-in-Picture handling: float, pin, keepaspectratio, `move 73% 72%`, `size 25%`, matched by a regex that covers 'Picture-in-Picture' and 'Picture in picture'.

The unused overrides.conf has a smart-gaps rule worth keeping: `workspace = w[tv1]s[false], gapsout:20, gapsin:20` and `f[1]s[false]`. It also has a pinned-window border colour rule: `windowrulev2 = bordercolor rgb($tertiary) rgba($tertiary88), pinned:1`.
SUPER+A floats and pins the active window in one keystroke (it toggles floating only if the window is tiled).
Layout toggle script (scripts/ChangeLayout): switches dwindle and master and hot-swaps the layout-specific keybinds with `hyprctl keyword bind`, then sends a notification.
structure_install:
Each app is a GNU stow package with the layout <app>/.config/<app>/…, e.g. hypr/.config/hypr, waybar/.config/waybar, rofi/.config/rofi, fish/.config/fish, ghostty/.config/ghostty, swaync/.config/swaync, niri/.config/niri. Scripts live in scripts/.local/scripts. The tmux config is in greed/.tmux.conf.

Other loose content in the repo:
- root-level .themes/ with a bundled GTK theme
- Comfy/ (a Spicetify theme)
- extras/
- bmodf/ (legacy JaKooLit-derived hypr tree)
- fonts/
- hyprpanel_config.json
- install_setup, rm_bak.sh

Install per the README:
1. `sudo pacman -S hyprland hypridle hyprlock pacman-contrib ghostty thunar spotify-launcher fish ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd cliphist brightnessctl wireplumber playerctl tmux`
2. `paru -S ags-hyprpanel-git rofi-lbonn-wayland-only-git youtube-music-bin vesktop-bin`
3. `git clone https://github.com/greeid/.dotfiles ~/.dotfiles/ -b catppuccin --depth=1` (note the old 'greeid' handle)
4. `stow hypr/ alacritty/ fish/ scripts/ rofi/ hyprpanel/ scripts/`

The README's package list is incomplete. The config also needs waybar, swww, swayosd, swaync, grimblast, swappy, fuzzel, uwsm, polkit-gnome, nm-applet, jq, Lexend, Google Sans and PP Neue Machina.

install_setup is an old personal Arch-only bash script with functions essential/hyprland/qtile/install_bsp and create_symlink_*. It runs `rm $HOME/.config/<app>` and then stows. It references outdated packages (waybar-hyprland-git, hyprland-git, exa) and has a typo ('rofistarship'). There is no NixOS or other distro support.

weaknesses: Outdated Hyprland syntax. `gestures { workspace_swipe = true }` was removed in Hyprland 0.51, which replaced it with `gesture = 3, horizontal, workspace`. windowrulev2, the old windowrule and layerrule forms throughout win_rules.conf and theme.conf predate the 0.53 window-rule overhaul (verified via hypr.land 0.51 news and the 0.53 syntax-change reports), so they will error on current Hyprland.

Broken or malformed rules and execs:
- `windowrule = move, 480 50 class:...` and `size, 954 763 class:...` put the comma in the wrong place.
- `idleinhibit fullscreen, class:^(*)$` is an invalid regex.
- `exec-once = class:^([Aa]rm[Cc]ord)$` and `exec-once = [workspace 8 silent] class:^(...)$` try to execute a window-rule string, not a command.
- The layerrule 'networkmneu' is a typo.
- `animation = border` is defined twice.
- theme.conf sets col.active_border and col.inactive_border twice.

Dead files: hyprland/overrides.conf, scheme/current.conf and hyprland/ignore.conf are never sourced. hyprpaper.conf is unused because swww is started. HyprPanel is configured and listed in the README, but its exec is commented out in favour of Waybar.

Broken references: Waybar's power button calls ~/.config/rofi/powermenu.sh, which returns 404 in the repo. ChangeLayout sends a notification icon from ~/.config/hypr/mako/icons/hyprland.png, which doesn't exist. The niri brightness binds pass `--brighntess` (typo), so they fail. All niri animations, including the showcase shaders, are turned off by `off`.

Hardcoded user and paths:
- `-theme /home/greed/.config/rofi/type1.rasi` in both Hyprland and niri binds.
- `$USER = greed` in hyprlock.
- monitors.conf hardcodes eDP-1 1920x1080@60 and HDMI-A-1 1366x768.
- battery modules hardcode BAT1/ACAD.
- the temperature module hardcodes hwmon1 paths.
- the Arch-only `pacman -Q | wc -l` appears on the lock screen, and `/usr/lib/polkit-gnome/...` in autostart.

Inconsistent theming. Catppuccin Mocha is used in hypr, kitty, swaync and starship. Tokyo Night is used in rofi, fuzzel, ghostty and fish. Waybar uses ad-hoc Nord/OneDark-ish hexes plus Macchiato accents. The inactive border is Macchiato base on an otherwise Mocha setup. No generator (matugen or wallust) ties them together.

Fragile hacks:
- the xdph script kills and restarts xdg-desktop-portal with sleeps, which is unnecessary with UWSM and systemd.
- `sleep 5; pkill xfce4-notifyd`.
- cliphist wl-paste watchers are launched four times with overlapping filters.
- only some execs use the `uwsm app --` prefix.
- `$fileManager` is nautilus while the rules and README assume thunar.
Unsafe bind: SUPER+SHIFT+Q runs `shutdown now` with no confirmation, one modifier away from common close-window binds.

Privacy and network issues on the lock screen. weatherinfo.sh calls http://ip-api.com over plain HTTP every second (cmd[update:1000]) for geolocation, then wttr.in. The ordinal-date logic compares zero-padded %d ('01') against `1)`, so the 1st, 2nd and 3rd get a 'th' suffix.

Repository hygiene:
- committed .bak files (keybinds.conf.bak, hyprlock.conf.bak, kitty.conf.bak, neofetch config.conf.bak1/.orgi).
- ncmpcpp/error.log.
- fish_variables, even though it is listed in .gitignore.
- the stale install_setup script (qtile/bspwm era, 'rofistarship' typo, deprecated exa, *-git packages).
- the README clone URL uses a different handle ('greeid').

Licensing and redistribution risks. It bundles GoogleSansNerdFont-Regular.ttf twice; Google Sans is a proprietary Google font and patched redistribution is questionable. It requires the commercial PP Neue Machina typeface. It vendors a third-party GTK theme (Lavanda-Dark-Compact-Tokyonight) and a Spicetify theme (Comfy) without license files. Rofi themes are adi1090x copies, credited in the file headers. No top-level LICENSE was found.
Not NixOS-friendly at all: no flake, no Home Manager, and Arch/pacman assumptions throughout (system-update.sh exits unless /etc/arch-release exists).
steal_list: Waybar drawer groups (`group/*` with drawer transition-duration 500 and transition-left-to-right) for cpu/temp/mem, audio/mic, backlight, battery, clock time/date, and idle/power-profile. Style them as #252733-like pills with radius 8 in a single palette.

The Waybar hyprland/window 'rewrite' map, which turns app classes into coloured Nerd Font icon plus pretty name. Generate its colours from the theme palette (matugen/Stylix template) instead of hardcoding them.
The per-core CPU sparkline format `{icon0}{icon1}{icon2}{icon3} {usage:>2}%` with ▁▂▃▄▅▆▇█ icons.

The hyprlock layout: stacked HH over MM in a heavy display font, time-of-day greeting, now-playing card, and white pill status chips. Swap PP Neue Machina for an OFL font (e.g. Outfit, Space Grotesk or Unbounded), cache the weather (update every 600000ms, HTTPS) and make the package count distro-aware (pacman vs `nix-store -q --requisites /run/current-system | wc -l`).
The staged hypridle: 150s dim with brightnessctl -s/-r, 300s lock, 330s DPMS off, 1800s suspend. On NixOS the equivalent is `services.hypridle.settings`.
The Material-3 bezier set (md3_decel 0.05,0.5,0.1,1; md3_accel 0.3,0,0.6,0.15; menu_decel 0.1,1,0,1; menu_accel 0.38,0.04,1,0.07) with windows popin 60% and layers/workspaces slide.
The niri circle-reveal open/close GLSL shaders (200ms and 175ms), enabled, as an optional 'fancy' niri profile.
The PiP rule set (float, pin, keepaspectratio, move 73% 72%, size 25%), rewritten in 0.53+ windowrule syntax.
Smart gaps for a single tiled window (`workspace = w[tv1]s[false], gapsout:20, gapsin:20` and `f[1]s[false]`) and a distinct border colour for pinned windows.
The SUPER+A 'float and pin' one-keystroke bind and the ChangeLayout dwindle/master toggle that hot-swaps layout-specific binds.

The Waybar system-update.sh pattern (count, tooltip breakdown, click to upgrade in terminal, RTMIN signal refresh). Add a NixOS branch that shows flake.lock input age or an `nvd diff` summary instead of pacman/AUR counts.
The fuzzel clipboard picker `cliphist list | fuzzel --match-mode fzf --dmenu --anchor center --lines 15 --width 80 | cliphist decode | wl-copy` and fuzzel-emoji on SUPER+comma.
The swaync card style (radius 12.6px, 0 0 8px shadow plus 1px inset surface border, critical notifications with an inset red glow), ported to the unified palette.
The starship catppuccin_mocha palette block with a minimal two-line prompt and a right-aligned cmd_duration.

The per-app GNU stow package layout (<app>/.config/<app>) for the Arch side, mirrored on NixOS by Home Manager `xdg.configFile` or `mkOutOfStoreSymlink` from the same tree so one set of dotfiles serves both distros.

target: multi-distro, Arch first. The installer also handles apt, dnf and zypper. There is no NixOS support: no flake and no .nix files.
one_line: "Panacea Shell": a monochrome, Nothing-OS / Dynamic-Island style Hyprland (0.55+ Lua config) desktop. The whole shell is a single Quickshell QML pill fused to a screen edge with concave notch corners. It replaces bar, launcher, notifications, polkit, lock, file manager, clipboard, recorder, password vault and settings. Matching GRUB and SDDM themes, foot and fish are included.
freshness: Very active. VERSION = 1.0.13. The commits atom feed (github.com/EnsixD/Panacea/commits/main.atom) shows dozens of commits on 2026-09-21 and 2026-09-22, three days before today (2026-09-25). It uses the brand-new Hyprland Lua config (hypr/hyprland.lua with the hl.* API). Per hypr.land/news/26_lua that is available from git on 2026-04-26 / Hyprland 0.55. switch_theme.sh already handles the hyprpaper 0.8+ `wallpaper { monitor, path, fit_mode }` block format. The installer carries an OBSOLETE_PKGS list (waybar, wob, tofi, hyprlock dropped in 1.0.7), which suggests fast iteration. It has a built-in self-updater (panacea/scripts/update.sh, 670 lines).

aesthetic.palette:
There are two separate palettes and they do not agree.
(1) Shell theme 'Nothing' (panacea/Themes.js, the only theme; 8 earlier accent themes were removed): bg #000000, fg #ffffff, on #ffffff, ok #ffffff, crit #d71921 (Nothing red, used only for recording and low battery). Derived colours: muted = fg at alpha 0.45, line and hover = fg at alpha 0.10. tint() collapses every status colour (e.g. warn #fbbf24) to fg, so the look is strictly monochrome. The pre-cfg default colOn in shell.qml is #3b82f6.
(2) App palette 'Fav' (hypr/palette.conf, derived from HyDE Graphite Mono per the README): $accent_color #c65a47 (terracotta), $bg_color #1b2b34 (the same value as Oceanic Next base00), $fg_color #e5d1c5 (warm beige), $term_bg #1b2b34.
Other hex values seen:
- Hyprland active border gradient rgba(ffffffff) to rgba(8a8a8aff) at 45°; inactive rgba(2a2a2aaa). The legacy theme.conf gradient is rgba(c65a47ee) to rgba(4d6d80ee).
- GRUB: desktop #050506, title #f2f2f2, items #c8c8c8, selected #ffffff, muted #7a7a7a / #6e6e6e / #5a5a5a, timeout bar #c65a47 on #1c1c20.
- SDDM: bg #050506, fg #f2f2f2, muted #8a8a8a, accent #c65a47, crit #ef4444.
- Niri focus ring #7FB3FF, inactive rgba(255,255,255,0.08).
- Fish prompt greys #4a4a4a and #6a6a6a, error #ff5555, autosuggestion 707070.
- Keyboard-layout indicator tint #7FB3FF when RU.
aesthetic.color_pipeline:
Static and hand-made. No matugen, pywal or wallust. Changing the wallpaper deliberately never recolours anything.
- hypr/palette.conf (edited by hand) goes into hypr/scripts/palette.sh (bash with embedded python/colorsys). It writes: foot/theme ([colors-dark] fg/bg/selection); fish conf.d/theme_colors.fish (syntax colours from HSV-desaturated accent variants s*0.55/v*0.85, s*0.35/v*0.7, s*0.45/v*0.8); Zed 'experimental.theme_overrides' merged into the user's settings.json; btop themes/dynamic.theme, with color_theme patched in btop.conf; nvim lua/theme_colors.lua; an Obsidian CSS snippet at ~/obsidian_vault; and the fastfetch accent, by rewriting the line after a '// panacea:accent' marker.
- It also runs `gsettings set ... color-scheme prefer-dark`, because foot only reads [colors-dark] under prefer-dark.
- Separately, the shell theme in Themes.js is shared by shell.qml and lock.qml. The shell writes foot/panacea-theme, included after the palette file so the terminal bg matches the widget cards, and puts the login-screen colours in /var/lib/panacea.
- switch_theme.sh changes only wallpapers. It writes hypr/wallpaper.conf, which is not sourced so Hyprland does not reload, and makes a pre-blurred SDDM background with ffmpeg `scale=1280:-1,gblur=sigma=28,eq=saturation=0.9`.
aesthetic.fonts:
JetBrainsMono Nerd Font everywhere:
- Shell: fontFam, fontBody and fontDisplay all set to it; fontSize 15, iconSize 17.
- foot: size=16. Lock and SDDM use it too.
- The installer fetches it from nerd-fonts releases if the package is missing.
- Glyphs are Material Design Icons (via the Nerd Font).
- Dot-matrix digits for the Nothing look (DotText.qml, DotIcon.qml, FlipText.qml).
- GRUB uses custom bitmap fonts panacea14.pf2, panacea18.pf2 and panacea22b.pf2, generated by grub/panacea/make_assets.py. Internal names are 'Panacea Regular Regular 18', 'Panacea Bold Bold 22' and 'Panacea Small Regular 14'.

aesthetic.animations:
Hyprland (hypr/lua/animations.lua; curves credited to ilyamiro/serpantinum).
Curves:
- myBezier (0.05,0.9),(0.1,1.05)
- easeOutQuint (0.23,1.0),(0.32,1.0)
- liquid (0.16,1.0),(0.3,1.0)
- gestureOut (0.4,0.0),(0.2,1.0)
- gestureIn (0.12,0.9),(0.15,1.0)
Leaves:
- windows and windowsIn: speed 7, myBezier, 'popin 80%'.
- windowsOut: speed 6, liquid, popin 80%. windowsMove: speed 6, liquid.
- layers and layersIn: speed 6, liquid, fade. layersOut: speed 5.
- fade: 6, liquid. border: 8, liquid.
- workspaces: speed 7, easeOutQuint, slide. specialWorkspaceIn and Out: fade, speed 6 and 5.
Trackpad gestures via built-in hl.gesture:
- 3 fingers: horizontal switches workspace, down closes, up goes fullscreen.
- 4 fingers: horizontal moves the window, down floats it.
QML (shell.qml):
- animMove 230 ms, animFade 200, animHover 150. animBounce 0; if raised, Easing.OutBack with overshoot.
- Otherwise Easing.InOutCubic for the capsule width, height and radius morph; OutCubic and OutQuint elsewhere. The wallpaper carousel uses OutQuint with 420 ms.
- A 'reduceMotion' toggle sets every duration to 0.
- The shell runs with QSG_RENDER_LOOP=threaded, so animations follow vsync at 144 Hz instead of 60.
aesthetic.wallpapers:
- wallpapers/ holds 300+ bundled images from ilyamiro/shell-wallpapers. They are named by tone and hue (bright_*, dim_*, dark_* × amber, blue, crimson, green, lime, mono, purple, red, teal, violet, yellow, grey). Many carry photographer names (anders_jilden, johannes_plenio, luca_bravo, etc., likely from Unsplash) plus odd ones like here_some_ultrakill_edited.png, catpuccin_dark_blue.jpg and house_pixel_art.jpg.
- hypr/wallpaper/ has NothingWall.png, ember_stripes.jpg and misty_peaks.jpg (from matteogini/dotfiles). spring_bloom.jpg comes from HyDE.
- Picker: a full-screen carousel in the pill (Super+Shift+T) with parallax previews that unfolds from the island.
- Live video wallpapers via mpvpaper from ~/.config/hypr/wallpaper/live; none are bundled.
- hyprsunset -t 5000 runs at start.
- The README admits none of the wallpapers are the author's.
aesthetic.vibe:
Honest take: extremely polished and product-like, but it is not cute or pastel.
The look is Nothing OS crossed with Apple's Dynamic Island: a pure-black capsule melts into the top edge through concave notch corners. It shows white dot-matrix digits, workspace dots and a single red accent. Windows get thin white-to-grey gradient borders, 12 px squircle rounding, and no blur or shadow.
It is a flat, austere monochrome aesthetic. The terminal, fastfetch, GRUB and SDDM still use the older terracotta #c65a47 on slate #1b2b34 'Fav' palette, so cohesion across layers is imperfect.
Interaction design is top tier: every panel is the same morphing capsule on one animation timeline, it opens on hover, can be dragged to any edge, and has live settings mock-ups.
Rating: UX and polish about 9/10. Cute/pastel appeal about 4/10. Overall visual elegance about 7.5/10 for a minimalist. Its value for a pastel rice is the architecture and interaction patterns, not the colours.

components.compositor: Hyprland, primary. It uses the Lua config (hypr/hyprland.lua requiring hypr/lua/{monitors,env,look_and_feel,input,workspaces,windowrules,keybindings,autostart,permissions}.lua, then pcall(require,'custom.*') user overrides). hypr/hyprland.conf is a deliberately minimal fallback for pre-Lua Hyprland. Niri is supported in beta (niri/config.kdl, 229 lines; the shell detects $NIRI_SOCKET). Autostart: foot --server, hyprpaper, the pill, two cliphist watchers, hyprsunset -t 5000, udiskie, switch_theme.sh --restore, and cliphist pruning to 500 entries.
components.bar_or_shell:
Quickshell 'Panacea' pill / dynamic island (panacea/shell.qml, 6543 lines, plus about 60 QML views and components). It is a WlrLayer.Overlay PanelWindow with NotificationServer, PolkitAgent and IpcHandler built in, driven by `qs -c ~/.config/panacea ipc call pill <page>`.
Pages: controls, wifi, bluetooth, notifications, overview (live workspace previews), launcher, clipboard, files, media viewer and trimmer, recorder, password vault, battery, power, settings (12 sections), shortcuts, wallpapers, weather, agents, what's-new.
Collapsed, it shows day, clock, workspace dots, keyboard layout and battery. It can sit at the top, bottom, left or right edge; at the side edges text is stacked vertically. Optional Nothing-style desktop widgets: analog 12-dot clock, concentric RAM/SSD rings, 24-segment day/year progress bar.
components.launcher: Built into the pill (LauncherView.qml, Super+A): app search, calculator, recents first, and an agents panel. It can also list other operating systems on the disk and reboot into one once (bootos.sh via grub-reboot or EFI BootNext through pkexec). No rofi, wofi or fuzzel; tofi was dropped in 1.0.7.
components.notifications: Built into the pill: Quickshell NotificationServer with live cards, one history list, DND, notifTimeout 5000 and a critical timeout of 0. The installer masks the dunst and mako user services so D-Bus activation cannot steal org.freedesktop.Notifications.
components.lock_idle_logout: Lock screen: panacea/lock.qml, a separate Quickshell process using ext-session-lock and Quickshell.Services.Pam. At rest it shows a sharp wallpaper with a clock; on input the background blurs (lockBlur 32) and a password capsule slides up. It installs swaylock only for its /etc/pam.d/swaylock profile. Super+L and both lid-switch on and off run scripts/lock.sh. Power menu: pill page on Ctrl+Alt+Del. No idle daemon (hypridle or swayidle) was found in the files read. hyprlock was dropped in 1.0.7.
components.wallpaper_tool: hyprpaper, with a config writer that detects the version and emits the 0.8+ `wallpaper { monitor = ; path; fit_mode = cover }` block or the old preload/wallpaper lines. mpvpaper handles live video (hypr/scripts/live_wallpaper.sh). hyprsunset handles night tint.
components.terminal:
foot running as a server (foot --server) with footclient windows:
- JetBrainsMono Nerd Font size 16, pad 22x18 center, beam cursor 1 px, blink, 10000 lines of scrollback, csd preferred=none.
- It includes the theme file, then panacea-theme, then custom.ini.
- Opacity comes from a Hyprland window rule generated from the shell slider (lua/term_data.lua), so changes apply live.
components.shell_prompt: fish with a custom one-line fish_prompt: a grey '▍' bar, the cwd in bold accent (home is shown as 'home'), a grey git branch with '*' when dirty, a background-job count '⏵N', and a '⟢' separator that turns #ff5555 after a failed command. Aliases: eza (icons, dirs first), zoxide as cd, bat as cat (BAT_THEME ansi). pacman abbreviations: upd, ins, i, syu, r, pacc, pace, y.
components.editor: No editor config is shipped. palette.sh generates colours for Zed (theme_overrides), Neovim (~/.config/nvim/lua/theme_colors.lua) and Obsidian. nano gets nano/nanorc.
components.file_manager: Built into the pill (FilesView.qml, Super+E): bookmarks, disks and removable media (udisks2, udiskie, gvfs-mtp), sorting, trash, context menu, drag between windows. It is registered as the default for inode/directory via applications/panacea-files.desktop. yazi in footclient is on Super+Shift+E.
components.fetch: fastfetch with the arch_small logo. Keys and logo use the accent colour 38;2;198;90;71 (rewritten by palette.sh), values are white. Nerd-font key icons, a custom line 'Shell: Panacea Island', the packages count shows pacman only, and a colors row uses the circle symbol. Includes custom.jsonc.
components.login_boot:
GRUB theme grub/panacea: background.png on #050506; 9-slice capsule highlight (select_*.png) and terminal box (menu_*.png); custom pf2 fonts; header 'Panacea' with the subtitle 'выберите систему' (Russian); timeout progress bar #c65a47. The installer sets GRUB_THEME and GRUB_DISABLE_OS_PROBER=false and checks for a mismatched grubx64.efi prefix.
SDDM theme sddm/panacea: a QML Main.qml with a big 76 px clock, an 84 px avatar circle, and a password capsule of radius 30. Background is the pre-blurred /var/lib/panacea/sddm-bg.jpg; accent #c65a47 comes from theme.conf or colours written by the shell.
No Plymouth.
components.extras:
- cava audio spectrum and microphone waveform inside the pill (CavaSource, MicCavaSource, WaveBars).
- Smart clipboard (cliphist) that detects HEX colours with a swatch and RGB/HSL copy, URLs, images, and pinned snippets.
- wf-recorder screen recorder (FPS setting, system audio, mic).
- Freeze-frame region screenshot (shot.sh plus shotcrop.py with grim and slurp).
- Encrypted password vault (vault.sh: openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2) with browser password import (browser_pw.py, python-secretstorage, cryptography) and save prompts.
- Offline voice-to-text with voxtype (Whisper medium, Silero VAD) on hold-Right-Alt, typed by wtype.
- UI sounds (charge, connect, disconnect, screenshot and voice wavs via pw-play).
- Weather, digital vibrance (vibrance.sh), ddcutil DDC/CI brightness for desktops, AMD s2idle helper.
- Acceleration-style smart_volume and smart_brightness scripts.
- Workspace packing on Super+Shift+A, written in Lua.
- Self-updater button in Settings > System.
- xdg-mime defaults point images, video and folders at the shell's own viewer and file manager.

standout_features: A single morphing capsule is the entire shell. Every page is the same pill at a different size, sharing one geometry, palette and animation timeline, with InOutCubic morphs of width, height and corner radii (animMove 230 ms). There are no separate bar, popup or launcher windows.

A true 'hardware notch' look: concave corners (NotchShape.qml draws a quarter-circle cut-out with QtQuick.Shapes PathArc and CurveRenderer; NotchCorner.qml is the Canvas version) make the pill grow out of the screen edge with no gap and no border.

It works at any edge: the island docks top, bottom, left or right and always expands toward the screen centre. At side edges text stacks letter by letter. It can be dragged to a new edge; edgeAt() picks the nearest edge within a quarter of the screen.
Opens on hover, contextually: the media player if something is playing, quick settings otherwise. Every page closes with Escape, the same key, or a click outside.

The settings panel has live mock-ups (a replica of the desktop with the real island on it), is searchable across 12 sections, and has a keybinding editor. Bindings compile into hypr/lua/binds_data.lua. A 'capture' submap removes all binds while you record a new combo, with Super+Shift+Escape as the escape hatch.

Keybinding helper B(id, default, action) in Lua: GUI overrides come from a generated table, and an empty string disables a bind. Risky binds (voxtype release binds) are wrapped in pcall so one API mismatch cannot take down the whole Hyprland config.
Nothing OS desktop widgets: a 12-dot analog clock with a red orbiting second hand, concentric RAM and SSD arcs with dot-matrix percentages, and a 24-segment day or 365-day year progress bar.

Boot-to-other-OS from the launcher: bootos.sh discovers the installed systems and tidies their names ('Windows Boot Manager (on /dev/nvme0n1p1)' becomes 'Windows'), then does a one-shot grub-reboot or EFI BootNext through pkexec. These entries are hidden from the empty launcher and never saved as recents.

The GRUB theme has a capsule-highlight 9-slice drawn in the same design language, with pf2 fonts generated by make_assets.py. The installer detects the silent failure where grubx64.efi's embedded prefix points elsewhere and prints the fix.

The lock screen is Quickshell with ext-session-lock and PAM. It shares Themes.js with the shell so colours cannot drift. At rest it shows the wallpaper sharp; when you type, it blurs and the input capsule slides up.
Pre-blurred SDDM wallpaper (ffmpeg gblur sigma 28 at 1280 px) written to /var/lib/panacea, because the sddm user cannot read ~ and QML blur on the greeter costs frames.
Terminal opacity is applied as a live Hyprland window rule from a shell slider instead of foot's alpha, so it changes open windows instantly.
NVIDIA-aware config: /proc/modules detection turns on software cursors, and QSG_RENDER_LOOP=threaded makes Qt animations run at the monitor's refresh rate instead of a 60 Hz timer.

A user-override layer that survives updates in every component: hypr/custom/*.lua|conf, foot/custom.ini, fish/custom.fish, niri/custom/custom.kdl, fastfetch custom.jsonc, settings.json merged with defaults via jq, and a post-update.sh hook.
structure_install:
Layout:
- panacea/: the Quickshell config (shell.qml, lock.qml, about 60 *View/Set* QML components, Themes.js, Translations.qml, settings.json, scripts/*.sh|py, sounds/*.wav).
- hypr/: hyprland.lua, lua/*.lua, custom/, the fallback hyprland.conf, palette.conf, theme.lua, theme.conf, scripts/ (palette.sh, switch_theme.sh, live_wallpaper.sh, pack_workspaces.sh), and 3 wallpapers.
- Other top-level dirs: niri/, foot/, fish/ (conf.d, functions), fastfetch/, nano/, bin/ (smart_volume, smart_brightness, battery_mode, notify, amd_s2idle.py), applications/*.desktop, grub/panacea/, sddm/panacea/, wallpapers/ (300+ images), docs/other-distros.md, plus a committed demo.mp4.

Install:
- `git clone` then `./install.sh`. The script is 1715 lines of imperative bash. It detects pacman, apt, dnf or zypper. It checks a binary|package|purpose DEPS table and offers to build yay-bin because quickshell is in the AUR; on other distros it can build quickshell from source.
- It installs GPU drivers and microcode, fonts and the cursor, backs up replaced files as *.bak-<timestamp>, and copies configs into ~/.config. It symlinks ~/.config/quickshell/panacea, ~/.nanorc and ~/.local/bin.
- It enables bluetooth, power-profiles-daemon and iwd, and handles NetworkManager if present. It masks dunst and mako, runs palette.sh and switch_theme.sh --restore, and creates /var/lib/panacea.
- It sets xdg-mime defaults. It prompts separately for the wallpaper pack, the GRUB theme (edits /etc/default/grub, turns on os-prober, regenerates the config) and the SDDM theme.
- Flags: --no-deps, --no-sddm, --no-grub, --no-services, --no-wallpapers, --no-restart, --yes.

Updates come through an in-shell button or `curl -fsSL .../update.sh | bash -s apply`, which clones the repo and carries user settings, keybinds and wallpapers across.

key_snippets.excerpt:
function animations.apply()
    -- Curve prese da serpantinum (ilyamiro/serpantinum), rallentate per fluidita'
    hl.curve("myBezier",     { type = "bezier", points = { {0.05, 0.9}, {0.1, 1.05} } })
    hl.curve("easeOutQuint", { type = "bezier", points = { {0.23, 1.0}, {0.32, 1.0} } })
    hl.curve("liquid",       { type = "bezier", points = { {0.16, 1.0}, {0.3,  1.0} } })
    -- для жестов: разгон помягче, торможение длиннее — движение читается как «уехало»
    hl.curve("gestureOut",   { type = "bezier", points = { {0.4,  0.0}, {0.2,  1.0} } })
    hl.curve("gestureIn",    { type = "bezier", points = { {0.12, 0.9}, {0.15, 1.0} } })

    -- Окна: popin, но мягче
    hl.animation({ leaf = "windows",    enabled = true, speed = 7, bezier = "myBezier", style = "popin 80%" })
    hl.animation({ leaf = "windowsIn",  enabled = true, speed = 7, bezier = "myBezier", style = "popin 80%" })
    hl.animation({ leaf = "windowsOut", enabled = true, speed = 6, bezier = "liquid",   style = "popin 80%" })
    hl.animation({ leaf = "windowsMove",enabled = true, speed = 6, bezier = "liquid" })

    -- Слои (панель, попапы quickshell): мягкое затухание
    hl.animation({ leaf = "layers",    enabled = true, speed = 6, bezier = "liquid", style = "fade" })
    hl.animation({ leaf = "layersIn",  enabled = true, speed = 6, bezier = "liquid", style = "fade" })
    hl.animation({ leaf = "layersOut", enabled = true, speed = 5, bezier = "liquid", style = "fade" })

    hl.animation({ leaf = "fade",      enabled = true, speed = 6, bezier = "liquid" })
    hl.animation({ leaf = "border",    enabled = true, speed = 8, bezier = "liquid" })

    -- Workspace: scorrimento continuo
    hl.animation({ leaf = "workspaces",           enabled = true, speed = 7, bezier = "easeOutQuint", style = "slide" })

key_snippets.purpose: GUI-overridable keybinding pattern: generated override table + default, empty string disables
key_snippets.excerpt:
-- Переопределения сочетаний из панели настроек (Super+I).
-- Файл генерируется автоматически; если его нет — берутся значения по умолчанию.
local ok, ov = pcall(require, "lua.binds_data")
if not ok or type(ov) ~= "table" then ov = {} end

-- B(id, сочетание по умолчанию, действие [, опции])
-- Пустая строка в переопределении = сочетание отключено.
local function B(id, def, action, opts)
    local combo = ov[id]
    if combo == nil then combo = def end
    if combo == "" then return end
    hl.bind(combo, action, opts)
end

weaknesses: No NixOS path at all: no flake, no home-manager module. Everything is imperative. palette.sh rewrites the user's Zed settings.json and btop.conf in place, the shell writes into ~/.config/foot/panacea-theme, hypr/lua/term_data.lua and binds_data.lua, and the installer edits /etc/default/grub and /var/lib/panacea. All of this clashes with home-manager's read-only store symlinks unless those files are made mutable or out-of-store.

It needs the Hyprland 0.55+ Lua config (hl.* API, available from 2026-04). The hyprland.conf fallback is deliberately stripped down. Whether home-manager or NixOS modules support hyprland.lua was not verified.

Dead or buggy legacy file: hypr/theme.conf (hyprlang vars) is not sourced by the Lua path and contains `$blur_vibrancy = 1696`, which should be 0.1696. Its gaps, blur and border gradient disagree with theme.lua.

Two palettes that do not agree. The shell, lock screen and window borders are pure black/white Nothing (#000000/#ffffff/#d71921). Terminals, fish, fastfetch, GRUB and SDDM still use terracotta #c65a47 on slate #1b2b34 from palette.conf. The code comments admit the login screen showed a 'terracotta circle' on the monochrome theme.
The aesthetic is flat and austere: blur and shadows are off and there is only one monochrome theme (8 accent themes were deliberately removed). It does not meet a cute or pastel brief.
Monolithic 6543-line shell.qml. Hard to maintain or reuse selectively.

Heavily localized and personal:
- Almost all comments are Russian, with some Italian.
- GRUB labels are hardcoded in Russian ('выберите систему' and the key hints).
- kb_layout is set to 'us,ru' and LC_TIME is forced to en_GB.UTF-8. The voxtype config is Russian.
- A window rule matches Italian file-dialog titles ('Apri file', 'Salva come').
- fish has pacman-only abbreviations and a ~/.opencode/bin path. Firefox is hardcoded as the browser.
- palette.sh assumes ~/obsidian_vault. fastfetch counts only pacman packages.

Bundles 300+ third-party wallpapers, many Unsplash-photographer-named plus game fan art (here_some_ultrakill_edited.png) and a committed demo.mp4. That bloats the repo and leaves licensing unclear; the README concedes none are the author's.

Security-sensitive features live in shell scripts:
- The password vault uses `openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2`, which has no authentication tag.
- There is a browser password import.
- The updater is `curl | bash`.
- swaylock is installed only to borrow its PAM profile.
