Both lid switch:on and switch:off are bound to lock, so opening the lid also runs lock.sh. No idle daemon (hypridle or swayidle) was found, so auto-lock and DPMS on idle appear to be missing in the files read.
No GTK or Qt theming beyond gsettings prefer-dark, so third-party apps will not match.
steal_list: The single-surface 'island' shell concept in Quickshell: one capsule morphs between pages (InOutCubic, about 230 ms, optional OutBack overshoot) and attaches to the screen edge with concave NotchShape corners. Recolour it pastel with some translucency instead of pure black.
The NotchShape.qml technique (Shape, ShapePath and PathArc with CurveRenderer) for concave corners where a panel meets the screen edge. It is reusable for a top bar that 'drips' from the edge.
Edge-agnostic layout: the pill docks at any edge and always grows toward the centre. Side edges get vertical stacked text, and dragging snaps it to the nearest edge.

Modular Hyprland 0.55 Lua config: hyprland.lua requires lua/* modules, then `pcall(require, 'custom.*')` loads a user layer that survives updates. On NixOS, generate the lua modules via home.file or xdg.configFile.

The keybinding helper B(id, default, action) reading a generated override table, plus a GUI shortcut editor. Add a 'capture' submap with an escape bind so combos can be recorded without triggering existing actions.

Animation set: the 'liquid' bezier (0.16,1,0.3,1) for windowsOut, layers, fade and border; 'myBezier' (0.05,0.9,0.1,1.05) with 'popin 80%'; workspaces slide on easeOutQuint (0.23,1,0.32,1). Also QSG_RENDER_LOOP=threaded for Quickshell on high-refresh or NVIDIA systems, and a global reduceMotion switch.
Built-in trackpad gestures via hl.gesture: 3 fingers horizontal switches workspace, 3 down closes, 3 up goes fullscreen, 4 horizontal moves, 4 down floats.
Window rules that remove borders and rounding on single-window workspaces (w[tv1], f[1]) for a clean monocle look.

A single palette source fanned out to every app, including HSV-derived syntax tints (s*0.55/v*0.85 etc.). On a dual Arch/NixOS rice, implement it with Stylix base16 on NixOS and a matugen/wallust template set on Arch, both fed from the same hex list.

A theme table shared between the shell and a separate lock-screen process (Themes.js) to prevent colour drift. The Quickshell ext-session-lock plus PAM lock screen moves from a sharp wallpaper to a blurred one with a sliding input capsule on input.

A pre-blurred SDDM background via ffmpeg (scale=1280, gblur sigma 28) written to a world-readable dir. A GRUB theme with 9-slice capsule highlight PNGs and generated pf2 fonts. An os-prober-driven 'reboot into Windows' launcher entry using one-shot grub-reboot or BootNext.

Smart clipboard that detects HEX colours with a swatch preview and RGB/HSL copy. Also a freeze-frame region screenshot, UI sound effects, hover-to-open with contextual media or quick settings, and Nothing-style desktop widgets (a dot clock, ring meters, a day-progress dot bar), which look great if restyled in pastel.
Terminal opacity through a live compositor window rule rather than foot alpha. foot server and footclient for instant windows. foot pad=22x18 center with a 1 px beam cursor for an airy terminal.
NVIDIA detection via /proc/modules to toggle cursor:no_hardware_cursors. On NixOS, set this declaratively per host instead.
A hyprpaper config writer that detects the version and emits the 0.8+ `wallpaper { monitor = ; path; fit_mode = cover }` block, with mpvpaper for optional live wallpapers.
Per-component 'custom' override files (foot custom.ini, fish custom.fish, hypr/custom, niri custom.kdl, settings.json merged with defaults via jq) so updates never clobber user tweaks.

one_line: A very actively maintained, NixOS-only flake that uses Hyprland's new Lua config with a hand-written Catppuccin (mostly Mocha/Mauve) theme. You pick the bar with one variable: waybar (minimal or stylish), noctalia or wayle. The rofi scripting (launcher, wallpaper picker, clipboard) is strong, but the colours are hard-coded in each file with no generator, and there are several stale hyprctl calls.
freshness: Very fresh. The master branch Atom feed shows commits on 2026-09-23 (4 that day), 09-21, 09-13, 09-09, 09-04, 08-29 and 08-27. flake.lock inputs were updated up to about 2026-09-08 (noctalia-shell lastModified 1788886125; Hyprland pinned to rev 7ebf13abb3c391604c60c9f627c7a403bcec8d17, lastModified 1788777480, about 2026-09-07). Inputs are nixos-unstable plus nixos-25.11 as stable, and Home Manager stateVersion is "26.05". The Hyprland config has already moved to Lua. The official wiki confirms: "Since Hyprland 0.55, hyprlang is deprecated in favor of lua." The GitHub page shows about 604 stars. I made one GitHub API call (the tree); commit dates came from the Atom feed, not the API.

aesthetic.palette:
Mostly Catppuccin Mocha with a Mauve accent, written out by hand in each file. Waybar, swaync and wayle all define: base #1e1e2e, mantle #181825, crust #11111b, text #cdd6f4, subtext1 #bac2de, subtext0 #a6adc8, surface0 #313244, surface1 #45475a, surface2 #585b70, overlay0 #6c7086, overlay1 #7f849c, overlay2 #9399b2, blue #89b4fa, lavender #b4befe, sapphire #74c7ec, sky #89dceb, teal #94e2d5, green #a6e3a1, yellow #f9e2af, peach #fab387, maroon #eba0ac, red #f38ba8, mauve #cba6f7, pink #f5c2e7, flamingo #f2cdcd, rosewater #f5e0dc. swaync has a typo'd base #1E1D2E.

Other flavours and palettes are mixed in:
- Hyprland active border: 45° gradient rgba(ca9ee6ff) to rgba(f2d5cfff), which are Frappé mauve and rosewater. Inactive: rgba(b4befecc) to rgba(6c7086cc).
- hyprlock uses Macchiato: rgb(36,39,58)=#24273a, rgb(198,160,246)=#c6a0f6, fail colour rgb(237,135,150)=#ed8796.
- noctalia uses the community palette "Catppuccin Macchiato Mauve" and session icon #ED8796. README badges are Macchiato (#F5BDE6, #C6A0F6, #91D7E3, #F5A97F).
- rofi uses adi1090x's old Catppuccin v0 file: #1E1D2FFF, #282839FF, #D9E0EEFF, active #ABE9B3FF, urgent #F28FADFF. The selection colour is Tokyo Night blue #7AA2F7FF. The drun theme uses rgba(30,29,47,80%) and rgba(122,162,247,80%).
- Starship uses Snazzy-style colours: directory #57C7FF, prompt ❯ #FF6AC1, error #FF5C57.
- Waybar calendar: months #ffead3, weekdays #ffcc66, today #ff6699.
- kitty tabs: active #1e1e2e on #cba6f7, inactive #bac2de on #313244.
- wlogout: background rgba(30,30,46,0.5), focus #cba6f7 with text #1e1e2e.
- cava gradient: #94e2d5, #89dceb, #74c7ec, #89b4fa, #cba6f7, #f5c2e7, #eba0ac, #f38ba8.
aesthetic.color_pipeline:
Static only. There is no matugen, wallust, pywal or stylix, and the catppuccin/nix flake is not used either. Every module has its own hard-coded @define-color block, hex values or rgba() values.
- GTK: pkgs.catppuccin-gtk.override { variant = "mocha"; accents = ["mauve"]; size = "compact"; }. The gtk-4.0 gtk.css, gtk-dark.css and assets are force-symlinked from the theme package.
- Qt: catppuccin-kvantum.override, with kvantum.kvconfig generated through pkgs.formats.ini.
- Some partial spread through GTK: waybar minimal uses @theme_base_color, and swaync uses @theme_bg_color and @theme_selected_bg_color, so they follow the GTK theme.
- noctalia: theme.source = "community", builtin/community templates disabled.
- wayle: theme-provider "wayle" with a hard-coded palette.
- Per-app themes: spicetify-nix catppuccin mocha; vesktop @import of catppuccin-mocha-mauve.theme.css (remote URL); zen userChrome hand-written as "Catppuccin Mocha Mauve"; thunderbird uses the catppuccin/thunderbird input.
- Changing the wallpaper does not change any colours.
aesthetic.fonts:
fonts.nix installs maple-mono.NF, nerd-fonts.jetbrains-mono, noto-fonts and noto-fonts-color-emoji.
fontconfig defaults: monospace = [JetBrainsMono Nerd Font, Maple Mono NF, Noto Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono]; sansSerif = Noto Sans; serif = Noto Serif; emoji = Noto Color Emoji.
Per app:
- kitty: "monospace" 12 (resolves to JetBrainsMono NF)
- waybar minimal: "monospace" 15px
- waybar stylish: "0xProto Nerd Font" bold 16px, with powerline glyphs at 23.1px. This font is NOT installed by fonts.nix.
- swaync: "JetBrainsMono NFM SemiBold"
- rofi: "JetBrains Mono Nerd Font 10"
- wlogout: monospace 14pt
- hyprlock: default font; $TIME at 64, greeting at 20, layout label at 14.
aesthetic.icons_cursor_gtk_qt:
- Icons: Papirus-Dark (papirus-icon-theme).
- Cursor: Bibata-Modern-Classic, size 24. Set through HM home.pointerCursor (gtk + x11), the Hyprland env XCURSOR_THEME/XCURSOR_SIZE, and SDDM settings.Theme.CursorTheme. HYPRCURSOR is not set.
- GTK: catppuccin-mocha-mauve-compact, gtk-application-prefer-dark-theme=1 for gtk3/gtk4, dconf color-scheme prefer-dark, ADW_COLOR_SCHEME=prefer-dark.
- Qt: qt.platformTheme.name="gtk3" with style kvantum (catppuccin-mocha-mauve). But the Hyprland Lua config sets QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME=qt6ct, which conflicts with this.
- Custom PNG/SVG icons are shipped for wlogout (normal and hover versions), swaync music.png, and a volume OSD set (vol-0 to vol-100 SVGs).
aesthetic.geometry:
Hyprland (settings.lua):
- gaps_in 4, gaps_out 9, border_size 2 with a 45° gradient, rounding 10
- shadow disabled; dim_special 0.3
- blur enabled, size 6, passes 2 (comments suggest 6/3), new_optimizations, ignore_opacity=true, special=true, xray=false
- layout dwindle with preserve_split; resize_on_border
- Opacity rules (active inactive): browsers 1.00 1.00; Discord/Vesktop, Emacs, obsidian, heroic, lutris 0.90 0.80; terminals, file managers, Steam, Spotify, VSCode, pavucontrol, settings apps 0.80 0.70
- Layer blur: rofi ignore_alpha 0.7, swaync-control-center 0.7, swaync-notification-window 0.8

Waybar minimal: floating, height 36, margin top/left/right 10, three "island" module groups with border-radius 11px. Left and right islands have a 1px @blue border, the centre one a 1px @overlay0 border. Workspace buttons: radius 10–11px, padding 5px, 9px when active.
Waybar stylish: full width, no margins, box margin 4px, powerline segments, workspace buttons radius 16px, tooltip border 2px radius 10px.
swaync: everything radius 8px; control centre 400x940 at the top right with 10px margins, 80% alpha background; notification width 375, icon 64px.
rofi drun (type-2/style-2): width 700px, window radius 15px, inputbar and elements radius 12px, padding 20, 2 columns x 9 lines (override), icons 32px, 80% alpha.
rofi wallpaper picker: 60% width, 6 columns x 1 line, 160px icons, radius 12.
hyprlock: blur_size 3, blur_passes 2, noise 0.0117, contrast 1.0, brightness 1.0, vibrancy 0.21; input 250x50, outline 3, dots 0.2/0.64.
noctalia bar: thickness 38, radius 12, margin_edge 10, padding 14, widget_spacing 6, border outline 0.5, no shadow.
wayle: rounding "sm", bar not rounded, button-variant block-prefix.
aesthetic.animations:
Curves (animations.lua):
- md3_decel = bezier (0.05,0.7),(0.1,1)
- easeOutExpo = (0.16,1),(0.3,1)
- fluent_decel = (0.1,1),(0,1) (only used in commented-out lines)

Animations:
- windows: speed 3, md3_decel, style "popin 60%"
- border: speed 10, default
- fade: speed 2.5, md3_decel
- workspaces: speed 3.5, easeOutExpo, "slide" (alternatives kept commented: md3_decel slide; fluent_decel 7 slidefade 15%)
- specialWorkspace: speed 3, md3_decel, "slidefade"

Other motion:
- Waybar minimal workspace pills: transition all 0.3–0.5s cubic-bezier(.55,-0.68,.48,1.682), an overshoot/elastic curve; padding grows from 5px to 9px when active. They also reference animation gradient_f, but no @keyframes gradient_f exists.
- Waybar critical-battery blink: 0.5s alternate.
- awww wallpaper picker: --transition-type wipe --transition-step 90 --transition-duration 1 --transition-fps 60.
- swaync transition-time 200; hyprlock fail_transition 300.
- A three-finger horizontal gesture switches workspaces.
- The gamemode script turns all animations, blur, gaps and rounding off.
aesthetic.wallpapers: 18 files in modules/themes/wallpapers: bamboo, basement.jpg, cyberpunk, dark-forest, escape_velocity, evening-sky (the default), galaxy, hollow-knight, kurzgesagt-galaxies (hyprlock background), kurzgesagt, moon, north-dark, puffy-stars, python-dev, quasar (noctalia lockscreen), storm.jpg, train-sideview, train. Most are .webp. They are selected by filename in variables.nix and set with awww. There is no attribution or licence file. Several are clearly copyrighted franchise or studio art (Hollow Knight, Kurzgesagt) sitting in an MIT-licensed repo.
aesthetic.vibe:
A tidy, conventional dark pastel Catppuccin rice. Soft mauve-to-rosewater gradient borders, pink cava bars, frosted 70–80% translucent terminals and file managers, rounded floating waybar islands and a bouncy workspace pill all give it a gentle, polished look. It reads as clean and cosy-techy rather than cute or kawaii. Fonts are monospace everywhere, there are no decorative or rounded UI fonts, no custom illustrations and no bespoke widgets beyond what noctalia provides.

Cohesion is weaker than it first looks. Frappé borders, a Macchiato lockscreen and noctalia, Mocha GTK/bar/terminal, an old-Catppuccin rofi with a Tokyo Night blue highlight, and Snazzy starship colours mean the accent drifts between components.

Its real strength is breadth and daily-driver UX (scripts, keybinds, choice of three shells) rather than art direction. I would call it 7/10 on polish and 5/10 on cuteness. I did not view the preview PNG screenshots, so this judgement comes from the config values.

components.compositor:
Hyprland from the hyprwm/Hyprland flake input (git, pinned rev 7ebf13ab), with the matching xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland plus the gtk portal (OpenURI/FileChooser/Print go to gtk).
- Config is Lua, deployed raw through xdg.configFile: hyprland.lua requires monitors, variables, settings, animations, binds and rules. variables.lua is generated by Nix with the script store paths.
- It does not use the HM wayland.windowManager.hyprland module. withUWSM is commented out.
- Polkit: hyprpolkitagent as a systemd user service.
- Extra tools: hyprshutdown, hyprsunset, hyprpicker, hypridle, hyprlock.
- Alternative desktops in the repo: i3 (polybar, picom, dunst), GNOME, Plasma 6 (plasma-manager).
components.bar_or_shell:
Chosen with the variable bar = "waybar" | "noctalia" | "wayle". The Default host uses waybar, the author's Singularity host uses noctalia.
- waybarTheme "minimal": three floating islands. Modules: workspaces and cava on the left; idle_inhibitor and clock in the centre; gpuinfo, cpu, memory, backlight, pulseaudio, network, bluetooth, tray and battery on the right.
- waybarTheme "stylish": full-width powerline built from custom/left_div and right_div glyph modules. Includes drawer groups (user/tray, pulseaudio in/out), hyprland/windowcount, a NixOS logo with the tooltip "I use NixOS, btw.", a rebuild button, and swaync and wlogout buttons.
- noctalia-shell (noctalia-dev flake, HM module): bar with control-center, workspaces, audio_visualizer, media | caffeine, clock | weather, tray, network, bluetooth, volume, brightness, notifications, battery, session. Also a control centre, the yuuto/calculator plugin, and its own lockscreen, idle handling and notifications.
- wayle (services.wayle): dashboard, hyprland-workspaces, cava | window-title | volume, network, systray, idle-inhibit, clock, notifications.
components.launcher:
rofi through HM programs.rofi, with plugins rofi-emoji and rofi-games. It vendors the adi1090x launcher themes (type-1 to type-7, about 60 styles) and 16 colour files, and the Catppuccin colour file is imported everywhere.
A single `launcher` script dispatches the modes, and pressing the key again while rofi is open closes it:
- drun: type-2/style-2
- window, tmux, emoji: type-4/style-4
- file: type-2/style-2
- games: type-1/style-5
- wallpaper: wallpaper-select.rasi grid
The clipboard manager uses type-1/style-6. The online-music picker is rofimusic.
components.notifications: swaync, imported only when bar == "waybar". It sits at the top right with timeouts 6/3/0 (normal/low/critical). Widgets: title, dnd, menubar#desktop (Screenshot and Power Menu dropdowns), volume with per-app sliders, mpris with 96px art, notifications, and a buttons-grid of toggles: mute, mic, bluetooth, wifi, gamemode 🎮, hyprsunset night light 3500K, caffeine ☕ (hypridle), power-save. noctalia and wayle use their own built-in notifications (wayle: popups 3500ms, top right, max 5). The dunst module is only used by i3.
components.lock_idle_logout:
- hyprlock: blurred kurzgesagt-galaxies wallpaper, $TIME at 64pt, "Hello $USER!" greeting, "Current Layout : $LAYOUT" label, Macchiato mauve input field.
- hypridle: one listener that locks the session after 600s. before_sleep runs loginctl lock-session; after_sleep runs `hyprctl dispatch dpms on`.
- wlogout: 4 buttons (Exit through hyprshutdown, Shutdown, Suspend, Reboot), launched with -b 4, custom PNG icons with hover variants.
- With noctalia, all three are mkForce-disabled and noctalia takes over: lock at 600s, screen-off at 660s (only when batterySupport), lock-and-suspend at 900s. Its lockscreen shows a login_box and fancy_audio_visualizer widgets.
- A swaylock module exists but is not used.
components.wallpaper_tool: awww (the successor name of swww), enabled through HM services.awww. A `wallpaper` script starts awww-daemon if needed, runs `awww restore`, and falls back to defaultWallpaper. Super+Shift+W opens a rofi picker whose thumbnails are built at Nix build time with ImageMagick at 320x180, then applies the choice with an awww wipe transition. noctalia's wallpaper module is configured but disabled.
components.terminal: kitty is the default (alacritty and wezterm are options). Settings: themeFile Catppuccin-Mocha, font monospace 12, powerline tab bar with round style, tab title = index, copy_on_select, scrollback 10000, no bell. The cursor_trail settings are present but commented out. Ctrl+T opens a tmux-sessionizer overlay.
components.shell_prompt: zsh by default (bash is an option) with starship. The format is minimal: username, hostname, directory, git branch/state/status, command duration, python, nix_shell and the prompt character. Language symbols are plain text ("rs ", "go ", ...), and nix_shell shows ❄️. Colours: directory #57C7FF, success ❯ #FF6AC1, error #FF5C57.
components.editor: nixvim by default, from the author's external Sly-Harvey/nixvim flake. Alternatives: neovim (Sly-Harvey/nvim), nvchad (nix4nvchad), doom-emacs (nix-doom-emacs-unstraightened plus Sly-Harvey/doom), helix, zed, vscode. The Hyprland SUPER+C bind is hard-coded to "zeditor".
components.file_manager: thunar on the Default host and yazi on the author's host (with a custom recycle-bin.lua plugin). lf is also available. A file-manager wrapper script launches TUI file managers inside the terminal.
components.fetch:
- fastfetch module (commented out by default): boxed layout with ┌─┐ frames, Nerd Font keys, a random PNG logo from ~/.config/fastfetch/icons, and an "OS Age" line computed with `stat -c %W /`.
- microfetch opens on Ctrl+Alt+M in a floating, centred 802x261 kitty window.
- pkgs/pokego is packaged.
components.login_boot:
- SDDM: kdePackages.sddm with wayland.enable and HiDPI, using `pkgs.sddm-astronaut.override { embeddedTheme = sddmTheme; themeConfig = ...; }`. Variants: astronaut, black_hole, purple_leaves, jake_the_dog, hyprland_kath. Bibata cursor.
- GRUB with EFI and os-prober, timeout = null (waits forever), gfxmode 2715x1527, theme AdisonCavani/distro-grub-themes v3.1 'customize/nixos'.
- pkgs/sddm-themes also packages sugar-dark and tokyo-night.
- No Plymouth configuration found.
- Kernel: linuxPackages_latest with preempt=full.
components.extras:
- cava with an 8-stop Mocha gradient; cava module in waybar.
- spicetify-nix (catppuccin mocha; extensions adblock, shuffle, keyboardShortcut, copyLyrics).
- vesktop/Vencord with a long plugin list and a remote catppuccin-mocha-mauve CSS import.
- zen-browser beta: Catppuccin Mocha Mauve userChrome and userContent, Zen mods (Better Active Tabs, Better Unloaded Tabs, No Top Sites, Floating History), Betterfox Fastfox/Peskyfox/Securefox/Smoothfox, locked prefs.
- Firefox and Floorp alternatives; thunderbird catppuccin; btop; lazygit; tmux; direnv; mpv; OBS; youtube-music.
- Scripts: screenshot (grimblast to swappy, then notify-send with the thumbnail), screen-record, cliphist+rofi clipboard with image previews, gamemode, hyprsunset night mode (Super+F9/F10), zoom (Super+Ctrl+scroll), autoclicker, gpuinfo, batterynotify, keyboardswitch (layouts gb,ru), a yad keybind cheat sheet (Super+/), and rebuild (Super+U).
- 40+ dev-shell flake templates.

standout_features: It already uses the new Hyprland Lua config (hl.config, hl.bind, hl.window_rule, hl.layer_rule, hl.curve, hl.animation, hl.gesture, hl.on("hyprland.start")) split across files with require(). The official wiki says hyprlang has been deprecated since 0.55, so this is a current reference for the new syntax. The workspace binds are generated with a Lua `for i = 1, 10` loop.

Nix writes the script paths and user variables into ~/.config/hypr/variables.lua (autoclicker, clipmanager, launcher, mainMod, term, kbdLayout, ...). The Lua files stay generic and only this generated file changes per system.

A single `bar` variable switches between waybar (two themes), noctalia and wayle. When noctalia provides its own lock, idle and session menu, the module mkForce-disables hyprlock, hypridle and wlogout, and swaync is only imported for waybar.

Rofi wallpaper picker with thumbnails built at Nix build time: a pkgs.runCommand + imagemagick derivation makes 320x180 JPG thumbnails, shown in a 6-column grid of 160px icons. The choice is applied with `awww img ... --transition-type wipe --transition-fps 60`.

Game windows are tagged automatically: content type 3, steam_app.*, gamescope, Waydroid, osu! and RetroArch get tag +games, and that tag sets content=game, fullscreen, sync_fullscreen, border_size 0 and no shadow, blur or animations.

The swaync quick-settings grid has toggles that reflect real state: gamemode (effects off), hyprsunset night light at 3500K, a caffeine toggle that stops/starts the hypridle service, a power-save mode, and wifi/bluetooth/mute. The menubar has Screenshot and Power dropdowns.

Window opacity is tiered by app class: browsers and video fully opaque, chat apps 0.9/0.8, terminals, file managers and tools 0.8/0.7. Combined with blur ignore_opacity and layer blur for rofi and swaync, this gives a consistent frosted look.

Waybar 'minimal': three floating islands with 1px blue or overlay borders, 11px radius, 10px margins, cava in pink, and elastic cubic-bezier(.55,-0.68,.48,1.682) workspace pills. Waybar 'stylish': a powerline bar where each segment gets a colour role (@workspaces, @cpu, @time, ...) aliased onto Mocha crust, mantle, base and surface0.

noctalia setup: a `forDisplays` Nix helper copies the lockscreen widgets (login_box, fancy_audio_visualizer bars_rings with bloom 0.5) to DP/eDP/HDMI-A/DVI-D/DVI-I/VGA outputs 1–4. Clicking the bar's dead zone opens the yuuto/calculator plugin.
Clipboard manager: cliphist piped through rofi, with gawk decoding image entries into temporary preview icons. Ctrl+Delete removes one entry and Alt+Delete wipes the history.

Interactive install.sh: pick or create a host from a template, the script patches flake.nix with awk, sets username and GPU driver with sed, copies or generates hardware-configuration, then runs nixos-rebuild boot. A separate live-install.sh covers the ISO. The rebuild script is bound to Super+U.

Ergonomic extras: mouse side buttons jump to or move windows to workspaces 5/6/7, Super+Ctrl+scroll zooms, and Ctrl+Escape toggles the bar for any shell. There are also 40+ `nix flake init -t` dev-shell templates.
structure_install:
Layout:
- flake.nix: nixosConfigurations Default and Singularity built with a mkHost helper; templates = ./dev-shells; formatter nixfmt-tree.
- hosts/<Host>/: configuration.nix (the list of module imports, chosen through variables), hardware-configuration.nix, host-packages.nix, and variables.nix (plain attrset: username, desktop, bar, waybarTheme, sddmTheme, defaultWallpaper, hyprlockWallpaper, terminal, editor, browser, fileManager, shell, games, videoDriver, nvidiaChannel, bluetooth/battery support, locale, kbdLayout, clock24h, capslockAsESC).
- modules/core: boot, fonts, sddm, starship, zsh, users (HM integration), etc.
- modules/desktop/{hyprland,i3,gnome,plasma6}. The hyprland folder contains lua/*.lua, programs/{waybar,noctalia,wayle,swaync,rofi,hyprlock,hypridle,wlogout,...}, scripts/*.nix (writeShellScriptBin), icons, and variables.nix.
- modules/programs/{browser,cli,editor,file-manager,media,misc,terminal}; modules/themes/{catppuccin,dracula,rose-pine,wallpapers}; modules/hardware/video/{nvidia,amdgpu,intel,nvk}; modules/scripts (launcher, rebuild, rollback, tmux-sessionizer, ...).
- overlays/, pkgs/ (pokego, sddm themes), dev-shells/ (40+ language templates).

Install: `git clone https://github.com/Sly-Harvey/NixOS ~/NixOS && cd ~/NixOS && ./install.sh`. The script exits on anything that is not NixOS, and on the live ISO it hands off to live-install.sh. After that, apply changes with `rebuild`, `nixos-rebuild switch --flake ~/NixOS#<HOST>` or `nh os switch`. Rollbacks use `list-gens` and `rollback N`.

All user-level config goes through Home Manager as a NixOS module (home-manager.sharedModules). Most dotfiles (waybar/swaync/wlogout CSS, hyprlock, kitty) exist only as Nix strings or attrsets. Only the Hyprland Lua files, rofi .rasi files, zen CSS, wezterm.lua and fastfetch config.jsonc are plain files that could be reused directly on Arch.
nix_patterns: One flake with a mkHost helper passing specialArgs {inputs, outputs, host, self, overlays}. Hosts live in hosts/<Name>/ and are selected by name.
Per-host plain `variables.nix` attrset read everywhere with `import ../../hosts/${host}/variables.nix`, not typed NixOS options. Easy to use but not type-checked or discoverable.
Modules are picked by interpolating paths: `../../modules/desktop/${vars.desktop}`, `./programs/${bar}`, `./${waybarTheme}.nix`, `programs/terminal/${vars.terminal}`.

Home Manager runs as a NixOS module (useGlobalPkgs, useUserPackages, backupFileExtension "backup", overwriteBackup). All user config goes through `home-manager.sharedModules`, so it applies to every HM user.
Hyprland Lua files are deployed raw with xdg.configFile. variables.lua is generated with `${getExe script}` store paths, a clean way to connect Nix packages to a non-Nix config language.
Scripts are packaged with `pkgs.writeShellScriptBin` + `callPackage` and absolute `${pkgs.x}/bin` paths, so they are reproducible but not portable to Arch without rewriting.
Build-time asset generation: `pkgs.runCommand` + imagemagick creates the wallpaper thumbnails.

Theming is manual through package overrides: catppuccin-gtk.override, catppuccin-kvantum.override, sddm-astronaut.override { embeddedTheme; themeConfig; }, and a GRUB theme built with stdenv.mkDerivation over fetchFromGitHub. It does not use stylix or catppuccin/nix.

Uses external flake HM modules: noctalia.homeModules.default, zen-browser.homeModules.beta, spicetify-nix.homeManagerModules.default, plasma-manager, nixvim, nix4nvchad, nix-doom-emacs-unstraightened, nix-index-database, nix-flatpak. Non-flake inputs (betterfox, doom config, nvim, thunderbird-catppuccin) use flake = false.
No disko, sops/agenix, impermanence or stylix. Users are mutable with initialPassword. nh module present.
Odd: `system = forAllSystems (system: system);` passes an attrset to nixosSystem's `system` argument. It probably only works because hardware-configuration.nix sets nixpkgs.hostPlatform.
dev-shells/default.nix exposes templates (`nix flake init -t ~/NixOS#python`) with .envrc files for direnv.

key_snippets.purpose: Core Hyprland geometry in the new 0.55+ Lua syntax: gaps, pastel gradient borders, rounding, blur
The full animation set: Material-3 decel popin windows and easeOutExpo workspace slides
key_snippets.excerpt:
-- Curves
hl.curve("md3_decel", { type = "bezier", points = { {0.05, 0.7}, {0.1, 1} } })
hl.curve("easeOutExpo", { type = "bezier", points = { {0.16, 1}, {0.3, 1} } })
hl.curve("fluent_decel", { type = "bezier", points = { {0.1, 1}, {0, 1} } })

-- Animations
hl.animation({ leaf = "windows", enabled = true, speed = 3, bezier = "md3_decel", style = "popin 60%" })
hl.animation({ leaf = "border", enabled = true, speed = 10, bezier = "default" })
hl.animation({ leaf = "fade", enabled = true, speed = 2.5, bezier = "md3_decel" })
-- hl.animation({ leaf = "workspaces", enabled = true, speed = 3.5, bezier = "md3_decel", style = "slide" })
hl.animation({ leaf = "workspaces", enabled = true, speed = 3.5, bezier = "easeOutExpo", style = "slide" })
-- hl.animation({ leaf = "workspaces", enabled = true, speed = 7, bezier = "fluent_decel", style = "slidefade 15%" })
-- hl.animation({ leaf = "specialWorkspace", enabled = true, speed = 3, bezier = "md3_decel", style = "slidefadevert 15%" })
hl.animation({ leaf = "specialWorkspace", enabled = true, speed = 3, bezier = "md3_decel", style = "slidefade" })

key_snippets.purpose: Wallpaper thumbnails built at Nix build time for the rofi icon-grid picker (applied later with an awww wipe)
key_snippets.excerpt:
wallpaperDir = "${../themes/wallpapers}";
  wallpaperThumbs =
    pkgs.runCommand "wallpaper-thumbnails"
      {
        buildInputs = [ pkgs.imagemagick ];
      }
      ''
        mkdir -p $out
        for wallpaper in "${wallpaperDir}"/*.{webp,jxl,jpg,jpeg,png,gif}; do
          if [ -f "$wallpaper" ]; then
            wallpaper_name=$(basename "$wallpaper")
            wallpaper_name="''${wallpaper_name%.*}"
            thumbnail_size="320x180"
            if [ ! -f "$out/''${wallpaper_name}.jpg" ]; then
              magick "$wallpaper[0]" -strip -gravity center -thumbnail "''${thumbnail_size}^" -extent "$thumbnail_size" "$out/''${wallpaper_name}.jpg"
            fi
          fi
        done
      '';

key_snippets.purpose: Tag-based game handling: tag once, then apply one rule set to every game
swaync button-grid toggles that report real state (night light and caffeine)

WEAKNESS: old hyprlang-era hyprctl calls left behind after the Lua migration (drop_shadow was removed long ago; the 0.55+ wiki lists `hyprctl eval`, Lua-expression dispatch and dot-form getoption, and no `keyword` command)
key_snippets.excerpt:
HYPRGAMEMODE=$(hyprctl getoption animations:enabled | ${pkgs.gnused}/bin/sed -n '1p' | ${pkgs.gawk}/bin/awk '{print $2}')

  if [ "$HYPRGAMEMODE" = 1 ]; then
    hyprctl -q --batch "\
          keyword animations:enabled 0;\
          keyword decoration:shadow:enabled 0;\
          keyword decoration:drop_shadow 0;\
          keyword decoration:blur:enabled 0;\
          keyword decoration:blur:xray 1;\
          keyword general:gaps_in 0;\
          keyword general:gaps_out 0;\
          keyword general:border_size 1;\
          keyword decoration:rounding 0;\
          keyword decoration:active_opacity 1 ;\
          keyword decoration:inactive_opacity 1 ;\
          keyword decoration:fullscreen_opacity 1 ;\
          keyword layerrule noanim,waybar ;\
          keyword layerrule noanim,swaync-notification-window ;\
          keyword layerrule noanim,awww-daemon ;\
          keyword layerrule noanim,rofi"
    hyprctl 'keyword windowrule opaque,class:(.*)'
    exit
  else
    hyprctl reload config-only -q
  fi

weaknesses: NixOS only: install.sh stops on anything else. Almost every dotfile (waybar and swaync CSS and JSON, wlogout, hyprlock, hypridle, kitty, starship) is a Nix string or attrset, and the scripts hard-code `${pkgs.x}/bin` store paths. Using any of it on Arch means extracting it into plain files or templates.

Stale hyprctl calls after the Lua migration. The Hyprland 0.55+ wiki documents `hyprctl eval`, Lua-expression `hyprctl dispatch 'hl.dsp...'` and dot-form `getoption section.option`, and lists no `keyword` command. The repo still has: gamemode.nix (`keyword ...`, the removed `decoration:drop_shadow`, old `layerrule noanim,waybar` and `windowrule opaque,class:(.*)` syntax, `getoption animations:enabled`); binds.lua exec'ing `hyprctl dispatch bringactivetotop` and `hyprctl dispatch layoutmsg move +col`; hypridle `hyprctl dispatch dpms on`; swaync `hyprctl dispatch exit 0` and `getoption animations:enabled`. This is from the documentation only; I did not run anything.
SUPER+Tab is bound twice, to hl.dsp.window.cycle_next() and to exec `hyprctl dispatch bringactivetotop`.

The author's hardware is hard-coded in shared config: monitors.lua pins workspaces 1–10 to three specific BenQ monitors by desc, and the Default host inherits this. noctalia desktop widgets hard-code output DP-1 at 1920x1080 coordinates, and lockscreen widget placement assumes 1920x1080. GRUB gfxmode is "2715x1527".

Stale or hard-coded paths: keybinds-yad reads "$HOME/ZyNixOS/flake.nix" (the wrong repo name) and parses a `settings = {` block that no longer exists, so the fields come out blank. Its list is also out of date: it says SUPER M mutes the mic, but SUPER M actually runs rofimusic, and it mentions hyprpanel. Hyprland `editor = "zeditor"` ignores the editor variable. The rebuild script assumes ~/NixOS or /etc/nixos.

Colour flavours are mixed and there is no single source of truth: Frappé border gradient, Macchiato hyprlock and noctalia, Mocha GTK/waybar/kitty/swaync, old Catppuccin v0 in rofi with a Tokyo Night #7AA2F7 highlight, and Snazzy colours in starship. The palette is copied into about 8 files and nothing is generated from the wallpaper.
Missing font: waybar 'stylish' asks for "0xProto Nerd Font", which fonts.nix does not install, so it silently falls back.

Licensing: copyrighted wallpapers (hollow-knight.webp, kurzgesagt.webp, kurzgesagt-galaxies.webp, others of unknown source) are bundled with no attribution in an MIT repo. The adi1090x rofi themes are GPL-3.0 (upstream LICENSE checked) but are vendored into this MIT-licensed repo. The Discord theme depends on a remote @import URL.

Weak default security: initialPassword "123", the user is added by default to docker, libvirtd, kvm, disk, vboxusers and adbusers, NIXPKGS_ALLOW_UNFREE=1 is exported in the Hyprland session, and an autoclicker is bound to Super+F8.

Daemons are started more than once. hypridle and swaync are enabled as HM services and also exec'd in hyprland.start, and swaync is exec'd even when bar is noctalia or wayle (where it is not imported). The caffeine toggle manages hypridle.service, so it may miss an exec'd instance (likely; not tested). `rm '$XDG_CACHE_HOME/cliphist/db'` uses single quotes, so the variable is never expanded, and it runs after the cliphist watchers have started. Exec'ing `polkit-agent-helper-1` is pointless because hyprpolkitagent already runs as a systemd service.

Leftovers: hyprpanel layer rules for a shell that is no longer used, a committed wlogout/default.nix.bak, unused swaylock and hyprland/dunst modules, waybar CSS pointing at `animation: gradient_f` with no matching @keyframes, and the wayle comment "Acid-HUD Palette" above Catppuccin values.
Qt theming conflict: HM sets qt.platformTheme "gtk3" plus Kvantum, but the Hyprland env forces QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME=qt6ct.

The flake passes `system = forAllSystems (system: system);`, an attrset, to nixosSystem. Variables are untyped imported attrsets instead of NixOS options, and installers edit them with sed/awk, which is fragile.
steal_list: Write the Hyprland config as split Lua files (hyprland.lua requiring monitors, variables, settings, animations, binds, rules). Keep one generated `variables.lua` per system: Nix writes it on NixOS, and chezmoi or an install script renders it on Arch. The other Lua files stay identical on both distros.

Use this animation set as the default: bezier md3_decel (0.05,0.7,0.1,1) for windows popin 60% at speed 3 and fade 2.5; easeOutExpo (0.16,1,0.3,1) for workspace slide at 3.5; specialWorkspace slidefade at 3.

Pastel geometry baseline: 45° active border gradient mauve to rosewater (from ONE Catppuccin flavour), inactive lavender to overlay0 at 80% alpha, border 2, rounding 10, gaps 4/9, blur size 6 passes 2 with ignore_opacity and special blur, dim_special 0.3.

Opacity tiers by app class (media/browsers 1.0; chat 0.9/0.8; terminals, file managers and settings 0.8/0.7) plus layer_rule blur with ignore_alpha 0.7 for rofi and the notification center, for a consistent frosted-glass look.

Game auto-tagging (content type 3, steam_app.*, gamescope, RetroArch, osu!, Waydroid → +games) with one rule for the tag: content=game, fullscreen, no blur, animations or border. Rewrite the gamemode toggle with `hyprctl eval` and Lua instead of `keyword`.
One `launcher` dispatcher script (drun, window, file, tmux, wallpaper, emoji, games) that closes rofi if it is already open, so each mode can be themed separately.

Wallpaper picker: pre-generated 320x180 thumbnails (a Nix derivation on NixOS, a cached ~/.cache step on Arch) in a rofi grid of 6 columns x 160px icons, applied with an awww wipe at 60fps. Also run matugen on the chosen wallpaper, which this repo does not do.
cliphist + rofi clipboard with image thumbnails decoded by gawk; Ctrl+Delete removes one entry, Alt+Delete wipes all.

Quick-settings toggles that reflect real state (night light via hyprsunset at 3500K, caffeine via the hypridle service, game mode, power-save, wifi, bluetooth, mic) in the swaync button grid, or copy the same set into a Quickshell or noctalia control center.

Waybar 'minimal' floating islands (height 36, margins 10, 11px radius, 1px accent borders) with the elastic cubic-bezier(.55,-0.68,.48,1.682) workspace pill that widens from 5px to 9px padding. It feels bouncy and cute. Add the missing @keyframes if you want the animation.

Colour roles in the style of waybar 'stylish': @define-color accent/workspaces/cpu/time/date/... aliased onto palette slots, so templates generated by matugen or wallust only have to fill the palette.
A bar/shell selector variable that automatically turns off redundant lock, idle, logout and notification daemons when the shell provides them (the lib.mkForce false pattern).
noctalia's per-output widget replication helper (forDisplays over DP/eDP/HDMI-A/DVI/VGA 1–4) for any config format that needs a named output.
Screenshot flow: grimblast area/freeze/output to swappy with a generated save config, then notify-send using the screenshot itself as the icon.
hyprlock recipe: blurred wallpaper (size 3, passes 2), noise 0.0117, vibrancy 0.21, $TIME at 64pt, a "Hello $USER!" greeting, a keyboard layout label, and fail_text showing $ATTEMPTS.

Theme apps consistently: Catppuccin Kvantum and GTK compact, Papirus-Dark, Bibata-Modern-Classic 24 (set in the HM cursor, env and SDDM), spicetify, vesktop, a zen-browser userChrome with Zen mods, thunderbird, and a matching cava gradient. Pick one flavour and generate them all from one source.

SDDM astronaut through `pkgs.sddm-astronaut.override { embeddedTheme; themeConfig = { FormPosition = "center"; PartialBlur = "false"; }; }` (the same theme is available from git or AUR on Arch), plus the distro-grub-themes nixos GRUB theme.
Generate the keybind cheat sheet (Super+/) from binds.lua instead of keeping a hand-written list, which is how this repo's list went out of date.
fastfetch boxed layout with an 'OS Age' line from `stat -c %W /` and a random logo from a folder.

one_line: A NixOS-only, infrastructure-first flake (homelab, VPS, microVMs, impermanence, agenix-rekey) with a lean desktop on niri + noctalia-shell (Quickshell), not Hyprland. The desktop is dark, flat and functional rather than cute, but it has a few very reusable ideas: libadwaita recoloring from base16, notification-action screenshot/OCR/QR scripts, and hiding chat windows from screencasts.
freshness: Actively maintained. Latest commit is 2026-08-31 ("fix: fix paperless behind 2 proxies which broke last update"), with several commits between 2026-08-08 and 2026-08-18, plus earlier ones in Jun, May, Apr and Mar 2026. 274 stars. The flake tracks nixos-unstable and also pins nixpkgs-2511 (nixos-25.11). The desktop moved from i3/X11 (i3.nix, flameshot and startx are still imported) to niri (niri-unstable via sodiboo/niri-flake) + noctalia-shell (noctalia-dev/noctalia-shell flake input). Recent commits are mostly about services (omnivoice, AFFiNE, llama-cpp, home-assistant). One desktop commit: "fix: temporary niri fix and mullvad fix".

aesthetic.palette: Three separate palettes that are not linked to each other. (1) The HM `lib.colors` base16 in users/malte/graphical/theme.nix: base00 #101419, base01 #171b20, base02 #21262e, base03 #242931, base04 #485263, base05 #b6beca, base06 #dee1e6, base07 #e3e6eb, base08 #e05f65 (red), base09 #f9a872 (orange), base0A #f1cf8a (yellow), base0B #78dba9 (green), base0C #74bee9 (cyan), base0D #70a5eb (blue), base0E #c68aee (purple), base0F #9378de. The source file does not name this scheme and I could not identify it. (2) Kitty uses a 'Modified onehalfdark': fg #c9d3e5, bg #090a0c, cursor #cccccc, color0 #090a0c, color8 #393e48, color1 #b2555d, color9 #e06c75, color2 #81a566, color10 #98c379, color3 #ccab6e, color11 #e6c17c, color4 #5395cc, color12 #61afef, color5 #9378de, color13 #c678dd, color6/14 #56b6c2, color7 #979eab, color15 #abb2bf, selection fg #282c34 on bg #979eab. (3) noctalia-shell uses colorSchemes.predefinedScheme = "Ayu"; I did not check the Ayu hex values inside noctalia. niri colors are hardcoded: focus-ring active #7fc8ff, inactive #505050; border (disabled) active #ffc87f; shadow #00000070; insert-hint #ffc87f80; tab-indicator uses the named colors "red" and "gray". Neovim uses onedark (users/malte/neovim/onedark.nix).
aesthetic.color_pipeline: Static and hand-written, with no stylix, matugen, wallust or pywal in the files read. A custom HM option `lib.colors.hex` / `lib.colors.withHashtag` (theme.nix) holds the base16 set. It is used by (a) fuzzel.nix, which writes RGBA strings like "${base00}ff", and (b) a generated gtk.css with a full libadwaita `@define-color` override map (accent/destructive/success/warning/error, window/view/headerbar/sidebar/card/dialog/popover colors, blue_1..5, green_1..5, ... dark_1..5), written to both gtk-3.0/gtk.css and gtk-4.0/gtk.css. Kitty, niri and noctalia do not use it; each has its own colors.
aesthetic.fonts: UI: Segoe UI (GTK font size 10, fuzzel 'Segoe UI:size=20', noctalia ui.fontDefault), packaged from the third-party repo mrbvrz/segoe-ui-linux (pkgs/segoe-ui-ttf.nix). Mono: JetBrains Mono (kitty size 14, noctalia ui.fontFixed, fontconfig monospace default). Nerd glyphs come from pkgs.nerd-fonts.symbols-only through kitty symbol_map ('Symbols Nerd Font Mono') instead of patched fonts. Other fonts: noto-fonts, noto-fonts-cjk-sans/serif, noto-fonts-color-emoji, dejavu_fonts. Default serif is 'IBM Plex Serif' and default emoji is 'Segoe UI Emoji'. A fontconfig localConf gives emoji weak priority for monospace, sans-serif and serif. Xft hinting: hintfull, rgba rgb, lcddefault.
aesthetic.icons_cursor_gtk_qt: GTK theme adw-gtk3 (also used for gtk4) with prefer-dark, recolored by the base16 gtk.css. GTK_THEME=adw-gtk3 session variable. Icons: WhiteSur-dark (pkgs.whitesur-icon-theme). Cursor: Bibata-Modern-Ice size 20 via home.pointerCursor (x11 + gtk), but gtk3/4 extraConfig sets gtk-cursor-theme-size = 32, which conflicts. gtk-xft-dpi = 160 is marked 'XXX: delete for wayland?'. Qt: platformTheme 'adwaita', style 'Adwaita-Dark'.
aesthetic.geometry: niri layout: gaps = 1, center-focused-column 'never', empty-workspace-above-first = true. Preset column widths and window heights are 0.33333 / 0.5 / 0.66667, default column width 0.5. focus-ring enabled, width 2. border disabled (width 2). shadow: softness 30, spread 5, offset x 0 / y 5, draw-behind-window true, color #00000070. tab-indicator: width 4, gap 5, corner-radius 8, position right, gaps-between-tabs 2, place-within-column, hide-when-single-tab. No window corner radius (no geometry-corner-radius rule) and no blur. layout.background-color 'transparent', with a layer-rule placing ^noctalia-wallpaper* within the backdrop. noctalia: general.radiusRatio 0.4, shadowDirection 'center' with 0/0 offsets, bar density 'compact', position 'bottom', marginHorizontal 0.2, marginVertical 0.1, showCapsule false, showOutline false, transparent false, outerCorners false, ui.panelBackgroundOpacity 1 (fully opaque). Fuzzel border uses base0D.
aesthetic.animations: No custom animation curves. niri has no animations block, so it uses niri's defaults. There are no bezier curves because this is not Hyprland. noctalia general.animationSpeed = 1.5, audio.cavaFrameRate = 60.
aesthetic.wallpapers: None bundled in the repo directories I inspected. noctalia handles wallpapers: wallpaper.enabled = true, directory = "/home/malte/.local/share/wallpapers" (hardcoded path), wallpaperChangeMode = "random", plus a WallpaperSelector bar widget. The README has one preview screenshot (GitHub user-attachments asset); I could not view it and it has no caption.
aesthetic.vibe: A dark, flat setup built for work. Near-black backgrounds (#090a0c / #101419) with soft pastel-ish accents (peach #f9a872, butter #f1cf8a, mint #78dba9, lilac #c68aee), square windows with 1px gaps, a thin sky-blue focus ring (#7fc8ff) and a soft drop shadow. The bar is a compact, opaque noctalia bar at the bottom with a system monitor, a 200px cava-style audio visualizer, a centered tray and named workspaces. The engineering is very polished; the look is not cute. There is no rounding on windows, no blur, no transparency, no pastel light theme and no themed wallpapers, and the three palettes do not match. For cute/pastel it is a weak visual reference (about 4/10), but a strong reference for plumbing and small UX scripts.

components.compositor: niri (pkgs.niri-unstable via sodiboo/niri-flake homeModules.niri, configured with programs.niri.settings). xwayland-satellite (xwayland-satellite-stable). Per-host outputs: on kroma, DP-3 is 3840x2160@240 and DP-2 is 3840x2160@143.999, both at scale 1.5 with VRR on-demand. Named workspaces (browser, default, term, term2, games, misc, comms, browser2, notes) mapped to Mod+1..9. Legacy i3 (X11, startx) config with sway-overfocus is still imported. No Hyprland config anywhere; the only reference is the hyprctl branch in clone-term.
components.bar_or_shell: noctalia-shell (Quickshell-based; noctalia-dev/noctalia-shell flake, homeModules.default, programs.noctalia-shell with systemd.enable). Bar widgets: left = ControlCenter (distro logo), WallpaperSelector, Spacer 20, SystemMonitor (CPU/GPU temp, memory %, disk /persist, network, enableNvidiaGpu), AudioVisualizer (primary color, width 200). center = Tray, Workspace (labelMode 'name'). right = MediaMini (progress ring, hover scrolling, maxWidth 145), Microphone, Volume, Brightness, Battery (warning at 20%), NotificationHistory (unread badge), Clock 'ddd dd.MM. HH:mm:ss'. Dock disabled.
components.launcher: fuzzel (programs.fuzzel) using the base16 colors: background base00, text base05, match base0A, selection base03, border base0D. Font 'Segoe UI:size=20'. Bound to Menu and Mod+asciicircum.
components.notifications: noctalia built-in notifications (notifications.enabled = true) with a NotificationHistory widget. The xdg-portal Notification interface uses gtk. No mako/dunst/swaync.
components.lock_idle_logout: No hyprlock/swaylock/hypridle/swayidle/wlogout in the files read. noctalia's lock screen is implied by general.showSessionButtonsOnLockScreen = false. Mod+Alt+l runs 'systemctl suspend'. niri quit is Mod+Ctrl+Shift+q with a confirmation dialog. Mod+Shift+p powers off the monitors. No idle daemon configured.
components.wallpaper_tool: noctalia's built-in wallpaper manager (random mode, WallpaperSelector widget). niri layer-rule place-within-backdrop for namespace ^noctalia-wallpaper* so the wallpaper shows behind the overview.
components.terminal: kitty with JetBrains Mono 14 and a modified onehalfdark palette. scrollback_lines 100000, Neovim as scrollback pager (Ctrl+Shift+H), disable_ligatures 'cursor', no cursor blink, no bell, symbol_map to Symbols Nerd Font Mono.
components.shell_prompt: zsh (users/config/shell/zsh) and nushell. Starship: add_newline false; left side is user/host(ssh only)/dir (fish-style length 1)/git branch/commit/state/status/character ('$' symbol); right_format is status/cmd_duration/jobs/python/rust/time; command_timeout 60ms. Also zoxide with '--cmd p', nix-index-database + comma, fzf and skim-histdb (zsh-skim-histdb package) for Ctrl+R.
components.editor: Neovim through nixvim (users/malte/neovim: alpha dashboard, onedark theme, neo-tree, lualine, lsp, completion, web-devicons). Also an isolated nixvim manpager (users/config/manpager.nix, per the README).
components.file_manager: None found in the graphical config (no thunar/nautilus/yazi/lf in the files read).
components.fetch: None found.
components.login_boot: No display manager: services.getty.autologinUser = "malte", and zsh initContent (mkOrder 9999) runs `niri-session` on /dev/tty1 when DISPLAY/WAYLAND_DISPLAY are unset. Boot uses systemd-in-initrd (emergency access, ip/ping/cryptsetup extraBin), console.earlySetup, loader timeout 2. lanzaboote (secure boot) is a flake input. No Plymouth or bootloader theme seen. ZFS on LUKS with remote unlock, and impermanence with ZFS rollback.
components.extras: Firefox with Betterfox (Securefox/Fastfox/Peskyfox pinned at rev 116.1), userChrome hiding #TabsToolbar (tree-style tabs), and a wrapper injecting NVIDIA VA-API env. Screenshots: custom grimblast scripts (area with OCR/satty edit/copy notification actions; area QR scan via zbarimg; full screen), plus the niri built-in screenshot on Mod+Shift+s. gpu-screen-recorder (+ gtk UI). Volume and brightness OSD scripts using notify-send with SVG assets (used in i3). clone-term (open a new terminal in the cwd of the focused terminal's deepest zsh). Discord, Spotify, Signal and Thunderbird with no theming (no spicetify/vesktop themes). cava visualizer through noctalia. xdg-desktop-portal per-interface config (gtk / gnome / gnome-keyring). nirius. wl-clipboard-rs. flatpak.

standout_features: niri window-rules with `block-out-from = "screencast"` for signal, discord and affine, and `"screen-capture"` for thunderbird, so chat and mail windows are automatically hidden from screen shares and screenshots. A privacy feature worth copying.

screenshot-area script: `grimblast --freeze save area`, copies to the clipboard, then loops on a notify-send notification with actions '🔠 Run OCR' (tesseract eng+deu into wl-copy), '✏️ Edit' (satty with brush tool, fullscreen, early-exit, numbered edit outputs) and '📋 Copy Image'. It updates the same notification in place through a --print-id / --replace-id map. A multi-step tool that lives entirely inside one notification.

screenshot-area-scan-qr: grimblast area | zbarimg --xml | xq. Handles multiple QR codes (joined with ---), copies the data, and sends a notification with a qr-scan.png icon and specific handling for exit code 4 (no codes found).

A full libadwaita/GTK4 recolor from a single base16 attrset through `@define-color` overrides (accent_*, destructive_*, headerbar_*, sidebar_*, card_*, popover_*, blue_1..5 ... dark_1..5), written to both gtk-3.0 and gtk-4.0 gtk.css on top of adw-gtk3.

noctalia-shell (Quickshell) configured fully from Nix: a bottom compact bar with a SystemMonitor that includes GPU temp, an AudioVisualizer (cava, 60fps), MediaMini with a progress ring, a WallpaperSelector and random wallpaper rotation. A ready-made Quickshell shell set up without any QML.

Per-host desktop config with `mkMerge [ {...} (mkIf (nixosConfig.node.name == "kroma") {...}) ]`: 4K@240 VRR outputs, and named workspaces pinned to outputs, generated with lib.mapAttrsToList into Mod+N focus and Mod+Shift+N move binds.

clone-term: finds the focused window's PID via swaymsg / hyprctl activewindow -j / niri msg -j focused-window / xdotool, walks child processes to the deepest zsh, and opens $TERMINAL in that process's cwd.

Volume OSD: notify-send --transient with --hint=int:value (a progress bar in the notification daemon) and an SVG icon chosen for increase/decrease/mute and sink/source. Values over 100% wrap the indicator.
Kitty uses Neovim as the scrollback pager and a symbol_map to Symbols Nerd Font Mono, so no patched Nerd Fonts are needed. fontconfig localConf gives emoji weak priority across mono, sans and serif.
The session starts from tty1 in zsh (no display manager) with getty autologin, which pairs with full-disk encryption as the real authentication step.
structure_install: flake-parts flake. Modules are under flake/ (agenix-rekey, devshell, globals, hosts, iso, pkgs, storage-box) and topology/. Top-level folders: config/ (applied to all hosts: boot, nix, net, impermanence, home-manager, users, plus graphical/ with fonts, steam and xserver, plus optional/ with laptop, sound and zfs), hosts/<name>/ (default.nix, fs.nix, net.nix, secrets/, guests/ for microvms), modules/ (reusable NixOS modules), pkgs/ (overlay with custom packages, `scripts` via writeShellApplication, segoe-ui-ttf, zsh-skim-histdb, git-fuzzy), secrets/ (age, generated, wireguard), users/ (users/config holds shared HM config for shell, htop, neovim and utils; users/malte holds default.nix, git/gpg/ssh, dev/, graphical/ and neovim/; users/root). Desktop files are in users/malte/graphical/: niri.nix, noctalia.nix, theme.nix, fuzzel.nix, kitty.nix, firefox.nix, discord.nix, signal.nix, thunderbird.nix, gpu-screen-recorder.nix, i3.nix, flameshot.nix, wlr-whichkey.nix (empty), games/. Install steps from the README: build a live ISO with `nix build --print-out-paths --no-link .#images.<system>.live-iso`, then `nix copy --to <target> .#nixosConfigurationsMinimal.config.system.build.installFromLive`, then run `install-system` (disko partitioning, ZFS), then ssh-keyscan the host key into hosts/<host>/secrets/host.pub, then `nix run .#rekey`, then redeploy. Repo-wide secrets need nix-plugins extra-builtins and the author's YubiKey, so the repo is not deployable by others as-is. There is no Arch or non-Nix install path.
nix_patterns: flake-parts mkFlake with per-concern flake modules (flake/*.nix) and systems x86_64-linux + aarch64-linux; nixos-unstable plus a nixpkgs-2511 pin

home-manager used as a NixOS module (home-manager.users.malte declared in users/malte/default.nix), with `nixosConfig` passed into HM modules for host checks (nixosConfig.node.name, nixosConfig.graphical.gaming.enable)
Custom HM option `lib.colors` (hex and withHashtag) used as a small in-house replacement for stylix/nix-colors
niri-flake homeModules.niri with typed `programs.niri.settings` and `config.lib.niri.actions` for binds; mkMerge + mkIf for per-host outputs and workspaces
noctalia-shell flake homeModules.default with the `programs.noctalia-shell.settings` attrset (the shell's JSON settings expressed in Nix)
impermanence everywhere: `home.persistence."/state"` and `"/persist"` directories/files declared next to each program (e.g. .cache/noctalia, .cache/fuzzel, .config/discord), with ZFS rollback on boot
agenix + agenix-rekey (YubiKey master identity, `rekeyFile`, generated secrets), plus repo-wide encrypted globals decrypted at eval time via nix-plugins extra-builtins
disko partitioning, lanzaboote, microvm.nix guests, nixos-generators ISO, nix-topology, nixos-extra-modules (author's reusable modules repo)
nixvim for editor and manpager; nix-index-database with comma

pkgs overlay `scripts` built with writeShellApplication and runtimeInputs (screenshot-area, screenshot-area-scan-qr, screenshot-screen, volume, brightness, clone-term), with SVG assets referenced through ${./assets}
`minimal` special arg (lib.optionalAttrs (!minimal)) to strip GUI and user config from installer/minimal configurations
Custom option `graphical.gaming.enable` controlling the games imports and sysctl tweaks
devshell, pre-commit-hooks.nix, treefmt-nix, statix.toml

key_snippets.purpose: niri layout geometry: gaps, focus ring, shadow, tab indicator
Hide chat and mail windows from screencasts and screenshots, and route apps to named workspaces
Single base16 source of truth exposed as an HM lib attrset
libadwaita/GTK4 recolor via @define-color (excerpt; note the missing '#' on headerbar_border_color)
Notification-driven screenshot flow: OCR, satty edit, copy, updating one notification in place
key_snippets.excerpt:
grimblast --freeze save area "$out" || exit 2
    wl-copy -t image/png < "$out"
    ...
    while true; do
      action=$(notify_wait_action main "$title" "$body" \
        --action=ocr="🔠 Run OCR" \
        --action=edit="✏️ Edit" \
        --action=copy="📋 Copy Image")

      case "$action" in
        ocr)
          notify_nowait main "$title" "⏳ Running OCR ..."
          if tesseract "$out" - -l eng+deu | wl-copy; then
            body="🔠 OCR copied to clipboard"
          else
            body="❌ Error while running OCR"
          fi
          ;;
        edit)
          satty --filename "$out" \
            --output-filename "$out_base-edit-$edit_counter.png" \
            --copy-command wl-copy \
            --initial-tool brush \
            --save-after-copy \
            --fullscreen \
            --early-exit

key_snippets.purpose: noctalia-shell global look settings and wallpaper backdrop integration with niri

weaknesses: Not Hyprland at all. The compositor is niri, and nothing in hyprland.conf syntax can be reused. The only Hyprland reference is the hyprctl branch in clone-term.nix.

NixOS-only and tightly coupled to the author's infrastructure: `home.persistence` (impermanence) lines in almost every module, agenix-rekey with YubiKey secrets, eval-time repo secrets via nix-plugins, ZFS/LUKS/disko. There is no path for Arch or plain dotfiles.

Hardcoded user, paths and hosts: wallpaper directory "/home/malte/.local/share/wallpapers"; getty autologin "malte"; hostname checks (nixosConfig.node.name == "kroma" / "nom") with fixed DP-2/DP-3 outputs; German 'de nodeadkeys' layout; location 'Munich, Germany'.

Three unrelated color systems: theme.nix base16 (#101419 bg), kitty 'modified onehalfdark' (#090a0c bg), noctalia predefined 'Ayu', plus Neovim onedark and hardcoded niri colors (#7fc8ff / #ffc87f). The base16 set only reaches GTK and fuzzel.
Bug in the GTK css: `@define-color headerbar_border_color ${base01};` is missing the '#' and produces an invalid color. Also warning_color is mapped to base0E (purple) instead of the yellow base0A.
Cursor size conflict: home.pointerCursor.size = 20 while the gtk3/4 extraConfig sets gtk-cursor-theme-size = 32. gtk-xft-dpi = 160 is left with an 'XXX: delete for wayland?' comment.

Licensing: Segoe UI, a Microsoft proprietary font, is fetched from the third-party GitHub repo mrbvrz/segoe-ui-linux and set as the system sans font. 'Segoe UI Emoji' is the default emoji font. Legally questionable to redistribute or copy.
'IBM Plex Serif' is set as the default serif, but it is not in fonts.packages in config/graphical/fonts.nix, so it may fall back silently.
Stale pins: Betterfox fetched at rev '116.1' (Firefox 116 era, 2023). Segoe UI source pinned to 'unstable-2023-09-04'.

Leftover and dead code: i3.nix (X11) is still imported, with a swaynag 'exit sway' prompt inside i3 and 'TODO eww' notes. flameshot and xserver/startx are still enabled. wlr-whichkey.nix is an empty `{ }`. The niri screenshot bind has an 'XXX' workaround note (niri-flake issue #1380). tab-indicator uses the placeholder colors "red"/"gray".
Firefox wrapper hardcodes NVIDIA VA-API env (LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME=nvidia, NVD_BACKEND=direct) for every host, including the Intel-based laptop.
clone-term needs xdotool and ps at runtime even on Wayland, only works when the shell is zsh, and relies on $TERMINAL being set.
Looks plain: 1px gaps, square windows, no blur, an opaque bar, and no light or pastel mode. Not a good visual reference for a 'cute' rice.
There is no idle or lock daemon config (no hypridle/swayidle equivalent in the files read). Locking and suspend are left to noctalia defaults and a manual Mod+Alt+l suspend.
steal_list: Keep one palette attrset (like `lib.colors.hex` / `withHashtag`) as the source of truth, then generate kitty, fuzzel/rofi, GTK, Qt and the bar from it. On Arch, render the same palette through a template engine (matugen/wallust templates) so both distros share one set of values. Avoid the repo's mistake of three separate palettes.

Copy the full libadwaita `@define-color` override map (accent/destructive/success/warning/error, window/view/headerbar/sidebar/card/dialog/popover, blue_1..5 ... dark_1..5) on top of adw-gtk3, and write it to both gtk-3.0/gtk.css and gtk-4.0/gtk.css. This is how GTK4/libadwaita apps get pastel colors. Fix the missing '#' and map warning to the yellow slot.

Adopt the screenshot-area notification loop (grimblast --freeze, then clipboard, then notification actions OCR/Edit/Copy with --replace-id updates, satty --early-exit --initial-tool brush). grimblast is a Hyprland contrib tool, so it fits a Hyprland rice directly and works on both Arch and NixOS.
Adopt the QR-scan screenshot (grimblast | zbarimg --xml | xq, multiple codes joined, notification with an icon).

Recreate the privacy rule that hides Signal, Discord and mail windows from screencasts. niri calls this block-out-from. I have not checked whether current Hyprland has an equivalent window rule; check the Hyprland wiki before relying on it.
Volume and brightness OSD through notify-send --transient with an int:value hint and state-specific SVG icons (increase/decrease/mute, sink/source). Swap in cute pastel SVGs to make it look nicer.
clone-term: open a new terminal in the focused terminal's cwd using `hyprctl activewindow -j | jq .pid` plus a child-process walk. Generalize it beyond zsh and drop xdotool.

Kitty: symbol_map to 'Symbols Nerd Font Mono' instead of patched fonts, Neovim as scrollback pager, disable_ligatures cursor, a 100000-line scrollback. fontconfig localConf that gives emoji weak priority for all generic families.
Starship with a split layout: git info on the left, status/duration/time in right_format, with command_timeout = 60.

Explicit xdg-desktop-portal per-interface routing (FileChooser = gtk, Secret = gnome-keyring, ScreenCast/Screenshot = the compositor's backend). For Hyprland, use xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland for ScreenCast/Screenshot.

Per-host monitor and workspace blocks via mkMerge + mkIf on hostname, with named workspaces generated into Mod+N / Mod+Shift+N binds via lib.mapAttrsToList. For Arch, split these into per-host sourced hypr/*.conf files.

noctalia-shell (Quickshell) is a turnkey bar, notification, lock, wallpaper and control-center option that can be configured declaratively. Consider it, or its widget set (SystemMonitor with GPU temp, cava AudioVisualizer, MediaMini with progress ring, WallpaperSelector), as the baseline for a Quickshell bar. I did not check its Hyprland support or its pastel schemes; confirm them against the noctalia docs.
Starting the session from tty1 with getty autologin is a minimal setup for encrypted-disk machines. For a polished cute rice, prefer greetd with a themed greeter instead.

one_line: NixOS + nix-darwin flake built around niri (not Hyprland) and a from-scratch Quickshell shell. Everything comes from one codebase: bar, launcher, notifications, OSD, dashboard, media dock with cava, wallpaper picker, lock screen and greetd greeter. The look is flat, square-cornered 'IBM Carbon' brutalism with hard offset shadows and M3-style springy motion. It is polished but not pastel or cute; the only cute touches are anime mascots.
freshness: Very active. The commits Atom feed shows the latest commit on 2026-09-23T01:22:37Z and about 11 more commits between 2026-09-17 and 2026-09-23. The flake tracks nixos-unstable plus nixos-25.11 as stable, home-manager master and nix-darwin master. dtsf-pc has system.stateVersion "26.05". The Quickshell package is versioned "2.0.0". CI workflows exist (.github/workflows/build.yml, run-tests.yml). The README is partly stale: it mentions an 'astal' addon plus 'templates' and 'scripts' dirs, and no astal code exists in the tree.

aesthetic.palette: Active theme is 'carbon' (vars/default.nix hostsConfig.theme = "carbon"), IBM Carbon-like: primary #78a9ff, fg #f4f4f4, bg #161616, altbg #262626, selection #393939, black #000000, red #fa4d56, green #42be65, yellow #3ddbd9 (actually teal), blue #78a9ff, magenta #ff7eb6, cyan #33b1ff, white #ffffff. Other themes use the same 13-key schema. min: primary #ffab70, bg #1a1a1a, fg #c1c1c1, red #ff7a84, blue #79b8ff, magenta #b392f0. catppuccin is not real Catppuccin: bg #111111, primary/magenta #ab9df2, altbg #303446, red #e78284, green #a6d189, yellow #e5c890, blue #8caaee, cyan #99d1db. vesper: bg #101010, primary #A0A0A0, fg #CCCCCC, red #FF8080, green #82D9C2, peach #FFCFA8. gruvbox: bg #1d2021, primary #d79921. solarized: bg #00181e, primary #2aa198. The shell derives a tonal ramp from bg/fg: panel = mix 0.06, layer1 0.11, layer2 0.17, outline 0.24, outlineStrong 0.45, subtext = fg mixed 0.14 toward bg, faint 0.34, accentDim = primary mixed 0.45 toward bg, scrim #000 @0.55, shadow #000 @0.62.
aesthetic.color_pipeline: Static palettes, no wallpaper-derived colors (no matugen, wallust, pywal or stylix). Each theme is a Nix attrset (modules/themes/<name>.nix). modules/themes/user.nix exposes an enum option plus per-theme enable toggles, and ~16 opt-in integration modules (alacritty, dunst, cava, neovim, zellij, gtk, i3, i3lock, sway, fish, ghostty, wezterm, rio, fzf, niri, fuzzel) write app configs through Home Manager. The Quickshell derivation gets the colorscheme via callPackage args and runs substituteInPlace --replace-fail @primary@/@background@/... into config/Appearance.qml at build time. Changing theme or wallpaper therefore needs a nixos-rebuild. GTK uses catppuccin-gtk mocha with the accent mapped per theme ('carbon' -> catppuccin-mocha-blue-standard+black) and Reversal-<color>-dark icons.
aesthetic.fonts: Inter (sans; also set as the serif default) and JetBrainsMono Nerd Font (mono), plus noto-fonts-cjk-sans and noto-fonts-color-emoji. enableDefaultPackages = false. Quickshell type scale in px: tiny 11, small 12, normal 13, medium 14, large 16, xlarge 19, title 23, display 32, hero 46. labelSpacing is 1.6; bar labels render as spaced caps in the screenshots. Lock clock is mono at 96px. Alacritty uses JetBrainsMono NF at size 15. GTK font is Inter 12. Fuzzel font is 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font:size=14,Inter:size=14' with prompt "検索 ".
aesthetic.icons_cursor_gtk_qt: Icons: Reversal icon theme, color variant per theme (carbon -> Reversal-blue-dark; Quickshell forced to QS_ICON_THEME Reversal-dark). Cursor: Quintom_Snow size 24, also set in the greeter. GTK: catppuccin-gtk (variant mocha, size standard, tweaks [black]) with accents [yellow red teal lavender blue mauve]. gtk-application-prefer-dark-theme = true, gtk-decoration-layout = "" (no CSD buttons), GTK_THEME=<name>:dark exported, dconf color-scheme prefer-dark. DPI is derived from the monitor scale (96 * scale). No Qt/Kvantum theming module was found.
aesthetic.geometry: niri (modules/themes/integration/niri.nix): gaps 8; struts 12 on all sides; focus-ring width 4 (active = primary, inactive = altbg); border off; window-rule geometry-corner-radius 6 with clip-to-geometry true; shadow softness 30, spread 5, offset x=0 y=5, color bg+"77"; prefer-no-csd; preset column widths 0.33333/0.5/0.66667, default 0.5. No compositor blur is configured. Quickshell: every rounding token = 0 (square cards); border width 1; neo-brutalist hard drop shadow (solid rect offset 5px, #000 @0.62). Bar: height 34, margin 6, side margin 20, item height 26, workspace cell 22; panel width 400; launcher width 560, placed at max(90, 16% of height) from top; wallpaper picker max 940x640. Lock: MultiEffect blur 1 with blurMax 32, brightness -0.4, saturation -0.3 on a 480px-wide downsampled wallpaper, then a 0.5 base-color overlay. Alacritty: opacity 0.9, padding 25/25, no decorations. Fuzzel: border width 4, radius 6, bg alpha 'dd'.
aesthetic.animations: niri: slowdown 0.5. workspace-switch spring damping-ratio=1.0 stiffness=1000 epsilon=0.0001; horizontal-view-movement, window-movement and window-resize springs damping 1.0 stiffness 800. window-open 150ms ease-out-expo, window-close 150ms ease-out-quad, screenshot-ui-open 200ms ease-out-quad. Quickshell Appearance.anim bezier tokens (Easing.BezierSpline): fast 200ms [0.34,0.80,0.34,1.00]; std 350ms [0.42,1.67,0.21,0.90] (overshoot); slow 500ms [0.38,1.21,0.22,1.00]; enter 400ms [0.05,0.7,0.1,1]; exit 200ms [0.3,0,0.8,0.15]. These look like Material 3 expressive/emphasized motion tokens (my inference). Cards scale 0.96->1 with an opacity fade from a per-popout transformOrigin. Toasts slide in x from 20% width. Password asterisks pop in with scale 0->1. Failed auth shakes the box ±7px, 45ms steps, 3 loops. Bar autohide slides y with opacity.
aesthetic.wallpapers: Wallpapers are not in the repo. hostsConfig.wallpaper = "/home/dtsf/gdrive/walls/70.png", fetched with rclone from Google Drive (sops secret), resized with ImageMagick to a canvas spanning all monitors, cropped per output, and shown with swaybg. The README screenshots show a pink/magenta Evangelion fan-art illustration (Rei and Unit-01). Bundled media: pkgs/quickshell/conf/assets/asuka.gif (Evangelion character mascot), gif0.gif, and shimeji-ee mascot archives via Git LFS.
aesthetic.vibe: Honest take: austere, dark, flat, terminal-brutalist. Square panels, 1px outlines, hard offset shadows, lowercase text-only labels ('pwr', 'msg', 'sys', 'eth', '|<', '||', '>|') and almost no icons. It is very coherent and well engineered. Motion is lively (overshoot curves, springs), and the media dock with cava bars and the dashboard graphs look slick in the screenshots. It is not cute or pastel. The charm comes from the vivid Evangelion wallpaper, an Asuka GIF above the power menu, and wl-shimeji desktop pets. Polish: high for a hand-written shell; aesthetic appeal: 'serious minimalist' more than 'kawaii'.

components.compositor: niri (scrolling Wayland). Config is assembled from raw KDL snippets into xdg.configFile "niri/config.kdl"; xwayland-satellite for X apps; started via a custom-niri-session script that runs systemctl --user --wait start niri.service. Legacy i3 (X11 + picom) and sway modules exist; the laptop host has a GNOME config. There is no Hyprland anywhere in the repo.
components.bar_or_shell: Custom Quickshell shell 'dats-quickshell' 2.0.0 (pkgs/quickshell). Modules: Bar (Workspaces, NowPlaying, ActiveWindow, centered Clock, Tray/TrayMenu, StatusCluster, Monitor 'sys', msg and pwr buttons), ControlCentre, NotificationCentre, CalendarPopout, Dashboard (CPU/mem/storage meters, temps, history graphs), MediaDock, Launcher, SessionMenu, WallpaperPicker, Notifications, OSD, Lock. Services: Apps, Audio, Brightness, Cava, Niri (event-stream JSON parser), Notifs, Players (MPRIS), SysInfo, Wallpapers. Runs as a systemd user service (PartOf graphical-session.target).
components.launcher: Quickshell Launcher.qml. Prefix modes: plain = app search, '>' = run in terminal, '?' = DuckDuckGo, '=' = calculator (regex-guarded Function eval). Shows 6-8 results, hover-to-select, Tab/Up/Down. Bound to Mod+D via the 'wlauncher' wrapper. A themed fuzzel.ini still exists as a legacy option.
components.notifications: Quickshell notification server. Toasts with image/app icon, actions, critical-urgency coloring; right-click discards. NotificationCentre has 'silenced' and 'clear' controls. Config: notificationTimeout 6000ms, maxNotifications 6. Dunst (themed) is used only for the i3/sway paths.
components.lock_idle_logout: Lock: Quickshell WlSessionLock + Quickshell.Services.Pam with a custom PAM service 'dats-lock' (security.pam.services.dats-lock). AuthFace shows a blurred wallpaper, 96px clock, date, asterisk entry, shake on failure and a now-playing caption; bound to Super+Alt+L ('wlock'). Logout: Quickshell SessionMenu (lock/logout/suspend/restart/shutdown cards; the last three styled destructive) with an animated asuka.gif mascot; Mod+Shift+E. Idle: no swayidle/hypridle/idle daemon found in the niri path.
components.wallpaper_tool: swaybg, run by two systemd user services. 'wallpaper' runs swaybg per output. 'wallpaper-updater' is a oneshot doing rclone fetch, ImageMagick resize/extent to the multi-monitor canvas and per-output crop, with md5 + zoom + layout-signature caching. Quickshell WallpaperPicker builds 420x260 thumbnails (xargs -P 3 magick) and live-previews on hover by swapping swaybg. 'apply' sed-edits vars/default.nix and runs sudo nixos-rebuild switch in a terminal.
components.terminal: Alacritty is the default (hostsConfig.terminal): opacity 0.9, padding 25, JetBrainsMono NF 15, blinking block cursor, shell fish. Modules also exist for ghostty, wezterm and rio. Zellij is the multiplexer: Mod+Return attaches or creates a zellij session named '*-dtsf'; zellij-switch flake input.
components.shell_prompt: fish with the fishPlugins.hydro prompt (hydro_symbol_prompt "💀"), fishPlugins.done, zoxide, and a custom fish_mode_prompt; colors from the fish theme integration.
components.editor: Neovim from the author's separate flake 'datsnvim' (github:datsfilipe/datsnvim). The theme integration passes the colorscheme name through programs.datsnvim.settings.theme.
components.file_manager: pcmanfm (modules/programs/desktopapps/user.nix).
components.fetch: None found.
components.login_boot: greetd runs a dedicated niri instance (animations off, no focus ring/border, Quintom_Snow cursor) that spawns the Quickshell greeter 'wgreet' (greeter.qml via Quickshell.Services.Greetd, sharing the AuthFace look with the lock screen). On success it launches custom-niri-session and quits the greeter niri. There is an alternative tty1 auto-launch 'displayManager' module. Boot: systemd-boot on dtsf-pc (grub disabled). A pkgs/refind-theme exists but is just text-mode config ('textonly', 'hideui hints badges'). No Plymouth found.
components.extras: cava inside the shell (96 bars, 60fps, raw ascii output, noise_reduction 40; subscribed only while the media dock is open and playing). wl-shimeji desktop mascots (CluelessCatBurger/wl_shimeji, Mod+Shift+M). focus-mode script (bar autohide + stop wallpaper). niri-stack-to-n. niri color picker bind (Alt+W copies hex to clipboard). Volume/brightness OSD via IPC. bottom/btop. Brave with policy.json. A 'work-browser' wrapper. Krita resource pack. Distrobox Arch Linux container ('archbox', podman). sops-nix secrets. Cachix cache. An Ollama module with persona prompts.

standout_features: One Quickshell codebase built as a Nix derivation. makeWrapper produces a binary per IPC target: wmain, wlauncher, wsession, wdashboard, wcontrol, wnotifications, wmedia, wwallpapers, wlock, wvolume-osd, wbrightness-osd, wbar. Compositor keybinds just call these names (e.g. XF86AudioRaiseVolume -> 'wpctl ... && wvolume-osd').
Two-color tonal system: Appearance.qml builds a full surface/outline/text ramp from only bg and fg with a mix(a,b,t) helper, so any 13-color palette produces a consistent UI.

Lock screen and greetd login share one AuthFace component: blurred, desaturated, downsampled wallpaper; big mono clock; per-character asterisk pop animation; ±7px shake on failure; MPRIS now-playing caption; custom PAM service 'dats-lock'.

Bottom MediaDock slides up and animates its exclusiveZone with the reveal, so windows get pushed up smoothly. It has live cava bars behind a 62% scrim, a clickable seek progress strip and album art. Cava only runs while the dock is visible and music is playing.

Bar autohide uses a 4px hover reveal strip, a 700ms hide timer and a Region input mask that switches between the reveal strip, the slider and the surface. It is toggled via 'wbar toggleAutohide' (Alt+H).
Launcher prefix modes in one text box: '>' runs in terminal, '?' does a web search, '=' shows a live calculator result.
Wallpaper picker grid with hover-to-preview on the real desktop (kills and restarts swaybg), a cached thumbnail pipeline, and restore on dismiss.

Multi-monitor spanning wallpaper: Nix computes the canvas from monitor coordinates and rotation, ImageMagick crops per output, and a layout signature plus md5 avoid re-rendering. It can pull the source from Google Drive with rclone and fall back to a cached copy offline.
Popouts auto-close on niri focused-window or active-workspace change. This is wired through a Niri.qml singleton that parses niri's JSON event stream (WorkspacesChanged, WindowOpenedOrChanged, etc.).
Cute layer: an animated Asuka GIF mascot above the session menu and wl-shimeji desktop pets on a keybind.
Vertical-slice Nix layout: every feature folder has os.nix (NixOS) and/or user.nix (Home Manager), all auto-imported by a recursive scanPaths, and hosts only flip enable options.
Theme integrations append their own KDL to niri's rawConfigValues list, so the colorscheme module owns the niri layout/focus-ring/shadow block independently of keybinds.
structure_install: Flake repo. flake.nix inputs: nixpkgs (nixos-unstable), nixpkgs-stable (nixos-25.11), nixpkgs-unstable, home-manager master, nix-darwin master, sops-nix, datsnvim, zellij-switch, unix-scripts (flake=false). outputs = import ./outputs, with per-arch dirs outputs/x86_64-linux/src/{dtsf-pc,dtsf-laptop,dtsf-server}.nix and outputs/aarch64-darwin/src/dtsf-mac.nix. Other top-level dirs: hosts/<host>/{default.nix, boot.nix, hardware-configuration.nix, home/{default.nix, packages.nix}}; lib/ (file.nix scanPaths, color.nix, spec.nix, nixosSystem/darwinSystem); modules/{core, desktop, editors, hardware, programs, secrets, services, themes}; pkgs/ (auto-callPackage'd custom packages: quickshell, wl-shimeji, focus-mode, niri-stack-to-n, refind-theme, krita-resources, trxsh, vaultwarden, tableplus, suwayomi-server, work-browser, scripts); vars/default.nix (username 'dtsf', dotfiles path, hostsConfig theme/terminal/browser/wallpaper/monitors). Apply with the justfile: 'just switch <target>' runs 'sudo nixos_switch', 'just build', 'just update'; plus fmt (alejandra, kdlfmt, qmlformat, shfmt, fish_indent), gc, 'bootstrap-keys' (ssh-to-age for sops), 'secrets', 'archbox'. The README says to add a host under hosts/ and generate hardware config with nixos-generate-config; submodules use ssh URLs; Git LFS is needed for the shimeji and Krita bundles. There is no Arch install path: Arch appears only as a distrobox dev container.
nix_patterns: Single flake; outputs split into per-system directories (x86_64-linux, aarch64-darwin), each host a file in src/

Vertical-slice modules: modules/<category>/<feature>/os.nix (NixOS) + user.nix (Home Manager). Hosts import (mylib.file.scanPaths ../../modules "os.nix") and HM imports scanPaths "user.nix", so every module is always imported and gated by mkEnableOption under a custom 'modules.*' namespace
Home Manager used as a NixOS/darwin module; host home/default.nix toggles features (modules.desktop.wm.niri.user.enable, modules.desktop.colorscheme.enable*Integration)
Theme system: options.modules.desktop.colorscheme.theme enum plus modules.themes.<name>.enable, which sets the theme via mkMerge/mkIf; integration files are imported functions taking {colorscheme}

niri config built as a list option rawConfigValues (types.listOf types.lines), concatenated into xdg.configFile."niri/config.kdl".text. The base niri.kdl gets @TOUCH_OUTPUT@ replaced by builtins.replaceStrings; output blocks are generated from vars monitors
