key_snippets.purpose: Bug: bashrcExtra is nested inside shellAliases, so it becomes an alias instead of sourcing bash-wakatime

weaknesses: The stack does not match the goal: it is X11 only (Qtile X11, picom, i3lock/betterlockscreen, flameshot, xdotool, xclip, startx). There are no Hyprland, Wayland, Waybar, launcher or hypr* configs. xdg-desktop-portal-wlr is installed but nothing uses it.

The palette is copied by hand into at least six places and has drifted: colors.py vs the README table (cyan 4FCFEB vs 8ADEF1, yellow-light EEC09F vs EED49F) vs kitty (color4 #8C8AF1) vs console.colors (an entirely different set) vs stock Catppuccin Macchiato in dunst vs flameshot #1435c7. There is no single source of truth or generator.

Catppuccin flavours and Qt theming are mixed: catppuccin/nix macchiato+blue, GTK mocha-lavender, cursor macchiato, spicetify mocha. Qt is set to kvantum in Home Manager but adwaita-dark at the system level. Enabling catppuccin/nix globally while also setting kitty and console colours by hand leaves the effective theme unclear.

The cursor is declared twice with different names: gtk.cursorTheme 'Catppuccin-Macchiato-Dark' and home.pointerCursor 'Catppuccin-Macchiato-Dark-Cursors'. The GTK theme depends on catppuccin-gtk, whose upstream is archived.
Bugs and typos: kitty 'hide_window_decorations = "yew"' should be 'yes'. In bash, bashrcExtra is placed inside shellAliases, so wakatime never gets sourced.

Hardcoded, machine-specific values: username 'sigmanificient' in flake.nix, homeDirectory '/home/${username}', oh-my-zsh custom '/home/${username}/extra/zsh', ThermalZone '/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone5/temp', Systray inserted at magic index 12, and the '$HOSTNAME = Bacon' branch in .xinitrc.
Security smells committed to the repo: users.users.<user>.initialPassword = "hello", networking.firewall.enable = false, and the bar shelling out to hostnamectl at config load.

The visuals are minimal: picom does fading only, with no rounded corners, blur, shadows or animations, even though picom-pijulius is installed. The bar is a plain 24px text strip with emoji battery glyphs, and there is no launcher UI beyond the Qtile Prompt.
Qtile is pinned to a one-off nixpkgs commit with tests disabled, which is fragile and has to be bumped by hand.
The README and .gitattributes are stale (Xanmod, Bpytop, Ranger, submodules, 'cp -r .* ~', config/bpytop paths), and there is no Arch or non-Nix install path despite what the README suggests.
wallpaper.png, lockscreen.png and banner.png are bundled with no source or licence attribution; I could not verify their origin.

CI actions are outdated (actions/checkout@v3, cachix/install-nix-action@v20 in check.yml). update-screenshot.yml pushes directly to master on every push using an SSH deploy key, which creates bot-commit noise.
steal_list: Adapt screenshot.nix for Hyprland: runNixOSTest that boots the real flake modules on a lightweight CI host, launches kitty with fastfetch and cbonsai through the compositor's IPC ('hyprctl dispatch exec' instead of 'qtile cmd-obj'), then machine.screenshot() or grim, and have CI commit the PNG. I have not verified that Hyprland renders under QEMU virtio-gpu or llvmpipe in the NixOS test driver; plan a fallback such as a headless wlroots session.

Copy the mk-system helper pattern (lib.nixosSystem conf) // { inherit conf; } and the per-host file naming convention (system/_<host>.nix + hardware/<host>.hardware-configuration.nix), plus a minimal 'Gha'-style host for CI and nix flake check.
Use git-hooks.nix pre-commit (nixpkgs-fmt or nixfmt) wired into checks and the devShell shellHook, plus a nix flake check GitHub Action.

Use the palette as a base for a deeper-than-Mocha pastel variant (bg #0F0F1C / #1A1C31 / #22263F, periwinkle accent #8B8AF1 / #A7A5FB, lilac #D78AF1 / #E5A5FB, text #CAD3F5). Define it once (a Nix attrset or base16 scheme for stylix/matugen templates, plus a shared file on Arch) and generate every app's colours from it to avoid the drift seen here.
Add an alpha helper in the palette source (hex + alpha byte) so the bar, notifications and hyprlock can share translucent variants, as with dunst #0D0D1680.
Use the cute lockscreen copy ('OwO what's this?', 'beep boop...', 'Oh no!') as hyprlock label and placeholder text (placeholder_text, fail_text).
Use Greek-letter workspace names (ζπδωλσς) as Waybar or Quickshell workspace labels.
Recreate the dropdown kitty scratchpad (90%, 0.95 opacity) as a Hyprland special workspace with window rules for size and opacity.
Make the bar chassis-aware: show the battery module only on laptops, via a host flag in Nix or a hostnamectl chassis check on Arch.
Reuse the tree-style fastfetch config (├/└ ANSI keys, ' ➜ ' separator, OS/HW/WM groups) and the two-line boxed zsh prompt layout.
Theme the TTY too: NixOS console.colors + earlySetup + Terminus + a custom /etc/issue (Arch: vconsole.conf FONT plus setvtrgb), and make nvim skip GUI colourschemes when TERM=linux.
Run the polkit agent as a systemd user service bound to graphical-session.target (on Hyprland, use hyprpolkitagent) and set TLP charge thresholds (30/70) on laptops.
Use catppuccin/nix pinned to a release tag (ref vYY.MM) for app ports on the Nix side (the Arch equivalent is the catppuccin port repos), but pick one flavour and accent and apply it everywhere.

one_line: A NixOS-only flake (flake-parts + import-tree + Home Manager) for the Niri scrolling compositor, not Hyprland. You choose DankMaterialShell or Noctalia as the Quickshell desktop shell, and everything is themed by a static Stylix Gruvbox Material palette. The look is dark and earthy, not pastel or cute.
freshness: Very active. The GitHub commit feed shows about 15 commits between 2026-09-23 and 2026-09-24 (latest 2026-09-24T16:00Z), mostly small qutebrowser, pihole and adblock tweaks with vague messages like "updated config". nixpkgs-unstable plus nixpkgs-stable 25.11. HM stateVersion is "26.05". The screenshots show NixOS 26.11 (Zokor) on Linux 7.2.4-zen2. Niri comes from sodiboo's niri-unstable. The README gives a Codeberg clone URL (codeberg.org/annmaro/nixri), so GitHub may be a mirror. MIT license, (c) 2026 Anand Kumar.

aesthetic.palette: Stylix base16 scheme gruvbox-material-dark-medium.yaml, used for everything. The hex fallbacks in the repo match it: base00 #292828 (bg), base01 #32302f, base03 #665c54, base04 #bdae93, base05 #ddc7a1 (fg), base07 #fbf1c7, base08 #ea6962 (red), base09 #e78a4e (orange), base0A #d8a657 (yellow, the main accent), base0B #a9b665 (green), base0C #89b482 (aqua), base0D #7daea3 (blue), base0E #d3869b (pink), base0F #bd6f3e. The hand-written QML launcher and keybind overlay add #d4be98 (fg), #a89984 (muted), #3c3836 (selection/badge), #32302f (row bg), #282828 (selected text), and a background of Qt.rgba(0.157,0.157,0.157,0.90). gruvbox-wall duotone endpoints: #1d2021 to #ebdbb2. The README badges use Catppuccin-style pastels (#f4b8e4, #babbf1, #81c8be, #ef9f76 on #363a4f labels), but the actual desktop is Gruvbox, not pastel. The cursor is Catppuccin Mocha Mauve, which clashes with Gruvbox.
aesthetic.color_pipeline: Static Stylix base16, with no wallpaper-driven colors. Stylix targets enabled: niri, gtk (with extraCss adding 1px base0D CSD borders and Thunar menu overrides), qt, btop, foot, swaylock, firefox (profile 'default'). Disabled on purpose: kitty, zed, waybar, dank-material-shell, spicetify, cava, feh, neovim, yazi. These apps read config.lib.stylix.colors by hand instead: DMS theme.json (Nix builds a Material-token JSON from base16), fastfetch, cava, yazi (mkForce theme), starship, fish FZF_DEFAULT_OPTS, qutebrowser, Firefox userChrome/userContent. DMS has dynamicTheming=false and currentThemeName='custom'. The niri env sets DMS_DISABLE_MATUGEN='0', so matugen is effectively unused. Noctalia uses its builtin 'Gruvbox' theme through lib.mkForce. The two QML overlays hardcode Gruvbox hex values and do not follow Stylix.
aesthetic.fonts: Stylix monospace: 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font' (nerd-fonts.jetbrains-mono). Foot uses mkForce 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font:size=14'. Stylix sansSerif: 'DejaVu Sans', which DMS also uses as fontFamily. System fonts: maple-mono.NF, nerd-fonts.jetbrains-mono, noto-fonts, noto-fonts-color-emoji. fontconfig defaults: mono = JetBrainsMono NF, then Maple Mono NF, Noto Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono. sans = Noto Sans, DejaVu Sans. serif = Noto Serif. emoji = Noto Color Emoji. DMS also pulls in material-symbols and material-design-icons. The DMS bar has fontScale 1.2 and iconScale 1.2.
aesthetic.icons_cursor_gtk_qt: Icons: Papirus-Dark / Papirus-Light via pkgs.papirus-icon-theme.override { color = "yellow"; } (yellow folders to match the Gruvbox accent). Cursor: catppuccin-mocha-mauve-cursors (pkgs.catppuccin-cursors.mochaMauve), size 24, also exported as XCURSOR_THEME and XCURSOR_SIZE system variables. GTK and Qt are themed by Stylix (qt.enable = true), plus the GTK extraCss for CSD decoration borders. prefer-no-csd is set in niri.
aesthetic.geometry: Niri layout: gaps 8, focus-ring off, border width 1 with active-color base0A #d8a657 and inactive transparent, background-color transparent, center-focused-column 'never', preset column widths 0.33333/0.5/0.66667. Window rule: geometry-corner-radius 12 with clip-to-geometry. Niri blur: passes 3, offset 2.0, noise 0.0, saturation 1.0. Per-app opacity tiers with background-effect blur=true, xray=false: terminals (foot, ghostty, alacritty, wezterm, yazi) 0.80; Nautilus, pcmanfm, spotify, youtube-music and steamwebhelper 0.70; editors, discord/vesktop, thunar, heroic and lutris 0.85; browsers and mpv 1.0 and open maximized. overview.workspace-shadow is off. DMS: cornerRadius 16, popupTransparency 0.40, blurEnabled, blurWallpaperOnOverview. Island bar at top: islandTransparency 0.75, islandCornerRadius 16, islandReserveThickness 31, islandCompactThickness 29, islandSatelliteGap 4, bar transparency 0.0, widgetTransparency 0.85, squareCorners true, spacing 0. QML launcher: 620x440, radius 14, 2px accent border, search field radius 8, rows 42px with radius 7. Keybind overlay: 780x560, radius 14, category pills radius 4. swaylock-effects: indicator-radius 100, indicator-thickness 7, effect-blur 7x5, effect-vignette 0.5:0.5, screenshots and clock on.
aesthetic.animations: None configured. There is no animations block in modules/data/niri/settings.nix, so niri's defaults apply, with no custom springs or bezier curves. DMS and Noctalia use their own built-in animations. The only transition tuned by hand is the awww wallpaper change: --transition-type grow --transition-pos center --transition-duration 1.2 --transition-fps 120.
aesthetic.wallpapers: One bundled video wallpaper, assets/output.mp4 (8,338,617 bytes). It is used by mpvpaper (via waypaper config, backend=mpvpaper) and as the SilentSDDM 'silvia' login background. The screenshots show a dark rocky cliff and sea scene. I infer that is this video but did not verify it. There is no attribution or license note for the video. ~/Pictures/Wallpapers is referenced but not included. The screenshots also show copyrighted comic pages and album art, but only in the preview PNGs. A gruvbox-wall ImageMagick script recolors any image into the palette.
aesthetic.vibe: Moody, earthy dark Gruvbox Material, and well polished. The DMS island bar is the highlight: a centered row of floating translucent pills (logo, workspace pills with a yellow active pill, focused-window title, cava/clock/weather/volume/brightness group, temperature, network, memory %). Below it are 80%-opaque blurred foot terminals and rmpc over a dark seascape video, with thin 1px yellow borders and 12px rounded windows. It is cohesive because Stylix drives almost everything. It is not cute, pastel or kawaii at all. Honest scores: polish about 7/10, cuteness/pastel about 1/10. It works as a structural reference, not a color or mood reference, for a pastel rice.

components.compositor: Niri, not Hyprland. It uses niri-unstable from sodiboo/niri-flake (niri.cachix.org substituter). The whole config is a Nix attrset (modules/data/niri/settings.nix) passed to BirdeeHub nix-wrapper-modules' wrappers.niri.wrap, with no hand-written config.kdl. It is installed through programs.niri.package = wrappedNiri. Portals: xdg-desktop-portal-gnome and -gtk (gtk handles OpenURI, FileChooser and Print). SDDM defaultSession is niri.
components.bar_or_shell: DankMaterialShell (Quickshell) is the default, via the inputs.dms HM module with systemd.enable. The island bar sits at the top with satellites. islandHomeLayout: media, clock, weather, status, volume, brightness, notifications. leftWidgets: launcherButton, workspaceSwitcher (pill style). rightWidgets: cpuTemp, systemTray, memUsage. A custom SystemLogo.qml overrides the logo with the NixOS nerd-font icon. DMS modules idle, lockscreen, wallpaper, launcher and dock are all disabled. The alternative is Noctalia, selected with systemSettings.bar = "noctalia". Its bar layout is workspaces, active_window, spacer, tray, sysmon, weather, clock, control-center.
components.launcher: DMS profile: a custom Quickshell QML launcher (~/.config/qml-launcher/shell.qml, Mod+Q, layer namespace 'qml-launcher'). It reads .desktop files with FolderListModel plus synchronous XMLHttpRequest from /run/current-system/sw/share/applications, ~/.nix-profile, /etc/profiles/per-user/$USER, ~/.local/share/applications and both Flatpak export dirs. It adds Lock/Suspend/Logout/Reboot/Shutdown entries, and Enter on no match runs the typed text as a command. It needs QML_XHR_ALLOW_FILE_READ=1. Noctalia profile: 'noctalia toggle launcher' on Mod+Space. Mod+G runs 'launcher games'. No rofi, fuzzel or wofi.
components.notifications: The DMS notifications module (notifications = true), with 'dms ipc call notifications toggle' on Mod+N. Noctalia notifications sit top-right. No mako, swaync or dunst. The scripts send notifications with notify-send (libnotify).
components.lock_idle_logout: swaylock-effects via HM programs.swaylock: screenshots, clock, indicator, radius 100, thickness 7, blur 7x5, vignette 0.5:0.5. Stylix colors the ring. swayidle: before-sleep locks, lock at 600s, monitors off at 420s through 'niri msg action power-off-monitors'. The order is wrong: screens turn off before the lock. Mod+Alt+L locks. Logout is the DMS session menu (Mod+Shift+E, 'dms ipc call session toggle'), 'noctalia toggle session', or the QML launcher's power entries.
components.wallpaper_tool: waypaper GUI (Mod+W; backend mpvpaper; post_command runs niri-wallpaper) plus a custom 'niri-wallpaper' writeShellApplication. Video files (.mp4/.webm/.mkv/.mov) go to mpvpaper --layer background with 'no-audio --loop-file=inf --hwdec=auto'. Images go to awww (the renamed swww) with a grow transition. The last wallpaper is cached in ~/.cache/wallpaper/last_wallpaper. A niri layer-rule place-within-backdrop on the awww-daemon and mpvpaper namespaces makes the wallpaper show in the overview backdrop.
components.terminal: foot is the default, run as a server (server.enable) and opened with footclient. It uses JetBrainsMono Nerd Font size 14, 10000 lines of scrollback, and Stylix colors. kitty is an option. ghostty is used for btop (Ctrl+Alt+Del). Ctrl+T opens a tmux-sessionizer footclient.
components.shell_prompt: fish by default (bash and zsh are options) with abbreviations: eza aliases, nix/nh shortcuts, trash-cli. Starship is minimal: format $username$hostname$directory$git_branch$git_state$git_status$cmd_duration$python$nix_shell$character. The prompt character is '❯', colored base0A on success and base08 on error, with vim mode '❮'. nix_shell shows '❄️ '. zoxide and direnv are enabled, and FZF colors come from Stylix.
components.editor: Neovim is the default (flake inputs nvf and nix4nvchad). Zed and Antigravity (antigravity-nix) are options. The EDITOR and VISUAL session variables follow homeSettings.editor.
components.file_manager: Thunar as the GUI file manager (runs as a daemon; Mod+Return opens it; thunar-volman). yazi as the TUI file manager (shell wrapper 'y', gvfs plugin for mount/unmount, ratio 1:3:4, show_hidden, forced Stylix-derived theme). lf is an option.
components.fetch: fastfetch shows a sixel NixOS logo PNG (modules/data/terminal/nixos-logo.png). The ' ── ' separator and every key's color come from base16 slots, with nerd-font key icons and a colors row of circles. microfetch is aliased to 'nf'.
components.login_boot: Login uses SDDM Wayland with SilentSDDM (uiriansan) theme 'silvia'. The video background is output.mp4 with fill mode, the per-user avatar is assets/nix.png, and the lock screen display is off. Boot is plain systemd-boot (consoleMode auto, timeout 10) with linuxPackages_zen, preempt=full and swappiness 100 with 50% zstd zram. No Plymouth and no bootloader theme.
components.extras: cava with an 8-stop gradient from base0B, base0C, base0D, base0A, base09, base08, base0E, base05 at 60 fps. spicetify-nix with the Comfy theme, 'Sunset' scheme and adblock/shuffle/keyboardShortcut/copyLyrics extensions. A Firefox userChrome/userContent variable bridge from Stylix, plus Betterfox and policies. qutebrowser with Stylix colors and a greasemonkey ad skipper. The Helium browser is the default. rmpc/rmpd for music, euphonica, easyeffects, mpv, Thunderbird with Catppuccin. Screenshots: grim, slurp and satty (Mod+Ctrl+P). Screen recording: wf-recorder with h264_vaapi. hyprpicker as a color picker. wlsunset at 3800K (Mod+F9/F10). cliphist. KeePassXC over an rclone mount. agenix secrets. pihole and StevenBlack hosts. btop with ROCm/CUDA and the Stylix theme. batterynotify, mediactrl and autoclicker scripts.

standout_features: The whole Niri config is written in Nix and serialized by BirdeeHub's nix-wrapper-modules (inputs.wrapper-modules.wrappers.niri.wrap), with no KDL. 'nix flake check' validates the generated compositor config.

Typed option layer. systemSettings in modules/core/settings.nix uses enums (bar: DMS|noctalia, terminal: foot|kitty, editor, browser, shell, videoDriver, clock24h, kbdLayout). It is translated into a per-user homeSettings submodule, so one switch swaps the whole desktop shell, its niri binds, the bar restart target and the layer-rule namespaces (^dms:.* vs ^noctalia:.*).

A Stylix base16 to Material 3 token bridge. Nix generates DankMaterialShell/themes/gruvbox/theme.json from config.lib.stylix.colors (primary=base0A, surface=base00, surfaceContainerHigh=base03, outline=base04, error=base08, info=base0D). DMS is then pinned to currentThemeName='custom' with dynamicTheming=false.

A declarative DMS 'island' bar: centered floating satellites with an islandHomeLayout of media, clock, weather, status, volume, brightness and notifications. Transparency 0.75, radius 16, satellite gap 4.

Two small hand-made Quickshell overlays: an app launcher that scans Nix and Flatpak .desktop dirs with FolderListModel plus XHR and includes power actions, and a searchable keybinding cheat-sheet (Mod+K) with category pills and accent key badges.

A hybrid video/static wallpaper pipeline. The waypaper post_command calls niri-wallpaper, which picks mpvpaper for videos or awww with a grow transition for images and caches the last choice. Niri's place-within-backdrop layer rule puts the wallpaper behind the overview.
Per-app opacity tiers (0.70 / 0.80 / 0.85 / 1.0) with niri background-effect blur and 12px clipped window corners.
gruvbox-wall, an ImageMagick recolor script (matte levels, warm gamma shift, a 26/74 duotone blend from #1d2021 to #ebdbb2, saturation cut to 84%) that forces any wallpaper into the palette.
SilentSDDM login with a video background and a declarative per-user avatar.

Stylix colors are pushed into apps Stylix does not theme itself: fastfetch key colors, the cava gradient, the yazi theme, the starship prompt, FZF options, qutebrowser and Firefox userChrome variables.
structure_install: Layout: flake.nix uses flake-parts with imports = [ (import-tree ./flake-modules) ]. flake-modules/hosts.nix defines nixosConfigurations.laptop and .desktop, both built from hosts/common.nix plus hosts/<host>. flake-modules/overlays.nix provides pkgs.stable and a Helium ozone wrapper. flake-modules/devshell.nix has rust and python shells. hosts/common.nix imports modules/core/settings.nix, modules/nixos/desktop/{niri,sddm}.nix and import-tree of modules/nixos/{core,hardware,services}. modules/nixos/desktop/niri.nix always imports both _niri/dms_niri.nix and _niri/noctalia_niri.nix, and each one gates itself with mkIf on systemSettings.bar. The underscore prefix keeps _niri out of import-tree auto-discovery. Home Manager runs as a NixOS module (modules/nixos/core/users.nix) with sharedModules = import-tree ../../home and useGlobalPkgs=false because of Stylix. modules/packages holds callPackage'd scripts (niri wrapper, niri-scripts/*.nix as writeShellApplication). modules/data holds raw data (niri settings attrset, browser policies, fastfetch logo). secrets/*.age uses agenix. Install steps: NixOS must already be installed. Run 'git clone https://codeberg.org/annmaro/nixri.git ~/nixri', replace hosts/<host>/hardware-configuration.nix, edit modules/core/settings.nix, then 'sudo nixos-rebuild switch --flake .#laptop' (or #desktop), and use 'nh os switch --hostname <HOST>' afterwards. Agenix needs ~/.config/agenix/key.txt, so a stranger has to strip the agenix module and its secrets before a build will succeed. There is no Arch or non-NixOS path at all. Only x86_64-linux is supported.
nix_patterns: flake-parts mkFlake with vic/import-tree auto-discovering ./flake-modules. import-tree is also used for modules/nixos/{core,hardware,services} and modules/home. The _niri directory is excluded from auto-discovery by its underscore prefix and imported explicitly.

Custom typed options module options.systemSettings (mkOption with types.enum/str/bool) plus a per-user options.homeSettings submodule, bridged in users.nix (homeSettings.terminal = config.systemSettings.terminal, and so on).
Home Manager as a NixOS module with home-manager.sharedModules (so extra users are reproducible), extraSpecialArgs { inputs; systemSettings }, and useGlobalPkgs=false because of Stylix's overlays.

Niri packaged as a wrapped derivation: pkgs.callPackage ../../packages/niri.nix { bar = "DMS"; } wraps sodiboo niri-unstable through BirdeeHub nix-wrapper-modules. programs.niri.package = wrappedNiri. The HM niri module is imported only for its schema, with programs.niri.config = null.

Stylix as a Home Manager module (inputs.stylix.homeModules.stylix + inputs.niri.homeModules.stylix) with base16Scheme from pkgs.base16-schemes, and selective targets.<app>.enable = false where the config themes the app by hand through config.lib.stylix.colors.
Profile switching by importing both profiles unconditionally and gating each with lib.mkIf (config.systemSettings.bar == ...), so module discovery never depends on option values.
Scripts packaged as pkgs.writeShellApplication with runtimeInputs (wallpaper, screen-record, screenshot, batterynotify, mediactrl, gruvbox-wall), sometimes with excludeShellChecks.
App configs written as generated text: xdg.configFile."...".text = builtins.toJSON {...} for DMS settings.json (force = true), and inline QML strings for the Quickshell overlays.
agenix HM module (age.secrets with custom path and mode, identityPaths), plus home.sessionVariablesExtra to export API keys.

Other inputs: nix-flatpak, disko (input only), nixvirt, nix-index-database, spicetify-nix, silentSDDM nixosModule, stevenblack-hosts nixosModule, noctalia nixosModules plus homeModules, and a pkgs.stable overlay pinned to nixos-25.11.

key_snippets.purpose: Niri geometry and blur, plus the layer rules that put the wallpaper inside the overview backdrop
Maps the Stylix base16 palette to DankMaterialShell Material tokens, written out as theme.json
Declarative DMS island bar with satellite pills (the most visually distinctive piece)
ImageMagick recipe that recolors any wallpaper to fit the palette (can be adapted to pastel endpoints)
key_snippets.excerpt:
# 1. Lift deep blacks and soften blown-out whites (matte curve).
      # 2. Shift temperature: boost Red/Green midtones, reduce cold Blues.
      # 3. Blend a Gruvbox luminance duotone map (#1d2021 -> #ebdbb2) over the original.
      # 4. Slightly mute digital saturation (84%) while preserving luminance.
      magick "$INPUT_IMG" \
        +level 4%,96% \
        -channel R -gamma 1.05 +channel \
        -channel B -gamma 0.90 +channel \
        \( +clone +level-colors "#1d2021,#ebdbb2" \) \
        -compose blend -define compose:args=26,74 -composite \
        -modulate 98,84,100 \
        "$OUTPUT_IMG"

key_snippets.purpose: Video branch of the hybrid wallpaper switcher (images go to awww with a grow transition: 1.2s, 120fps, centered)
key_snippets.excerpt:
case "$TARGET_WALL" in
      *.mp4|*.webm|*.mkv|*.mov)
        if [ ! -f "$TARGET_WALL" ]; then
          echo "Error: video wallpaper '$TARGET_WALL' does not exist." >&2
          exit 1
        fi
        awww kill 2>/dev/null || pkill -x awww-daemon 2>/dev/null || true
        pkill -x mpvpaper 2>/dev/null || true
        printf '%s\n' "$TARGET_WALL" > "$LAST_WALL"
        # Keep mpvpaper on the normal background layer. Niri's layer rule
        # places that surface behind windows and inside the overview backdrop.
        mpvpaper \
          --fork \
          --layer background \
          -o 'no-audio --loop-file=inf --cache=no --demuxer-readahead-secs=1 --hwdec=auto' \
          ALL "$TARGET_WALL" >"$CACHE_DIR/mpvpaper.log" 2>&1
        ;;

key_snippets.purpose: Bug example: monitors power off at 420s, before the 600s lock, even though the comment says 2 minutes after locking. It also calls unwrapped pkgs.niri.

weaknesses: Wrong fit for the brief. It is Niri, not Hyprland, and NixOS-only with no Arch path. The theme is earthy Gruvbox Material, not pastel or cute. The README's Catppuccin-pastel badges are misleading about the actual look.

Hardcoded personal values: username default 'annmaro' and a real git email in modules/core/settings.nix; the alias dots = "cd /home/annmaro/nixri"; nrs/dr/nhb/nhu aliases pinned to '.#laptop' and '--hostname laptop'; weather 'Jharkhand, India' at 23.63,85.52 in a home.activation jq script; monitor 'desc:BOE 0x0690' at 1920x1080@60.014; launcher and keybinds paths built as /home/${username}/.config/...; the screen recorder hardcodes -c h264_vaapi -d /dev/dri/renderD128, which breaks on NVIDIA.
Idle ordering bug. swayidle powers off monitors at 420s, before the 600s lock, and the comment claims the opposite. It also uses ${pkgs.niri} instead of the wrapped niri package.
The keybind cheat-sheet is maintained by hand and has already drifted. It says 'Mod + Return: Open Ghostty terminal', but the bind spawns thunar. It should be generated from the commonBinds attrset.

The QML launcher and keybind overlays hardcode Gruvbox hex values (#d8a657, #d4be98, #3c3836...) instead of reading Stylix, so they break the single-source palette. The launcher also does synchronous XHR file reads (needs QML_XHR_ALLOW_FILE_READ=1), has no icons and no fuzzy matching.

Leftovers from Hyprland dotfiles: screenshot.nix uses grimblast, which depends on hyprctl and is dead or broken on niri. mediactrl points at ~/.config/hypr/icons/music.png. batterynotify appears to be adapted from HyDE/hyprdots' batterynotify.sh (GPL-3.0), and this MIT repo has no attribution. I did not verify that provenance.

Stale or wrong comments: 'Let Stylix handle your Bibata cursor' above a Catppuccin Mocha Mauve cursor, and Firefox userChrome comments saying 'Absolute Black' and 'Catppuccin Mocha Mauve Accent' on Gruvbox slots. The Catppuccin mauve cursor clashes with Gruvbox.
Cargo-cult environment variables in the niri config: WLR_RENDERER_ALLOW_SOFTWARE=1 (niri is not wlroots), NIXPKGS_ALLOW_UNFREE=1 in the compositor env, and DMS_DISABLE_MATUGEN="0".
Startup ordering relies on 'sleep 1 && ...' and 'sleep 2 && thunar --daemon' in spawn-sh-at-startup instead of systemd user units.
Imperative state edits. home.activation mutates DMS session.json with jq, and settings.json uses force = true, which silently overwrites anything the user changes in the GUI.
The qutebrowser config has duplicate settings (zoom.default 140 and then 125, user_agent set twice) and spoofs a Chrome 124 user agent.
yazi settings use the 'manager' section and 'keymap.manager'. Yazi 25.x renamed this to 'mgr', so it is likely deprecated. I did not verify this against the current Yazi version in-session.
Agenix identity path mismatch: the module uses ~/.config/agenix/key.txt but the 'age' alias uses keys.txt. The secrets make the flake unbuildable for anyone else until the agenix modules are removed.
Security smells: the user is in the 'disk' group (raw block device access) and users.mutableUsers = true.
Bundled 8.3 MB assets/output.mp4 video wallpaper with no source or license attribution. It is reused as the SDDM background (the 'silvia' copy is made via runCommand cp).
No animation tuning (no niri animations block, no curves), no Plymouth or bootloader theme, and no custom notification styling beyond DMS defaults.

Commit hygiene is poor. Messages are like 'updated config', 'iupdated the hit colors', 'corrected the bakgroud image error'. Only x86_64-linux, and the desktop hardware-configuration is a placeholder.
steal_list: Palette to shell-token bridge. Generate a Material-token theme.json (primary, surface, surfaceContainer*, outline, error, info, warning) from a single base16/pastel palette in Nix. On Arch, generate the same token file from a matugen or wallust template so DMS, Noctalia or a custom Quickshell shell gets the same names on both distros.

Typed 'systemSettings' options with enums for bar, terminal, shell, editor and GPU, translated into per-user homeSettings. Import every profile and gate each with mkIf so one option swaps the whole shell stack.

Declarative island or satellite bar (DMS barConfigs with island = true, islandTransparency 0.75, islandCornerRadius 16, satellite gap 4) as the pill-bar baseline. Keep settings.json generated from Nix or chezmoi so it stays identical on Arch and NixOS.

Per-app opacity tiers with blur (terminals 0.80, media and file managers 0.70, editors and chat 0.85, browsers and video 1.0). In Hyprland, express these as windowrule opacity plus layerrule blur and ignorealpha.

Hybrid wallpaper script: mpvpaper for video with 'no-audio --loop-file=inf --hwdec=auto', awww (swww) for images with a grow transition (--transition-duration 1.2 --transition-fps 120, centered), a cached last_wallpaper, and waypaper's post_command as the single entry point. Extend it to also trigger matugen or wallust for dynamic pastel palettes.
A duotone recolor script like gruvbox-wall, retargeted to pastel endpoints (for example Catppuccin Latte/Mocha base and text colors) so any wallpaper fits the rice.
A searchable Quickshell keybind cheat-sheet overlay with category pills and accent key badges, but generated from the keybind data source instead of kept by hand.

The Quickshell launcher's desktop-entry discovery list: /run/current-system/sw/share/applications, ~/.nix-profile, /etc/profiles/per-user/$USER, ~/.local/share/applications and both Flatpak exports dirs. Add /usr/share/applications for Arch.

Theme apps Stylix does not cover by feeding them palette variables: a cava 8-stop gradient, fastfetch per-key colors with a sixel logo, a starship '❯' prompt colored by palette slots, FZF_DEFAULT_OPTS, a yazi theme, and Firefox userChrome --uc-* variables.

SilentSDDM with a video background and declarative per-user avatar (programs.silentSDDM.backgrounds / profileIcons). It is a cheap way to get a polished login on NixOS; on Arch install the same theme from AUR or git.

swaylock-effects 'screenshots + effect-blur 7x5 + effect-vignette 0.5:0.5 + indicator-radius 100' as a lightweight lock fallback. Fix the idle ordering: lock first, then turn displays off, then suspend.

Put niri-style wallpaper layers in the backdrop (place-within-backdrop for the awww-daemon and mpvpaper namespaces) so the overview shows a blurred wallpaper. The equivalent idea in Hyprland is blurring the wallpaper behind overview or expo plugins.

repo: https://github.com/librephoenix/nixos-config (GitHub mirror; primary is gitlab.com/librephoenix/nixos-config, another mirror on codeberg)
one_line: Emmet's (LibrePhoenix) multi-host NixOS flake: a Stylix/base16-driven Hyprland setup with more than 55 hot-switchable themes stored as plain Nix attrsets, each with its own wallpaper URL and sha256. The look is flat and square: 0 rounding, 0 border, heavy blur and translucency. The bar is a patched ashell, with fuzzel/nwggrid as launchers, fnott for notifications, and hyprlock/hypridle for locking and idle. The more interesting parts are the workflow scripts: hyprprofiles, hyprgamemode, a global performance toggle, and special-workspace scratchpads.
freshness: Still active but slows down in places. The newest flake.lock input has lastModified 1766826803, about 2025-12-27. Hyprland is pinned to github:hyprwm/Hyprland/v0.52.2 and hyprlock to v0.9.2. nixpkgs-stable is 25.11 and nixpkgs is nixos-unstable. The GitHub page shows about 1,000 stars, 66 forks, 1,248 commits, GPL-3.0, not archived. I could not verify the exact latest commit date: the GitLab commits page did not render and I made only one API call. The old auto-install script was removed ('wasn't really stable'). phoenix-system-builder is marked '# FIXME this thing doesn't work at all'.
